cards.name: Zephyr Vitesse
cards.description: Hector's old friend. He rushes like a gale-force wind to mark his opponents.
cards.description_es: Es un viejo amigo de Hector. Es rápido como el viento a la hora de marcar al adversario.

cards.name: Zohen
cards.description: Blocks the goalmouth with the huge frame he bulked up through martial arts.
cards.description_es: Domina las artes marciales y corta el paso a cualquiera con su cuerpo.

cards.name: Axel Blaze
cards.description: Beneath his cool exterior burns an intense and fiery passion for football.
cards.description_es: Tras su aspecto frío se esconde una pasión sin límites por el fútbol.

cards.name: Basile Hardy
cards.description: The team's only city kid, cool and detached, but relentless in his drive to improve.
cards.description_es: Es el único chico de ciudad del equipo. Es algo pasota pero guay, y siempre busca seguir mejorando.

cards.name: Biggsy
cards.description: A dupli of Fei's with muscles of steel. His broad chest can stop any ball.
cards.description_es: Este duplicado de Fei tiene músculos de acero y para tiros con el pecho.

cards.name: Byron Love
cards.description: Captivating the opposition with artistic grace, he plays with the aura of a deity from on high.
cards.description_es: Embelesa a rivales con un toque de balón cercano al arte más bello.

cards.name: Caleb Stonewall
cards.description: Cunning and ruthless, he plays with fierce sincerity and exploits any weakness he spots—arrogance included.

cards.name: Changsu Choi
cards.description: A natural-born playmaker whose sharp control may even rival Jude.
cards.description_es: Un organizador de juego nato que detesta perder contra Jude.

cards.name: Daisy Fields
cards.description: She's the national girl's sumo champ, but is actually a bit of a cry-baby.
cards.description_es: Es la campeona nacional de sumo. Es un poco llorona.

cards.name: Dasan
cards.description: With his superhuman speed, this striker moves like a bat out of hell.
cards.description_es: La velocidad de este delantero es temida entre sus rivales.

cards.name: David Samford
cards.description: A striker with a deadly shot arsenal and Jude's ever-reliable right hand.
cards.description_es: Delantero con un tiro imparable. Suele ser la mano derecha de Jude.

cards.name: Elliot Ember
cards.description: This player's maniacal grin will surely bring on the chills. He overwhelms the opposition with a hyper-aggressive playstyle.
cards.description_es: La sonrisa demente de este jugador pone los vellos de punta. Agobia al rival con un estilo de juego hiperagresivo.

cards.name: Fei Rune
cards.description: A young boy who adores football. In the depths of his piercing eyes burns true passion.
cards.description_es: Viajó 200 años desde el futuro para ayudar a Arion a proteger el fútbol.

cards.name: Fei Rune
cards.description: Fei and the Tyrannosaurus Rex's miximaxed form. A strong forward!
cards.description_es: El Miximax Trans de Fei y el tiranosaurio. ¡Un delantero de aúpa!

cards.name: Foxtrot
cards.description: A cool midfielder. Wears dark glasses to avoid betraying his emotions.
cards.description_es: Este centrocampista lleva gafas de sol para ocultar sus emociones.

cards.name: Gentian
cards.description: Aster's dupli forward. He has an oddly wide knowledge of herbal medicine.
cards.description_es: Delantero y duplicado de Aster. Tiene amplios conocimientos de herbolaria.

cards.name: Hairy
cards.description: A cool and withdrawn dupli of Fei's who has no shortage of admirers.
cards.description_es: Esta reservada chica es un duplicado de Fei. No le faltan admiradores.

cards.name: Hector Helio
cards.description: A Victoirean boy from out in the sticks. It's already clear that he has incredible potential.
cards.description_es: Procede de una remota región llamada Costail y tiene un potencial enorme.

cards.name: Hotel
cards.description: A keystone in his team who defends the goal with his brains and tenacity.
cards.description_es: Este portero es una pieza clave del equipo por su astucia y tenacidad.

cards.name: Ian C. Wincy
cards.description: Physically, he was weak till Zoolan Rice turbocharged him. Now he's built like a tank.
cards.description_es: El físico de este jugador no era gran cosa. Sin embargo, Zoolan supo ponerle remedio.

cards.name: Janus
cards.description: Though known for his cold nature among his peers from Alius Academy, beneath the facade actually lies an affectionate personality.
cards.description_es: Ya no se hace llamar Janus, pero le siguen gustando los refranes.

cards.name: Janus
cards.description: A former Inazuma National midfielder. Currently Xavier Schiller's secretary.
cards.description_es: Antiguo medio del Inazuma Japón. Es secretario de Xavier Schiller.

cards.name: Jean-Pierre Lapin
cards.description: He's not the biggest player, but he might be the most energetic! An optimistic young boy who's always ready when you are.
cards.description_es: Jugador pequeño de cuerpo, ¡pero desbordante de energía y entusiasmo!

cards.name: Jean-Pierre Lapin
cards.description: He's not the biggest player, but he might be the most energetic! An optimistic young boy who's always ready when you are.
cards.description_es: Un chico lleno de energía que ahora defiende la portería del Raimon.

cards.name: Jean-Pierre Lapin
cards.description_es: Un chico lleno de energía que ahora defiende la portería del Raimon.

cards.name: John Neville
cards.description: People think he looks like a wimp until they see him with a ball.
cards.description_es: Parece pusilánime, pero al mirar el balón le cambia el semblante.

cards.name: Joseph King
cards.description: The King of Keepers. There is no angle that he can not cover.

cards.name: Jude Sharp
cards.description: Royal Academy's supreme commander and manager. Still as sharp as ever.
cards.description_es: El entrenador de la Royal Academy no ha perdido su dominio de la táctica.

cards.name: Jynx Jenkins
cards.description: He has an ominous aura. Not even his teammates are sure of his past.
cards.description_es: Tiene un aire siniestro. Ni siquiera sus compañeros conocen su pasado.

cards.name: Lephiel
cards.description: This odd, slippery character has obtained the power of the heavens.
cards.description_es: Un jugador extraño y escurridizo que ha obtenido poderes celestiales.

cards.name: Magnol
cards.description: Aster's dupli defender. Despite his looks, he's actually quite pleasant.
cards.description_es: Defensa y duplicado de Aster. Es muy majo a pesar de su aspecto agresivo.

cards.name: Navan
cards.description: A striker of incredible talent. When he plays, the pitch becomes a battlefield.
cards.description_es: Un delantero de gran talento que sale al campo con la furia de un guerrero.

cards.name: Nelly Evans
cards.description: Previously a Raimon coordinator, she's now the chairwoman of the school.
cards.description_es: Tiene carácter, aunque su padre dice que a veces es un poco llorona.

cards.name: Njord Snio
cards.description: The hottest striker of the north, scouted out by Shawn Froste.
cards.description_es: El delantero más destacado del norte, descubierto por Shawn Froste.

cards.name: Rex Remington
cards.description: Never loud or violent, but opponents feel intimidated by his fierce gaze.
cards.description_es: No necesita gritos ni fuerza para intimidar. Con la mirada le basta.

cards.name: Riccardo Di Rigo
cards.description: Riccardo Di and Nobunaga's miximaxed form is the ultimate gamemaker!
cards.description_es: El Miximax Trans de Riccardo y Nobunaga. ¡El estratega definitivo!

cards.name: Scott Banyan
cards.description_es: Personalidad falsa Es muy travieso. Su pequeño cuerpo esconde una fuerza impresionante.

cards.name: Scott Banyan
cards.description: A former Inazuma National defender. Now works for a top business.
cards.description_es: Un bromista empedernido. Parece poca cosa, pero tiene mucha fuerza.

cards.name: Shawn Froste
cards.description: Formerly known as the Bear Killer. His calm temperament belies a powerful playstyle.
cards.description_es: La estrella del Instituto Alpino. Como defensa es invencible.

cards.name: Taian Inaba
cards.description: Gang leader of the White Deer. A ruthless man who'd steal from a child.
cards.description_es: El líder del Ciervo Blanco es un tipo cruel, capaz de robarle a un niño.

cards.name: Tom Walters
cards.description: A wild child who grew up catching and cooking his own roast chicken.
cards.description_es: Mozo salvaje que caza pájaros y se los come como si fueran pollo frito.

cards.name: Tulip
cards.description: Aster's dupli warrior queen. She never fails to do her daily workout.
cards.description_es: Duplicado de Aster y temible guerrera que nunca se salta el entrenamiento.

cards.name: Tyler Murdock
cards.description: Youngest of three. Looks up to his brothers and works twice as hard to catch up.
cards.description_es: Admira a sus dos hermanos mayores y se entrena para ser como ellos.

cards.name: Tyrah
cards.description: A vicious defender whose shrill laugh gives her opponents nightmares.
cards.description_es: Una defensa implacable cuya risa estridente provoca pesadillas.

cards.name: Victor Blade
cards.description: Young Victor, who loved playing with his brother Vladimir. Even back then, he already admired football players.
cards.description_es: La habilidad del delantero estrella del Raimon no tiene parangón.

cards.name: Xene
cards.description: There was a time when he went by "Xene" and led Alius Academy. His shots rip through the air like comets.
cards.description_es: Antiguo rival del Raimon y ahora aliado. Sus tiros perecen cometas.

cards.name: Aitor Cazador
cards.description: A young boy with superb body balance. He has his highs and lows, but is a good kid at heart.
cards.description_es: Un defensa con un equilibrio superior que a veces parece algo borde.

cards.name: Aitor Cazador
cards.description: The Miximax of Gabriel and Aitor. It looks like they make a good match!

cards.name: Albert Green
cards.description: Loves pickles and gets cranky if he can't eat them at every meal.
cards.description_es: Le chiflan los encurtidos. Si para de comer no hay, pone mala cara.

cards.name: Ar Ecks
cards.description: The captain of Perfect Cascade, he is completely loyal to Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: El capitán del Cascada Perfecta no cuestiona órdenes de Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Ar Ecks
cards.description: Perfect Cascade's captain is actually an android built by Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: El capitán del Cascada Perfecta no cuestiona órdenes de Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Archer Hawkins
cards.description: Runs Rai Rai Noodles' second branch, where he's known as Archie the Noodle Master.
cards.description_es: Un chico con un pasado misterioso. Lo llaman "Archie el Coces".

cards.name: Arion Sherwind
cards.description: An innocent young boy who adores football. A player as pleasant as a breath of fresh air.
cards.description_es: El capitán del Raimon es un chico sencillo y puro como la brisa.

cards.name: Arion Sherwind
cards.description_es: Un chico sencillo y puro como la brisa. Nunca se rinde ante los problemas.

cards.name: Baller
cards.description: She loves trinkets and will go to any lengths to get the ones she wants.
cards.description_es: Cuando quiere algo, hace cualquier cosa con tal de conseguirlo.

cards.name: Bump Trungus
cards.description: Younger twin with a - mark on his forehead, known for his monosyllabic grunts.
cards.description_es: ¡Bumpa, bumpa, bump!

cards.name: Caleb Stonewall
cards.description: He likes to boast, but does have the skill to back it up. He makes playthings of others with his trick plays.
cards.description_es: Un chico rebelde al que le gusta alardear ante sus oponentes.

cards.name: Canon Evans
cards.description: Mark's great-grandson, a fiery kid from eighty years in the future. Born to love football.
cards.description_es: Chico entusiasta que ama el fútbol. ¿Será el bisnieto de Mark?

cards.name: Clear
cards.description: Wears a faint smile as she utters harsh remarks. Many like that about her, though.
cards.description_es: Habla con frialdad mientras sonríe. A muchos les gusta que lo haga.

cards.name: Dolph Hensen
cards.description: A noble son of the majestic sea, and the captain of the Australian squad.
cards.description_es: Este joven de la costa es la punta de lanza y capitán del equipo australiano.

cards.name: Droll
cards.description: His feelings are written all over his face. His solution? To wear a mask at all times.
cards.description_es: Lleva máscara porque enseguida se le ve en la cara lo que piensa.

cards.name: Dvalin
cards.description: Grows displeased when things don't go precisely as planned.
cards.description_es: Futbolista que presume de su técnica Lanza de Odín. Antes se hacía llamar Dvalin.

cards.name: Escavan Malice
cards.description: He's so hot-blooded, if a chance on goal is stolen from him, he flies into a rage.
cards.description_es: Es tan temperamental que monta en cólera si pierde la ocasión de marcar.

cards.name: Gabriel Garcia
cards.description: The Miximax of Gabriel and Aitor. It looks like they make a good match!

cards.name: Herb Sherman
cards.description: Who needs a mobile? His family just got a fine rotary-dial house phone.
cards.description_es: En su casa no usan teléfono móvil porque nadie parece necesitarlo.

cards.name: Hernán Tévez
cards.description: Despite his young age, he helps out at the local radio station, covering football matches.
cards.description_es: A pesar de su corta edad, es comentarista de fútbol en la emisora local de radio.

cards.name: Hurley Kane
cards.description: Adult or not, there's no wave that this surfer dude won't ride!
cards.description_es: Cuando se trata de pillar olas, a este surfero no le pesan los años.

cards.name: Icer
cards.description: Arkew's little sister. She uses her brother's calculations to play football with greater accuracy.
cards.description_es: Hermana de Arkew. Juega tal y como su hermano le dice que lo haga.

cards.name: Jimi Gaines
cards.description: He wears sunglasses to try to stand out, but they make him look a bit creepy.
cards.description_es: Lleva gafas de sol para pasar desapercibido. Sin embargo, le dan un aspecto siniestro...

cards.name: Jimmy Kyrk
cards.description: Always very polite, but never stands up to authority and can be heartless.
cards.description_es: El capitán del Colegio Tengawara tiene una personalidad educada. Siempre lleva una cinta en la cabeza debido a su pelo rizado.

cards.name: Joseph King
cards.description: The King of Keepers. There is no angle that he can not cover.
cards.description_es: Le llaman "el rey de los porteros". No deja ningún hueco sin cubrir.

cards.name: Joseph King
cards.description: The King of Keepers. There is no angle that he can not cover.
cards.description_es: Le llaman "el rey de los porteros". No deja ningún hueco sin cubrir.

cards.name: Kilo
cards.description: A veritable wall of a lad. Many get knocked out when running into him.
cards.description_es: Es tan robusto que muchos de sus rivales no resisten colisiones con él.

cards.name: Kilo
cards.description: Miximaxed with Zanark, he whips the ball from his opponents with a smile.
cards.description_es: Tras el Miximax con Zanark, roba balones con una sonrisa perenne.

cards.name: Krypto
cards.description_es: Se mueve tan rápido que simula ser varias personas y no una.

cards.name: Lucian Dark
cards.description: An earnest and positive boy. Though a beginner, he has great natural skill.
cards.description_es: Un chico serio y optimista, con mucha intuición pese a ser un novato.

cards.name: Mercury
cards.description_es: A consecuencia de su mejora, ahora puede liberar energía llena de ira.

cards.name: Neith Venus
cards.description: His beautiful technique entrances onlookers, and at times even himself.
cards.description_es: Su depurada técnica encandila a los que la ven, incluso a veces a él mismo.

cards.name: Nenel
cards.description: This heavenly player need only close his eyes to see the truth.
cards.description_es: Este jugador celestial puede ver la verdad con solo cerrar los ojos.

cards.name: November
cards.description: A midfielder with a wiry body like a spring. Good friends with Beta.

cards.name: November
cards.description: Miximaxed with Zanark, her supple movements are fortified with strength.

cards.name: Quint Hampton
cards.description: He thought he'd try a perm, but he still doesn't make much of an impression.
cards.description_es: Pensó en hacerse la permanente, pero vio que no causaría mucha impresión.

cards.name: Ringo Saturn
cards.description: His saving skills are superb, and his loud voice keeps his team's spirits up.
cards.description_es: Su habilidad en la portería y su voz potente dan gran seguridad al equipo.

cards.name: Ryoma Nishiki
cards.description: A chivalrous boy with a strong moral compass. Spent some time in Italy.
cards.description_es: Caballeroso y con un gran sentido de la justicia. Vivió un tiempo en Italia.

cards.name: Ryoma Nishiki
cards.description: A chivalrous boy with a strong moral compass. Spent some time in Italy.
cards.description_es: Era delantero, pero volvió de Italia convertido en centrocampista.

cards.name: Seymour Hillman
cards.description: Although he's the proprietor of a ramen place now, he was once crucial to Inazuma Eleven.
cards.description_es: Ama el fútbol. Su hobby es invitar a sus amigos a comer fideos chinos.

cards.name: Skinny
cards.description: This dupli of Fei's is always chewing on a straw. He keeps a supply of them.
cards.description_es: Este duplicado de Fei se pasa el día masticando una pajita.

cards.name: Smiley
cards.description: A dupli of Fei's whose cheery grin keeps morale high in the team.
cards.description_es: Un duplicado de Fei que siempre hace sonreír al resto del equipo.

cards.name: Tasuke
cards.description: A keen kemari player from Owari. Son of a tofu-maker and Katsu's brother.
cards.description_es: Hermano de Katsu y jugador de kemari de Owari. Su familia hace tofu.

cards.name: Victor Blade
cards.description: A dark side striker whose incredible talents overwhelm all who witness them.
cards.description_es: Un siniestro delantero capaz de derrotar él solo a un equipo entero.

cards.name: Victoria Vanguard
cards.description: The only daughter of Stewart Vanguard. She is a strong-willed player with a boyish exuberance.
cards.description_es: La torre de control del equipo. Con ella al mando, la velocidad de resolución de incidentes se triplica.

cards.name: Victoria Vanguard
cards.description: Prime Minister Vanguard's daughter. From rebel firebrand to elegant lady.
cards.description_es: La única hija del Primer ministro Sosuke Zaizen. Es tan femenina a diferencia de hace 10 años.

cards.name: Zell
cards.description_es: Tiene aún más confianza en su juego y le discute hasta al árbitro.

cards.name: Acker Reese
cards.description: Always calm under pressure, this strategist is the glue that holds the team together.
cards.description_es: Todo un estratega que siempre mantiene la calma. Es el pegamento que mantiene unido al equipo.

cards.name: Aiden Froste
cards.description: Though he's Shawn's younger brother, Alpine's ace striker plays with a calculating mind all his own.
cards.description_es: El Hermano menor de Shiro Fubuki y delantero estrella del Hakuren. Su personalidad y estilo de juego parecen ser exactamente opuestos a los de su hermano, pero también puede ser sorprendentemente calculador y tranquilo.

cards.name: Aitor Cazador
cards.description: A young boy with superb body balance. He has his highs and lows, but is a good kid at heart.
cards.description_es: Recién llegado al club. Tiene una cara amable, pero también un lado oscuro.

cards.name: Ali Caiman
cards.description: This player's unpolished ball skills were improved by Zoolan Rice.
cards.description_es: Con la ayuda de Zoolan, este jugador perfeccionó sus habilidades.

cards.name: Anton Graziuso
cards.description: This plucky chap hopes to join the police and take on the criminal underworld.
cards.description_es: Quiere ser policía para acabar con la delincuencia.

cards.name: Arion Sherwind
cards.description: An innocent young boy who adores football. A player as pleasant as a breath of fresh air.
cards.description_es: Un chico sencillo y puro como la brisa. Apasionado por el fútbol como pocos.

cards.name: Arion Sherwind
cards.description: An innocent young boy who adores football. A player as pleasant as a breath of fresh air.
cards.description_es: El capitán del Raimon es un chico sencillo y puro como la brisa.

cards.name: Arion Sherwind
cards.description: When he was a young boy, Arion started playing football after being saved by Axel on a beach in Okinawa.
cards.description_es: Un chico sencillo y puro como la brisa. Apasionado por el fútbol como pocos.

cards.name: Axel Blaze
cards.description: Beneath his cool exterior burns an intense and fiery passion for football.

cards.name: Behemoth
cards.description: A player from the underworld. The size of his body matches his greed.
cards.description_es: Un jugador del inframundo. Es tan grande como avaricioso.

cards.name: Bilal Kalil
cards.description: A shadowy man who leads his team with a relentless energy.
cards.description_es: Un jugador que deja huella. Es incansable y tira del resto del equipo como capitán.

cards.name: Bobby Shearer
cards.description: Despite his somewhat frivolous nature, he has a warm heart and genuinely cares for his friends.
cards.description_es: No se toma las cosas en serio, pero tiene buen corazón.

cards.name: Bomber
cards.description: A player who radiates red-hot enthusiasm. He is exceptionally particular about his headband.
cards.description_es: Saca su potencia de las llamas. Le interesan las cintas de pelo.

cards.name: Byron Love
cards.description: Captivating the opposition with artistic grace, he plays with the aura of a deity from on high.
cards.description_es: El antiguo capitán del Zeus es ahora el entrenador del Kirkwood.

cards.name: Byron Love
cards.description: Raimon's defeat fueled him to refine his game into something sharp and almost artistic.

cards.name: Caleb Stonewall
cards.description: He likes to boast, but does have the skill to back it up. He makes playthings of others with his trick plays.

cards.name: Camellia Travis
cards.description: Manager Travis's daughter and childhood friend of Mark Evans, now a caring nurse at the hospital.
cards.description_es: Amiga de la infancia de Mark. Algo tímida, pero cariñosa.

cards.name: Celia Hills
cards.description: She serves as the advisor for the Raimon football team, always keeping a gentle, watchful eye on the players.
cards.description_es: Antigua gerente del Raimon. Ahora se ocupa de Arion y del equipo.

cards.name: David Samford
cards.description: He's been integral to the efforts to create a leaner, meaner Royal team.
cards.description_es: Esta formando un nuevo equipo al que le ha dedicado mucho tiempo.

cards.name: David Samford
cards.description: Once Jude's strategist, now Royal's captain, he leads with tactics backed by sheer force of will.

cards.name: Erik Eagle
cards.description: An all-rounder once lauded as a genius. A powerhouse up front and a wall in the back.
cards.description_es: Centrocampista excepcional. Le llaman "El mago del campo".

cards.name: Gabriel Garcia
cards.description: Riccardo Di and Gabi's Miximax. These good friends make a great combo!

cards.name: Gigi Blasi
cards.description: He's the best goalie in Italy, so you can count on his saves.
cards.description_es: El ángel de la guarda de Italia. ¡No hay un portero tan firme como él!

cards.name: Gus Martin
cards.description: His history and motives are unclear to all but himself.
cards.description_es: No se sabe de dónde ha salido, ni siquiera Jude.

cards.name: Heat
cards.description: Torch's childhood friend. He used to be a weakling, but training toughened him up.
cards.description_es: Amigo de la infancia de Torch. Se entrenó para ser mas fuerte.

cards.name: Indigo Lazuli
cards.description: He has a strong sense of right and wrong. He only joined Team D to save his own hide.
cards.description_es: Sabe lo que está bien y lo que está mal. Se unió al Equipo D solo por pura conveniencia.

cards.name: Infinity Beyond
cards.description: A striker with tremendous power. His kicks are like sharpened blades.
cards.description_es: Los disparos de este poderoso delantero son como hojas afiladas.

cards.name: Isabelle Trick
cards.description: Always calm and collected, she supports her lifelong friend Hunter with a steady hand.

cards.name: Jorge Ortega
cards.description: He's known for his aggressive style. His brutal tackles often lead to melees.
cards.description_es: Es famoso por practicar un juego agresivo. ¡Siempre se lía cuando salta al césped!

cards.name: Jude Sharp
cards.description_es: Un genio organizando el juego. El equipo lo sigue como a un líder.

cards.name: Jude Sharp
cards.description: A captain who guides his team to victory with precise instructions. He is an excellent player skilled at both techniques and tactics.

cards.name: Julio Acosta
cards.description: He has a fondness for yerba maté tea, and he always packs some when he plays away.

cards.name: Karl Kappa
cards.description: A cucumber-lover who just wanna play some splish-splash football!
cards.description_es: ¡Blub, blub! ¡Le encantan los pepinos y juega al fútbol chapoteando!

cards.name: Keenan DiFortune
cards.description: He's known Hector for a long time, and he really looks up to him.
cards.description_es: Conoce a Hector desde hace tiempo y siente una gran admiración por él.

cards.name: Kevin Dragonfly
cards.description: A hothead who cares deeply for his pals. He seems scary, but behind the scenes, he works incredibly hard.
cards.description_es: Su afán de superación impresiona, pero su cara... ¡todavía más!

cards.name: Lean
cards.description: "Nobody's allowed to be the strongest but me!" Her dream is to be the best footballer in the universe.
cards.description_es: Odia que otros la superen. Quiere ser la mejor del mundo.

cards.name: Malcolm Night
cards.description: Erik Eagle's friend from the States. Fastidious about his hairstyle.
cards.description_es: Como todos los grandes jugadores, lleva un peinado que da el cante.

cards.name: Mark Evans
cards.description: Has more passion for football than anyone else. His mighty heart will never give up, no matter what.
cards.description_es: Enérgico capitán del Raimon. Nadie vive el fútbol como él.

cards.name: Maximino Cruz
cards.description: He's rather fickle. His teammates worry that he'll get tired of football.
cards.description_es: Es un veleta. A sus compañeros de equipo les preocupa que un día se canse del fútbol.

cards.name: Metron
cards.description_es: Es aún más violento. Si el rival no cae en sus provocaciones, le ataca.

cards.name: Michael Ballzack
cards.description: His seemingly unconcerned attitude hides an intense passion for football.
cards.description_es: Su aparente frialdad oculta una enorme pasión por el fútbol.

cards.name: Michael Ballzack
cards.description: His seemingly unconcerned attitude hides an intense passion for football.
cards.description_es: Su aparente frialdad oculta una enorme pasión por el fútbol.

cards.name: Morgan Sanders

cards.name: Riccardo Di Rigo

cards.name: Sail Bluesea
cards.description: Top-tier ninja who sometimes forgets it's football and uses his hands.

cards.name: Sam Samurai

cards.name: Sergi Hernández
cards.description: Stronger than most, this captain carries the calm authority of a champion and underestimates no one.

cards.name: Sonny Wright

cards.name: Thomas Feldt
cards.description: Follows instructions well, but was left emotionless after his brainwashing.

cards.name: Viol
cards.description: Aster's dupli midfielder. Talk about a solid player—he's no pushover!

cards.name: Archer Hawkins

cards.name: Ark

cards.name: Arkew
cards.description: He starts studying the moment he wakes up. His IQ must be over a thousand by now.

cards.name: Arthur Sweet

cards.description: He hopes to be a model, but as yet he's still unrecognized in the fashion world.

cards.name: Borboleta Barboza
cards.description: He wants to look beyond the borders of Brazil and study the playing styles of other nations.

cards.name: Charles Island
cards.description: Rumor has it that this mysterious figure who lives by the riverbank is quite the big deal.
cards.description_es: Es popular con las chicas por su físico, pero a él eso le da igual.

cards.name: Charles Island
cards.description: His looks make him a hit with the ladies, but he's not all that fussed.

cards.description_es: Este chico es un recetario con patatas. Conoce infinidad de platos de pasta.

cards.name: Sepia Bartletti
cards.description: Got her passion for scuba-diving from her mother, who was a shell diver.
cards.description_es: Heredó de su madre, recolectora de conchas, su pasión por el buceo.

cards.name: Seymour Hillman
cards.description: Core member of the legendary Inazuma Eleven, and respected as both a teammate and manager.

cards.name: Shadow Cimmerian
cards.description: A soldier born out of darkness. The darkness has grown deeper...
cards.description_es: Caballero tenebroso que nació de la oscuridad más profunda.

cards.name: Shawn Froste
cards.description: The north's best striker is usually cool and calm until he's on the pitch...
cards.description_es: El Delantero estrella de las tierras del norte. Suele ser muy tranquilo.

cards.name: Shawn Froste
cards.description: Alpine's captain commands the pitch with icy precision, yet his flashy plays leave everyone spellbound.

cards.name: Steve Grim
cards.description: This jack-of-all-trades hopes the Alius crystal can make him a master of all.
cards.description_es: Cree que la Piedra Alius podrá ayudarle a ser más decidido.

cards.name: Sue Sparrow
cards.description: Royal Academy Redux's genius midfielder. Her game-changing techniques made her a regular.
cards.description_es: Centrocampista extraordinaria que juega en la Royal Academy Redux.

cards.name: Thomas Feldt
cards.description: He was a firm believer in fair play, but now he's focused only on winning.
cards.description_es: Antes siempre jugaba limpio, pero ahora solo piensa en ganar.

cards.name: Tod Ironside
cards.description: The Alius crystal drained him of all his chirpy cheerfulness.
cards.description_es: Antes era el que animaba al equipo, pero ha perdido la alegría.

cards.name: Tod Ironside
cards.description: Raimon's lovable class clown who never gets out-hustled on guts and grit.

cards.name: Trevor Cook
cards.description: A defender with legs honed by island life, known for his blazing speed on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Un defensa con unas piernas curtidas por su vida isleña. Famoso por su velocidad en el campo.

cards.name: Una Lightning
cards.description: The eldest of eleven and de facto leader. Incredibly precise when kicking a ball.

cards.name: Xavier Schiller
cards.description: Kicking a ball alone at the estate, he grew resentful of a father who never noticed him.
cards.description_es: El heredero de Grupo Kira, que patrocina a la Academia Eisei. Si bien es arrogante y hace las cosas a su manera, se dice que su abrumador juego individual se acerca al de un dios entre los delanteros.

cards.name: Yasir Haddad
cards.description: This player uses karate techniques to snatch away the ball! Hi-YAH!
cards.description_es: Es un gran karateka y utiliza las técnicas de ese arte marcial para robar el balón.

cards.name: Zack Avalon
cards.description: The eldest son of a prestigious kabuki family, he assumed the name Zack while still in middle school.
cards.description_es: Maestro en el teatro kabuki. Mark le convenció de unirse al equipo.

cards.name: Alexia Sand
cards.description: Her family of pro baseball fans are glued to the telly every game.
cards.description_es: Pertenece a la tercera generación de aficionados acérrimos al béisbol.

cards.name: Arion Sherwind
cards.description: Arion and Tezcat's miximaxed form combines strength and passion!
cards.description_es: El Miximax Trans de Arion y Tezcat combina fuerza y pasión.

cards.name: Artie Mishman
cards.description: Zeus's sweeper with arrow-like precision. His passes and shots land as if guided by fate.

cards.name: Auberon Ouranos
cards.description: His eagle eyes lead some to believe he has two more in the back of his head.
cards.description_es: Tiene una vista de lince que hace que no se le escape una.

cards.name: Azubel Turchese
cards.description: He's always trying to find a solution to the refuse problem in Naples.
cards.description_es: Quiere solucionar el problema de recogida de basura en Nápoles de una vez por todas.

cards.name: Bianco Perla
cards.description: He's never even seen a bottle of wine, but he still dreams of becoming a sommelier.
cards.description_es: Quiere ser sumiller aunque no ha probado ni un solo licor en su vida...

cards.name: Bobby Shearer
cards.description: Despite his somewhat frivolous nature, he has a warm heart and genuinely cares for his friends.

cards.name: Bunny Cottontail
cards.description: The bright-spirited heiress of Rabbit Food is new to football but gifted with remarkable athleticism.

cards.name: Cadence Soundtown
cards.description: Headphones on and always vibing. Walking, talking, or passing, he's got rhythm in his soul.
cards.description_es: Se pasa el día escuchando música, ¿Qué canciones le gustarán?

cards.name: Danny Wood
cards.description: Unleashes plays like a volcano, roaring down the pitch and shaking the opposition.

cards.name: Dave Coppfielder
cards.description: Uses astrology to predict events, but isn't great at split-second decisions.
cards.description_es: Confía en la astrología, pero no sabe tomar decisiones rápidas.

cards.name: Dave Inchy
cards.description: Can study the whole pitch in a second with his remarkable perceptive ability.
cards.description_es: De un solo vistazo percibe la posición de todos los jugadores en el campo.

cards.name: Dean Goddard
cards.description: He was no good at teamwork, but Zoolan Rice kicked him into touch.
cards.description_es: A este chico se le daba bien el trabajo en equipo y Zoolan le apretó la tuercas.

cards.name: Diego Oro
cards.description: This nutty player sets off fireworks in his bathroom at Christmas and new year.
cards.description_es: Este jugador está un poco chiflado: en Año Nuevo se dedica a tirar petardos en el baño.

cards.name: Eos Dawn
cards.description: Always washes his hands and feet before a match for good luck.
cards.description_es: Tiene la costumbre de lavarse las manos y pies para purificarse antes de jugar.

cards.name: Esteban Carlos
cards.description: He does altitude training in the Andes, so there's no escaping his tenacious plays.
cards.description_es: Entrena a gran altitud en los Andes. ¡No hay quien escape de sus jugadas!

cards.name: Esther Greenland
cards.description: A restaurant waitress who won't stand for any lip from rude customers.
cards.description_es: Es la camarera más solicitada de un restaurante de brochetas.

cards.name: Falcão Da Silva
cards.description: He trained his reflexes in the depths of the Amazon, and puts them to work on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Desarrolló sus reflejos en el corazón de la selva amazónica.

cards.name: Freddy McQueen
cards.description: A life of derring-do as a spy in MI6—that's this player's dream.
cards.description_es: Su mayor ilusión es ser espía para su país y llevar una vida llena de aventuras.

cards.name: Gabriel Garcia
cards.description: A player so striking in looks that some mistake him for a girl. He's close with Riccardo Di.
cards.description_es: El elegante defensa del Raimon. Conoce a Riccardo mejor que nadie.

specials.name: Joan of Arc, Riccardo Di, Aitor

cards.name: Hauser
cards.description: Utilizing his body's elasticity, he can strike from unexpected directions.
cards.description_es: Utiliza su flexibilidad par atacar por donde el rival no se lo espera.

cards.name: Hurley Kane
cards.description: A compassionate man of the sea who's always in high spirits. "Never seen a wave I couldn't ride!"
cards.description_es: Surfista del campo. La gente le adora por su carácter entusiasta.

cards.name: Hurley Kane
cards.description_es: Surfista del campo. La gente le adora por su carácter entusiasta.

cards.name: Ian Ferrum
cards.description: He packs a lot of guts in that small frame! When things heat up he's right there.
cards.description_es: ¡Es pequeñito pero matón! Cuando la cosa se pone difícil, se puede confiar en él.

cards.name: Iapetus Pierce
cards.description: Never loses sight of the ball in any situation. His defence is flawless.
cards.description_es: Nunca pierde de vista el balón y defiende de forma implacable.

cards.name: Ichabod Stark
cards.description: His personality, his playing style, his face... It's all so spiky.
cards.description_es: Su personalidad, su estilo de juego, su cara... Es todo tan agresivo...

cards.name: Jack Wallside
cards.description: With his bulky frame, the team's defence is as sturdy as a wall.
cards.description_es: ﻿Su gran cuerpo es como una pared que utiliza para que nadie pase.

cards.name: Jack Wallside
cards.description: With his bulky frame, the team's defence is as sturdy as a wall.
cards.description_es: ¡Este defensa es grande como una muralla! Aunque un poco miedica.

cards.name: Jeff Iron
cards.description: Tends to hog the spotlight and get carried away, even in clutch moments.
cards.description_es: Roba balones con la fiereza de un volcán en erupción.

cards.name: Jet Onyx
cards.description: If he holds out his hand above a field, the grass lies down and forms a path.
cards.description_es: Con su fuerza de voluntad, es capaz de hacer que las plantas crezcan.

cards.name: Jim Wraith
cards.description: His eyes are hidden by his fringe, but they're filled with darkness.
cards.description_es: Su flequillo esconde unos ojos que rebosan oscuridad.

cards.name: John Bloom
cards.description: A naturally rough player. He runs wild on the pitch.

cards.name: Jonas Demetrius
cards.description: Able to grasp the subtle topography of the pitch and plays like he's one with the ground he walks on.
cards.description_es: Capta las irregularidades del campo y las utiliza en beneficio propio.

cards.name: Jonathan Luckyman
cards.description: Eats offal hotpot every day, which he claims is ideal football fuel.
cards.description_es: Los estofados que come cada día son la fuente de su energía.

cards.name: Jude Sharp
cards.description: With his goggles set aside, he commands the pitch with keen eyes that never miss a beat.
cards.description_es: De sus botas sale fútbol de muchos quilates. El mejor en su posición.

cards.name: Lane War
cards.description: He looks shy, but can also charge up the pitch, slaying the opposition.

cards.name: Leone Badigo
cards.description: His swooping, powerful plays have earned him the nickname El Cóndor.
cards.description_es: Lo llaman el Cóndor porque sus ataques son tan efectivos como los de esta ave rapaz.

cards.name: Lily Willow
cards.description: Her family runs one of Osaka's biggest companies, but she's not at all snooty.
cards.description_es: Hija de un empresario importante de Osaka. Es muy sociable.

cards.name: Lima
cards.description: Despite his pensive air, he is down to earth on the pitch—and an ace player.
cards.description_es: A pesar de su aspecto pensativo, es un jugador centrado y muy hábil.

cards.name: Lima
cards.description: Miximaxed with Zanark, his dreamy gaze never seems to change.
cards.description_es: Tras el Miximax con Zanark, no ha cambiado su aspecto soñador.

cards.name: Lump Trungus
cards.description: Elder twin with a + mark on his forehead, known for his monosyllabic laughter.
cards.description_es: ¡Lumpi, lumpi, lump!

cards.name: Maxim Millennium
cards.description: A tricksy manipulator who uses words and actions to influence his foes.

cards.name: Maxwell Carson
cards.description: Gifted at everything, yet football is the only thing that ever managed to hold his attention.

cards.name: Mercury
cards.description: She looks cute at first glance, but that all changes if she doesn't get her way.
cards.description_es: Es muy dulce, pero se enfada de golpe si no consigue lo que quiere.

cards.name: Morris Moore
cards.description: Looks imposing, but usually quiet. You wouldn't want to see him angry, mind.
cards.description_es: Impone bastante, pero es muy dócil. Eso sí, procura que no se enfade...

cards.name: Nathan Swift
cards.description: His fancy footwork puts the opposition in their place. He's nothing short of a gale-force wind sweeping the pitch.
cards.description_es: ¡Este chico corre como el viento! Uno de los mejores amigos de Mark.

cards.name: Nigel August
cards.description: A young boy with dark eyes. The depths of his heart are a mystery to all.

cards.name: Oni Triumvir
cards.description: With his army training, he always keeps a watchful eye on the enemy.
cards.description_es: Nunca pierde de vista al enemigo gracias a su entrenamiento militar.

cards.name: Perses Destroyer
cards.description: Powerful yet accurate kicks are his specialty. His leg is like a longsword.
cards.description_es: Su especialidad son los tiros fuertes, precisos y mortales como una espada.

cards.name: Philip Marvel
cards.description: A ninth grader eager to look imposing to juniors, yet surprisingly jumpy for someone his size.

cards.name: Phillip Owen
cards.description: He's a master of English cuisine, and won't tolerate those who put it down.
cards.description_es: Su especialidad es el rosbif y no tolera que alguien menosprecie dicha exquisitez.

cards.name: Ronny Metcalf
cards.description: He gets past opponents by hassling them until they make mistakes.

cards.name: Sam Kincaid
cards.description: Easygoing and endlessly teased, yet capable of pulling off plays that catch everyone's eye.

cards.name: Sapta
cards.description: An unrelenting midfielder who's trying for that petrifying Medusa look.
cards.description_es: Una tenaz centrocampista que se peina para parecerse a Medusa.

cards.name: Shawn Froste
cards.description: Having lost what gives his existence meaning, this striker is desperately trying to suppress Aiden.
cards.description_es: El Delantero estrella de las tierras del norte. Suele ser muy tranquilo.

cards.name: Steve Grim
cards.description: "Don't call me average!" He really is exceptionally ordinary, though...

cards.name: Thanatos
cards.description: A player from the underworld. The proud owner of an astronomical ego.
cards.description_es: Un jugador del inframundo con un ego enorme. ¡Y a mucha honra!

cards.description: Considers his goal a sacred area and has no mercy for those who violate it.

cards.description: Cold at first glance, but observant and deeply caring, anchoring his team on both ends of the pitch.

cards.description: A self-proclaimed popular guy who looks great in glasses, he may come off as vain, but his Otaku knowledge is the real deal.

cards.description: Fueled by a noble spirit, he tests his limits by flaunting his skill for all to see.

cards.description_es: Confía plenamente en su destreza y culpa a los demás si algo sale mal.

cards.name: Adé Kébé
cards.description: A canny lad who brightens the team's mood. Sea fishing is his hobby.

cards.description: Warm on the outside, cold killer instinct within. Will do anything to win.

cards.description: Always joking but sharp and strategic, never ever letting his guard down.

cards.name: Bonnie Sparks
cards.description: What she wants, she gets; which is why her locker overflows with cute collectibles.

cards.description_es: Sabe de fútbol casi tanto como Jude. Sus informes técnicos son muy útiles.

cards.name: Claire Lesnow
cards.description: Wears a faint smile as she utters harsh remarks. Many like that about her, though.

cards.name: Cliff Parker
cards.description: A towering wall of a defender, known to teammates by the well-earned nickname "Golem."
cards.description_es: Un defensa famoso por su gran estatura. Sus compañeros lo conocen como "Gólem".

cards.description: His powerful physique is down to his arduous training carrying bundles of sugar cane.
cards.description_es: Tiene un gran físico porque se entrena recogiendo montones de caña de azúcar.

cards.description: His ability and tactical acumen are both in heavy demand.

cards.description_es: Centrocampista de visión aguda. Amable pero muy irónico, si la situación lo requiere.

cards.description: Team Zoolan's leader on the pitch. He's also known by the ominous name Grim Reaper.
cards.description_es: Es el líder del Zoolan Team, Se le conoce como el Exterminador.

cards.description: Fearless vanguard who charges upfield and fires explosive shots with his long legs.

cards.name: David Buckingham
cards.description: This spendthrift can't resist any "by royal appointment" products.
cards.description_es: Es un derrochador. No puede resistirse a ningún producto que lleve el sello real.

cards.name: Derek Swing
cards.description: Quick thinker and tricky, like a puzzle box. Slips through with feints and flair.

cards.name: Edge Ripper
cards.description: He's already earned a cult following abroad as a heavy metal vocalist.
cards.description_es: Tiene un gran éxito en el extranjero como cantante de heavy metal.

cards.name: Elior March
cards.description: Fearless at heart, he darts across the pitch with light, tireless steps.

cards.name: Faith Winter
cards.description: Emotionally scarred by the Ares Project, Elliot's childhood friend remained hospitalized for years.

cards.name: Folke Fem
cards.description: Incredibly healthy, to the point that he has never even caught a cold.
cards.description_es: No ha cogido nunca ni un simple resfriado gracias a su salud de hierro.

cards.description: A player so striking in looks that some mistake him for a girl. He's close with Riccardo Di.
cards.description_es: El elegante defensa del Raimon. Conoce a Riccardo mejor que nadie.

cards.name: Gary Lancaster
cards.description: Beats the ball into the goal with his ape-like size and strength.
cards.description_es: Emplea su severo semblante y sólido cuerpo para invadir el área rival.

cards.name: Gary Mane
cards.description: He bakes a mean scone, which can form the centerpiece of even the poshest cream teas.
cards.description_es: Hornea unas deliciosas pastitas. ¡Las sirven en cualquier merienda de postín!

cards.name: Giuseppe Cannavaro
cards.description: Fascinated by the ruins of Pompeii, he spends his Saturdays helping out on digs.

cards.name: Herman Waldon
cards.description: Has great pride in the Academy and looks down on all other teams.
cards.description_es: Tiene a su equipo en alta estima y desprecia a todos los demás.

cards.name: Hidetoshi Nakata
cards.description_es: Este chico es una leyenda en todo el mundo.

cards.name: Howie Itzer
cards.description: His eyes are two different colors. Has a tendency to be overconfident.
cards.description_es: Tiene los ojos de distinto color y una excesiva confianza en sí mismo.

cards.name: Hugues Baudet
cards.description: Known for helping out his teammates and has a keen sense of strategy.

cards.description: Gives off spooky, ghostly vibes, but all he really wants is to be noticed.

cards.name: Joaquine Downtown
cards.description: Whenever she is beaten down, she jumps right back up with renewed energy.

cards.name: Jonas Demetrius
cards.description: Able to grasp the subtle topography of the pitch and plays like he's one with the ground he walks on.

cards.name: Jonny Gascoigne
cards.description: He might dress and act like a punk, but deep down he's a real softie.
cards.description_es: Aunque vista y se comporte como un gamberro, en el fondo es un blandengue.

cards.name: Lane War
cards.description: He looks shy, but can also charge up the pitch, slaying the opposition.
cards.description_es: A simple vista parece afable, pero anula a sus rivales a base de cargas.

cards.name: Light Nobel
cards.description: Enjoys cheesy novels and enters writing competitions every month.
cards.description_es: Devora novelas cortas y cada mes participa en concursos literarios.

cards.name: Malphas
cards.description: This devilish player enjoys deceiving his enemies with cruel lies.
cards.description_es: Este jugador demoniaco disfruta engañando al rival con crueles mentiras.

cards.name: Marge Fielding
cards.description: A security guard and master of self-defense who can gracefully sidestep any attack.
cards.description_es: Domina las técnicas defensivas. Puede parar cualquier ataque.

cards.name: Mark Evans
cards.description: Though his bandana may be gone, he still stands as the team's steadfast pillar, his burning fighting spirit brighter than ever.
cards.description_es: El enérgico capitán del Raimon. ¡Es famoso por no rendirse jamás!

cards.name: Marvin Murdock
cards.description: Eldest of three and Kirkwood's captain. A perfectionist who treats victory as sacred.

cards.name: Mikey Richards
cards.description: His hobby is tailoring suits, and no other junior high school student can touch his ability.
cards.description_es: ¡Nadie puede hacer sombra a este sastre! Confecciona trajes muy molones.

cards.name: Miles Ryan
cards.description: A student in the track and field club with Nathan.
cards.description_es: Por lo visto, está aprendiendo el lenguaje de los signos y el braille.

cards.name: Nino Nango
cards.description: Small and nimble, he studied ninjutsu online, and snatches the ball with lightning speed.
cards.description_es: Pequeño y ágil este estudiante de ninja a distancia es capaz de robar el balón a la velocidad del rayo.

cards.name: Octavus Kraken
cards.description: His trademark is an unusual kick where he snaps his leg forward like a whip.
cards.description_es: Conocido por un extraño disparo en el que extiende su pierna como un látigo.

cards.name: Pinkus Mountbatten
cards.description: The manager of the Sanctum training facility. An ace player despite his age.
cards.description_es: Director del Santuario. Sigue siendo un fenómeno a pesar de su edad.

cards.name: Raffaele Generani
cards.description: Even though he's still in junior high, he's getting a nice income from modelling.
cards.description_es: Aunque todavía es muy joven, es modelo y ¡cobra un pastizal!

cards.name: Ross Siddon
cards.description: Little brother to the fearsome Poseidon, his power and potential rival his sibling's.

cards.name: Sas
cards.description: They say nobody has ever seen his eyes and lived to tell the tale...
cards.description_es: Dicen que nadie le ha mirado a los ojos y ha vivido para contarlo...

cards.name: Sean Snowfield
cards.description: He studies snowflakes and has filled thirty books with his observations.
cards.description_es: Estudia los cristales de nieve y los dibujado en más de 30 libretas.

cards.name: Shunsuke Aoyama
cards.description: An analytical player more interested in strategy than physical prowess.
cards.description_es: Le fascina la teoría y analiza su propia actuación después de cada partido.

cards.description_es: Un jugador muy analítico y basa todo su juego en la estrategia.

cards.name: Steve Grim
cards.description: He is a jack-of-all-trades. In other words, well balanced.
cards.description_es: Ordinario empleado de oficina pero buen entrenador del Inazuma Kids FC.

cards.name: Sworm
cards.description_es: Puede invocar tantos insectos como para tapar el cielo.

cards.name: Thomas Murdock
cards.description: Middle brother of the trio. Friendly and approachable, the team's go-to for venting.

cards.name: Thor Stoutberg
cards.description: This large chap has a big heart and is a great shoulder to cry on.
cards.description_es: Tiene un buen corazón y siempre cuida de sus amigos.

cards.name: Vic Vitrum
cards.description: He has a keen eye for enemy strategies, so his teammates often consult him on tactics.
cards.description_es: Sus compañeros le consultan acerca de los rivales porque siempre está enterado de todo.

cards.name: Adrian Speed
cards.description: He can run as fast as a cheetah— 100m in ten seconds flat!
cards.description_es: Deja a todos sentados con su increíble marca de cien metros en diez segundos.

cards.name: Alessandro Rossa
cards.description: You can see your face in the fine Italian leather of this lad's shoes.
cards.description_es: Calza zapatos italianos de cuero tan relucientes que podrás verte en ellos.

cards.name: Argie Bargie
cards.description: This pushy player is determined to win the ball even if he has to barge players aside.
cards.description_es: Jugador agresivo que roba el balón aunque tenga que derribar al rival.

cards.name: Axel Blaze
cards.description: Beneath his cool exterior burns an intense and fiery passion for football.
cards.description_es: Nuevo y carismático estudiante. Le llaman "el punta legendario".

cards.name: Billy Dash
cards.description: He wants to be a cowboy in a western. He's always practicing lines in the mirror.
cards.description_es: Le gustan tanto las películas del Oeste que recita guiones de memoria delante del espejo.

cards.name: Bobby Shearer
cards.description: Despite his somewhat frivolous nature, he has a warm heart and genuinely cares for his friends.
cards.description_es: Es despreocupado, pero pasional. Vivió un tiempo en Estados Unidos.

cards.name: Bountine
cards.description: Don't get taken in by her looks— she's absolutely ruthless.
cards.description_es: Los chicos se quedan embobados con su físico y padecen por su amor.

cards.name: Charlie Boardfield
cards.description: He runs at the ball like a boar to truffles.
cards.description_es: Bajo palos, parece un jabalí que sale a lo bestia a por balones.

cards.name: Chris Ellis
cards.description: He didn't have much stamina until Zoolan Rice supercharged him.
cards.description_es: Gracias a Zoolan, este jugador ha sabido aumentar su resistencia.

cards.name: Daniel Hatch
cards.description: Fearless vanguard who charges upfield and fires explosive shots with his long legs.
cards.description_es: Delantero estrella de la Royal. Sus largas piernas son su mejor arma

cards.name: David Quintola
cards.description: The heir to an ancient and noble family. Takes pride in his lineage.
cards.description_es: Guarda para sí el orgullo de pertenecer a una antigua y aristocrática familia.

cards.name: David Samford
cards.description: A striker with a deadly shot arsenal and Jude's ever-reliable right hand.
cards.description_es: Se echa el equipo a sus espaldas. Sus técnicas conjuntas son letales.

cards.name: Dirk Artz
cards.description: He works well with his brother Marshall and rarely misses.
cards.description_es: Juega muy bien junto a Marshall. Sus disparos suelen entrar a puerta.

cards.name: Eugene Peabody
cards.description: Raimon's fastest midfielder. Has distinctly pessimistic tendencies.
cards.description_es: El centrocampista más rápido del equipo, pero también un pesimista.

cards.name: Finn Stoned
cards.description: There is nothing he can't steal— but he only targets the rich.
cards.description_es: Asegura que no hay objeto que no se pueda birlar. Solo roba a ricos.

cards.name: Goth Grimshaw
cards.description: Loves to read novels set in the past. Has real respect for historical figures.
cards.description_es: Adora las novelas históricas e idolatra a los grandes próceres del pasado.

cards.name: Gus Gamer
cards.description: A total gamer who's always at the front of the queue for any new games.
cards.description_es: Maníaco de los videojuegos. Se los compra todos el día del lanzamiento.

cards.name: Ishmael Ahab
cards.description: A master of free-diving, with amazing muscles and lung capacity.
cards.description_es: Es un experto buceador, de poderosos músculos y pulmones.

cards.name: Jack Wallside
cards.description: With his bulky frame, the team's defence is as sturdy as a wall.
cards.description_es: ﻿Su gran cuerpo es como una pared que utiliza para que nadie pase.

cards.name: Jarell Mangrove
cards.description: This prankster will snatch away the ball while you're not looking.
cards.description_es: No te descuides o este bromista te robará el balón sin que te des cuenta.

cards.name: Jazzy Hedgeer
cards.description: A southern surf dude with boundless enthusiasm, and a natty sun visor.
cards.description_es: A este coleguita del sur le chifla surfear. Lleva una visera muy molona.

cards.name: Li Leung
cards.description: A popular, happy-go-lucky player who is deceptively strong on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Este futbolista tan despreocupado es muy popular. Además es muy bueno en el campo.

cards.name: Mitchell Angelio
cards.description: Reads 10,000 words a minute and is training to go even faster.
cards.description_es: Puede leer 10 000 palabras por minuto y resumírtelas al acabar...

cards.name: Nathan Swift
cards.description: His fancy footwork puts the opposition in their place. He's nothing short of a gale-force wind sweeping the pitch.
cards.description_es: Defensa veloz como un torbellino. Conoce a Mark desde hace tiempo.

cards.name: Ned Yousef
cards.description: His piercing eyes can turn the opposition to stone.
cards.description_es: Pese a su mirada fiera es muy tierno con los niños.

cards.name: Neil Turner
cards.description_es: Era tranquilo hasta que le lavaron el cerebro. Se ha vuelto agresivo.

cards.name: Panca
cards.description: Wears a mask to hide his peculiar face, but that only makes him scarier.
cards.description_es: Como es vergonzoso, lleva máscara, así que todo el mundo le tiene miedo.

cards.name: Pandora
cards.description: There is a strange rumor that she brings calamity on her opponents.
cards.description_es: Dicen que los que se relacionan con ella le ocurren desgracias.

cards.name: Pentra Chek
cards.description: Decisiveness and momentum are the name of his game. A rough type of lad.
cards.description_es: Toma las decisiones justas en el momento adecuado. Un pelín rudo.

cards.name: Rihm
cards.description: A cruel girl who will attack any weakness she sees in her opponents.
cards.description_es: Es muy bruta y aprovecha cualquier despiste del rival para atacar.

cards.name: Ringo Saturn
cards.description: It's game over for any player that gets sucked in by his hypnotic red eyes.
cards.description_es: Su habilidad en la portería y su voz potente dan gran seguridad al equipo.

cards.name: Rosso Granato
cards.description: He's a born aristocrat, but he's determined to do something worthwhile with his life.
cards.description_es: Es aristócrata y tiene la vida resuelta, pero prefiere no quedarse de brazos cruzados.

cards.name: Steve Grim
cards.description: He is a jack-of-all-trades. In other words, well balanced.
cards.description_es: No destaca en nada, pero sus habilidades están bien equilibradas.

cards.name: Subaru Honda
cards.description: A hot-headed go-getter. Dribbles the ball like a runaway train.
cards.description_es: Un cordial hombre de acción. Avanza con el balón como una locomotora.

cards.name: Subaru Honda
cards.description: A hot-headed go-getter. Dribbles the ball like a runaway train.
cards.description_es: Un jugador muy impulsivo. Avanza con el balón como una locomotora.

cards.name: Tigre Mendes
cards.description: He gets more and more pumped as the crowd cheer louder and louder!
cards.description_es: ¡Cuanto más alto grita la afición, más se anima!

cards.name: Troy Moon
cards.description: Just a glance at a full moon gives "Wolf Boy" violent tendencies.
cards.description_es: Le llaman "el licántropo" porque al mirar la luna pierde el juicio.

cards.name: Wesley Knox
cards.description: Known as the brain of Zeus Junior High, so clever some say he channels divine wisdom.
cards.description_es: Crack del Zeus. Sus jugadas son dignas de una divinidad, es un mago del campo.

cards.name: Wolfe Whyte
cards.description: A goalie as impassable as a wall. Believes that winning is everything.
cards.description_es: Asegura la portería como un muro. La victoria lo es todo para él.

cards.name: Abram Cadabra
cards.description: Has amazing reflexes for his size, and considers penalty kicks his specialty.
cards.description_es: Tiene buenos reflejos para su tamaño y es especialista en parar penaltis.

cards.name: Alan Master
cards.description: The rhythm from his headphones is the secret to his strength.
cards.description_es: Este incansable jugador nunca deja de luchar. Los cascos que lleva le dan poder y seguridad.

cards.name: Andy Chronic
cards.description: Even without a watch, he always knows how much game time remains.
cards.description_es: Aunque no lleve reloj, siempre sabe con exactitud el minuto de juego.

cards.name: Antonio Bagre
cards.description: He's involved in an environmental movement to save the endangered Brazilwood tree.
cards.description_es: Es miembro de una asociación que lucha contra la explotación maderera de Brasil.

cards.name: Arculus Orbes
cards.description: The king of Falam Orbius reborn, appearing as the black Picksie before Victor.
cards.description_es: La apariencia del rey de Falam Orbius. También era el Picksie que guio a Victor.

cards.name: Ari Zimmerman
cards.description: Meticulous, with the spirit of a craftsman. He lets his flawless plays speak for him.
cards.description_es: Es tan perfeccionista y meticuloso como un artesano. Deja que sus implacables jugadas hablen por él.

cards.name: Augusto Gomez
cards.description: Overwhelming confidence powers his plays, and he treats his fan club like family.

cards.name: Azzurro Zaffiro
cards.description: He's active in organizations attempting to halt the sinking of Venice.
cards.description_es: Pertenece a una organización que busca forma de evitar que Venecia se hunda.

cards.name: Balen
cards.description: He has a complex about being so cute, and plays wearing a mask and makeup.
cards.description_es: Tiene complejo de cara aniñada y se maquilla para dar miedo.

cards.name: Bandy Horsman
cards.description: His resolve on the pitch was weak, but Zoolan Rice gifted him a steady nerve.
cards.description_es: Zoolan le enseñó a tener la determinación que le hacía falta en el campo.

cards.name: Ben Simmons
cards.description: Lunges for the ball like a mad dog. Size doesn't matter. Once he's on, he won't let go.
cards.description_es: Perro de presa que usará cualquier medio para robar el balón al rival.

cards.name: Cal Trops
cards.description: He possesses fine ability, but excels at being a team player.
cards.description_es: Tiene valía y dotes para enseñar. Sabe compenetrarse con el equipo.

cards.name: Circulus Corona
cards.description: A legendary warrior of planet Nomor reincarnated, and the white Picksie who appeared before Arion.
cards.description_es: Legendario guerrero del planeta Nomor que guio a Arion cuando era Picksie.

cards.name: Drachen Gunther
cards.description: Anyone he fixes with his fearful gaze becomes paralyzed with horror.
cards.description_es: Utiliza el contacto visual para dejar al enemigo paralizado de terror.

cards.name: Drake Dynamo
cards.description: Legend says that he once wrestled a buffalo to the ground, but some people doubt the story.
cards.description_es: Dicen por ahí que una vez tumbó a un búfalo él solo... ¿Será verdad?

cards.name: Erik Eagle
cards.description: An all-rounder once lauded as a genius. A powerhouse up front and a wall in the back.
cards.description_es: Centrocampista excepcional. Le llaman "El mago del campo".

cards.name: Eugene Peabody
cards.description: Raimon's fastest midfielder. Has distinctly pessimistic tendencies.
cards.description_es: Es un centrocampista ágil, pero con tendencia al pesimismo.

cards.name: Federigo Cinco
cards.description: A key member who works with team leader Quentin to manage the defence.
cards.description_es: Es el as en la manga de Quentin para mantener una defensa perfecta.

cards.name: Frank Foreman
cards.description: Footwork honed through relentless boxing training gives him an agility few can match.
cards.description_es: ¡Boxeador y marinero! Este chico tiene una gran fuerza en sus piernas.

cards.name: Gene Ghiskhan
cards.description: After club activities, he recovers by eating steamed pork buns bought in bulk.
cards.description_es: Empleando su fuerza física se abre camino entre las filas del equipo rival.

cards.name: Grant Icewater
cards.description: Claims he used to be devastatingly handsome in his youth, but no one believes him.

cards.name: Gus Heeley
cards.description: Possesses amazing strength, but succumbs easily to ankle injuries.
cards.description_es: Tiene calidad, pero chupa banquillo porque se resiente de los tobillos.

cards.name: Harry Closs
cards.description: Strong but uncontrollable. Has a soft spot for the ladies.
cards.description_es: Es fuerte y algo bruto. Sin embargo, se derrite por las chicas.

cards.name: Hellen Hearth
cards.description: She's rather laid back and has been known to fall asleep mid-sentence.
cards.description_es: Su calma y flema al hablar hacen que su interlocutor se duerma.

cards.name: Henry House
cards.description: Burns with jealousy when others steal the spotlight. Can't stand players who outshine him.
cards.description_es: No le reconoce el mérito a otros jugadores mejores que él.

cards.name: Homer Grower
cards.description: Only eats farm produce that he and his family grows.
cards.description_es: Es muy exigente con la calidad del arroz y por eso lo recoge él mismo.

cards.name: Hurricane Zeta
cards.description: Known as the largest typhoon in recorded history. A raging tempest that blows all things into oblivion.
cards.description_es: El huracán más grande jamás visto. Sus furiosos vientos aplastan todo a su paso.

cards.name: Hyperion Wise
cards.description: When in top form, seems to shine like the summer sky with a divine glow.
cards.description_es: Cuando está al máximo, su juego es tan brillante como un día de verano.

cards.name: Iggy Russ
cards.description: He handles the ball in the air with the grace of a bird in flight.
cards.description_es: El juego aéreo es lo suyo; Si salta, parece un ave surcando los cielos.

cards.name: Indra Vayu
cards.description: Raised on a planet where fireballs fall by day and icicles by night, he thrives in any condition.
cards.description_es: Gran portento físico que fue criado en los climas más extremos del universo.

cards.name: Jaymes Randie
cards.description: His family owns a lot of land. Their spring water is quite popular locally.
cards.description_es: Su familia posee tierras con aguas termales, muy apreciadas en la zona.

cards.name: Joaquine Downtown
cards.description: Whenever she is beaten down, she jumps right back up with renewed energy.
cards.description_es: Aunque la tumben, se levanta de nuevo llena de energía.

cards.name: Johan Tassman
cards.description: Rumor has it he's psychic, and trains with the spirits of football legends.
cards.description_es: Su "don" le permite contactar con espíritus de futbolistas.

cards.name: Joss Fool
cards.description: A fearless vanguard who charged first into enemy lines and admired Circulus as his "brother."
cards.description_es: Fiel a su capitán y más veloz que cualquier rival.

cards.name: Leonard O'Shea
cards.description: He doesn't take any back talk and guards his title as Wild's king.
cards.description_es: No hay quien le lleve la contraria. Defiende su zona con zarpa férrea.

cards.name: Lorne Mower
cards.description: An eccentric type that enjoys plucking grass to chew.
cards.description_es: Chaval inocente, algo estrafalario, al que le gusta cortar el césped.

cards.name: Malcolm Night
cards.description: Erik Eagle's friend from the States. Fastidious about his hairstyle.

cards.name: Maxwell Carson
cards.description: A gifted all-rounder who just can't stay interested for long.
cards.description_es: Por su pinta, nunca dirías que es un as de los deportes.

cards.name: Mecha-Mark
cards.description: An android El Dorado developed in secret using Mark Evans's data.

cards.name: Nathan Jones
cards.description: He's the kind of nut who brings a machete to mow the field.
cards.description_es: Peligroso personaje que corta el césped del campo con una guadaña.

cards.name: Ogar Circes
cards.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors, he tries to solve every problem with brute force.
cards.description_es: Jugador del Falam Medius. Le gusta resolver las jugadas usando su fuerza.

cards.name: Pablo Castillo
cards.description: The natural beauty of Argentina inspires his art, and he hopes for recognition.
cards.description_es: Se inspira en la belleza de la flora Argentina para crear obras de arte que le den fama.

cards.name: Papa
cards.description: The fire inside him burns as red as his hair. Despite his name, he's not a dad.
cards.description_es: Su pelo refleja la pasión que siente. A pesar de su nombre, no tiene hijos.

cards.name: Papa
cards.description: Miximaxed with Zanark, he works hard and plays hard. Beware!
cards.description_es: Tras el Miximax con Zanark, es muy duro de roer. ¡Cuidado!.

cards.name: Phobos Quasar
cards.description: Known as Ixar Fleet's Shadow Shooter, he tears apart anyone foolish enough to approach his goal.
cards.description_es: Portero de la Flota Ixar. Es apodado como "Dios de la destrucción".

cards.name: Rae Godmother
cards.description: Takes a very philosophical attitude to life. Never lets anything unsettle him.
cards.description_es: Tiene un intelecto privilegiado para su edad, y nada parece perturbarlo.

cards.name: Rolf Howells
cards.description: Can speak to dogs. Often seen chasing them through the village.
cards.description_es: Asegura que puede hablar con los perros. Se dedica a perseguirlos.

cards.name: Roseo Diamante
cards.description: He was born on the wrong side of the tracks, so he's determined to succeed in life.
cards.description_es: Nació en un barrio humilde, así que quiere jugar al fútbol para triunfar en la vida.

cards.name: Scotty O'Brien
cards.description: Has a habit of knocking other players over with his rough shoulder charge.
cards.description_es: En el campo juega limpio, pero fuera de él su ética deja que desear.

cards.name: Seward Hayseed
cards.description: Follows his nan's instructions to bath in front of the fire, even now.
cards.description_es: ﻿Calienta el agua con carbón por consejo expreso de su abuela.

cards.name: Shadow Cimmerian
cards.description: A soldier born out of darkness. His power is overwhelming.
cards.description_es: Guerrero que nació de la oscuridad. Su fuerza es portentosa.

cards.name: Shane Pierce
cards.description: He's only young, but he has a good grasp of Wall Street's complex financial structures.
cards.description_es: Aunque sea muy joven, se le da muy bien las finanzas y podría trabajar en Wall Street.

cards.name: Talal Hamad
cards.description: The ultimate goal of this player is to be a newsreader on a Middle Eastern TV station.
cards.description_es: Sueña con ser presentador de telediario en alguna cadena de Oriente Medio.

cards.name: Triton Nettuno
cards.description: Unleashes powerful kicks by twisting his whole body like a whip.
cards.description_es: Realiza poderosos tiros usando todo el cuerpo como si fuese un látigo.

cards.name: Wesley Knox
cards.description: Known as the brain of Zeus Junior High, so clever some say he channels divine wisdom.

cards.name: Zachary Moore
cards.description: No flashy moves or superstar aura, but his setup instincts are pure gold.
cards.description_es: No es demasiado bueno, pero cuando da asistencias es otro cantar.

cards.name: Zack Abdulla
cards.description: Camel herding was the traditional occupation of this player's tribe.
cards.description_es: Viene de un pueblo cuya tradición es criar camellos.

cards.name: Zaphod Riker
cards.description: The other students call him "Lord Snotty." He's an insufferable snob.
cards.description_es: Por su aire soberbio, los demás alumnos lo llaman "su alteza".

cards.name: Adam Montayne
cards.description: He uses his size and bulk to maintain possession of the ball as he surges forward.

cards.name: Alan Master
cards.description: The rhythm from his headphones is the secret to his strength.
cards.description_es: Los cascos le dan poder. Marea a los rivales al ritmo de la música.

cards.name: Arachne
cards.description: Using dark powers on the pitch, she inspires fear with her spider-like movements.
cards.description_es: Jugadora del inframundo que usa sus técnicas arácnidas par aterrar a sus rivales.

cards.name: Ashley Sarpala
cards.description: A sensitive player with a cluster of 80,000 eyes and a keen sense of touch.
cards.description_es: Sus 8 ojos la permiten tener una buena visión de juego.

cards.name: Ashvina Bharani
cards.description: A fearless hunter from a planet ruled by colossal beasts, unmatched in her ability to take them down.
cards.description_es: Se dice que ella sola es capaz de cazar monstruos de 15 metros.

cards.name: Atlas Carrier
cards.description: A former kick-boxer. Now he puts that powerful legwork to use on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Antes hacía kickboxing, experiencia que aprovecha ahora en el campo.

cards.name: Beldio Smeraldo
cards.description: This player is livid about the damage done to Rome's architectural heritage by pollution.
cards.description_es: Le preocupa que la contaminación de Roma estropee los monumentos de la ciudad.

cards.name: Ben Nevis
cards.description: Loves studying wildlife so much, he moved to the deep countryside.
cards.description_es: Disfruta observando animales. Se mudó al campo para tenerlos cerca.

cards.name: Bertie Cees
cards.description: A champion in the unusual sport of unwrapping shop-bought rice balls.

cards.name: Bindal Hermit
cards.description: An astrologer who foresaw Circulus's death and laments failing to protect him.
cards.description_es: Lamenta el no haber podido hacer nada por la muerte de Circulus.

cards.name: Blazer Firefoot
cards.description: He can blast the ball through the opposition's defence like a pillar of flame.
cards.description_es: Las defensas enemigas no son rival para la potencia de sus tiros.

cards.name: Bobby Shearer
cards.description: Despite his somewhat frivolous nature, he has a warm heart and genuinely cares for his friends.
cards.description_es: Es despreocupado, pero pasional. Vivió un tiempo en Estados Unidos.

cards.name: Brook Linden
cards.description: Has a short fuse—he's liable to get heated up about the smallest things.
cards.description_es: Tiene muy malas pulgas y cualquier cosilla lo puede hacer enfadar.

cards.name: Buddy Plains
cards.description: He used to back out of challenges for fear of injury, but Zoolan Rice helped him improve.
cards.description_es: No quería jugar al fútbol por temor a lesionarse, pero Zoolan le ayudó a superarlo.

cards.name: Cao Cao
cards.description: Rival of Liu Bei who came to be ruler of Wei, one of the Three Kingdoms.
cards.description_es: Rival de Liu Bei que llego a gobernar Wei, uno de los Tres Reinos.

cards.name: Capro Lynes
cards.description: Has a good sense of balance and shows it off by sprinting along wires.
cards.description_es: Por confirmar.

cards.name: Cecil Crowley
cards.description: He wasn't able to see very well in the daytime, but Zoolan Rice soon fixed that.
cards.description_es: Zoolan lo ayudó a mejorar su visión. ¡Ya puede ver perfectamente al adversario!

cards.name: Crimson Wiseman
cards.description: The "Shifting Mirage." Though large, he moves around the pitch with stealth.
cards.description_es: Apodado "Espejismo". Se mueve con sigilo para robarle el balón al rival.

cards.name: Cuba Lieber
cards.description: He can't make his mind up, rather like wobbly old scales.

cards.name: Dan Mirthful
cards.description: Likes nothing better than a good sleep... often during school time.
cards.description_es: Dormir le hace tan feliz que siempre llega tarde a todas partes.

cards.name: Desmodus Drakul
cards.description: Scion of a noble clan, his cool nature hides an ardent love of himself.
cards.description_es: Descendiente de un noble clan. Su aspecto flemático oculta un gran ego.

cards.name: Desmodus Drakul
cards.description: Desmodus's Mix 'n' Matched vampire form!
cards.description_es: Descendiente de un noble clan. Su aspecto flemático oculta un gran ego.

cards.name: Dva
cards.description: Changed his hairstyle to express his individuality, but still shy and retiring.
cards.description_es: Aunque lleve esos pelos, no le gusta que lo comparen con una escoba.

cards.name: Egor Coxcomb
cards.description: Hugely proud of his mohawk, but gets easily deflated if people criticize it.

cards.name: Ekadel
cards.description: Sanctus's cool lieutenant has magical gifts of his own, so watch out.
cards.description_es: Es el genial lugarteniente de Sael. Tiene sus propios poderes mágicos, ¡cuidado con él!

cards.name: Falco Flashman
cards.description: A former track and field standout with speed that hits like a sudden gust of wind.
cards.description_es: Posee una velocidad tan rápida como la de una ráfaga de viento.

cards.name: Falco Flashman
cards.description: He has unleashed the darkness inside, showing his true self without lies or pretense.
cards.description_es: Posee una velocidad tan rápida como la de una ráfaga de viento.

cards.name: Feduhm
cards.description: Zan's fiendish guardian angel will do whatever it takes to defend the goal.
cards.description_es: El diabólico ángel guardián del Zan defiende la portería a toda costa.

cards.name: Fermín Sánchez
cards.description: Like a bull at a matador, he charges straight through the crowd to grab the ball.

cards.name: Flam Berger
cards.description: A cool and collected goal hunter. Uninterested in anything but scoring.
cards.description_es: Un goleador sobrio y tranquilo. Su único interés es marcar goles.

cards.name: Fow Tudas
cards.description: Former knight and scout whose vision and speed make him a threat on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Su gran visión de juego y su fuerza en las piernas lo hacen un gran jugador.

cards.name: Gabriel Jax
cards.description: He's one of those Hollywood child stars. Let's hope his success continues.
cards.description_es: Sus padres son estrellas de Hollywood, y desea tener tanta fama como ellos.

cards.name: Gandares Baran
cards.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors, he's utterly convinced that his brother Ruger is a genius.
cards.description_es: Jugador del Falam Medius. Piensa que su hermano Ruger es un genio.

cards.name: Genel
cards.description: He is gifted with a supernatural bulk, with which he blasts away his foes.
cards.description_es: Le ha sido concedido un gran tamaño y lo utiliza para machacar a sus enemigos.

cards.name: Giallo Topazio
cards.description: He dreams of being a great fashion designer some day, but so far he hasn't had much luck.
cards.description_es: Aspira a convertirse en un famoso diseñador de moda; pero, por ahora, no ha tenido suerte.

cards.name: Grigio Quarzo
cards.description: He'd love to go on a date in Rome, but he keeps getting knocked back.
cards.description_es: Le encantaría pasar una velada romántica en Roma, pero siempre le dan calabazas.

cards.name: Grillo Santos
cards.description: His family runs a traditional Brazilian eatery, so he's always cooking for his teammates.
cards.description_es: Su familia dirige un restaurante brasileño y por eso siempre cocina para sus compañeros.

cards.name: Grover Noggin
cards.description: He looks as if he's staring into space, but he's watching like a hawk.

cards.name: Gustav Weathervane
cards.description: He can read the wind, and uses it to control the ball's movements.
cards.description_es: Puede adivinar el movimiento del balón por los cambios en el viento.

cards.name: Heat
