cards.description: Torch's childhood friend. He used to be a weakling, but training toughened him up.
cards.description_es: Amigo de la infancia de Torch. Se entrenó para ser mas fuerte.

cards.name: Henry House
cards.description: Burns with jealousy when others steal the spotlight. Can't stand players who outshine him.
cards.description_es: No le reconoce el mérito a otros jugadores mejores que él.

cards.name: Hugo Tallgeese
cards.description: Charges repeatedly, just like a stubborn rooster pecking around.

cards.name: Ientel
cards.description: She's got supernatural powers, but she'll win anyone over with her bright personality.
cards.description_es: No le hace falta usar sus poderes, su actitud alegre le basta para ganarse a cualquiera.

cards.name: Isla Pullens
cards.description: Her gaze is like a tractor beam to any boy who meets it. Resistance is futile.
cards.description_es: Su mirada es como una cosechadora que aspira a cualquier chico que se encuentra con ella. La resistencia es inútil.

cards.name: Jamila Wali
cards.description: A keen traveler, this player dreams of a world which is not dependent on fossil fuels.
cards.description_es: Le encanta viajar y sueña con el día en el que el mundo no dependa del petróleo.

cards.name: Jeongsu Cho
cards.description: An ambitious player who wants to see Korean footballers on the world stage.

cards.name: Jesse Spiller
cards.description: He heads a shadowy group researching the great mysteries of the world.
cards.description_es: Es presidente de una nueva sociedad que investiga las maravillas del mundo.

cards.name: John Reynolds
cards.description: He used to be a violent ronin, but found calm through football.
cards.description_es: Camorrista que se volvió serio tras hacerse futbolista ninja.

cards.name: Jonas Demetrius
cards.description: Able to grasp the subtle topography of the pitch and plays like he's one with the ground he walks on.
cards.description_es: Capta las irregularidades del campo y las utiliza en beneficio propio.

cards.name: Jude Sharp
cards.description_es: De sus botas sale fútbol de muchos quilates. El mejor en su posición.

cards.name: Jupiter Jumper
cards.description: Climbs like a cat and always lands on his feet.
cards.description_es: Su ligero cuerpo le permite trepar a cualquier sitio como un mono.

cards.name: Kakui Ten
cards.description: A total glutton! He dreams about one day eating all the food in the world.

cards.name: Kayson
cards.description_es: No importa quién sea. No confía ni en su propio padre.

cards.name: Ken Furan
cards.description: Trying to create life, but biology is his worst class.
cards.description_es: Hace experimentos para crear vida, pero no les encuentra el pulso.

cards.name: Kerry Bootgaiter
cards.description: She loves snow and runs around her snowy garden laughing like mad.
cards.description_es: Cuando la nieve cuaja está tan alegre que sale a jugar al jardín.

cards.name: Kevin Castle
cards.description: Skilled at marking opponents and surrounds them until they give up.
cards.description_es: Se pega al rival como una lapa y no lo suelta hasta hacerle rendirse.

cards.name: Kevin Dragonfly
cards.description: A hothead who cares deeply for his pals. He seems scary, but behind the scenes, he works incredibly hard.
cards.description_es: Goleador del Raimon. Algo arisco, pero se deja la piel por el equipo.

cards.name: Launce Berton
cards.description: Doesn't usually play up front, but actually has excellent shooting skills.
cards.description_es: Su juego no es muy ofensivo, aunque posee un potente disparo.

cards.name: Ledger Demain
cards.description: Claims to be able to see things that others can't, but isn't able to prove it.
cards.description_es: Dice poder ver cosas que otros no perciben, pero no puede probarlo.

cards.name: Lee Canthrup
cards.description: A goalie of ancient honor. He can catch any shot with his teeth.
cards.description_es: Se dice que este portero es capaz de parar el balón de un mordico.

cards.name: Luke Lively
cards.description: His family is so healthy that even his great-grandmother is lively.
cards.description_es: Su familia es muy longeva: su bisabuela se conserva muy bien.

cards.name: Marshall Artison
cards.description: He'll take on any opponent with nothing other than his fists.

cards.name: Marshall Artz
cards.description: Cuts through the enemy lines with his brother Dirk.
cards.description_es: Cuando se junta con Dirk, cruzan la línea del enemigo a su antojo.

cards.name: Mary Antoine
cards.description: A sophisticated girl with refined tastes. She prefers cake to bread.
cards.description_es: Desprende refinamiento y belleza. Prefiere pasteles a bocadillos.

cards.name: Maurice Badgame
cards.description: He aspires to be a world-class defender and create an impregnable defensive wall.
cards.description_es: Tiene nivel de profesional. Quiere que su defensa sea inquebrantable.

cards.name: Miehd
cards.description: This girl genius may look young, but don't underestimate her!
cards.description_es: Esta moza parece poquita cosa, pero no conviene subestimarla...

cards.name: Miguel Pereira
cards.description: His hobby is making model sailing boats. He's assembling an invincible armada in his bathtub.
cards.description_es: Monta maquetas de barcos y ha reproducido la Armada Invencible en su bañera.

cards.name: Mnemo Pool
cards.description: Worships the game of football and would do anything for his team.
cards.description_es: Es un fiel creyente en del dios del fútbol y apoya a su equipo hasta el final.

cards.name: Morr Fauche
cards.description: Her glossy hair glimmers in sunlight, drawing visitors to Juuro Village all on its own.

cards.name: Ned Jovan
cards.description: An old-fashioned robot with a simple design that can run indefinitely with proper maintenance.

cards.name: Niccolo Mantegna
cards.description: His technique was lacking in edge, but Zoolan Rice soon sorted that out.

cards.name: Nick Pincher
cards.description: He has the uncanny ability to read the contents of a person's pockets in an instant.
cards.description_es: Tiene una asombrosa habilidad para saber lo que tiene la gente en los bolsillos.

cards.name: Norbert Poindexter
cards.description: He didn't care much for American football, but he really took to soccer.
cards.description_es: Después de probar varios deportes, ha acabado aficionándose al fútbol.

cards.name: Olivia Baker
cards.description: She likes making dinner for friends and hopes to run a restaurant.

cards.name: Pam Duff
cards.description: She'll go straight for the ball. Anyone in her way risks getting "duffed up."

cards.name: Paul Peabody
cards.description: His small body hides a mysterious power. As cute as a mascot.
cards.description_es: La mascota del Raimon es pequeña, pero tiene un poder especial.

cards.name: Penn Minim
cards.description: A student of calligraphy, his powers of concentration are second to none.
cards.description_es: Experto estudiante de caligrafía, su concentración es imperturbable.

cards.name: Promon Shubill
cards.description: Secretly in love with Etna, he gives everything on the pitch to impress her.
cards.description_es: Tiene una relación amorosa en secreto con Etna.

cards.name: Rafael López
cards.description: He's a great flamenco dancer. Girls are lining up for a chance to dance with him.
cards.description_es: Las chicas hacen cola para que este jugador las saque a bailar sevillanas.

cards.name: Rex Less
cards.description: Isn't afraid of throwing himself into the fray. The one with the most scars.

cards.name: Riku Pants Matsushita
cards.description_es: Es una ganadora nata. Confunde al contrincante con magníficas jugadas.

cards.name: Roland Climbstein
cards.description: Core strength from snowboarding is his weapon. Expert in all winter sports.
cards.description_es: Controla tan bien su cuerpo que podría jugar al fútbol sobre hielo.

cards.name: Rudra Ardo
cards.description: This scholar from an advanced world was forced to submit after his civilization fell.
cards.description_es: Era un famoso erudito que fue a la guerra y fue derrotado.

cards.name: Ruff Weedon
cards.description: Despite his tough appearance, has a weak constitution and falls ill easily.
cards.description_es: Pese a su cara de tipo duro, es un debilucho y siempre anda resfriado.

cards.name: Sam Idol
cards.description: His hobby is finding the stars of the future before they are famous.
cards.description_es: Cazatalentos que busca con fervor las estrellas del mañana.

cards.name: Scaber Enoki
cards.description: The team's main muscle went on a faddish mushroom diet and now has no get-up-and-go.
cards.description_es: El más fuerte del equipo. Ahora come muchas setas y no tienen fuerzas.

cards.name: Scarlett Strands
cards.description: Mixes and sells her own hair dyes, made from natural ingredients only.

cards.name: Seamus Rock
cards.description: It's too hard to find four-leaf clovers, so this chap is trying to cultivate them at home.

cards.name: Seats
cards.description: He worries so much about the future that he makes himself ill.
cards.description_es: Es muy planificador, pero si piensa demasiado, le duele el estomago.

cards.name: Selenia Mund
cards.description: Loves to cook, showing up on match and practice days with homemade lunches for the whole squad.
cards.description_es: No le gustan los partidos ni los entrenamientos y su equipo lo sabe.

cards.name: Sergio Pérez
cards.description: He has lofty ambitions of reinventing the Argentinian literary scene.

cards.name: Seth Hedges
cards.description: He was weak against opponents' attacks, but Zoolan Rice helped him overcome that.
cards.description_es: Gracias a Zoolan, este jugador aprendió a ser fuerte ante los ataques del rival.

cards.name: Solomon Roundhay
cards.description: The "Shimmering Air." Try as they may, other players can't even touch him.
cards.description_es: Lo apodan "Calima" y sus trallazos ponen los pelos de punta.

cards.name: Strem Goozer
cards.description: A powerhouse ax wielder who can go toe-to-toe with Circulus in single combat.
cards.description_es: Portero muy talentoso que da mucha seguridad al equipo.

cards.name: Strom Boojum
cards.description: Seems like a tough, opinionated guy, but is actually kind of mellow.
cards.description_es: Parece duro y obstinado, pero en realidad es pura amabilidad.

cards.name: Sworm
cards.description: He likes to speak to plants, but doesn't listen to anything his team says.
cards.description_es: Puede comunicarse con las plantas, pero nunca escucha a los del equipo.

cards.name: Ted Autumn
cards.description: This young goalie is considered one of the big four in junior high footie.
cards.description_es: Un prominente y famoso portero, miembro de los "4 Magníficos".

cards.name: Terry Archibald
cards.description: A basketball player with extremely long arms who works best alone and takes orders from no one.
cards.description_es: Un Solitario jugador de baloncesto que odia recibir órdenes.

cards.name: Tim Saunders
cards.description: Darts around the pitch with kung fu flair, nailing headers with his rock-hard skull.
cards.description_es: Sus gráciles movimientos y dominio del balón son fruto del kung-fu.

cards.name: Tinkel Urmia
cards.description: Always at Plink's side, curious and chasing fun wherever it can be found.
cards.description_es: Siempre juega con Plink. Su aspecto es como el de una niña pequeña.

cards.name: Trina Verdure
cards.description: A shy girl with no sports experience who spends most of her time at the zoo, surrounded by the animals she loves.
cards.description_es: Una chica introvertida que no tiene experiencia en deportes. Le encantan los animales y suele ir al zoológico.

cards.name: Tuff Weedon
cards.description: Despite his tough appearance, has low pain tolerance and bruises easily.
cards.description_es: Pese a su cara de tipo duro, es un debilucho y siempre le duele todo

cards.name: Tyler Thomas
cards.description: A bespoke tailor who believes only in fitted suits.
cards.description_es: Mide a sus amigos y les hace ropa para coger experiencia.

cards.name: Ulisses Nogueira
cards.description: His cool and calculated style doesn't always mesh with passionate Latin football.
cards.description_es: Su estilo frío y calculador no encaja con su ardiente pasión por el fútbol.

cards.name: Umi Hwang
cards.description: The heir to an industrial fortune, this player had the benefit of an elite education.

cards.name: Verne Spring
cards.description: This genius tactician is one of the big four in junior high footie.
cards.description_es: Uno de los "4 magníficos" con un juicio propio de genios.

cards.name: Virginia Goldstein
cards.description: A dreamy romantic lost in fairy tales and star-crossed love stories.

cards.name: Zartan Walder
cards.description: Veteran commander of the kingdom's heavy cavalry who fought alongside Bambaros.
cards.description_es: Jefe de la caballería pesada. Es un guerrero con más de mil historias.

cards.name: Adriano Donati
cards.description: Driving the frontline with guts and momentum, he may seem reckless but always delivers when it counts.
cards.description_es: Lidera la delantera con valor. Osado al jugar, pero nunca defrauda en los momentos difíciles.

cards.name: Alan Master
cards.description: The rhythm from his headphones is the secret to his strength.

cards.name: Alan Sumner
cards.description: A world-class defender who's one of the big four in junior high football.
cards.description_es: Defensa famoso. Es uno de los "4 magníficos".

cards.name: Argon Bulgess
cards.description: A commanding presence hailed as the guardian deity of Falam Medius, and a goalkeeper of remarkable skill.
cards.description_es: Guardián de Falam Orbius. Es un portero asombroso.

cards.name: Aspen Blewit
cards.description: The team brainbox, he was fiercely opposed to the team's expedition from the start.
cards.description_es: El intelectual del equipo. Siempre ha sido contrario a la expedición.

cards.name: Astro Justin
cards.description: Senior to Circulus in the knights, though everyone has long forgotten it.
cards.description_es: Todo el mundo le reconoce como un gran caballero por sus hazañas.

cards.name: Attila Hun
cards.description: Barrels up the field with low-slung dribbling power. Built like a tank and moves like one too.
cards.description_es: Es un tanque sobre el campo, efectivo en defensa y aplastante en el regate.

cards.name: B'adaen
cards.description: The oldest member of Silica Eleven wears an eyepatch to match his seniority.
cards.description_es: El parche de su ojo mejora su vista para poder detener disparos veloces.

cards.name: Bala Gasgula
cards.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors, he's devious and stops at nothing to achieve his goals.
cards.description_es: Jugador del Falam Medius. Hace uso de juego sucio para ganar.

cards.name: Bambaros Tower
cards.description: Ex-captain who defended the kingdom and stepped aside for Circulus out of respect.

cards.name: Bass Danish
cards.description: A grandmaster survivalist hailing from a planet dominated by toxic swamps.
cards.description_es: Vivía en un pantano en el que el 98% de la vegetación era venenosa.

cards.name: Beck Heath
cards.description: His family has an esteemed history in traditional theatre.
cards.description_es: Su familia es de una institución en el teatro tradicional de la región.

cards.name: Ben Blowton
cards.description: A player who radiates red-hot enthusiasm. He is exceptionally particular about his headband.

cards.name: Ben Simmons
cards.description: Lunges for the ball like a mad dog. Size doesn't matter. Once he's on, he won't let go.

cards.name: Bhaga Guni
cards.description: Built like a tank, he was scouted from a planet with crushing gravity.
cards.description_es: Entrenó en un planeta cuya gravedad es 80 veces mayor que en la tierra.

cards.name: Bill Steakspear
cards.description: This steakhouse owner restores his strength with char-grilled meat.
cards.description_es: Dueño de un asadero. ¡Sus filetes dan energía para todo el día!

cards.name: Billy Miller
cards.description: Built the school's football club from nothing through pure grit, never losing sight of the joy of the game.

cards.name: Bobine Apples
cards.description: A lively lady who loves a bit of fun. Often heard whistling to herself.
cards.description_es: Una anciana encantadora y alegre que se pasa el día silbando.

cards.name: Brimstone Bol
cards.description: Keeps a cool face but hates to lose, quietly eyeing a future seat among the Purple Emperors.
cards.description_es: Quiere mucho a su mascota pero es muy negativo con las personas.

cards.name: Caesar Pike
cards.description: Built like a brute but disciplined, he fuels his strength with a steady diet of seafood.
cards.description_es: De complexión robusta pero disciplinado. Su fuerza es el resultado de una dieta a base de marisco.

cards.name: Cam Mando
cards.description: The Forest Team's formidable commander is well known for his survival tactics.
cards.description_es: El capitán del equipo. Es un maestro de las técnicas de supervivencia.

cards.name: Cannon Random
cards.description: His family's garden is a treasure trove of priceless antique artefacts.
cards.description_es: De vez en cuando halla antigüedades en el jardín de su casa.

cards.name: Carles Ripoll
cards.description: A defender with explosive speed whose synergy with Xavi is a joy to watch.

cards.name: Chase Faithfull
cards.description: The team's deputy faithfully follows his leader.
cards.description_es: El teniente del equipo. Admira profundamente al capitán.

cards.name: Chitoh
cards.description: He looks gentle, but has a terrifying personality. Don't cross this goalie.
cards.description_es: Este portero parece inofensivo, pero en realidad es un enemigo temible.

cards.name: Chris Ticker
cards.description: The team's drill sergeant. Can he really have eyes made from a digital watch?
cards.description_es: El que pasa lista del equipo. Lleva un reloj digital en los ojos.

cards.name: Cygnus Starkey
cards.description: He values team harmony and authority, showing no mercy to anyone slacking in practice.
cards.description_es: Aprecia la armonía y disciplina en su equipo. Es implacable con los que se escaquean al entrenar.

cards.name: Daffyd Blayne
cards.description: Spent a year alone in the mountains honing his skills to perfection.
cards.description_es: Pasó un año solo en las montañas perfeccionando sus técnicas.

cards.name: Daniel Dawson
cards.description: Loves being close to nature. Often seen running barefoot in summer.
cards.description_es: Le encanta notar la tierra bajo sus pies, por eso siempre va descalzo.

cards.name: Daniel Hatch
cards.description: Fearless vanguard who charges upfield and fires explosive shots with his long legs.
cards.description_es: Delantero estrella de la Royal. Sus largas piernas son su mejor arma

cards.name: Dante Diavolo
cards.description: He's always riding his bike. He hopes to represent Italy as a cyclist.
cards.description_es: Va a todos lados en bici porque quiere representar a Italia en el Tour de Francia.

cards.name: Despina Lux
cards.description: While once beloved by children, past despair has hardened her into someone almost unrecognizable.
cards.description_es: De pequeña era muy buena pero su pasado la ha cambiado.

cards.name: Domitri Sobirov
cards.description: Captain of the Storm Wolves, leading more with his play than with words.
cards.description_es: Capitán del Storm Wolves. Es más de hechos que palabras.

cards.name: Dryden Zephyr
cards.description: Known as the "Desert Rose," he is an entrancing but dangerous player.
cards.description_es: "El áspid" es un futbolista que aúna técnica depurada y juego duro.

cards.name: Eric Purpleton
cards.description: Wimbledon was calling for this talented player, but an arm injury signaled a move to football.
cards.description_es: Estuvo a punto de jugar en Wimbledon; pero, se rompió el brazo, se pasó al fútbol.

cards.name: Fedrin Fennley
cards.description: Hard to read and even harder to rattle, he supports the team with calm, razor-sharp advice.

cards.name: Filbert Weissman
cards.description: A formidable striker whose eyes are always on the goal.
cards.description_es: Fantástico delantero que siempre lleva el gol entre ceja y ceja.

cards.name: Friedrich Schiller
cards.description: An aggressive and instinctive player. Does "Schiller" remind you of anyone?
cards.description_es: "Schiller"... Suena alemán. Quizá por eso su juego es ordenado y efectivo.

cards.name: Frost
cards.description: He gets in trouble with his own teammates for his cold behavior.
cards.description_es: Tiene el corazón de hielo y hasta sus compañeros le temen.

cards.name: Garjan Cypress
cards.description: This lazy, laid-back loafer has a tree growing out of his head.
cards.description_es: Es el más holgazán del equipo. Se ve que le creció un árbol en la cabeza.

cards.name: Geert Vandevijf
cards.description: Takes pictures of lighthouses at night. Wants to tour the world someday.
cards.description_es: Colecciona fotos nocturnas de faros. Su sueño es ver todos los del mundo.

cards.name: Gele
cards.description: Not a single enemy movement escapes his intense, piercing gaze.
cards.description_es: Observa los movimientos del rival con su mirada penetrante.

cards.name: Gervasio Oliveira
cards.description: His big plan is to start an international biofuel business in Brazil.
cards.description_es: Su meta es fundar una empresa internacional de biocombustibles en Brasil.

cards.name: Gianluca Zanardi
cards.description: He works as a gondolier in Venice to improve his strength and balance.
cards.description_es: Trabajó como gondolero en Venecia para mejorar su equilibrio y hacerse más fuerte.

cards.name: Goldus Janque
cards.description: This flashy show-off of a player was summoned by Grandfather.
cards.description_es: Un jugador bastante fanfarrón convocado por el Abuelo.

cards.name: Grisley Bear
cards.description: A dangerous boy who likes to injure others and has the strength to do so.
cards.description_es: Muy peligroso. Busca lesionar a los demás y tiene la fuerza para hacerlo.

cards.name: Hadrian Diesel
cards.description: Cold, gleaming eyes hide a fiery ambition that keeps him pushing full-throttle, even when ahead.

cards.name: Hamilton Reith
cards.description: This player's hobby is free diving for tropical fish amid the coral reefs.
cards.description_es: Le pirran los peces tropicales de los arrecifes de coral. Tubo, gafas, aletas... ¡y al agua patos!.

cards.name: Hans Randall
cards.description: Competed on the national junior stage. Dreams of being Raimon's ace striker.
cards.description_es: Hábil jugador que llegó a debutar en el campeonato de cadetes.

cards.name: Harry Boufante
cards.description: The Forest Team's trend setter is justly proud of his flowing locks.
cards.description_es: El presumido lider del equipo. Está orgulloso de su larga melena.

cards.name: Hastar Savitar
cards.description: Discovered by Arculus on a planet with a lethal, gas-filled environment and promptly scouted.
cards.description_es: Está genéticamente modificado por una explosión de gas espacial.

cards.name: Herschel De Villiers
cards.description: He has an affinity with wild beasts. They say he once rode on a lion's back.
cards.description_es: Se le dan bien los animales salvajes. Dicen que una vez cabalgó a lomos de un león.

cards.name: Holt Northam
cards.description: Calm off the pitch, his piercing gaze on game day tracks every move to block the goal.
cards.description_es: Tranquilo fuera del campo, pero durante los partidos protege la portería de goles rivales bajo su atenta mirada.

cards.name: Ian Suffolk
cards.description: A student guidance teacher who used to need guidance himself.
cards.description_es: Aunque es el más gamberro de la zona, es el más educado de todos.

cards.name: Ian Suffolk
cards.description: The baddest boy in town. Strangely enough, his manners are impeccable.
cards.description_es: Aunque es el más gamberro de la zona, es el más educado de todos.

cards.name: Ian Suffolk
cards.description: The baddest boy in town. Strangely enough, his manners are impeccable.
cards.description_es: Aunque es el más gamberro de la zona, es el más educado de todos.

cards.name: Igor Ferreira
cards.description: He's an avid consumer of paella, but he's really fussy about the type of rice.
cards.description_es: Le encanta la paella, pero solo se la come si el arroz está a su punto.

cards.name: Isaac César
cards.description: An opportunist on and off the pitch. If he sees a beautiful girl, he'll try to charm her.
cards.description_es: Un oportunista dentro y fuera del campo. Las chicas bonitas son su debilidad.

cards.name: Jacques Cinquini
cards.description: Able to turn the tiniest opening into an attacking opportunity.
cards.description_es: Sabe aprovechar cualquier minúsculo resquicio para iniciar un ataque.

cards.name: Jean Darc
cards.description: Has no flashy moves of his own, but provides valuable support to the team.
cards.description_es: No destaca en acciones individuales, pero aporta mucho al equipo.

cards.name: Jim Wraith
cards.description: Gives off spooky, ghostly vibes, but all he really wants is to be noticed.
cards.description_es: Nadie ha podido ver jamás la mirada que esconde detrás de su flequillo.

cards.name: Joan Asensi
cards.description: A natural finisher who's fiercely competitive with a fire that drives him forward.

cards.name: Joe Ingram
cards.description: No matter the situation, he always has a joke to lighten the mood.
cards.description_es: Chaval gracioso al que le gusta bromear incluso en momentos duros.

cards.name: John Bloom
cards.description: A naturally rough player. He runs wild on the pitch.
cards.description_es: El juego duro es lo suyo. Corre que se las pela por todo el campo.

cards.name: Jonas Polk
cards.description: He hopes to fly to Mars in a rocket of his own design one day.
cards.description_es: Le gustaría diseñar un cohete que pueda viajar hasta Marte.

cards.name: Jordi Belloch
cards.description: With a strikingly handsome face, he's adored by fans and fearlessly charges into sliding tackles.

cards.name: Josh Nathaniel
cards.description: Likes a regular life and working for a regular company.
cards.description_es: Su sueño es ser oficinista. No le gusta ser diferente a los demás.

cards.name: Josh Nathaniel
cards.description: He fears sticking out from the crowd and craves an average hum-drum life.
cards.description_es: Su sueño es ser oficinista. No le gusta ser diferente a los demás.

cards.name: Josh Nathaniel
cards.description: He fears sticking out from the crowd and craves an average hum-drum life.
cards.description_es: Su sueño es ser oficinista. No le gusta ser diferente a los demás.

cards.name: Judas Deathcap
cards.description: This foolish young chap has a mushroom on his head he likes to call "Max."
cards.description_es: El pardillo del equipo. La seta de su cabeza se llama Pinon.

cards.name: Julien Rousseau
cards.description: He likes to play with a rose clamped between his teeth. How very pretentious.
cards.description_es: Siempre lleva una rosa en la boca cuando salta al césped. ¡Está hecho un teatrero!

cards.name: Junior Fardream
cards.description: This mysterious guy toots on a flute as he wanders around the country.
cards.description_es: Chico misterioso que toca la flauta mientras viaja.

cards.name: Kent Work
cards.description: He prefers a toolbox to a regular bag at school, so stands out a lot.
cards.description_es: Chico raro que utiliza hatillo en vez de mochila para ir al instituto.

cards.name: Kerry Bootgaiter
cards.description: She loves snow and runs around her snowy garden laughing like mad.

cards.name: Kia Tanner
cards.description: A football-loving girl shrouded in mystery who's often seen wearing an identical bracelet to the team's furry mascot, Rocco.

cards.name: Kiko Calavento
cards.description: The team's spark and resident straight-shooter, he keeps his pace even through the toughest drills.
cards.description_es: El motor del equipo y el más sensato de todos. Mantiene el ritmo incluso en los entrenamientos más duros.

cards.name: Laike Alder
cards.description: Researches ways to restore polluted lakes and marshes back to normal.
cards.description_es: Investiga cómo limpiar los lagos y pantanos contaminados.

cards.name: Laven
cards.description: Aster's dupli midfielder. Deeply suspicious, he doesn't trust anyone.
cards.description_es: Medio y duplicado de Aster. Es tan desconfiado que no habla con nadie.

cards.name: Ludeau
cards.description: Nothing will stop him now that he's found somewhere he can show off.
cards.description_es: Su afición por pavonearse delante de todo el mundo lo hace imparable.

cards.name: Mac Emake
cards.description: Excellent at cooking on a stove. Can always find the perfect temperature.
cards.description_es: Su especialidad es cocinar estofados a la temperatura perfecta.

cards.name: Majdi Ismail
cards.description: As a hobby, this player likes to collect reptiles in the desert and frighten little girls with them.
cards.description_es: Le encanta atrapar reptiles en el desierto y luego asustar a las niñas con ellos.

cards.name: Marismus Oregon
cards.description: A fearsome player, but beneath that tough exterior is a big blubbing softy.
cards.description_es: Su cara da miedo, pero es el romántico del equipo.

cards.name: Mehr
cards.description: Midfielder and captain of Gihl, known through all N-Gen for her stunning beauty.
cards.description_es: Todos los integrantes de Nu-Gen conocen a la capitana del Gir.

cards.name: Melisizwe Zamani
cards.description: He says that mutton is a versatile and delicious meat, and won't hear otherwise.
cards.description_es: Afirma que la carne de carnero es versátil y deliciosa y no piensa dar su brazo a torcer.

cards.name: Musa Sylla
cards.description: This player wants to improve Qatar's manufacturing base and diversify.
cards.description_es: Quiere mejorar la producción industrial de Catar y dedicarse a su exportación.

cards.name: Nathan Tswane
cards.description: He lets an ostrich chase him to train his legs and balance.
cards.description_es: Deja que le persiga un avestruz para reforzar sus piernas y ganar velocidad.

cards.name: Neil Turner
cards.description: Stepping up as captain after Thomas, he thrives with cutting-edge tools and tech-driven play.

cards.name: Nick Woodgate
cards.description: He's seriously thinking about opening a school for wizards.
cards.description_es: No bromea cuando dice que quiere abrir una escuela para magos.

cards.name: Nuel
cards.description: This chap's magical powers come in useful on the pitch, and all the girls love him.
cards.description_es: Sus poderes mágicos resultan muy útiles en el campo. Causa furor entre las chicas.

cards.name: Nyira Fezun
cards.description: Fated rivals with Aoba, they called a temporary truce to face a planetary crisis together.
cards.description_es: Rival sano de Aoba. Sería capaz de dar su vida por él.

cards.name: Oleander Meadows
cards.description: Exceptional athleticism and pinpoint passes let him set up goals and carry the team forward.
cards.description_es: Extremadamente atlético y milimétrico en sus pases Sus jugadas son ocasión de gol y su energía es contagiosa.

cards.name: Orville Newman
cards.description: Hones his willpower by standing in a waterfall every morning.
cards.description_es: ﻿Cada mañana se planta bajo una cascada para fortalecer la mente.

cards.name: Ottorino Nobili
cards.description: Can spin out the perfect pizza dough with sheer force.
cards.description_es: Es de Pisa y quiere que sus ciudad esté orgullosa de sus logros.

cards.name: Paul Appleton
cards.description: He'd love to get the old band together for one last reunion, but the guys aren't having it.
cards.description_es: Quiere dar un concierto de despedida con su grupo, pero los demás no están por la labor.

cards.name: Percy Hurst
cards.description: An indomitable, hot-blooded rookie who runs like he's got wings when on the pitch.

cards.name: Petey Sorcar
cards.description: Enjoys surprising others with sleight of hand. Always inventing new tricks.
cards.description_es: Le gusta sorprender a los demás con trucos que siempre está inventando.

cards.name: Puddel Khaspian
cards.description: Quiet and seemingly strong, but actually the loneliest member of the team.
cards.description_es: Tiene mucha fuerza a pesar de su tamaño. Es muy solitaria.

cards.name: Quinque Flores
cards.description: Considers all who oppose him to be evil, and football a kind of purification.
cards.description_es: Cree malignos a quienes se enfrentan a él. Intenta purificarlos con el fútbol.

cards.name: Reg Underwood
cards.description: Accepted brainwashing to become a pro and help his poor family.
cards.description_es: Se sometió al experimento para sacar a su familia de la miseria.

cards.name: Robert Skipolson
cards.description: This boy came from the far north and loves rollmop herrings.
cards.description_es: Procede del extremo norte del país. Le encanta el arenque.

cards.name: Rocky Black
cards.description: This tireless player remorselessly blocks all goal-bound balls.
cards.description_es: Es como un perro guardián que ahuyenta a los balones.

cards.name: Roland Climbstein
cards.description: Core strength from snowboarding is his weapon. Expert in all winter sports.

cards.name: Rolland Bowlby
cards.description: Once bullied, this tearful boy now works harder than anyone and never gives up.
cards.description_es: Aunque era el blanco de los matones, ahora este chico de lágrima fácil trabaja más duro que ninguna otra persona.

cards.name: Ron Innwater
cards.description: This defender flits around the pitch like a ghost to sweep the ball away.
cards.description_es: Este defensa se desliza por el campo como un alma en pena.

cards.name: Roy Daring
cards.description: A good-looking guy, but there's no one to admire him in the deep, dark forest.
cards.description_es: El guapo del equipo. Aunque donde vive eso no tiene importancia.

cards.name: Ruger Baran
cards.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors, his combination moves with his brother Gandares never cease to amaze.
cards.description_es: Jugador del Falam Medius. Hace una dupla letal con Gandares.

cards.name: Sean Muller
cards.description: Despite his tough appearance, he needs a big woolly scarf to keep warm.
cards.description_es: Parece duro, pero le afecta mucho el frío. Con una bufanda es invencible.

cards.name: Sean Snowfield
cards.description: He studies snowflakes and has filled thirty books with his observations.

cards.name: Simon Calier
cards.description: Runs up and down the stairs to his top-floor flat to train his legs.
cards.description_es: Para fortalecer sus piernas, sube y baja las escaleras de su edificio.

cards.name: Slot MacHines
cards.description: A compulsive gambler known to play high-stakes on football matches.
cards.description_es: Tahúr errante. En los partidos se juega también el todo por el todo.

cards.name: Ted Poe
cards.description: A university professor who uses such difficult words, nobody can understand him.
cards.description_es: Profesor de universidad. Habla raro y no hay quien le entienda.

cards.name: Tet Aqua
cards.description: His slick technique and elegant looks have earned him his own fan club.
cards.description_es: Es muy popular entre las fans por su físico y su juego perfectos.

cards.name: Tez Beyan
cards.description: Elder of two brothers. A keen actor who enjoys portraying deep emotions.
cards.description_es: Este leal delantero de rostro juvenil es la mano derecha de Alfa.

cards.name: Tez Beyan
cards.description: A striker with a sweet, youthful face. Loyal second-in-command to Alpha.
cards.description_es: Este leal delantero de rostro juvenil es la mano derecha de Alfa.

cards.name: Tod Ironside
cards.description: Raimon's lovable class clown who never gets out-hustled on guts and grit.
cards.description_es: Su cuerpo es pequeño, pero su coraje enorme. Da vidilla al equipo.

cards.name: Todd Stuhl
cards.description: A greedy-guts who can't get enough of those sautéed woodland mushrooms.
cards.description_es: El glotón del equipo. Le encantan las setas salteadas.

cards.name: Tyler Thomas
cards.description: A talented tailor who makes bespoke suits for his friends just for fun.
cards.description_es: Mide a sus amigos y les hace ropa para coger experiencia.

cards.name: Tyler Thomas
cards.description: A talented tailor who makes bespoke suits for his friends just for fun.
cards.description_es: Mide a sus amigos y les hace ropa para coger experiencia.

cards.name: Vince Sizor
cards.description: A ferociously strong goalie. They say that under his mask he has sharp fangs...
cards.description_es: Se dice que este portero oculta bajo la máscara unos colmillos gigantes.

cards.name: William Glass
cards.description: A self-proclaimed popular guy who looks great in glasses, he may come off as vain, but his Otaku knowledge is the real deal.
cards.description_es: ﻿Un triunfador al que le quedan bien las gafas. O eso dice él...

cards.name: William Glass
cards.description: Otaku squad leader and proud nerd. Glasses dreams of making their own indie game.
cards.description_es: Líder de un grupo de hackers. Solo juega a la consola con sus amigos.

cards.name: Winston Falls
cards.description: Puts his ninja experience to use before every match as a spy.
cards.description_es: Gran espía que no destaca sobre el terreno de juego, sino fuera de él.

cards.name: Wittz
cards.description: A dangerous player who pretends to shoot, only to scatter the opponent with the ball.
cards.description_es: Apunta a rivales con su chut para que salgan por los aires.

cards.name: Wolfram Vulpeen
cards.description: A warrior descended from the great Vulpeen clan, as wild as he looks.
cards.description_es: Este guerrero parece salvaje, pero descendiente del gran clan Vulpeen.

cards.name: Wolfram Vulpeen
cards.description: Wolfram's Mix 'n' Matched werewolf form!
cards.description_es: Este guerrero parece salvaje, pero descendiente del gran clan Vulpeen.

cards.name: Woodrow Stake
cards.description: A supernaturally gifted striker with hypnotically elegant form.
cards.description_es: Un delantero de pericia sobrehumana que hipnotiza a todos con su juego.

cards.name: York Nashmith
cards.description: Loves nothing more than a nap on the roof. Fortunately, he lives in a bungalow.

cards.name: Zohen
cards.description: Blocks the goalmouth with the huge frame he bulked up through martial arts.
cards.description_es: Domina las artes marciales y corta el paso a cualquiera con su cuerpo.

cards.name: A'ddah
cards.description: Leverages his strong build for powerful plays, but is timid and drifts along like shifting sand.
cards.description_es: Tiene un físico muy potente y lo aprovecha en cada partido.

cards.name: Adam Ropes
cards.description: He might not look the type, but he loves a nice romantic sunset.
cards.description_es: No le pega, pero es un romántico enamorado de las vistas nocturnas.

cards.name: Al Kazam
cards.description: Heir to a family of traditional dancers. His strict upbringing has left its mark.
cards.description_es: Recibió una educación estricta en una familia de bailarines tradicionales.

cards.name: Alan Most
cards.description: He is unable to succeed at anything without his parents' advice.
cards.description_es: Le sale mal todo lo que hace, pero mejora con los consejos paternos.

cards.name: Alex Hawke
cards.description: He insists that he can read the signs in nature to predict the weather.
cards.description_es: Puede pronosticar el tiempo a través de las señales de la naturaleza.

cards.name: Alfred Meenan
cards.description: Fashion-forward and trend-obsessed, his wardrobe changes faster than the scoreboard.

cards.name: Antoni Valls
cards.description: A full-back with world-class stamina and technique, earning him a reputation among the elite.

cards.name: Balcke
cards.description: He looks cheerful, but is he really smiling behind the sunglasses?
cards.description_es: Parece muy alegre, pero las gafas de sol esconden unos ojos tristes.

cards.name: Barnabas Rossa
cards.description: Obsessed with seabirds, he spends weekends on the coast with binoculars.
cards.description_es: Especialista en balones aéreos, es una buena baza ante la portería.

cards.name: Bernadette Stoker
cards.description: She gets annoyed at anyone who shows up late—except herself.
cards.description_es: Sus tácticas son tan peligrosas como el fuego. Sus oponentes suelen acabar escaldados.

cards.name: Bhufa
cards.description: To enable him to save more goals, he installed a nanodevice into his eye.
cards.description_es: Gracias al implante que tiene en el ojo es un guardameta de cuidado.

cards.name: Bobby Bruce
cards.description: Often claims that his muscles are his life. His hobby is bench pressing.
cards.description_es: Dice que vive para sus músculos y dedica mucho tiempo a hacer pesas.

cards.name: Braveon Halvors
cards.description: Forever burning with competitive fire, he smashes through defences with unstoppable force.
cards.description_es: Su espíritu competitivo le motiva a seguir adelante. Arrasa con la defensa enemiga con una fuerza imparable.

cards.name: Brook Bold
cards.description: The most prone to declare his undying love. Also the most used to rejection.
cards.description_es: Confiesa inmediatamente su amor cuando se encapricha. No pierde ante nadie cuando se trata de haber experimentado varias dificultades en las relaciones.

cards.name: Buck Tucker
cards.description: Though he loves football, his favorite thing is the post-match fish and chips.
cards.description_es: Lo da todo en el campo para disfrutar de una opípara comida después.

cards.name: Burt Wolf
cards.description: Pale from always doing night shifts. Loves tomato juice.
cards.description_es: Al caer la noche juega como nadie. Bebe mucho zumo de tomate.

cards.name: Cherio Pardon
cards.description: Lost to Circulus in the tournament final, then came back next year to win and join the knights.
cards.description_es: Fue derrotado por Circulus en la final del torneo de luchadores.

cards.name: Coeus Heavens
cards.description: Has been trained to become an elite football player since a very young age.
cards.description_es: Un jugador estrella entrenado desde pequeño para ser el mejor.

cards.name: Colby Columbia
cards.description: His powers of observation never miss a telltale sign or opportunity.
cards.description_es: No se le escapa ningún defecto o desliz del rival.

cards.name: Cole Reef
cards.description: Captain of Big Waves whose surfing skills earn respect even from the pros.
cards.description_es: Capitán del Big Waves y reconocido surfista profesional.

cards.name: Damien Blackloch
cards.description: A mysterious boy. Has travelled far and wide, but no one knows why.
cards.description_es: Tiene un aire misterioso. Viaja la tira, pero nunca le cuenta a nadie porqué.

cards.name: Dan Hopper
cards.description: A super jumper, but the higher he goes, the more likely he is to miss.
cards.description_es: Tiene tal potencia de salto que a veces se eleva más de la cuenta.

cards.name: Darren Gouger
cards.description: Once frail, he rebuilt his body through a strict diet of fresh vegetables and sheer persistence.

cards.name: Deimos Lepton
cards.description: An enraged strike captain fighting to avenge a friend lost during Falam Orbius's invasion.
cards.description_es: Perdió amigos en la batalla por Falam Orbius. Está muy enfadado por ello.

cards.name: Deimos Mars
cards.description: Acts blunt and rough, but really he's incredibly loyal and dutiful.
cards.description_es: Es demasiado brusco en el trato, pero muy leal y responsable.

cards.name: Dom Foreman
cards.description: A council worker supervisor who trains for matches by doing construction work.
cards.description_es: Patrón de obras públicas. El curro de la obra le mantiene en forma.

cards.name: Don Ation
cards.description: The scion of a family who have run an extremely famous temple for centuries.
cards.description_es: Hijo del monje que lleva un templo budista muy famoso y visitado.

cards.name: Duke Dartmouth
cards.description: Opposing teams have been known to tremble at his brutal defensive skills.
cards.description_es: Los rivales lo pasan mal cuando intentan superar su férrea defensa.

cards.name: Eddy O'Ryan
cards.description: Pure sweat and effort has enabled this hawk-eyed player to run like the wind and outpace just about anyone.
cards.description_es: Su esfuerzo y sudor le han permitido a este perspicaz jugador correr como el viento y superar a casi cualquiera.

cards.name: Eddy Steady
cards.description: He stands tall like a mountain in the face of any charge.
cards.description_es: Se comporta como una roca, permanece impasible ante cualquier ataque.

cards.name: Edward Gladstone
cards.description: Always shouting "How rude!" at people wherever he goes.
cards.description_es: Siempre está enfadado. Incluso cuando se ríe frunce el ceño.

cards.name: Edward Gladstone
cards.description: He's always angry about something and looks slightly pained when he smiles.
cards.description_es: Siempre está enfadado. Incluso cuando se ríe frunce el ceño.

cards.name: Edward Gladstone
cards.description: He's always angry about something and looks slightly pained when he smiles.
cards.description_es: Siempre está enfadado. Incluso cuando se ríe frunce el ceño.

cards.name: Erwin Völz
cards.description: He's deeply concerned about environmental issues, and always acts accordingly.
cards.description_es: Le preocupa mucho el cuidado del medio ambiente y siempre actúa en consecuencia.

cards.name: Fivier Saviola
cards.description: A quick thinker whose arithmetic is world-class. The brains of the team.
cards.description_es: Piensa con rapidez, y su calculador cerebro es de gran ayuda al equipo.

cards.name: G'ob
cards.description: Was raised with A'ddah like a brother, which is precisely why their teamwork is beyond great.
cards.description_es: Hermano de Addah. Se llevan muy mal y se insultan todo el tiempo.

cards.name: Galen Thunderbird
cards.description: Swears by frog oil for every injury and swabs it on anyone hurt.
cards.description_es: Da aceite de sapo a los lesionados porque dice que es mano de santo.

cards.name: Garret Hairtown
cards.description: His friends won't let him cut their hair. Not after what happened last time...
cards.description_es: Como hace peinados excéntricos, nadie se deja cortar el pelo por él.

cards.name: Gayle Revel
cards.description: She gets very excited by carnivals and runs wild around the floats.
cards.description_es: En los festivales se emociona y lleva los templetes como una loca.

cards.name: Gerald Fuss
cards.description: When the moon glows red, he really comes into his own...
cards.description_es: Cuando hay luna llena, le cambia la personalidad completamente...

cards.name: Geraldo Enrique
cards.description: He sees the world differently, turning even a simple stone into a work of art.

cards.name: Giorgio Giannini
cards.description: He's from a well-established family, but he's not one to rest on his laurels.
cards.description_es: Este chico es un recetario con patatas. Conoce infinidad de platos de pasta.

cards.name: Hank Tennyson
cards.description: This international soul-surfer spends his life in pursuit of the ultimate wave.
cards.description_es: Surfista internacional con un único sueño: conquistar la ola perfecta.

cards.name: Hasan Ahmed
cards.description: This forward is known as the Eagle of Qatar for his swooping attacks.
cards.description_es: Le apodan el Halcón Catarí porque se tira en picado a por el balón.

cards.name: Heinrich Farber
cards.description: Because of his strange hobby of sharpening knives, he is often mistaken for a baddy.
cards.description_es: Muchos lo toman por un delincuente porque se pasa el día afilando navajas.

cards.name: Hippos Kohlt
cards.description: If wishes were horses, every goalie would be as good as this one.
cards.description_es: Cuando se pone ante la portería, es como un caballo desbocado.

cards.name: Ike Steiner
cards.description: Looks after his five brothers while his parents work the farm.
cards.description_es: Cuida de sus cinco hermanitos en sustitución de sus padres.

cards.name: Joe Small
cards.description: Maintains his health by drinking fresh goat milk every day.
cards.description_es: Está fortachón porque bebe todas las mañanas la leche de su cabra.

cards.name: Jonathan Seller
cards.description: This solitary player is made to feel he's under immense pressure to win.
cards.description_es: Solitario muchacho que padece la necesidad de ganar a toda costa.

cards.name: Jonathan Seller
cards.description: Fiercely competitive and a diligent scout, but pressure ties his stomach in knots.

cards.name: Joshua Bleak
cards.description: A contemplative youth with a gift for poetry. Snaps out of it on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Un poeta muy romántico que, sin embargo, se transforma cuando juega.

cards.name: José Costa
cards.description: He's an experienced and tenacious mountain biker.
cards.description_es: Lo suyo es el ciclismo de fondo, por lo que tiene unas piernas fuertes para defender.

cards.name: K'al
cards.description: Aggressive but admiring of strength, he's the type to always trail someone he respects.
cards.description_es: Viene de una familia de militares y su fuerza es superior a la del resto.

cards.name: K'aran
cards.description: The Captain of Silica Eleven believes every match should be played fair and square.

cards.name: Katya Felis
cards.description: Uses agile movements to play cat and mouse with her foes.
cards.description_es: Le encanta jugar al gato y al ratón con sus contrincantes.

cards.name: Keenan Sharpe
cards.description: A wannabe detective with a mind as sharp as his eyes who yearns for a case or two to crack.
cards.description_es: Muy observador y bueno para razonar. Su sueño es convertirse en detective.

cards.name: Keenan Sharpe
cards.description: In his early years, Keenan spent his days playing with his father, already dreaming of following in his detective footsteps.
cards.description_es: Muy observador y bueno para razonar. Su sueño es convertirse en detective.

cards.name: Keith Wellington
cards.description: The "Horned Buffalo." It is unclear if his hairdo is intentional or not.
cards.description_es: Lo llaman "Búfalo". No se sabe si se peina así aposta.

cards.name: Lee Dinglite
cards.description: A famous period actor's son, he even gets the odd bit part himself.
cards.description_es: Hijo de un actor famoso. Él también actúa de vez en cuando.

cards.name: Lionel Cruz
cards.description: He makes incredible pork sausages. It's like a hobby for him.
cards.description_es: Le chiflan las salchicas y sabe hacerlas él mismo: las de cerdo le salen riquísimas.

cards.name: Lucan Stag
cards.description: The oldest member and captain of Fertilia Eleven, he's lived far longer than most of his kind.
cards.description_es: Capitán de Los Fertilia. Es el más longevo del equipo.

cards.name: Lukas Schmidt
cards.description: He loves tanks, so he's taking a tour of all the tank museums in Europe.
cards.description_es: Quiere visitar todos los museos militares de Europa porque le encantan los tanques.

cards.name: Luke Kayon
cards.description: A proud Vulpeen family warrior, he has never bowed his head to anyone.
cards.description_es: Orgulloso guerrero del clan Vulpeen que no se doblega ante nadie.

cards.name: Manning Moon
cards.description: Able to predict the night's weather just by reading the morning sky.
cards.description_es: Con solo mirar al cielo puede predecir el tiempo que hará por la noche.

cards.name: Marshall Heart
cards.description: A martial arts teacher known for breaking down his opponents.
cards.description_es: "Sensei" de artes marciales. Con su flexibilidad esquiva todo ataque.

cards.name: Max Fortune
cards.description: There's a rumor that touching this guy's ears brings good fortune.
cards.description_es: Dicen que si le tocas las orejas,te pasan cosas buenas.

cards.name: Mole
cards.description_es: Ha fortalecido tanto sus pulmones que ahora le da asco el aire normal.

cards.name: Mona Selene
cards.description: Loves chasing round things. Football matches are her favorite things ever.
cards.description_es: Como le encanta correr detrás de una pelota, el fútbol es su gran pasión.

cards.name: Nasir Mustafa
cards.description: A scion of a powerful tribe, he cannot return home unless it is to announce victory.
cards.description_es: Descendiente de una familia importante. Solo volverá a casa para anunciar su victoria.

cards.name: Nevado Condorum
cards.description: Magmavia Eleven's most passionate player, intense and unstoppable once he takes a liking to you.
cards.description_es: Mediocentro que está de moda en el planeta Magmavís.

cards.name: Parry Waxon
cards.description: This player blocks his opponents with direct, decisive moves.
cards.description_es: No duda en ningún momento. Bloquea al contrario con su juego directo.

cards.name: Pedro Moreno
cards.description: He's raising a black Iberian pig at home, in the hope of producing tasty ham.
cards.description_es: Cría cerdos ibéricos en casa para producir toneladas de delicioso jamón serrano.

cards.name: Pen Teller
cards.description: A trickster who mixes in just enough truth to make his lies undetectable.
cards.description_es: Embaucador nato que deja ver solo lo justo de sus verdaderas intenciones.

cards.name: Peter Cole
cards.description: A music buff who insists that the British music scene is the best in the world.
cards.description_es: Vive convencido de que la música británica es la mejor del mundo.

cards.name: Peter Drent
cards.description: This young giant is capable of ground-shaking skills.

cards.name: Piers Thornton
cards.description: He anchors the defence with sharp awareness and nerves of steel, unfazed even against tough odds.

cards.name: Reed Maind
cards.description: Though of average build, his sixth sense allows him to dominate midfield.
cards.description_es: Poco dotado físicamente, controla el partido gracias a su sexto sentido..

cards.name: Reggie Ines
cards.description: He's taking a stand against the illegal hunting of wild pachyderms.
cards.description_es: Está completamente en contra de la caza indiscriminada de paquidermos salvajes.

cards.name: Riley Jamm
cards.description: His slippery movements confound, confuse and confuddle his opponents.
cards.description_es: Sus movimientos engañosos confunden al contrario.

cards.name: Roland Pérec
cards.description: He spends his free time watching the world go by in Parisian-style café society.
cards.description_es: Su pasatiempo favorito es sentarse en una cafetería y ver pasar a la gente por la calle.

cards.name: Ryuun Cho
cards.description: On top of being handsome, he's brainy and athletic! Talk about lucky.
cards.description_es: Además de guapo, es intelectual y está en forma. ¡Es que lo tiene todo!

cards.name: S'haha
cards.description: Struggles to act on his own and searches for someone to give him the right instructions.
cards.description_es: No sabe actuar sin recibir órdenes del capitán o el entrenador.

cards.name: Sachinel
cards.description: He has magical power, but at heart he's a joker who loves to entertain.
cards.description_es: Tiene poderes mágicos, pero no es más que un bromista y le gusta entretener a la gente.

cards.name: Sam Kincaid
cards.description: Often the punchline on Raimon's team, with hair that shouts louder than he ever does.
cards.description_es: Va siempre a su ritmo, aunque los demás le chinchen por ello.

cards.name: Samuel Mayo
cards.description: This plucky Pamplonica dreams of one day showing his mettle at the Running of the Bulls.
cards.description_es: Este intrépido pamplonica sueña con correr en los encierros de San Fermín.

cards.name: Santelmo Phyre
cards.description: Midfielder who lives for aquatic shoulder wars, Pirates Cove's wildest event.
cards.description_es: Es muy competitivo y juega mejor cuando se ve rodeado por los rivales.

cards.name: Serban Bacha
cards.description: Can read Aethyrs, yet his innocence makes him take jokes and lies at face value.
cards.description_es: Un tipo de corazón puro que bromea con sus amigos constantemente.

cards.name: Shaun Bonce
cards.description: Has a tendency to take scissors to his hair when disappointed in love...
cards.description_es: Se hace trasquilones cada vez que le dan calabazas. Y así tiene la cabeza...

cards.name: Sid Safehouse
cards.description: Anyone he is assigned to protect can rest easier in their beds.
cards.description_es: Si protege a alguien, su seguridad está totalmente garantizada.

cards.name: Socrat Eiss
cards.description: Son of the president of a major book store chain. His house is full of books.
cards.description_es: Su padre es dueño de una cadena de librerías y su casa está llena de libros.

cards.name: Tom Skipper
cards.description: He wants nothing more than to sail the high seas as a pirate king.
cards.description_es: Hoy también surcará los mares. ¿Querrá ser el rey de los piratas?

cards.name: Trent Peggs
cards.description: He can cook dinner on a single piece of coal on his stove.
cards.description_es: Puede cocinar cualquier plato con solo un pedazo de carbón.

cards.name: Tyke Wando
cards.description: He uses martial arts handed down by a secret group that protects Kyoto.
cards.description_es: Sucesor de un comando secreto que protege Kioto con artes marciales.

cards.name: Van Tarel
cards.description: Follows any order from Plink to the letter, no matter how difficult.
cards.description_es: Solo es fiel a las órdenes que le da Plink.

cards.name: William Glass
cards.description: A self-proclaimed popular guy who looks great in glasses, he may come off as vain, but his Otaku knowledge is the real deal.
cards.description_es: ﻿Un triunfador al que le quedan bien las gafas. O eso dice él...

cards.name: Xavi Casals
cards.description: A versatile player at the top of his game, with a soft spot for cute character merch.

cards.name: Xavier Shotwell
cards.description: The "Quicksand Terror." The strongest shots just seem to sink into his hands.
cards.description_es: Apodado "Arenas movedizas", sus guantes engullen cualquier disparo.

cards.name: Xenon Reith
cards.description: Always tweaking his look and mannerisms to stand out, yet still frustrated that he barely registers within the team.
cards.description_es: Es el único del equipo que nunca muestra un ápice de preocupación.

cards.name: Yuh
cards.description: This striker's chief weapons are a cool head and an icy smile.
cards.description_es: Las armas de este delantero son su impasibilidad y su enigmática sonrisa.

cards.name: Yusuf Massoud
cards.description: This player deeply respects tribal traditions, and wouldn't like to live away from home.
cards.description_es: Respeta profundamente las tradiciones de su país y no le gustaría vivir muy lejos de casa.

cards.name: Zell
cards.description: Has total confidence in his own skill, and blames those around him when things go wrong.
cards.description_es: Confía plenamente en su destreza y culpa a los demás si algo sale mal.

cards.name: Aaron Gachinsky
cards.description: A rock-climbing enthusiast who's scaled the famous Greater Chimgan mountain multiple times.
cards.description_es: En sus ratos libres le gusta hacer escalada en grandes montañas.

cards.name: Adam Marunga
cards.description: This player hopes that football can become a tool to end racial discrimination.
cards.description_es: Este jugador piensa que el fútbol puede ser un medio para acabar con el racismo.

cards.name: Adam Ropes
cards.description: He might not look the type, but he loves a nice romantic sunset.

cards.name: Aegir Cepheid
cards.description: Once a scholar and still brilliantly sharp, he even helps draft Ozrock's strategic plans.
cards.description_es: Está completamente involucrado en el malvado plan de Ozrock.

cards.name: Alain Favreau
cards.description: The son of a bicycle repairman. He'd like to help out at the Tour de France one day.
cards.description_es: Su padre repara bicicletas y a él de mayor le gustaría trabajar en el Tour de Francia.

cards.name: Alexander Hausen
cards.description: This player always acts logically, no matter what kind of situation he's in.
cards.description_es: Este jugador siempre actúa guiado por la lógica, sea cual sea la situación.

cards.name: Alfred Meenan
cards.description: Fashion-forward and trend-obsessed, his wardrobe changes faster than the scoreboard.
cards.description_es: Siempre trata de ir al último grito en moda, y para ello viste de marca.

cards.name: Anas Eidah
cards.description: Attacks are like water off a duck's back to this beefy defender.
cards.description_es: Aquel que se enfrente a este robusto defensa tendrá que pagar el pato.

cards.name: Astro Ceres
cards.description: Always doodles zigzag patterns in the empty spaces of his notebook.
cards.description_es: Le gusta hacer dibujos zigzagueantes en sus cuadernos de notas.

cards.name: Banda Crix
cards.description: The team's mood-maker, he's endlessly curious and blessed with extraordinary athleticism.
cards.description_es: Jugador fundamental de Los Fertilia. Posee un gran físico.

cards.name: Beluga
cards.description: A walking contradiction, he's hot-blooded but has an icy stare. His history's a mystery.
cards.description_es: Parece una persona fría, pero tiene muy buen corazón.

cards.name: Blain Chills
cards.description: Skilled at ice fishing; he can drill a perfect hole in the ice with his foot.
cards.description_es: Sabe abrir círculos perfectos en el hielo y luego pesca a través de ellos.

cards.name: Bruce Marlin
cards.description: Rivals had better be careful of this player's kangaroo-style footwork.
cards.description_es: ¡Cuidado con este chico! Su juego de pies es digno de un marsupial.

cards.name: Brutus Nastion
cards.description: A skilled but vicious player, made goalkeeper to curb his violent habits.
cards.description_es: Talentoso pero muy bruto. Lo obligan a jugar de portero para evitar lesiones.

cards.name: Ceram Longicorn
cards.description: A player with no standout traits and no weaknesses, fully trusted by Captain Lucan.
cards.description_es: Este portero no tiene ninguna debilidad. El capitán confía en él.

cards.name: Claude Moreau
cards.description: People come from all over France to try his delicious baguettes.
cards.description_es: Sus baguettes son conocidas en toda Francia. Mmm... ¡Están deliciosas!

cards.name: Cole Ebony
cards.description: Regularly prunes the trees in the local forest to keep them in tip-top shape.
cards.description_es: Se dedica a podar con regularidad los árboles de un bosque cercano.

cards.name: Dora Delight
cards.description: She has an extensive collection of seashells and knows the name of almost all of them.
cards.description_es: Colecciona conchas. Se sabe el nombre de casi todos los moluscos.

cards.name: Drancis Fake
cards.description: An international exchange student who knows all about the world.
cards.description_es: Habla con estudiantes extranjeros y sabe mucho del mundo.

cards.name: Elizabeth Buble
cards.description: A teen idol in Riverside. Wears a skull hairgrip to "goth it up" a bit.
cards.description_es: Ídolo de la ribera, lleva un adorno para el pelo en forma de calavera.

cards.name: Emmanuel Ewerz
cards.description: An accomplished sausage maker who keeps his team well supplied with protein.
cards.description_es: Este fabricante de salchichas provee a su equipo de proteínas de alta calidad.

cards.name: Etna Horx
cards.description: A cute player who's won over all of Magmavia, with skill to match her looks.
cards.description_es: Linda jugadora de Los Magmavís. Su popularidad es bastante alta.

cards.name: Eton Messer
cards.description: He tracks his opponents' movements with mind-blowing precision.
cards.description_es: Sigue los movimientos del contrario muy de cerca. Sus ojos dan miedo.

cards.name: Fedora
cards.description_es: Su juego es tan peligroso que deja a sus rivales hechos cisco.

cards.name: Fumh
cards.description: This defender is the team's mental heart, and bounces shots like a wall.
cards.description_es: Este defensa detiene cualquier pase. Es uno de los pilares del equipo.

cards.name: Garreau
cards.description: Whatever it is, if it doesn't conform to his vision, he's not interested.
cards.description_es: No le interesan las cosas que no se adaptan a su punto de vista.

cards.name: Garret Hairtown
cards.description: A hair salon owner who instinctively gives players a crew-cut.
cards.description_es: Como hace peinados excéntricos, nadie se deja cortar el pelo por él.

cards.name: Grizzler Bruin
cards.description: He'd lacked precision on the pitch, but thanks to Zoolan Rice, he's like a laser now.
cards.description_es: Su juego carecía de precisión, pero eso es agua pasada gracias a Zoolan.

cards.name: Hal Byrd
cards.description: All he ever thinks about is how best to achieve his missions from Fifth Sector.
cards.description_es: Lo único que le importa es cumplir los encargos del Sector Quinto.

cards.name: Hayden Whyrl
cards.description: The star striker at Ivy Selective. A prickly character with a short fuse.
cards.description_es: El delantero más peligroso del Aoba. Estalla cuando se le acercan descuidadamente.

cards.name: Holly Mirror
cards.description: A criminal profiler who gets into the minds of criminals to solve cases.
cards.description_es: Prevé lo que piensan los criminales y evita que ocurran desgracias.

cards.name: Holly Summers
cards.description: He dresses up as Santa every year, but it's pretty sweaty work where he lives.
cards.description_es: Se viste de Papá Noel en Navidad, aunque en su país la gente vaya en bañador.

cards.name: Holly Waters
cards.description: An accomplished footballer who can also beat anyone in pride and vanity.
cards.description_es: Una jugadora extraordinaria cuyo punto flaco es la falta de modestia.

cards.name: Jan Oster
cards.description: This keen amateur mechanic is lucky enough to hail from the home of precision engineering.
cards.description_es: Este mecánico amateur tiene la suerte de vivir en el país de la ingeniería de precisión.

cards.name: Jens Hoffman
cards.description: He's studying at music school in the hopes of surpassing Beethoven.
cards.description_es: Está estudiando en un conservatorio y espera sobrepasar a Beethoven uno de estos días.

cards.name: Jezebeth
cards.description: This player harnesses dark forces to communicate with the animal world.
cards.description_es: Jugadora del inframundo que usa sus poderes para comunicarse con los animales.

cards.name: Jimbo Cellar
cards.description: He baffles his opponents by using strange fencing techniques.
cards.description_es: Domina la esgrima y se mueve de una forma que confunde al contrario.

cards.name: Joe Dawes
cards.description: A stealthy player who creeps up to rivals slowly, then pounces suddenly.
cards.description_es: Tan sigiloso como un felino, siempre está al acecho. Ataca cuando menos te lo esperas.

cards.name: Joon-Ho Hwang
cards.description: A proven forward, but often fades into the shadows of his two standout teammates.
cards.description_es: Aunque es un gran delantero, necesita de 2 mediocentros para brillar.

cards.name: Juan Nadal
cards.description: He eats five meals a day to keep his strength up when he's travelling overseas.

cards.name: Jung-Hoon Yi
cards.description: This player is well thought of for his good manners towards his elders.
cards.description_es: Es muy educado con los mayores.

cards.name: Kayson
cards.description: This obtuse character chooses not to believe a word anyone tells him.
cards.description_es: Es tan escéptico que no se fía ni de su propia sombra.

cards.name: Ken Crackham
cards.description: As well as a footballer, this player is an active conservationist of Australia's rich biodiversity.
cards.description_es: Este jugador lucha por preservar la flora y la fauna de Australia.

cards.name: Khalfan Jibril
cards.description: This player is keen on preserving ancient mosques, and the fine arts of the Middle East.
cards.description_es: Lucha por la conservación de las mezquitas y otras obras de arte de Oriente Medio.

cards.name: Kjell Snapper
cards.description: This player applies the wisdom of the ancients to his style of play.
cards.description_es: El estilo de juego de este futbolista encierra la sabiduría de sus antepasados.

cards.name: Konrad Hardin
cards.description: A fierce, imposing presence whose aggressive play keeps opponents at bay.
cards.description_es: Su presencia en el campo es feroz e imponente. Su estilo de juego agresivo mantiene a los rivales a la raya.

cards.name: Kym Errer
cards.description: She makes up for her small size with an extra helping of boastfulness.
cards.description_es: Aunque es pequeña, en el campo vale por tres jugadores.

cards.name: Lance Rawton
cards.description: Clinging to the rights and privileges of the aristocracy, he asserts his right to lead.
cards.description_es: Como proviene de una familia de aristócratas, se cree con derecho a mandar.

cards.name: Lee Bamboo
cards.description: He has superior sprinting skills and can turn on a dime.
cards.description_es: Puede cambiar la dirección en la que corre en un instante.

cards.name: Linda Shadey
cards.description: A talented spy capable of stealing opponent intel without leaving any traces.
cards.description_es: Espía que obtiene información sobre los enemigos furtivamente.

cards.name: Linder Loper
cards.description: An expert at camouflage, he appears out of nowhere to intercept passes.
cards.description_es: Experto en camuflaje. Cuando no te lo esperas hace zas y aparece a tu lado.

cards.name: Louis Leave
cards.description: This defender's thunderous tackles come thick and fast.
cards.description_es: Defiende el área con embestidas tan violentas como un mar bravo.

cards.name: Macah Psitta
cards.description: Loves bright colors and using repetition in his rhetoric.
cards.description_es: Repite todo lo que le dicen como un loro y adora las galletas.

cards.name: Mark Gambling
cards.description: A famous manga artist, he spends his school days signing books.
cards.description_es: Dibujante en boga cuyos cómics crean adeptos. Su firma se cotiza.

cards.name: Matther Horne
cards.description: Often helps out at the port warehouse, and has the muscles to show for it.
cards.description_es: A veces trabaja como estibador en el puerto. Músculos no le faltan.

cards.name: Maximilian Müller
cards.description: A proud Frankfurter who will never reveal his family's secret mix of seven herbs.
cards.description_es: Este francofortés jamás revelará la receta de las salchichas que hace su familia.

cards.name: Michaël Aron
cards.description: Despite his appearance, he's a master of subtle French cuisine.
cards.description_es: A pesar de su aspecto, este chico tiene un don para la cocina francesa.

cards.name: Michel Morland
cards.description: When it comes to tending vineyards, he's got green fingers for sure.
cards.description_es: Tiene un don para la jardinería, especialmente si se trata de cultivar la vida.

cards.name: Mickey Way
cards.description: A wild-haired goalkeeper who snares every shot with unrelenting precision.
cards.description_es: Un portero de pelo indomable. Detiene cada tiro con una exquisita precisión.

cards.name: Minho Cho
cards.description: The fierce power of tae kwon do kicks are put to good use on the pitch by this player.
cards.description_es: Este futbolista ha sabido darle un buen uso a las clases de taekwondo. ¡Mira como chuta!

cards.name: Nero Night
cards.description: Knows a lot about wild grasses. Often gathers herbs in the countryside.
cards.description_es: Sabe mucho sobre plantas silvestres y le gusta salir a recolectarlas.

cards.name: Newton Flust
cards.description: A professional marksman who can shoot a flea off a dog at 100m.
cards.description_es: Genio del rifle capaz de darle a un pequeño blanco situado a 100 m.

cards.name: Niklas Kuster
cards.description: A brutal player, he's able to overwhelm his rivals with constant attacks.
cards.description_es: Sus brutales embates dejan sin respiración a la defensa enemiga.

cards.name: Nobby Naga
cards.description: Once a benchwarmer, he clawed into the starting lineup through sheer grit and nonstop hustle.
cards.description_es: Se ganó la titularidad con varios goles tras entrar como sustituto.

cards.name: Nora Flexion
cards.description: A striker so skilled that you're never quite sure how she did it.
cards.description_es: Una delantera que a veces parece volverse invisible para los rivales.

cards.name: Orphion Ordain
cards.description: A lover of the sun, he joined the football club just to soak up its warmth on the pitch.

cards.name: Otto Bismark
cards.description: His grandfather was German. Rather straight-laced and by-the-book.
cards.description_es: Su abuelo era alemán. Es disciplinado pero un poco cuadriculado.

cards.name: Peter Banker
cards.description: Believes his tactics will—once perfected—revolutionize football.
cards.description_es: Considera que las tácticas que está investigando son revolucionarias.

cards.name: Plunk Balkhash
cards.description: The team's muscle who handles all the heavy lifting, he's often used as a stepstool by Tinkel.
cards.description_es: Delantero poderoso del equipo. Se apoya bastante en Urmi.

cards.name: Puck Fishley
cards.description: Known for appearing out of nowhere and stealing the ball in a split second.
cards.description_es: Conocido por su habilidad para salir de la nada y robar el balón..

cards.name: Queintas Quillmere
cards.description: Shy in the spotlight, he slips away from defenders with uncanny ease.

cards.name: Redd Hazzard
cards.description: A lively, aggressive player who was summoned by Grandfather.

cards.name: Robert Lee
cards.description: Heir to an ancient two-sword fighting style. His instincts are top-notch.
cards.description_es: Domina la lucha con dos espadas y su instinto está siempre alerta.

cards.name: Romborina Drohn
cards.description: A defender as tough as armor who shrugs off ordinary tackles without a flinch.
cards.description_es: Defensa cuyo cuerpo es fuerte como una armadura. No siente el dolor.

cards.name: S'harqiyah
cards.description: K'aran's close friend and trusted confidant who quietly supports the hot-headed forwards.
cards.description_es: Mejor amigo de K'aran que tiene sangre de delantero puro.

cards.name: Said Ashraf
cards.description: The Captain of Shamshir's style is akin to that of a fierce lion.
cards.description_es: Capitán de Los Cimitarras. Tiene un estilo agresivo como el de un león.

cards.name: Servilius Jeeves
cards.description: He was born into a long line of butlers, so he knows the finer points of entertaining guests.
cards.description_es: Viene de una familia de mayordomos y sabe cómo atender a los demás con elegancia.

cards.name: Shawn Princeton
cards.description: This player has a prodigious knack for finding rare minerals just by reading the landscape.
cards.description_es: Tiene un sexto sentido para encontrar rocas extrañas analizando el terreno de un vistazo.

cards.name: Silasar Noirmont
cards.description: The strict manager of Green Hill's team and a reliable former football enthusiast.

cards.name: Silvain Hache
cards.description: A youth with chilling, cold eyes who was summoned by Grandfather.

cards.name: Sog Galily
cards.description: He notices even the tiniest things and calls them out with surprising courtesy.
cards.description_es: Tipo muy caballeroso que convierte los pequeños detalles en buenos gestos.

cards.name: Soma Lobi
cards.description: Has a unique perspective as he comes from a people whose eyes can see the past.
cards.description_es: Puede ver el pasado de otras personas mirándolas a los ojos.

cards.name: Songhwan Ko
cards.description: Highly skilled in baseball and football, this player cannot decide which to go pro in.

cards.name: Spring Millpond
cards.description: Attacks the ball like a shark and won't let go once it's in his grasp.
cards.description_es: Es como un tiburón. Una vez que agarra la pelota, no lo suelta.

cards.name: Stan Roller
cards.description: A mountain of a lad. His mighty shots blast through anything in their path.
cards.description_es: Un coloso. Ojito con ponerte en medio cuando tira, porque arrasa con todo.

cards.name: Sterling Stanford
cards.description: So strict about regulations that his friends call him a "demon sergeant."
cards.description_es: Es tan estricto con las reglas que lo llaman "el sargento de la vara".

cards.name: Sting Xiang
cards.description: A girl summoned by Grandfather. She looks sweet but she's quite ruthless.

cards.name: Sung-Jin Noh
cards.description: This player dreams of taking K-pop to the world stage. Well, the way things are going...
cards.description_es: Le gustaría que la música pop coreana fuera conocida en todo el mundo.

cards.name: Sylvester Bullet
cards.description: Paints his face with warpaint, but remains surprisingly handsome.
cards.description_es: Siempre lleva pinturas de guerra en la cara, pero no le quedan mal del todo.

cards.name: Terri Ann Thrope
cards.description: Everyone calls her a carnivore, but she swears she's a herbivore.
cards.description_es: Se rumorea que come carne humana pero en realidad es vegetariana.

cards.name: Tez La
cards.description: Can locate his foes through intuition alone. Also a skilled student of Iaido.
cards.description_es: Intuye a los rivales en el campo sin verlos. Su hobby es la táctica militar.

cards.name: Theodor Ulrich
cards.description: With a civilized demeanor and an iron will, he's the model of a German sportsman.
cards.description_es: Su deportividad y su voluntad de hierro hacen de él un ejemplo de atleta alemán.

cards.name: Therion Daywick
cards.description: He spends two hours each morning perfecting his hair and avoids heading the ball at all costs.

cards.name: Thorsten Welger
cards.description: His family are brewers, but he prefers a nice glass of Apfelschorle.
cards.description_es: Su familia elabora cerveza artesanal, pero él prefiere un buen vaso de zumo de manzana.

cards.name: Toby Damian
cards.description: Small but mighty, his insane vertical leap owns the airspace.
cards.description_es: Es pequeñajo, pero su capacidad de salto deja atónito a cualquiera.

cards.name: Turner Fogg
cards.description: He moves as fast and flittery as a bat to unnerve his foes and steal the ball.
cards.description_es: Revolotea por el campo con frenesí en busca del balón.

cards.name: Udom Kaochuea
cards.description: His massive arms unleash elbow strikes powerful enough to drop an opponent in one hit.
cards.description_es: Tiene fuerza en sus brazos y da golpes muy potentes con los codos.

cards.name: Van Yamano
cards.description: An LBX champion with a strong sense of justice and a dedication to fair play.
cards.description_es: Un campeón de LBX muy honorable que siempre defiende el juego limpio.

cards.name: Victor Hills
cards.description: He cleans up his local beaches every day by picking up rubbish.
cards.description_es: Cada día recoge basura y limpia las playas de la isla de Okinawa.

cards.name: Victor Kind
cards.description: He crunches enemy data to predict victory, yet his plans often crumble by overlooking his own limits.

cards.name: Violetto Ametista
cards.description: He's arrogant and pushy, so the other players don't like him all that much.
