cards.description_es: Es arrogante y un poco agresivo. No es muy popular entre los jugadores.

cards.name: William Kidd
cards.description: An adventurous schoolboy who has single-handedly crossed the Pacific.
cards.description_es: Un chico de espíritu aventurero, que cruzó solo y sin ayuda el Pacífico.

cards.name: A'tac
cards.description: A rare red-eyed descendant whose physical ability stands out on the team.
cards.description_es: Tiene los ojos del color de la sangre. Es un arma peligrosa para el equipo.

cards.name: Abigor
cards.description: Using his dark abilities, this player is able to trace and predict the path of the ball.
cards.description_es: Un jugador del inframundo que predice la trayectoria del balón gracias a sus poderes.

cards.name: Al Woo
cards.description: Does vocal practice every day. His howl can be heard for miles.
cards.description_es: Va a clases de canto para aprender a modular sus potentes aullidos.

cards.name: Aleksei Karimov
cards.description: He closes his eyes to block out distractions, relying on wind and sound to defend.
cards.description_es: Mantiene siempre los ojos cerrados y se guía por el viento y el sonido.

cards.name: Alf Holmes
cards.description: At home, he adores his family, but secretly he prefers football.
cards.description_es: Parece el padre modelo, pero si hay partido no hace ni caso a la familia.

cards.name: Asad Gheisari
cards.description: He can't get enough of hobz bread smothered in hummus.
cards.description_es: Juega al fútbol y es cocinero. Su especialidad es la pasta.

cards.name: Astero Black
cards.description: The mysterious manager behind Earth Eleven whose sunglasses hide the madness within.
cards.description_es: Entrenador del Inazuma Japón. Observador y gran estratega.

cards.name: Barack Daniels
cards.description: A jackaroo who dreams of producing the world's tastiest beef someday.
cards.description_es: Aprendiz de ganadero. Sueña con producir la carneHay un error ortográfico en su descripción en la que en vez de "carne" pone "carde". de ternera más sabrosa del mundo.

cards.name: Batal Majid
cards.description: Grew his hair long just to have it cut by a hairstylist.
cards.description_es: Conoce a un gran peluquero japonés el cual le ha estado tratando el pelo.

cards.name: Blown
cards.description: Hyper-alert, he knows what his opponents are going to do before they do.
cards.description_es: Es capaz de prever los movimientos del rival y nunca baja la guardia.

cards.name: Bracknell Forge
cards.description: A dynamic player who charges through opponents, causing them to scatter.
cards.description_es: Da miedo verlo correr. Sus rivales se apartan para que no los arrolle.

cards.name: Callis Jove
cards.description: A charismatic aromatherapist. Able to identify any oil by scent alone.
cards.description_es: Le encanta la aromaterapia. Conoce todos los olores y sus propiedades.

cards.name: Chad Bullford
cards.description: A complete glutton who goes into a rage if he runs out of food.
cards.description_es: Es tan glotón que, si se le acaba la comida, se pone hecho una furia.

cards.name: Corin Cainver
cards.description: A relentless striker, he takes on even injured opponents and chases every goal with unyielding drive.

cards.name: Dan Mirthful
cards.description: Likes nothing better than a good sleep... often during school time.

cards.name: Dave Walker
cards.description: Sleeps in a coffin and is always grumpy from a bad night's sleep.
cards.description_es: Como se empeña en dormir en un ataúd tiene problemas de espalda.

cards.name: Davi Peroqué
cards.description: He's fiercely proud of Spanish football, and doesn't hide his desire to take on the world.

cards.name: Djung Hamstah
cards.description: Quick and restless as a hamster on a wheel, he defends the goal.
cards.description_es: Un defensa veloz como un hámster que hace inexpugnable su portería.

cards.name: Enrico Oliviero
cards.description: His passion is fashion design. He's already worked up a stylish take on his team's kit.
cards.description_es: Le chifla el mundo de la moda. ¡Hasta ha diseñado el uniforme de su equipo!

cards.name: Gerhard Enders
cards.description: He can't wait to pass his test and get behind the wheel of a smart German motor.
cards.description_es: Quiere sacarse el carnet de conducir para poder comprarse un elegante coche alemán.

cards.name: Hugh Mumford
cards.description: He burns if he so much as looks at the sun. Maybe he's a vampire.
cards.description_es: En cuanto le da un poco el sol, se quema. ¿Será acaso un vampiro?

cards.name: Ian Telektual
cards.description: This brainbox is already studying at a top university.
cards.description_es: Se dice que este genio ha estudiado en las facultades más prestigiosas.

cards.name: Io
cards.description: Wild animals? Venomous snakes? No problem. Just get those ladybirds away from him!
cards.description_es: Le gustan los animales fieros. Pero le dan miedo los tábanos.

cards.name: Jez Shell
cards.description: An able ninja, skilled in using smoke screens to hide his movements.
cards.description_es: Ilusionista cuyo juego de fantasía confunde al rival.

cards.name: Jodi Green
cards.description: An earnest rookie who keeps improving at a startling pace each and every day.

cards.name: Jonah Spark
cards.description: Bizarrely, he never needs to drink water, no matter how hard he exercises.
cards.description_es: Es tan duro que por mucho que corra no necesita hidratarse.

cards.name: Joon-Ho Ja
cards.description: Applying technical ingenuity, this player hopes to open markets for new digital devices.
cards.description_es: Le gustaría triunfar vendiendo aparatos electrónicos de última generación.

cards.name: Jérôme Hervaud
cards.description: With his subtle sense of smell, he's able to blend the ideal perfume for any given person.

cards.name: Kyon Canis
cards.description: This striker moves like an animal and may bark without any warning.
cards.description_es: Este delantero se mueve como una fiera para sorprender a sus rivales.

cards.name: Lucas Skywalk
cards.description: Used to play football properly, but has come to rely on dirty tricks.
cards.description_es: Solía jugar al fútbol con deportividad, pero el juego sucio lo sedujo.

cards.name: Lucian Skye
cards.description: His time under Ares sharpened his skills, but the strict management never sat right with him.

cards.name: Macha Green
cards.description: Others envy her long, straight hair, but all she wants is natural curls.

cards.name: Madison Barada
cards.description: A genius strategist for the knights who recognized Circulus's power and put it to use.
cards.description_es: Gran guerrero que ha presenciado el poder absoluto de Circulus.

cards.name: Marcus Train
cards.description: Likes model trains and his dream is to have a roomful some day.
cards.description_es: Le pirran las maquetas de trenes y sueña con llenar su cuarto con ellas.

cards.name: Marrone Corniola
cards.description: He likes to make pizzas with wacky toppings, but they are mostly disgusting.
cards.description_es: ¿Pizza de anchoa, melocotón y mayonesa?... Pues al él le encanta.

cards.name: Maxwell Mahogany
cards.description: Bathing in hot springs is his greatest pleasure. It energizes and heals him.
cards.description_es: Cree que bañarse en aguas termales es la cura para todo.

cards.name: N'ameeb
cards.description: Looks up to K'aran like an older brother, and uses nimble moves to outsmart opponents and steal the ball.
cards.description_es: Defensa que quiere a K'aran como un hermano. Despeja todos los balones.

cards.name: Natalie Sunrise
cards.description: This girl munches on toffee apples every day on her way home from school.
cards.description_es: Le gustan tanto las bolitas de pulpo que las come cada día.

cards.name: Nello Agata
cards.description: He longed for the life of an urbanite, so he chose football to make a name for himself.

cards.name: Nixon Earlnight
cards.description: Ivy Selective's brightest strategist, but utterly useless before midday.
cards.description_es: Suele actuar como consejero lúcido de la Escuela Aoba, pero su hipotermia le hace inútil por las mañanas.

cards.name: Plip Batur
cards.description: His looks have won plenty of fangirls, but Droplit is the one calling the shots.
cards.description_es: Todo el mundo cree que es una mujer por su aspecto, pero no le importa.

cards.name: Queraldo Naval
cards.description: He's trained to be a matador since he was a child, but he hates hurting animals.

cards.name: Radon Mons
cards.description: Can scarcely see past his bangs, relying instead on sharp hearing and horn-like feelers to read the field.
cards.description_es: Casi no ve nada por su flequillo. Usa el sensor de sus cuernos para jugar.

cards.name: Robert Skipolson
cards.description: This boy came from the far north and loves rollmop herrings.

cards.name: Roger Pialat
cards.description: This player from Montmartre is always creating football-themed paintings.
cards.description_es: Viene del barrio parisino de Montmarte. Pinta cuadros cuyo tema principal es el fútbol.

cards.name: Roman Ballista
cards.description: Uses remarkable agility to always reach the best position on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Con su rapidez y agilidad, parece estar en todos los sitios a la vez.

cards.name: Romuald Huysmans
cards.description: France's number one model in his age group. He's in demand for photos and shows.
cards.description_es: Trabaja como modelo y es muy popular. Es portada de muchas revistas de moda.

cards.name: Siid Sinapis
cards.description: When he was young, he was very small, but he's grown into a giant.
cards.description_es: De pequeño era diminuto, pero ha pegado un estirón de espanto.

cards.name: Spike Gleeson
cards.description: Takes his sunglasses seriously and switches designs for big matches. Sadly, no one notices.

cards.name: Starbuck Rogers
cards.description: A wild goalie who's no stranger to rough play. Oddly quiet in the morning due to low blood pressure.
cards.description_es: Un portero correoso. No le hace ascos al juego duro y es muy impulsivo.

cards.name: Steve Eagle
cards.description: He catches opponents' movements with his eagle-eyes.
cards.description_es: Detecta y se lanza sobre el rival con la agudeza visual de un águila.

cards.name: Suchart Chaowarat
cards.description: A late riser who's hardly recognizable until noon. Honestly, it's doubtful he's ever shown up to morning practice.
cards.description_es: Tiene muy mal despertar y no le gusta entrenar con sus compañeros.

cards.name: Sulayk Sulaiman
cards.description: This player hopes to help Qatar by finding a cheap way to desalinate seawater.
cards.description_es: Desea encontrar la manera de desalinear el agua del mar para así ayudar a su país.

cards.name: Tarquin Orchards
cards.description: A cool, level-headed striker from Ivy Selective. The yin to Whyrl's yang.
cards.description_es: Juicioso ariete del Colegio Ultramegahiedra. Forma un dúo estupendo con Hayden.

cards.name: Tarvon Runnel
cards.description: The team's champion of grit, he has endured grueling training without ever complaining.

cards.name: Tarvos Boson
cards.description: Fights driven by desire, taking more pleasure in showing his strength than in revenge.
cards.description_es: El fuerte sentimiento de la venganza que tiene le provoca una gran sonrisa.

cards.name: Venom Braggard
cards.description: Summoned by Grandfather, he has a mysterious and intimidating aura.

cards.name: Vesuvion Bubo
cards.description: Aoba's right-hand man is respected by the elders and carries more than his fair share of burdens.
cards.description_es: Mano derecha de Aoba. También tiene una gran amistad con su padre.

cards.name: Walt Riverside
cards.description: May not look the sporty type, but has lightning reflexes and a gift for dance.
cards.description_es: Rellenito pero con grandes reflejos y un don innato para el baile.

cards.name: Yule Hoarfrost
cards.description: A speed skater first and foremost. His legs are terrifyingly strong.
cards.description_es: Es ante todo un patinador veloz y tiene unas piernas muy fuertes.

cards.name: Yurkeh
cards.description: N-Gen call this midfielder the Blue Meteor of Team Gahl.
cards.description_es: Este centrocampista es conocido en Nu-Gen como "El meteoro azul".

cards.name: Zachary Moore
cards.description: No flashy moves or superstar aura, but his setup instincts are pure gold.

cards.name: Zafar Malayev
cards.description: First item on the agenda each morning: planning the day with tarot cards.
cards.description_es: Cree en las cartas del tarot a pesar de que solo le han dado mala suerte.

cards.name: Zippy Lerner
cards.description: A math and physics whiz whose skills earned him victory in the Calculation Superman Contest.
cards.description_es: : Bueno con las matemáticas y la física. Ganó un concurso muy importante.

cards.name: Adamant Walhalla
cards.description: Uses his imposing form to pressure opponents. Trains with weights two hours a day.
cards.description_es: Con su imponente figura intimida a los rivales hasta robarles el balón.

cards.name: Anorel
cards.description: He seems to be able to harness supernatural powers using mushrooms.
cards.description_es: Aprovecha la energía de los bosques para conseguir poderes sobrenaturales.

cards.name: Aoba Gyr
cards.description: The captain of Magmavia Eleven is proud of the power he gained upon giving up his wings.
cards.description_es: Capitán de Los Magmavís. Cambió sus alas por unos poderosos brazos.

cards.name: Arty Xerxes
cards.description: Near impossible to read. Always seems to be one step ahead of his opponent.
cards.description_es: Resulta difícil anticiparse a él, ya que piensa más rápido que los demás.

cards.name: Aurel Ashdown
cards.description: Easygoing and team-minded, he draws everyone into his relaxed pace on the pitch.

cards.name: Aveline Morrin
cards.description: Moves like a butterfly, dazzling fans with elegant plays under Orphion's watchful eye.

cards.name: Bart Black
cards.description: His abilities are excellent, but his rebellious attitude can cause trouble.
cards.description_es: Es muy habilidoso, pero su actitud rebelde suele generar problemas.

cards.name: Bud Bloome
cards.description: Launches attacks that span the pitch. Unlike many, he openly respects Heath's ability despite being his senior.
cards.description_es: Construye ataques desde la retaguardia y, a diferencia de otros, respeta la habilidad de a pesar de su edad.

cards.name: Charon
cards.description: His hellish gaze demoralizes anyone who makes eye contact.
cards.description_es: Hace que el equipo rival lo pase mal y les quita las ganas de jugar.

cards.name: Chell
cards.description: Turns heads with his looks, but there's a lot more to him than that.
cards.description_es: Tiene una belleza tan delicada que a veces lo confunden con una chica.

cards.name: Chi-Won Ho
cards.description: Being from southern Korea, he's not too keen on the cold winters in Seoul.
cards.description_es: Es del Sur de Korea y no acaba de acostumbrarse al fío invierno del Seúl.

cards.name: Coral
cards.description: It's impossible to guess what he's thinking or predict his next move.
cards.description_es: Su cara carece de expresión y es imposible predecir sus movimientos.

cards.name: Corwin Lumen
cards.description: Small but nimble, he outplays opponents without relying on brute strength.

cards.name: Cotopax Gerigar
cards.description: He's handsome by Magmavia's standards and popular with everyone.
cards.description_es: Es considerado el más atractivo de Magmavís y un gran héroe del planeta.

cards.name: Darius Cyrus
cards.description: Stoic, and harsh on both himself and others. Guides the team's movements.
cards.description_es: Espartano y severo con los demás y consigo mismo, es el guía del equipo.

cards.name: Dione Bolide
cards.description: Possesses a sixth-sense ability, sensing opponents' movements through subtle shifts in presence.
cards.description_es: Tiene un sexto sentido con el que puede saber el movimiento del rival.

cards.name: Duff Dooley
cards.description: Loves any kind of dish involving turnips. Eats them almost every day.
cards.description_es: Le encantan los rábanos, en especial cocidos, y los come diariamente.

cards.name: Ernst Fliedner
cards.description: He's from Bremen, but is driven to distraction by caterwauling farm animals.
cards.description_es: Es de Bremen y siempre se distrae cuando ve a un grupo de músicos.

cards.name: Ewa Mouton
cards.description: Highly alert and quick to defend herself in danger. She's often seen running away from Kyon Canis.
cards.description_es: Aunque su defensa es impecable es mansa como un corderillo.

cards.name: Felix Higgins
cards.description: An oddball who lives with no fewer than 16 cats. Are those...cat ears?
cards.description_es: Vive con 16 gatos y, quizá por eso, se le han puesto las orejas de felino...

cards.name: Flynt Pine
cards.description: Likes to dart around here and there, leaving his opponent in disarray.
cards.description_es: Cambia de posición muy rápidamente, descolocando así a los rivales.

cards.name: Galad Worden
cards.description: Captivating fans with long-legged finesse, he clasps his hands in focus while sending free kicks flying.

cards.name: Garret Hairtown
cards.description: His friends won't let him cut their hair. Not after what happened last time...
cards.description_es: Como hace peinados excéntricos, nadie se deja cortar el pelo por él.

cards.name: Ghimus
cards.description: He has brains AND beauty! All the girls think he loves only them.
cards.description_es: Es tan inteligente como apuesto. ¡Todas las chicas se lo rifan!

cards.name: Gigs
cards.description: Always angry about something, he uses his pent-up rage to power himself.
cards.description_es: Siempre esta enfadado por algo transforma su ira en energía.

cards.name: Griffit Valiance
cards.description: Stronger than he looks, he relies on his physical prowess while a pollen allergy keeps him masked year-round.

cards.name: Hanny Bawl
cards.description: A military gear junkie who snacks on ration packs like candy.
cards.description_es: Colecciona raciones de alimento de ejércitos de todo el mundo.

cards.name: Harkness Torchwood
cards.description: His piercing gaze can make out details even in the blackest darkness.
cards.description_es: Su mirada penetrante puede ver incluso en la más profunda oscuridad.

cards.name: Heterocera Mothlin
cards.description: Sprinkles glittering scales with every move. While mostly harmless, he is annoyingly persistent.
cards.description_es: Es un chico problemático pero que no causa ningún daño a su equipo.

cards.name: Hiro Hughes
cards.description: A self-confessed special effects geek, and an LBX player with ace reflexes.
cards.description_es: Un fan de los efectos especiales que juega a LBX. Tiene buenos reflejos.

cards.name: Jerry Fulton
cards.description: He believes he's invincible, making him a danger to himself and others.
cards.description_es: Como cree que es inmortal, se pone en peligro a propósito.

cards.name: Joston Easton
cards.description: He has an impressive repertoire of chat-up lines for the girls visiting from the mainland.
cards.description_es: Se le da bien hablar con chicas en la playa.

cards.name: Kazach
cards.description: The brains of the team, every move is run past him first.
cards.description_es: El cerebro del equipo. Tiene que dar su aprobación a todas las estrategias.

cards.name: Laudelino Castor
cards.description: Like Don Quixote, he acts rashly without considering consequences.
cards.description_es: Se guía por sus ideales y actúa sin pensar en las consecuencias. Es todo un quijote.

cards.name: Leif Bolt
cards.description: Driven by a strong sense of justice, this hot-blooded player sharpens his skill with every match.

cards.name: Martin Ursus
cards.description: Legend has it that this guy fought a polar bear and won.
cards.description_es: Según una leyenda urbana, se peleó con un oso polar y le ganó.

cards.name: Matt Fischer
cards.description: Patience strengthened by spiritual discipline is the key to this player's power.
cards.description_es: Su punto fuerte es la paciencia. Dicen que la ha adquirido con ejercicios de meditación.

cards.name: Mayon Langcrest
cards.description: Giving up their wings side by side, she and Aoba share a past no one else can touch.

cards.name: Misty Aul
cards.description: A master at sneaking up silently and stealing the ball, she's quiet and easy to overlook.
cards.description_es: Se guía por la direccionalidad del sonido para hacerse con la pelota.

cards.name: Mitra Jeshu
cards.description: Immortal and agile, he strikes with insect-like reflexes honed over countless battles.
cards.description_es: Posee habilidades físicas mayores que la de los habitantes de Fertilia.

cards.name: Mitya Eremin
cards.description: The shadowy strategist behind Domitri, always plotting the smartest move.
cards.description_es: Mano derecha de Dmitri Sobirov que analiza cada situación que se da en el campo.

cards.name: Mohrir
cards.description: Has a certain fascinating quality that can charm the football from your feet.
cards.description_es: Tiene un atractivo especial que deja embelesados a sus oponentes.

cards.name: Mole
cards.description: She trains by using an oxygen tank to improve the strength of her lungs.
cards.description_es: Mejora el rendimiento de sus pulmones con bombonas de oxígeno.

cards.name: Nobunaga Oda
cards.description: A powerful lord from the Sengoku Era fighting to seize power and rule Japan.
cards.description_es: Un poderoso señor feudal de la era Sengoku que quiere gobernar Japón.

cards.name: Noel Good
cards.description: Flaunts the rules with every move since being brainwashed.
cards.description_es: El lavado de cerebro consiguió que hiciera tareas de manera ordenada.

cards.name: Norimaru Gazen
cards.description: Usually a cold, sullen type, but can be easily mollified with flattery.
cards.description_es: Normalmente es frio y vengativo, pero se deja bailar el agua.

cards.name: Oliver Golightly
cards.description: Cool under pressure, his strong skills strike a fine contrast with his adorable looks.
cards.description_es: Sabe mantener la calma en los momentos más tensos. Su gran talento contrasta con su adorable aspecto.

cards.name: Optimum Limbo
cards.description: Methodical and steady, he's a master of consistency but slow to pivot.
cards.description_es: Sabe guardar la compostura incluso mientras defiende ataques peligrosos.

cards.name: Panacea Utopia
cards.description: His tricky moves confuse the opposing team, throwing them into disarray.
cards.description_es: Con sus fintas logra confundir al rival y que pierda su posición en el campo.

cards.name: Pete Bogg
cards.description: After training in the marshes, his lower body strength is unbeatable.
cards.description_es: Fortaleció sus piernas y caderas entrenando en pantanos.

cards.name: Peter Naumann
cards.description: He's often seen in the park, reading from a volume of Heinrich Heine's poetry.
cards.description_es: Le gusta sentarse en el parque a leer poesías de Heinrich Heine, su autor favorito.

cards.name: Plumian Whitlock
cards.description: A diligent go-getter, he works steadily toward being the best in both school and football.

cards.name: Qasim Batal
cards.description: A master of kabsa, the rice dish he loves serving to his teammates after practice.
cards.description_es: Le gusta quedar con sus compañeros después de cada entrenamiento.

cards.name: Raven Vale
cards.description: Even when emotions run high, he keeps a poker face and baffles opponents with dazzling ball control.
cards.description_es: Mantiene la calma incluso en los momentos más tensos. Sorprende a sus rivales con su increíble control sobre el balón.

cards.name: Raylon Highmoor
cards.description: He yields to those he deems superior, then carries out their orders with ruthless precision.

cards.name: Ronaldo Ramallets
cards.description: An infectious personality whose explosive speed keeps opponents constantly off-balance.

cards.name: Sid Viper
cards.description: Considers himself a vampire and drinks tomato juice every morning.
cards.description_es: Se cree que es un vampiro y todos los días se bebe un zumo de tomate.

cards.name: Sothern Newman
cards.description: Loves practice nearly as much as food. Trains hard, plays harder, snacks hardest.
cards.description_es: Se entrena muy duro, pero tiende a engordar porque pica entre horas.

cards.name: Spencer Duskplay
cards.description: He lives a straightforward life and hates things not being in order.
cards.description_es: Odia que las cosas se tuerzan y por eso vive con rectitud.

cards.name: Spike Gleeson
cards.description: Takes his sunglasses seriously and switches designs for big matches. Sadly, no one notices.
cards.description_es: Puede jugar incluso cuando hay ventisca gracias a su gorro.

cards.name: Steve Ingham
cards.description: He fires the team up when the heat is on.
cards.description_es: Es el revulsivo ideal cuando el equipo está en apuros.

cards.name: Tahk
cards.description: This midfielder's play is as elegant as brushstrokes on a canvas.
cards.description_es: El juego de este medio es elegante como un cuadro impresionista.

cards.name: Terry Stronger
cards.description: His augments make him prone to losing his will.
cards.description_es: Ha sacrificado hasta su propia consciencia para tener más fuerza.

cards.name: Tsync
cards.description: Don't let appearances fool you! His small body is overflowing with malice.
cards.description_es: Aunque parezca pequeño, en su interior alberga gran malicia.

specials.name: Warrior of the South Zhu Que

cards.name: Tytan
cards.description_es: Sus ataques violentos son aún más fuertes y golpea todo lo que pilla.

cards.name: Vespa Hornest
cards.description: A calm striker for Fertilia Eleven, always composed and precise, even under pressure.
cards.description_es: Delantera de Los Fertilia que siempre busca el punto débil del rival.

cards.name: Willow Proude
cards.description: He reads minds on the pitch, stealing the ball with minimal movement and maximum flair.
cards.description_es: Puede leer la mente a sus rivales. Es rápido y muy elegante al robarles el balón.

cards.name: Xeno Eris
cards.description: Lives for rainbows; the moment the rain stops, he races outside on his bike.
cards.description_es: Le gusta pulverizar agua en los días soleados para ver el arcoíris.

cards.name: Yongjin Seo
cards.description: Loves soaking in hot baths and unwinds in hot springs after matches to ease fatigue.
cards.description_es: Después de cada partido le gusta darse un baño de agua caliente.

cards.name: Zetoh
cards.description: Exceedingly proud, but his pride is warranted. Also works very hard.
cards.description_es: Es un chico orgulloso, pero con su talento, está más que justificado.

cards.name: Zolani Baloi
cards.description: He thinks his life is so interesting that he'd like to make a documentary about it.
cards.description_es: Piensa que su vida es tan interesante que debería hacer un documental sobre ella.

cards.name: Émile Lazare
cards.description: He's a connoisseur of French cinema, with a huge DVD collection.
cards.description_es: Se considera un devoto del cine francés y tiene una gran colección de películas en DVD.

cards.name: Adel Siddique
cards.description: A budding filmmaker, this player hopes that one day he can produce real Qatari cinema.
cards.description_es: Es un director en ciernes. Le gustaría convertirse en el precursor del cine catarí.

cards.name: Alton Cotts
cards.description: This hungry fellow is always first in line for second helpings. And thirds.
cards.description_es: Siempre come ración extra de sopa de fideos chinos con cerdo.

cards.name: Apas Mulan
cards.description: He can stretch and retract his body hair at will, a quirk he uses purely for fun.
cards.description_es: Puede extender su vello corporal a su antojo. Lo hace para divertirse.

cards.name: Bart Grantham
cards.description: Loves aeroplanes and dreams of becoming a pilot one day.
cards.description_es: Le encantan los aviones y sueña con convertirse en piloto.

cards.name: Bevan Breakfast
cards.description: His family runs a cozy lodge that's popular with tourists.
cards.description_es: La pensión de su familia es muy acogedora y los clientes vuelven.

cards.name: Bhabass
cards.description: A natural strategist who memorizes every pitch he's ever played on.
cards.description_es: Un estratega natural que se aprende los detalles de todos los campos.

cards.name: Bhak Sepakroh
cards.description: The brains to Klaharn's brawn, Bhak plays with effortless grace and precision.
cards.description_es: Usa un estilo de juego muy atractivo para los grandes equipos del mundo.

cards.name: Billy Lingsoo
cards.description: Has the unusual talent of performing acrobatics while balancing on a ball.
cards.description_es: Tiene un especial talento para hacer acrobacias subido a una pelota.

cards.name: Bob Carlton
cards.description: Physically strong and fast. He can close down attackers in a second.
cards.description_es: Es corpulento, aunque rapidísimo. Deja atrás al rival en un pispás.

cards.name: Bourne Birch
cards.description: The descendant of a local hero. Doesn't talk about it, though.
cards.description_es: El nunca lo menciona, pero sus antepasados eran gente importante.

cards.name: Brendan Water
cards.description: This player also doubles as the team's cook.
cards.description_es: Aunque no es cocinero, prepara la comida a los de su equipo cada día.

cards.name: Caesar Cornell
cards.description: A cold fellow who will never hold back even if his enemy is weak or injured.
cards.description_es: Nunca baja de revoluciones, tampoco frente a rivales débiles o lesionados.

cards.name: Chiron Vestal
cards.description: A master of random trivia, none of which ever really comes in useful.
cards.description_es: Experto en curiosidades absurdas que no sirven para nada.

cards.name: Clay Moor
cards.description: A brawny player who can deflect even the most powerful shot with ease.
cards.description_es: Un jugador recio, capaz de desviar con facilidad los disparos más fuertes.

cards.name: Croy Roy
cards.description: A shell with steel-like skin, his black "helmet" is actually hollow.

cards.name: Cyber Dalekman
cards.description: The team's "phantom member," he only ever shows up for actual matches.

cards.name: Dee Vee
cards.description: This defender shows no pain and obeys Schemer Guile unquestioningly.
cards.description_es: Este defensa nunca muestra dolor y siempre obedece a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Dee Vee
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Este defensa nunca muestra dolor y siempre obedece a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Desmond Cartes
cards.description: His family is wealthy, but he keeps this a secret to avoid special treatment.
cards.description_es: Su familia tiene dinero, pero no quiere que por eso le den un trato especial.

cards.name: Driss
cards.description: The brains of Team Zan, renowned for his brutal yet effective tactics.
cards.description_es: El cerebro del equipo es famoso por sus tácticas brutales, pero efectivas.

cards.name: Earnest Bookworm
cards.description: A diligent student who pores over dusty old tomes long into the night.
cards.description_es: Estudia concienzudamente legajos antiguos.

cards.name: Fedora
cards.description: A rough lad who's prone to exploding on and off the pitch.
cards.description_es: Le gustan todos los deportes en los que se pueda volver violento.

cards.name: Fred Featherstonhaugh
cards.description: Much more agile than his huge body would suggest, but often careless.
cards.description_es: Pese a su gran tamaño es muy ágil, aunque bastante descuidado.

cards.name: Glasya
cards.description: This player combines magic power, sharp intelligence and untempered cruelty.

cards.name: Grant Eldorado
cards.description: He always wins fighting games using the least favorite characters.
cards.description_es: Ama los juegos de lucha. Juega con personajes que nadie elige.

cards.name: Gumille
cards.description: Behind her glasses are innocent eyes that deceive prey as she toys with them.
cards.description_es: Su mirada inocente oculta la ferocidad animal que bulle en su interior.

cards.name: Gunnar Boatwright
cards.description: He has an abiding love for Viking longships, so he's looking into methods of restoration.
cards.description_es: Le apasionan los barcos vikingos, por lo que investiga métodos de restauración.

cards.name: Hillary Bush
cards.description: She has a sharp wit and a sharper tongue. You don't want to be the butt of her jokes.
cards.description_es: Es la típica bromista. Si no le ríes las gracias, se enfada.

cards.name: Juan Espindola
cards.description: Everyone is bewitched by his virtuosic skill at flamenco guitar.
cards.description_es: Es un virtuoso de la guitarra española que hechiza a todos con su arte.

cards.name: Jude Gordon
cards.description: Loves scuba diving in seas where coral reefs stretch as far as the eye can see.
cards.description_es: Hay un mito que dice que nadó de lado a lado un arrecife de coral.

cards.name: Jun-Yeong Lee
cards.description: Captain of the Fire Dragons, he's so fast they call him the Korean Zephyr.
cards.description_es: Capitán de los Dragones de Fuego. Por su rapidez lo llaman el viento coreano.

cards.name: Kenja Jo'rayev
cards.description: Loves grilled skewers, though he's been cutting back after Ruslan told him to slim down.
cards.description_es: Está tratando de adelgazar porque no puede ponerse su kimono favorito.

cards.name: Kenville
cards.description_es: Se ha hecho más fuerte y ahora lo único que hace es presumir.

cards.name: Kevin Pinot
cards.description: He's currently trying to adapt Napoleonic tactics for the football pitch.
cards.description_es: Quiere aplicar las estrategias de batalla napoleónicas en el campo de juego.

cards.name: King Arthur
cards.description: Leader of the Knights of the Round Table, he is secure in his role as king.

cards.name: Laban Lux
cards.description: Uses self-taught martial art skills to weave through any attack.

cards.name: Lance Speares
cards.description: A steadfast goalkeeper who can read the course of a shot in an instant.
cards.description_es: Este portero impasible puede anticipar al instante la trayectoria del balón.

cards.name: Leonid Mirzayev
cards.description: Formed a three-person band with Yuri and Zafar... though all they can play is bass.
cards.description_es: Formaba una banda de música junto a Melekh, Averin y 3 personas más.

cards.name: Lou Garrou
cards.description: Wears a silver noseguard because his nose is always red from colds.
cards.description_es: Se tapa la nariz con un protector metálico para no resfriarse.

cards.name: Mansur Jasim
cards.description: This player is an expert at finding natural pearls. They're pretty pricey these days.
cards.description_es: Tiene un talento natural para encontrar perlas. ¡Su precio está por las nubes!

cards.name: Mario Saviola
cards.description: His pushy parents said to him, "you'd better win, or else!" which caused him much angst.
cards.description_es: Siempre se muestra nervioso en el campo, porque en case le presionan para que gane.

cards.name: Masego Molelo
cards.description: He's interested in stocks and shares, so he's boning up on all that stuff now.
cards.description_es: Le interesa el mercado de valores y se informa sobre el tema para estar al día.

cards.name: Maxim Adrov
cards.description: A power striker from Uzbekistan who quietly sees Domitri as a rival.
cards.description_es: Es rival de Dilshod en secreto. Delantero estrella del equipo.

cards.name: Monstro Ximenes
cards.description: When he drinks coffee, he surges with power. Doesn't do his health much good, though.
cards.description_es: Bebe mucho café porque le aporta energía, aunque no sea bueno para su salud.

cards.name: Nun Chuck
cards.description: What you see is what you get: a real power fighter. Has a cruel edge to him.
cards.description_es: Un jugador sin dobleces, contundente y un tanto cruel con sus rivales.

cards.name: Omega Elysium
cards.description: His greatest weapon is his tough-as- iron body, which can deflect any shot.
cards.description_es: Su mayor virtud es su férreo cuerpo, capaz de desviar cualquier disparo.

cards.name: Ough Cee
cards.description: A calculating striker who is devoted to following Schemer Guile's orders.
cards.description_es: Un delantero calculador que dedica su vida a obedecer a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Ough Cee
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Un delantero calculador que dedica su vida a obedecer a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Pinoh
cards.description: Small but packed with strength! He's still growing, so gets tired easily.
cards.description_es: Pequeño, pero fuerte como un mulo. Lo malo es que se cansa enseguida.

cards.name: Porphyria Filia
cards.description: Can never get up in the morning. Is she a vampire, or just lazy?
cards.description_es: Le cuesta tanto despertarse por las mañanas que podría ser un vampiro.

cards.name: R'adji
cards.description: The hardest-headed member of Silica Eleven, his rocklike forehead makes for devastating headers.
cards.description_es: El mejor defensa de Los Sílice tiene la cabeza tan dura como una roca.

cards.name: Rajab Ismail
cards.description: With the dream of getting published, this player is working on a novel set in Qatar.
cards.description_es: Está escribiendo una novela que se desarrolla en Catar. ¡Sueña con que se la publiquen!

cards.name: Rose Pinkpetal
cards.description: She believes that Tokyo can't hold a candle to Osaka's fashion sense.
cards.description_es: Quiere demostrar que los de Osaka también saben vestir bien.

cards.name: Rowan Beltzer
cards.description: This sure-footed player stands his ground even on the muddiest pitch.
cards.description_es: Puede correr con total estabilidad hasta en campos embarrados.

cards.name: Ryan Tappin
cards.description: He intercepts criminals' phone calls and emails. He has eyes and ears everywhere.
cards.description_es: Líder de un grupo que intercepta mensajes y llamadas criminales.

cards.name: Salman Karim
cards.description: He's always helping his parents with the date palm harvest.
cards.description_es: Ayuda a sus padres a cosechar frutos de palmeras datileras que cultivan.

cards.name: Sempiterno Bliss
cards.description: A top sprinter in the track and field club. Football is his secondary hobby.
cards.description_es: Gran velocista del club de atletismo, juega al fútbol por pasar el rato.

cards.name: Soji Okita
cards.description: Ace swordsman of the Shinsengumi. Burns with passion despite his illness.
cards.description_es: Espadachín legendario del Shinsengumi. Arde de pasión a pesar de su enfermedad.

cards.name: Sonny Shore
cards.description: An eco-warrior who can't bear the sight of a polluted beach.
cards.description_es: A este ecologista le gusta que las playas estén impolutas ¡La basura, al contenedor!

cards.name: Spencer Gates
cards.description: Enjoys 'cosplay', but has to make costumes he can't afford to buy.
cards.description_es: Él mismo se hace disfraces de personajes de dibujos animados.

cards.name: Tamgan Jaa
cards.description: Chosen to captain the Thai national team, but he stepped aside, insisting Napa was the better fit.

cards.name: Timothy Western
cards.description: He carries an old truncheon and never lets wrong-doers get away with it.
cards.description_es: Siempre lleva una porra y si coge a un criminal, no lo suelta.

cards.name: Tom Contented
cards.description: He likes being fashionably late and is always an hour later than anyone else.
cards.description_es: Para él llegar una hora tarde no es retrasarse.

cards.name: Trent Poplar
cards.description: Enjoys going jogging around the local lakes and ponds.
cards.description_es: Le gusta ir a correr por los lagos y los ríos de la región.

cards.name: Whaly Walker
cards.description: Always chasing the perfect hairstyle, and rumor has it he's getting close to nailing it.
cards.description_es: Se dedica a peinarse durante los partidos, ya que le incomoda su pelo.

cards.name: Worff Chewback
cards.description: His family runs a café. He created a dish himself, but it wasn't too popular.
cards.description_es: Ha creado un menú propio para el bar de su familia, pero sin mucho éxito.

cards.name: Ymir Catena
cards.description: Left with almost no memories after the war, he now fights on raw, instinctive aggression alone.
cards.description_es: Debido a la conmoción de la guerra ha perdido gran parte de su memoria.

cards.name: Zohtan
cards.description: His sunglasses predict his opponent's every move.
cards.description_es: Las gafas de sol que lleva lo ayudan a predecir los movimientos del rival.

cards.name: Acme Rapture
cards.description: A martial-arts genius who achieved instructor rank at the age of ten.
cards.description_es: Un genio de las artes marciales, que con 10 años ya era entrenador.

cards.name: Alexander Brave
cards.description: People say he knows how to invoke catastrophic curses when angry.
cards.description_es: Experto en maleficios y brujerías. Enojarle es buscarse la ruina.

cards.name: Art Tundra
cards.description: Has taken over 2,000 photographs of frost-covered trees as a hobby.
cards.description_es: Por pura afición ha hecho más de 1000 fotos de árboles con escarcha.

cards.name: Brighton Spark
cards.description: A supporting player with excellent communication skills. An unsung hero.
cards.description_es: Aunque le gusta estar en segundo plano, su lucidez es inestimable.

cards.name: Bruce Barkley
cards.description: Some people might hear the call of the wild. He's got it on speed dial.
cards.description_es: Un peligro de tío que acostumbra a decir: "Me hierve la sangre".

cards.name: Bucky Colt
cards.description: This rodeo champ can break any horse, no matter how wild.
cards.description_es: Este as del rodeo puede domar a cualquier caballo por muy salvaje que sea.

cards.name: Bucky Woodchuck
cards.description: A little timid in nature, but very nimble and dexterous with a ball.
cards.description_es: Un poco timido, pero en el campo es todo una habilidad con el balón.

cards.name: Coral Talent
cards.description: Tourists love the jewelry she makes out of coral.
cards.description_es: Fabrica accesorios con coral que entusiasman a los turistas.

cards.name: Corbin Brickham
cards.description: So hard on himself that he starts dissecting his mistakes the moment the match ends.

cards.name: Dakarai Furman
cards.description: On the pitch, he entrusts his movements to instinct, and the rhythm of nature.
cards.description_es: En el campo, deja que la naturaleza y su propio instinto guíen sus movimientos.

cards.name: Dekih
cards.description: This exceptional striker gets antsy if he isn't in the center.
cards.description_es: Delantero excepcional que se irrita si no es el centro de atención.

cards.name: Djibz
cards.description: He finally found peace channeling his fearsome power into football.
cards.description_es: Usar su temible poder para el fútbol le ha dado por fin la paz que buscaba.

cards.name: Do-Hyeon Nam
cards.description: He hypes himself up for matches by blasting upbeat dance music.
cards.description_es: Tiene buen gusto musical. Su tensión aumenta mucho cuando juega un partido.

cards.name: Dooyoon Hong
cards.description: He can't handle spicy food, so he struggles with his home country's chili-laden cuisine.

cards.name: Droplit Turkana
cards.description: Obsessed with style and secretly convinced she's the cutest of them all.
cards.description_es: Siempre está a la moda y los demás piensan que es muy linda.

cards.name: Elata Mighty
cards.description: She tends to speak condescendingly, though she doesn't mean anything by it.
cards.description_es: No lo hace a propósito, pero habla de una forma un poco pedante.

cards.name: Faraz Farooq
cards.description: This player's famous for making delicious desserts with dates.
cards.description_es: Este jugador es famoso por elaborar deliciosos postres con dátiles.

cards.name: Gaby Farmer
cards.description: He can make computers all by himself. He has over ten at home.
cards.description_es: Él mismo se monta sus ordenadores. Tiene más de diez en casa.

cards.name: Galileo
cards.description: This sturdy keeper boasts that he could even stop a meteorite.
cards.description_es: Portero con agallas que afirma poder detener meteoritos.

cards.name: Gem Shorn
cards.description: A talented ocarina player. Birds even come and listen to him play.
cards.description_es: Un talentoso intérprete de ocarina. Incluso los pájaros vienen y lo escuchan tocar.

cards.name: George Wu
cards.description: Deeply into Feng Shui. Even worries about where he puts down his pencil.
cards.description_es: Forofo del feng shui, piensa al detalle cómo colocar el estuche en la mesa.

cards.name: Ghiris
cards.description: Mehr's boyfriend. He has eyes only for her.
cards.description_es: El novio de Mehr solo tiene ojos para ella.

cards.name: Giles Farmer
cards.description: He joined the football club looking for something to commit to, and the brutal training delivered.

cards.name: Harry Leading
cards.description: Took up football to get famous, but forgot it all after "conditioning."
cards.description_es: Empezó a jugar al fútbol para ser famoso, y se dejó lavar el cerebro.

cards.name: Harry Snake
cards.description: Once he has the ball wrapped up, he doesn't release it.
cards.description_es: Al apoderarse del balón, parece que lo envuelve y ya no lo suelta.

cards.name: Hugh Makebe
cards.description: He has to be supplied with rooibos tea, or he gets anxious.
cards.description_es: Si no se toma una tila al día, se pone muy nervioso.

cards.name: Ian Flappable
cards.description: Whatever the crisis, he reads the opposition's game flawlessly.

cards.name: Isaac Glass
cards.description: Unlike his brother, he's actually good at football. But he's nowhere near as brainy...
cards.description_es: Isaac no será tan listo como su hermano, aunque sí se le da bien jugar al fútbol.

cards.name: Jim Hillfort
cards.description: Gets sick very easily, so he's never had a chance to shine.
cards.description_es: Como enseguida le da fiebre, nunca llega a terminar bien un partido.

cards.name: Joe Bloggs
cards.description: This rock band vocalist loathes to be called by his real name.
cards.description_es: Canta en un grupo de estética glam. Odia que lo llamen por su nombre real.

cards.name: Josep Anglesola
cards.description: A playmaker with an eye for the unexpected, threading passes through the enemy's weakest points.

cards.name: Larry Lyre
cards.description: His uncanny sense of the game lets him read opponents' moves before they even make them.
cards.description_es: Tiene un sexto sentido que le permite anticiparse a los movimientos de sus rivales durante los partidos.

cards.name: Leon Ohnepart
cards.description: Closes in on the opponent in a flash with movements honed to perfection.
cards.description_es: Cierra huecos a los rivales con movimientos rápidos y precisos.

cards.name: Loge Colles
cards.description: A warrior who channels hatred into power and obeys Ozrock without question.
cards.description_es: Odia las cicatrices de guerra que tiene por todo su cuerpo.

cards.name: Maddox Rock
cards.description: He'll ski straight down any slope no matter how steep it is.

cards.name: Mark Osman
cards.description: He can take out a can with a ball from fifty meters. That's pretty good.

cards.name: Morgan Stern
cards.description: Believes that victory should be earned by crushing the foe without restraint.
cards.description_es: Piensa que vencer sin destrozar al rival es dejar el trabajo a medias.

cards.name: Namak Haumea
cards.description: Proud of the fact that he never catches colds and his injuries heal super fast.
cards.description_es: Presume no coger nunca catarros y curarse rápido de las lesiones.

cards.name: Noel Good
cards.description: A stickler for rules, he even polices himself. Until temptation wins and he gorges on ice cream.

cards.name: Ollie Gami
cards.description: He uses arcane paper charms to master mysterious techniques.
cards.description_es: Hace amuletos de papel y los usa para realizar técnicas extrañas.

cards.name: Orion Hunter
cards.description: Serious about training. Usually trains from the crack of dawn until sunset.
cards.description_es: Se toma el entrenamiento muy en serio y le dedica interminables horas.

cards.name: Pardo Berillo
cards.description: Initially he'd hoped to be an opera singer, but his vocal cords gave out.
cards.description_es: Quería trabajar en la ópera, pero sus cuerdas vocales no dan para mucho.

cards.name: Peter Drent
cards.description: This young giant is capable of ground-shaking skills.
cards.description_es: Granuja de cuerpo gigantesco cuyo peso hace temblar el suelo.

cards.name: Philip Marvel
cards.description: Brainwashing implanted fear in him. He now overreacts to all surprises.
cards.description_es: Extrae fuerzas del pánico que le causó el lavado de cerebro.

cards.name: Plink Powai
cards.description: The captain of Naiadi Eleven picks strategies based solely on her mood and whims.
cards.description_es: Capitana de Los Naiadi. Decide su jugada viendo el pensamiento del rival.

cards.name: Quentin Rackner
cards.description: This mysterious wanderer turns up and joins the team every winter.

cards.name: Rashid Hakim
cards.description: Loves tearing across the desert on camelback, and his camel impression is something to behold.
cards.description_es: Para desconectar le gusta montar a camello por el desierto.

cards.name: Ray Mannings
cards.description: Although a bit stiff, he disturbs opponents by flying around them.
cards.description_es: Su cuerpo es tan rígido que al correr parece que vaya rebotando.

cards.name: Robert Mayer
cards.description: As he gets cold easily, he always keeps well wrapped up.
cards.description_es: Su piel se seca con suma facilidad y por eso se la cubre de vendajes.

cards.name: Romeo
cards.description: Despite his gentle looks, he fights tooth and nail to protect the goal.
cards.description_es: A pesar de su aspecto dócil, defiende la portería con uñas y dientes.

cards.name: Romeo
cards.description: Miximaxed with Zanark, he guards the goal with a terrifying look on his face.
cards.description_es: Tras el Miximax con Zanark, defiende la portería con fanatismo renovado.

cards.name: Sebastian Fortwright
cards.description: Unflappable and reassuring, he plays with delicate precision despite his imposing frame.

cards.name: Sithri Peon
cards.description: Usually a slacker, but in a crisis he can steal the ball in the blink of an eye.
cards.description_es: Es un holgazán, pero cuando quiere puede robar el balón en un instante.

cards.name: Skylar Lepton
cards.description: With his high jump and powerful header, he's a menace near the goal.
cards.description_es: Sus saltos y remates de cabeza son una amenaza para cualquier portero.

cards.name: Squalcha Nhess
cards.description: A player who doubles as a coordinator that has a knack for housework—cleaning in particular.
cards.description_es: Jugador y gerente de Los Naiadi. Está obsesionado con la limpieza.

cards.name: Steve Woodmark
cards.description: His ambition is to sit in the Oval Office, but no one takes him seriously.
cards.description_es: Dice que quiere ser presidente de Estados Unidos, pero nadie se lo toma en serio...

cards.name: Stéphane Hinault
cards.description: This young man is already a hitmaker in the world of French music.
cards.description_es: Las canciones que compone este jugador son todo un éxito en las listas francesas.

cards.name: Sun Tzu
cards.description: Controls the team's defence as a rear commander. Good at covering space.
cards.description_es: Dirige la defensa como un general y sabe achicar espacios.

cards.name: Sylvar Verdis
cards.description: Driven by a strong sense of justice, he keeps his fiery emotions in check to stay sharp on the pitch.

cards.name: Tamir Nasr
cards.description: Values elegance above all else and never skips his post-meal Arabica coffee.
cards.description_es: Siempre toma café de Arabia después de comer.

cards.name: Taylor Firepool
cards.description: He'll complete impossible missions without even breaking a sweat.
cards.description_es: Cumple en un santiamén cualquier misión imposible que le propongan.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 8
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army and one of Zhuge's biggest admirers.

cards.name: Themba Sepeng
cards.description: He wants to grow South African flowers, and share them with the world.
cards.description_es: Quiere cultivar flores sudafricanas y darlas a conocer al resto del mundo.

cards.name: Tim Roubadour
cards.description: He's currently researching Italian folk songs, and has even written a few.
cards.description_es: Estudia el origen del folclore musical italiano. Incluso ha reescrito algunas canciones.

cards.name: Tobin Harveston
cards.description: A devoted rice lover who downs thirty bowls a day, and somehow still has room to grow.

cards.name: Toby Damian
cards.description: Small but mighty, his insane vertical leap owns the airspace.

cards.name: Tzeikh
cards.description: A born narcissist, his powers are just one more thing to boast about.
cards.description_es: Un narcisista nato que no deja de jactarse de su gran habilidad.

cards.name: Victor Kind
cards.description: Brainwashed into believing that his team's tactics are the best.
cards.description_es: Le han hecho creer que el juego de su equipo no tiene rival.

cards.name: Wryn Twincrest
cards.description: With deft hands, he blocks shots, always trying to compete with his childhood friend and eternal rival, Griffit.

cards.name: Yuri Avelin
cards.description: New to football, but his raw instinct earned him a spot on the national team.
cards.description_es: Fue seleccionado para jugar con el equipo nacional porque es un genio.

cards.name: Zhuge Liang
cards.description: Liu Bei's most brilliant strategist. Beautiful, but reserved and elusive.
cards.description_es: La estratega mas brillante de Liu Bei, Tan bella como retraída y esquiva.

cards.name: Agnethe Presari
cards.description: A master silverworker who can create intricate masterpieces in moments.
cards.description_es: Le gusta trabajar la plata y crea verdaderas obras de arte.

cards.name: Antonio Gallego
cards.description: He's always making sketches for abstract paintings, like Picasso.

cards.name: Aris Tottle
cards.description: Manages the school library, and always knows which books are where.
cards.description_es: Es bibliotecario en el instituto y sabe siempre dónde está cada libro.

cards.name: Bill Moony
cards.description: A fan of cheesy love stories who is careful not to let people find out.

cards.name: Blade Healen
cards.description: He marks his opponents until they howl with frustration.
cards.description_es: Marca tan bien al rival que este acaba gritando de desesperación.

cards.name: Caesar Lionheart
cards.description: Usually faint of heart, but turns into an unstoppable beast during a match.
cards.description_es: Muy tranquilo, pero cuando juega al fútbol se transforma en una fiera.

cards.name: Cameron Morefield
cards.description: Turned to football after hurting his wrist playing semi-pro tennis.
cards.description_es: Fue un gran tenista, pero se pasó al fútbol por un dolor de muñeca.

cards.name: Carlos Arroyo
cards.description: He hopes to raise architectural wonders like the Sagrada Familia.
cards.description_es: Desea ser diseñador de obras de arte arquitectónicas como la Sagrada Familia.

cards.name: Celer Lightfoot
cards.description: A harefooted boy who can accelerate from stationary to full tilt in moments.

cards.name: Conant Ó Briain
cards.description: A laid-back lad who refuses to be rushed, no matter the situation.
cards.description_es: A veces se relaja demasiado, e irrita a quienes tienen que tratar con él.

cards.name: Damon Valiant
cards.description: Boasts unmatched kicking power. No one can stop him once he's in motion.

cards.name: Darehn
cards.description: Sees herself as a rival to Mehr. She's a well-bred lady who hates to lose.
cards.description_es: Una chica sofisticada que odia perder y que se considera rival de Mehr.

cards.name: Des Einer
cards.description: It's said that if you get him to design your business card, you're sure to do well.

cards.name: Enimaux
cards.description: The closest thing to a team mascot. Looks simple, but is ruthlessly smart.
cards.description_es: Casi podría ser la mascota del equipo. Parece simple, pero es muy lista.

cards.name: Everest Brightwell
cards.description: He picked up football on a whim, only to be surprised by how completely it pulled him in.

cards.name: Ewano Bee
cards.description: Hot-headed underboss of Newcrest's Reef Rats, quick to throw down with anyone.

cards.name: Federico Rubiera
cards.description: He'd like to have a go at synchronized swimming, but he can't find a boys' team.
cards.description_es: Le gustaría triunfar en natación sincronizada, pero no encuentra ningún equipo masculino.

cards.name: Folie Vora
cards.description: Expends as little energy as she can during matches, and loves napping.
cards.description_es: Cumple con la ley del mínimo esfuerzo y se echa siestas de varias horas.

cards.name: Francis Tell
cards.description: Follows instructions religiously after getting brainwashed.
cards.description_es: Dice haber visto apariciones. Cree a pies juntillas lo que le digan.

cards.name: Francis Tuffnot
cards.description: Looks tough at first, but has a soft heart that won't turn away those in need.
cards.description_es: Tiene la resistencia y la fragilidad de una chica, ¡pero es muy masculino!

cards.name: Fritz Brisk
cards.description: An expert mountaineer with a tough body and keen decision-making skills.
cards.description_es: Un montañero experto y recio, con gran frialdad para tomar decisiones.

cards.name: Garvin Cliffmarch
cards.description: As a natural mood-maker, his voice booms across the pitch, rallying the team and keeping spirits high.

cards.name: Gaston Cooley
cards.description: He was born in Okinawa but can't stand the heat, so constantly uses air conditioning.
cards.description_es: Aunque nació en una isla tropical, no aguanta bien el calor.

cards.name: Gerard Carbonell
cards.description: A defensive anchor trusted by teammates for his sharp judgment and precise calls.

cards.name: Harry Leading
cards.description: He turned to brainwashing to win hearts, only to learn that sincerity was far more effective.

cards.name: Helena Harwood
cards.description: A mysterious presence whose clean, efficient movement keeps fatigue at bay.

cards.name: Himesh Himalaya
cards.description: Studying the local deer population and seeking ways to preserve their habitat.
cards.description_es: Estudia la población local de ciervos para conservar mejor su habitad.

cards.name: Hunter O'Mann
cards.description: Wears a muzzle to stop him driving his teammates mad with his howling.
cards.description_es: Lleva bozal para no volver locos a sus compañeros con sus aullidos.

cards.name: Ian Smith
cards.description: There's nowhere to run and nowhere to hide from his hawk-like eye.
cards.description_es: Cuando marca a un jugador, lo persigue hasta el fin del mundo.

cards.name: Jun-Ho Bae
cards.description: A mischievous prankster, always looking for ways to catch teammates off guard.
cards.description_es: Es muy travieso y siempre se hace el sorprendido cuando le pillan liándola.

cards.name: Keane Gardner
cards.description: A gentle soul with a green thumb. Has a soft spot for wild flowers and weeds.
cards.description_es: Es muy amable y le chifla la jardinería, en especial las flores silvestres.

cards.name: La Hire
cards.description: A rough, quick-tempered knight in the employ of Prince Charles of France.

cards.name: Lepidoptera Flutterby
cards.description: Just emerged from her chrysalis, she's in her prime and her abilities have skyrocketed.

cards.name: Linden Haregrove
cards.description: The "Eyes of Truth." An able and loyal aide to the captain, Cirrus Whisp.
cards.description_es: La mano derecha de Cirrus, el capitán. Lo llaman "El rostro de la verdad".

cards.name: Marley Hookson
cards.description: At night, she's alive by the sea, always drawn to the waves' endless rhythm.
cards.description_es: Tiene una extraña afición por nadar de noche en el mar.

cards.name: Martin Squall
cards.description: An expert in equestrian matters, he's already raised a few Grand National winners!
cards.description_es: Se le da muy bien montar a caballo. Entrena junto a los mejores equitadores del país.

cards.name: Massimo Donati
cards.description: Adriano's father is a larger-than-life figure who leads the carpenters of Backwater Island.

cards.name: Mel Lowe
cards.description: An archetypal gentle giant who has a kind word for everyone.
cards.description_es: Es muy corpulento, pero es muy amable y siempre sonríe a todos.

cards.name: Merrick Seawell
cards.description: A flashy all-rounder who thrives under attention and aims to become the best of the best.

cards.name: Mhadoor
cards.description: A brutal boy. If eyes are windows to the soul, be glad for his sunglasses!
cards.description_es: Un chico brutal. Si no llevara gafas de sol, se podría ver malicia en los ojos.

cards.name: Mick Mishap
cards.description: He likes boating in the park in his free time, but has nobody to row with.
cards.description_es: Le gusta subir a los botes del lago, pero no tiene quién le acompañe.

cards.name: Moe Sart
cards.description: Comes from a poor family, but attained academic greatness on talent alone.
cards.description_es: De familia humilde, alcanzó prestigio académico por méritos propios.

cards.name: Moeneeb Booysen
cards.description: In order to tackle global warming, this player plants new trees.
cards.description_es: Planta árboles para aportar un granito de arena contra el calentamiento global.

cards.name: Mustah
cards.description: Loves inventing things, so he spends hours a day at the drawing board.
cards.description_es: Le encanta inventar cacharros, así que se pasa el día diseñando.

cards.name: Naid Sirisukha
cards.description: An elephant handler who commands the others with ease— sometimes even taking his teammates for a ride.
cards.description_es: Manipula libremente a los elefantes. Monta en ellos con sus compañeros.

cards.name: Neon Rotarus
cards.description: Lives by the motto of having fun, treating even matches against Earthlings as nothing more than play.
cards.description_es: Le gusta hacer que sus compañeros se sientan cómodos y agradables.

cards.name: Neville Boyle
cards.description: He's got some very particular ideas about the best way to prepare rice.
cards.description_es: Tiene algunas ideas muy particulares sobre la mejor manera de preparar el arroz.

cards.name: Octavius Parson
cards.description: A hobbyist boomerang carver with a proud heritage rumored to trace back to Australian Aborigines.
cards.description_es: Su hobby es jugar con un boomerang. Todos sus ancestros son australianos.

cards.name: Owen Greenfield
cards.description: He knows all about fruit and veg as his parents are greengrocers.

cards.name: Ralph Chasing
cards.description: His ardent curiosity towards the spirit world is given vent in excursions to "haunted" sites.

cards.name: Rob Cardson
cards.description: He loves card games and likes to play snap with red and yellow cards.
cards.description_es: Maestro de los juegos de cartas. Siempre gana.

cards.name: Rocky Shears
cards.description: Has never won a single game of rock, paper, scissors in his life.
cards.description_es: No ha ganado nunca en la vida al juego de piedra, papel y tijeras.

cards.name: Rodh
cards.description: This evil genius of a midfielder is known as The Demolisher.
cards.description_es: Es un genial centrocampista de gran maldad apodado "Demoledor".

specials.name: Ruler of the Seven Seas Poseidon

cards.name: Romeo Fitzroy
cards.description: A versatile player, capable in both attack and defence. Popular with girls.
cards.description_es: Jugador versátil de los que atacan y defienden. Bastante ligón, además.

cards.name: Ruslan Kashimov
cards.description: Links up with defender Mitya to relay instructions to the front line.
cards.description_es: Colabora bastante en las tareas defensivas y da bastantes órdenes.

cards.name: Russo Rosmarus
cards.description: He slides the ball out from his foes with icily graceful movements.
cards.description_es: Es capaz de robarles el balón a sus oponentes sin que se den cuenta.

cards.name: Sayid Armand
cards.description: This player is concerned that his country's economy is dependent on oil exports.
cards.description_es: Le preocupa que su país dependa demasiado de la exportación de petróleo.

cards.name: Shirley Stevens
cards.description: A security officer who will undergo any hardship to ensure the safety of his country.
cards.description_es: Haría cualquier cosa con tal de proteger la paz de su país.

cards.name: Solomon Owle
cards.description: A walking playbook, he internalizes the patterns of countless players and anticipates every move.
cards.description_es: Es como un libro de jugadas sobre el fútbol. Memoriza todas las jugadas rivales para anticiparse a ellas.

cards.name: Solren Dawnwright
cards.description: Cool and detached by nature, yet his play on the pitch is anything but restrained.

cards.name: Soyeon Sim
cards.description: With cute looks and fearless play, she's won the hearts of fans all around the world.
cards.description_es: De aspecto lindo pero de juego sucio. Tiene fans por todo Corea.

cards.name: Sven Johansson
cards.description: A sly boy. Likes football, but doesn't like to oppose people with power.
cards.description_es: Le gusta un tipo de fútbol en el que se emplea más la astucia que la fuerza.

cards.name: Terry Stronger
cards.description: So absorbed in the game he often gets hurt and spends his free time inventing fast-healing bandages.

cards.name: Themis Law
cards.description: Obsessed with mastering the perfect free kick. Doesn't care about goals.
cards.description_es: Quiere tirar faltas con una trayectoria perfecta. Le da igual si entran o no.

cards.name: Theodore Master
cards.description: Makes a living from winning on arcade machines.
cards.description_es: Genio de los juegos de azar que gana muchos premios con ellos.

cards.name: Thor Nado
cards.description: Body hair so dense it's hard to tell apart from his hair or beard, curling differently depending on his mood.

cards.name: Tyrian Purpel
cards.description: His family runs a clothing store. He dyed the team's uniforms himself.
cards.description_es: Su familia lleva una tienda de kimonos. Ha teñido los uniformes de su equipo.

cards.name: Tytan
cards.description: An unstoppable man mountain who crushes anything in his path.
cards.description_es: Lo va rompiendo todo porque no puede controlar su enorme cuerpo.

cards.name: Ugg LeMugg
cards.description: He swears blind that his appearance is the result of a cruel joke.

cards.name: Zatang
cards.description: Loves to fight, and lives to do battle on the football pitch.
cards.description_es: Le encanta luchar. Se toma el terreno de juego como un campo de batalla.

cards.name: A'kra
cards.description: Long limbs give him an unusually wide defensive range, and once he traps an opponent, there's no escape.
cards.description_es: Gracias a sus piernas tan largas hace que cualquier rival no escape de él.

cards.name: A. Woodbridge
cards.description: He is passionate about robots. He gets excited when they are on TV.
cards.description_es: Su vida son las series de robots. Alucina con sus transformaciones.

cards.name: Alaric Durnham
cards.description: Quick-tempered and easily flustered, he calms himself with deep breaths when anger flares.

cards.name: Aren Yarrow
cards.description: Quiet and composed, he strikes with surgical precision whenever the chance arises.
cards.description_es: Es calmado y resolutivo. Chutará con precisión si se le plantea la ocasión.

cards.name: Ben Curd
cards.description: A die-hard tofu advocate who just loves any tofu-based dish.
cards.description_es: Con que la comida tenga algo de tofu, él ya es feliz.

cards.name: Big
cards.description: The boss of Big Beast Valley who never backs down from a fight. He now resembles his mother even more as he's grown.
cards.description_es: El gran jefe del Valle de las Bestias. Ha crecido muy parecido a su madre Boss.

cards.name: Borel Aurora
cards.description: Able to swim in freezing winter rivers. Claims it's because of his herring diet.
cards.description_es: Se alimenta de arenques y es capaz de nadar en ríos de aguas heladas.

cards.name: Chomo Ba
cards.description: Very strong, and quick to argue. But he's also quick to apologize after.

cards.name: Clive Mooney
cards.description: Thanks to brainwashing, he never remembers the fouls he commits.
cards.description_es: Después de un partido se olvida de las infracciones que ha cometido.

cards.name: Corey Washington
cards.description: He wants to live the American dream by taking his country all the way to the top.

cards.name: Dany Destiny
cards.description: Wild horses wouldn't keep this lad from joining in the town's summer festival.
cards.description_es: Es de Hakata, y aunque vaya la vida en ello, no falta a su festival.

cards.name: Daz Tighthead
cards.description: The rugby club's star player. Has a fierce rivalry with footballers.

cards.name: Dios
cards.description: He'll mow down anything that stands in his way—even his own teammates.
cards.description_es: Arrolla todo lo que interpone en su camino... incluso a sus compañeros.

cards.name: Dirk Anlace
cards.description: Closes in on opposing players at high speed to nip their offensive in the bud.
cards.description_es: Marca tenazmente a los jugadores rivales hasta anular sus ataques.

cards.name: Em Tee
cards.description: This striker plays without emotion and follows Schemer Guile's every wish.
cards.description_es: Un delantero que juega sin emoción y siempre hace caso a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Em Tee
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Un delantero que juega sin emoción y siempre hace caso a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Fishel Bucket
cards.description: His sideburns are lovingly crafted, but everyone thinks they're just stubble.

cards.name: Flint Charcoal
cards.description: A Sanctum trainer. His passes are said to be practically unstoppable.
cards.description_es: Entrenador del Santuario. Dicen que da unos pases milimétricos.

cards.name: Francis Tell
cards.description: Trusting to a fault, he's easily fooled. Both by others, and their well-timed feints.

cards.name: Frey Fielding
cards.description: The school's vegetable plots are in safe hands, as he oversees every crop from planting to harvest.

cards.name: Gaffer Mason
cards.description: Easygoing and solid as a rock, he trains harder than anyone to live up to their trust.

cards.name: Golgi Tai
cards.description: Surprisingly tidy despite his bold appearance and often called on by friends to clean their rooms.

cards.name: Harry Dwind
cards.description: The "Raging Sandstorm." Don't be fooled by his looks—he's ruthless.
cards.description_es: Nunca te fíes de "La tormenta": es implacable y no le caes bien.

cards.name: Heyze
cards.description: This martial arts master gets stressed when she doesn't use her powers.
cards.description_es: Esta hábil guerrera se frustra si no puede dar rienda suelta a su poder.

cards.name: Hoichiro Ashiguro
cards.description: Often getting into trouble for tracking mud around the house after practice.
cards.description_es: Siempre deja la casa llena de barro cuando vuelve del entrenamiento.

cards.name: Jack Sawyer
cards.description: Deeply principled and loyal to a fault, he plans to apprentice as a chef after graduating.

cards.name: Jen Quibble
cards.description: A big-hearted boy who doesn't get distracted by the little things.

cards.name: Kenville
cards.description: He kowtows to strong players, but bullies the weak.
cards.description_es: Él juega con ganas cuando tiene delante a un jugador mediocre.

cards.name: Kurt Zawel
cards.description: If he doesn't get his daily portion of Kartoffelsalat, he's got no energy.
cards.description_es: Si no consigue su ración diaria de chucrut, se queda sin energía.

cards.name: Lou Edmonds
cards.description: Always seen running around helping out at his parents' restaurant.
cards.description_es: Ayuda en el bar de sus padres repartiendo comida a domicilio.

cards.name: Lucia
cards.description: Young girl who became able to see again thanks to Ray Dark. She admires her benefactor and can't wait to meet him again.

cards.name: Marshall Firsthand
cards.description: He can stop crimes before they're committed by second-guessing criminal's moves.
cards.description_es: Prevé lo que piensan los criminales y evita que ocurran desgracias.

cards.name: Mary Moor
cards.description: In her free time, she performs elaborate dance routines in the park.
cards.description_es: Los días de fiesta actúa en la calle.

cards.name: Maston Color
cards.description: He lacks motivation at first, but once he gets going, he gives it his all.
cards.description_es: No le pone muchas ganas, pero si se lo toma en serio, arrasa.

cards.name: Matt Durer
cards.description: Ivy Selective's respectable goalie. Often mistaken for their manager.
cards.description_es: Admirado portero del Colegio Ultramegahiedra. Lo suelen confundir con el entrenador.

cards.name: Mei Chaptri
cards.description: Her parents run a floating market, so she's been living life on the water since she was little.
cards.description_es: Sus padres abrieron un mercado en Kioto y ella les proporciona su ayuda.

cards.name: Merapil Sekretair
cards.description: Always chasing the new, he was the first on the team to trade wings for a mechanical arm.

cards.name: Milton Bindings
cards.description: He loves shellfish and has an emergency supply to nibble during games.

cards.name: Nathan Adams
cards.description: A fifth grader from Springdale who tracks down the town's yokai with his Yokai Watch.
cards.description_es: : Alumno del colegio de Floridablanca. Ve Yo-kai con su reloj.

cards.name: Nix Pluto
cards.description: His status as a member of the team is sometimes called into question.
cards.description_es: Aunque solo construye aparatos para sí mismo, se considera un inventor.

cards.name: Oscar Pio
cards.description: Easygoing and popular, he sets up seamless plays for his teammates.
cards.description_es: Tranquilo y popular. Ayuda a sus compañeros con sus dotes de trabajo en equipo.

cards.name: Pacey Hawker
cards.description: A fiery, competitive striker with downtown roots, he keeps the team's energy and spirits high.

cards.name: Pelta Chincha
cards.description: She loves to write letters, but she's too embarrassed to actually send any.
cards.description_es: Le encanta escribir cartas, pero no las manda nunca por vergüenza.

cards.name: Pike Pollack
cards.description: The son of a fisherman. Never fails to catch his mark.
cards.description_es: Hijo de un experimentado pescador, da mucha caña en el campo de fútbol.

cards.name: Poppy Playhard
cards.description: She does her homework before she goes to school, so she's free after class.
cards.description_es: Hace sus tareas antes de ir a la escuela, por lo que está libre después de clases.

cards.name: Queen of Dragons
cards.description: A dragon who opposed King Arthur in the legend of Camelot. Carries the ferocity of a beast, and the intellect of a sage.

cards.name: Reid Rivers
cards.description: A gentle-looking, old-fashioned player who stays composed and holds the defence together.
cards.description_es: Un jugador de aspecto delicado y algo chapado a la antigua. Mantiene la defensa unida con su determinación.

cards.name: Ricky Clover
cards.description: Rock solid and stock still, he's often mistaken for a statue.
cards.description_es: Suele estar quieto como una estatua y todos lo toman por una.

cards.name: Ricky Clover
cards.description: Rock solid and stock still, he's often mistaken for a statue.

cards.name: Rocky Hardcastle
cards.description: One of the team's pillars, he bulldozes past opponents with his sheer physical dominance.

cards.name: Rocky Rollans
cards.description: He plays in a noisy rock band at school and is busy making a CD.

cards.name: Shakir Zahir
cards.description: His bandana is meant as a style statement, but it's often mistaken for a bandage at first.
cards.description_es: La gente confunde el pañuelo que lleva en la cabeza con un vendaje.

cards.name: Sidern
cards.description: He weight trains every day and fazes opponents with his steely gaze.
cards.description_es: Su mirada penetrante asusta a los rivales. Entrena cada día sin falta.

cards.name: Sigfryd Roi
cards.description: A hobbyist trick art illustrator with big dreams, currently planning his first gallery show.
cards.description_es: Usa ilusiones ópticas para eludir la vigilancia del equipo rival.

cards.name: Siyabonga Mahlangu
cards.description: His ambition is to sail around the world on a boat that he made himself.
cards.description_es: Sueña con dar la vuelta al mundo en un velero de manufactura propia.

cards.name: Sploosh Saroma
cards.description: While somewhat reserved, she's an excellent listener and often sought out for life advice.
cards.description_es: Es muy antipática y por eso ha sufrido muchos problemas en su vida.

cards.name: Stan Andagi
cards.description: He bakes vast batches of doughnuts, but eats them all himself.
cards.description_es: Hace una rosquillas para chuparse los dedos, pero no da a nadie.

cards.name: Tar Parky
cards.description: Always found at Nevado's side. Yet, what he's thinking remains a complete mystery.
cards.description_es: Siempre está con Nevado. Nadie sabe qué es lo que piensa

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 3
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Worried that it's all going to pot.

cards.name: Tessell
cards.description: A talented midfielder who studies special moves intensely.
cards.description_es: Una centrocampista de gran talento a la que le pirra estudiar supertécnicas.

cards.name: Tim Crochett
cards.description: Always by the fireplace in winter. Believes Santa will come through it.

cards.name: Torhm
cards.description: Had no friends when he was young and now finds it hard to trust others.
cards.description_es: De pequeño no tenía amigos, así que ahora le cuesta confiar en otros.

cards.name: Vee Wai
cards.description: This creepily red-eyed goalkeeper follows Schemer Guile's every order.
cards.description_es: Este portero de ojos rojos obedece todas las órdenes de Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Vee Wai
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Este portero de ojos rojos obedece todas las órdenes de Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Wallace Hammond
cards.description: No one's faster when it comes to tracking down criminals.
cards.description_es: Cuando se trata de perseguir a un criminal, nadie corre más que él.

cards.name: Walter Trope
cards.description: He's on a quest for old parts so he can restore his beloved antique clocks.

cards.name: Wesley Provolone
cards.description: He's famous for his mastery of complex wrestling holds.
