cards.description_es: Es famoso por su destreza ejecutando complicadas llaves de lucha libre.

cards.name: Yve Dunbar
cards.description: Looks aren't important to her. If a guy can rip a phone book in half, she's sold.
cards.description_es: Le gustan los hombres fuertes sin importarle que sean feos.

cards.name: Zato Memmor
cards.description: Always remembers the names and faces of people he meets in person.

cards.name: Amanda Ray
cards.description: She quietly keeps the team running, but isn't afraid to scold the troublemakers either.
cards.description_es: Es la más madura del equipo y regaña a sus compañeros más traviesos.

cards.name: Amaranto Rubino
cards.description: They laughed when he said he wanted to turn pro, but he's determined to laugh last.
cards.description_es: Se burlaban de él cuando decía que quería ser futbolista. ¡Ja! ¡A ver quién ser ríe ahora!

cards.name: Anton Nortje
cards.description: His signature move is an all-or-nothing charge that he perfected playing rugby.
cards.description_es: Su técnica personal es realizar una carga salvaje que perfeccionó jugando al rugby.

cards.name: Bayonet Gunne
cards.description: Though his body is small, his kicking strength is borderline destructive.
cards.description_es: Aunque pasa físicamente inadvertido, sus disparos con casi destructivos.

cards.name: Bri Spark
cards.description: His football improved when he got hold of a mysterious jewel.
cards.description_es: Juega mejor al fútbol desde que consiguió una joya con poderes.

cards.name: Caelif Hopper
cards.description: His incredible legs let him leap five meters straight up and fifteen on a run.
cards.description_es: Es capaz de saltar 5 metros de alto y 15 de metros de largo.

cards.name: Catro Corydoras
cards.description: Possesses beautiful hair, though those unruly curls coil around his neck and cause him trouble.

cards.name: Chops Denton
cards.description: Has more confidence in shooting with his chin than with his feet.
cards.description_es: Prefiere darle al balón con el mentón que con el pie.

cards.name: Cirrus Whisp
cards.description: The "Royal Pharaoh." Well-respected, but his origins are a mystery to all.
cards.description_es: Todo el mundo respeta al "Faraón", aunque nadie sabe de dónde viene.

cards.name: Constance Durand
cards.description: A dependable older sister of eight, she enjoys looking after the team.

cards.name: Cosimo Beck
cards.description: He dabbled in all sorts of sports before finally settling on football.
cards.description_es: Aplica su experiencia en otros deportes en los partidos de fútbol.

cards.name: David Waterman
cards.description: He cut his teeth on Aussie Rules football, but joined the Big Waves to take on the world.
cards.description_es: Empezó jugando al fútbol australiano, pero se unió al Big Waves para llegar a lo más alto.

cards.name: Dino Zolletta
cards.description: He's always drinking cappuccinos. He also seems like a bit of a poser.
cards.description_es: Su bebida favorita es el capuchino y suele frecuentar cafeterías de moda.

cards.name: Earl Eton
cards.description: Like a runaway train on the pitch, he crushes the foe with vicious tackles.
cards.description_es: Entra sobre los rivales como un tren de mercancías.

cards.name: Echo
cards.description: Fast and stealthy. By the time you've seen her grin, the ball is already lost.
cards.description_es: Rápida y silenciosa. Para cuando la veas sonreír, ya te habrá quitado el balón.

cards.name: Eljas Viisi
cards.description: His headbutt is unrivalled. Naturally, he's also a master at flying headers.
cards.description_es: Sus remates de cabeza no tienen rival, gracias a la dureza de su cráneo.

cards.name: Fake Victor
cards.description: Will take on any job if the price is right, using masterful disguises to impersonate even Victor.

cards.name: Ferdinand Delafünfe
cards.description: Somewhat excitable, he can get worked up over the smallest things.
cards.description_es: Inquieto e impetuoso, se irrita con el menor incidente a su alrededor.

cards.name: Finn Geld
cards.description: An amateur treasure hunter who may have just struck gold.
cards.description_es: Buscar tesoros es su hobby. Se dice que ha encontrado oro enterrado.

cards.name: Francis Poujol
cards.description: He dreams of building an iconic structure one day, like the Eiffel Tower or Arc de Triomphe.
cards.description_es: Le gustaría erigir un monumento simbólico como la torre Eiffel o el Arco del Triunfo.

cards.name: Frank Drake
cards.description: Opponents feel the pressure just at the sight of him standing on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Solo de verlo en el campo, los rivales comienzan a ponerse nerviosos.

cards.name: Fürimmer Jung
cards.description: Though small in build, his incredible stamina makes him a potent defender.
cards.description_es: Es una defensa pequeño, pero con una gran resistencia física.

cards.name: Gamal Everlast
cards.description: Called the "Prince of the Desert" for his ability to play in the blazing heat.
cards.description_es: Juega de maravilla haga el calor que haga. Lo llaman "El rey del desierto".

cards.name: Geoff Nory
cards.description: A master at exploiting others' conflicts who won't lift a finger until the fight reaches full flare.

cards.name: Herman Samuel
cards.description: Serve him a steak, sprinkled with sea salt and grilled over an open fire, and he's in heaven.
cards.description_es: Invítalo a un buen bistec a la parrilla y será tu amigo de por vida.

cards.name: Hick Idris
cards.description: A mad scientist obsessed with modifications who secretly tinkers with others' arms.

cards.name: Ikkatsu Kano
cards.description: A sullen young man who can't take a joke. They say he's the scariest in White Deer when angry.
cards.description_es: Este chico se pasa el día frustrado porque nunca pilla los chistes.

cards.name: Isami Kondo
cards.description: The commander of the Shinsengumi, he fights for the future of Japan.
cards.description_es: El Comandante del Shinsengumi lucha por el futuro de Japón.

cards.name: Jack Mate
cards.description: Collects chess pieces from all over the world to use in games at school.

cards.name: Jacqueline Rabbit
cards.description: Gifted with exceptionally sharp ears. Wears a hat to drown out the noise.
cards.description_es: A pesar del gorro que siempre lleva puesto, tiene un oído finísimo..

cards.name: Jean Gutain
cards.description: A self-styled fashion prodigy. However, he hasn't really proved himself yet.
cards.description_es: Aunque aún no haya dado el salto a la fama, este chico es un prodigio de la moda.

cards.name: Jerry Onimo
cards.description: Wants to become a policeman! A hard- working student who's big on justice.
cards.description_es: De mayor quiere ser policía. Estudia mucho y busca siempre la justicia.

cards.name: Jig Charleston
cards.description: Ballroom dancing is his life. He dances wherever and whenever he can.

cards.name: Joe Bajie
cards.description: He's a lazybones and a glutton, but he's good-natured, so you can't dislike him.

cards.name: Joe Kenneddy
cards.description: He follows the boss's orders no matter how demanding they are.
cards.description_es: Obedece las órdenes de sus jefes por muy difíciles que sean.

cards.name: Ken Ironwall
cards.description: This iron man doesn't allow any monkey business while he's around.
cards.description_es: Es imposible que se cometa un delito si él está presente.

cards.name: Kendall Sefton
cards.description: He practices tai chi to warm up before a match.
cards.description_es: Sabe taichi y lo usa para calentar los músculos de un modo genuino.

cards.name: Mark Izushy
cards.description: This rice ball expert maker can make over a hundred tasty varieties.

cards.name: Martin Blando
cards.description: Maintains a perfectly bland demeanor that makes him impossible to read.
cards.description_es: Engaña al más pintado con su dominio de las expresiones faciales.

cards.name: Mitch Blackston
cards.description: A mysterious shadowy figure who shoots with bruised and battered legs.
cards.description_es: Chico misterioso cuyas piernas están llenas de heridas

cards.name: Noel Vacancies
cards.description: Likes looking after people and dreams of owning his own B&B.

cards.name: Paekyeong Park
cards.description: Academics aren't this player's strong point, so he's hoping for a football scholarship.

cards.name: Pierre Godin
cards.description: His motto is to always play with style and grace, whoever you're up against.
cards.description_es: Su lema es: juega siempre con estilo y elegancia, sin importar quién sea tu rival.

cards.name: Qamar Sadir
cards.description: A motorsports fanatic who'll travel all the way to Bahrain to catch a race live.
cards.description_es: Fanático de los deportes del motor. Suele ir a Baréin para ver carreras.

cards.name: Quetzalcoatlus
cards.description: Quetzalcoatlus, a majestic pterosaur from the Cretaceous era who raised the lost Sor.

cards.name: Ray Pier
cards.description: He's studying fencing at the moment, and loves getting armored up for a fight.

cards.name: Robert Affett
cards.description: Particularly proud of his pearly whites, but his glare tends to scare people.
cards.description_es: Muy orgulloso de sus blanquísimos dientes, sonríe siempre que puede.

cards.name: Schisto Locus
cards.description: Stag's childhood friend, who fought alongside him until taking his last breath in a football battle.
cards.description_es: Amigo de la infancia de Lucan que teme por él en cada partido.

cards.name: Sergei Chernov
cards.description: Lives on naan, a round bread he packs even on trips abroad.
cards.description_es: El pan es su alimento básico. Incluso en viajes largos lo lleva en la maleta.

cards.name: Sinope Linea
cards.description: A player and coordinator who worries about her team members' futures rather than their pasts.
cards.description_es: Gerente y jugadora de la Flota Ixar que solo piensa en el futuro.

cards.name: Sirius Pounding
cards.description: This player's rugby experience makes him prone to committing handballs.
cards.description_es: Jugaba al rugby y se ha acostumbrado a recibir el balón con las manos. Cuidado...

cards.name: Solada Kulkit
cards.description: Burning with passion for spicy and sour soup, she roams restaurants in search of the perfect bowl.
cards.description_es: Siente una pasión considerable por el tom yum, una sopa tailandesa.

cards.name: Taiga West
cards.description: Nimble, swift and powerful, she is an unstoppable force on the pitch.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 10
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Very careful about avoiding scratches.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 11
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Dreams of becoming a great tactician.

cards.name: Terran Gaea
cards.description: Watches a lot of gangster movies, but on the pitch he's a model of decency.
cards.description_es: Le gustan las películas de gánsteres, pero juega limpio al fútbol.

cards.name: Terry Pinn
cards.description: He is as solid and dependable as the black tortoise of Chinese mythology.

cards.name: Tetrae Charlong
cards.description: A dependable organizer whose eyes gleam and shift color with the light.

cards.name: Tez Beyan
cards.description: Miximaxed with Zanark, he still retains his loyalty to Alpha.
cards.description_es: Tras el Miximax con Zanark, sigue siendo completamente leal a Alfa.

cards.name: Tom Gato
cards.description: Always acts frank and blunt, but has a secret habit of caring for stray cats.
cards.description_es: Abierto y sincero, aunque oculta su afición por cuidar gatos callejeros.

cards.name: Trump Loyal
cards.description: His beady eyes make him look shady, but he's really honest and upstanding.
cards.description_es: Su mirada le hace parecer malévolo, pero en realidad es amable y sincero.

cards.name: Ulric Richmen
cards.description: He busks on the street on weekends to cheer up passers-by.
cards.description_es: Los fines de semana canta en la calle para entretener a la gente.

cards.name: Zed Kyu
cards.description: A midfielder who carries out Schemer Guile's orders without compassion.
cards.description_es: Un medio que ejecuta las órdenes de Schemer Guile sin compasión.

cards.name: Zed Kyu
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Un medio que ejecuta las órdenes de Schemer Guile sin compasión.

cards.name: Ace Breaker
cards.description: An awesome athlete who makes tandem lifts and never wipes out.

cards.name: Adrastus Argos
cards.description: The mastermind behind El Dorado, who sends his envoys from 200 years in the future to try and erase football from history.

cards.name: Alex Dauger
cards.description: He always wears an iron mask, and rumor has it that he's actually very handsome.
cards.description_es: Lleva siempre una mascara de hierro. Se dice que es guapo...

cards.name: Anfaira D'vantage
cards.description: He loves Japanese games and anime. He's always bulk purchasing trading cards.

cards.name: Barton Combo
cards.description: Known as the "Game Master," he travels the country visiting arcades.

cards.name: Bernie Ellement
cards.description: He loves the color red, because it matches the burning passion in his heart!
cards.description_es: Le encanta el color rojo porque lo identifica con la pasión que arde en su pecho.

cards.name: Bert Neptune
cards.description: Born into a prominent family, he is now a bigwig on the student council.
cards.description_es: Nació en el seno de una familia bien. Preside la comisión de alumnos.

cards.name: Bettas Renden
cards.description: A dependable, caring presence whose hair flares and glows when she's angry.

cards.name: Bilbo Baton
cards.description: Values efficiency above all else, and pursues it in every aspect of his game.
cards.description_es: Pone la eficiencia por encima de todo y la busca en cada aspecto del juego.

cards.name: Bob Bobbins
cards.description: He's a real slob. He loves to sprawl on the sofa, swilling cola and chomping chips.
cards.description_es: Se pasa el día en el sofá, bebiendo refrescos y comiendo porquerías... ¡Que gandul!

cards.name: Bob Jammen
cards.description: A chilled-out youngster with a love for reggae music.
cards.description_es: Joven carismático que ama sin condición la música reggae.

cards.name: Cassius Tobler
cards.description: He wants to find a way to combine both instinct and scientific reasoning.
cards.description_es: Quiere encontrar una manera de combinar instinto natural y razonamiento científico.

cards.name: Cham Lion
cards.description: He is able to steal the ball before opponents know he is even there.
cards.description_es: Disimula totalmente su presencia para robar balones de extranjis.

cards.name: Chandler Blanc
cards.description: Doesn't show emotion very often, but when he is angry, anyone can see it.
cards.description_es: Poco dado a mostrar sus emociones, cuando se enfada es imparable.

cards.name: Chikka
cards.description: When things go well, she dances. When they go badly, she collapses.
cards.description_es: Cuando las cosas van bien, baila, pero cuando no, se echa a llorar.

cards.name: Clay Ellement
cards.description: He's always calm and collected, and is respected for an intelligent style of football.

cards.name: Clem Chowdry
cards.description: Apparently a huge fan of the Australian hero anime, Koala Diver Man.
cards.description_es: Es muy fan de una serie de animación australiana llamada "Koala Diverman".

cards.name: Conor Abley
cards.description: Values loyalty highly. Has no mercy for anyone who crosses him.

cards.name: Decker Pile
cards.description: He's a meticulous person. They say he's searching for his missing twin brother.
cards.description_es: Es muy meticuloso. Dicen que tiene un hermano gemelo perdido y lo está buscando.

cards.name: Doug Lapp
cards.description: This obliging fellow will do anything you ask without a word of complaint.

cards.name: Eas Tarmo
cards.description: When he has nothing to do, he spends the day staring at the sky, barely moving a muscle.

cards.name: En Sicks
cards.description: This expressionless defender will do anything requested by Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: Cuando Schemer Guile da una orden, este defensa se lanza a cumplirla.

cards.name: En Sicks
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Cuando Schemer Guile da una orden, este defensa se lanza a cumplirla.

cards.name: Equin Knocks
cards.description: Super energetic in autumn, but goes dead the rest of the year.
cards.description_es: Le encanta el otoño y sólo se le ve activo durante esos meses.

cards.name: Ernest Goodman
cards.description: An altruistic fellow who wants to help during a crisis. He's on a crisis-searching tour now.
cards.description_es: Un tipo alturista que ayuda siempre en las crisis. Viaja por el mundo en busca de una.

cards.name: Escott Aspen
cards.description: He's really into old Japanese legends and likes visiting shrines and temples.
cards.description_es: Le fascina la mitología japonesa y le gusta visitar templos y santuarios.

cards.name: Fake Victor
cards.description: An impostor posing as Victor, traveling with the group, but really a space mercenary hired by Ozrock.

cards.name: Gezun Dight
cards.description: Believes your soul escapes when you sneeze, so he's scared stiff of pollen.

cards.name: Hartwin Throbb
cards.description: Lead vocalist in an indie rock band. Particularly popular with the girls.

cards.name: Herman Muller
cards.description: Gamer turned field warrior. Learned all the rules from video games.
cards.description_es: Se aprendió el reglamento jugando a videojuegos de fútbol.

cards.name: Ian Sights
cards.description: Among the sharpest shooters on the planet, he never loses his cool.
cards.description_es: Francotirador excelente que podría representar a su país en torneos.

cards.name: Irving Gusher
cards.description: He gets a nosebleed if a girl so much as touches him.
cards.description_es: Por confirmar.

cards.name: Isabell Mish
cards.description: She's rather conceited and is blissfully unaware how off-putting it is for others.

cards.name: Jack Griddle
cards.description: He needs to eat meat to be at full power. Any meat will do.
cards.description_es: Si no come carne de cerdo o de ternera, no tiene fuerzas.

cards.name: Jen Erris
cards.description: She's a caring person who always takes the time to listen to her friends' problems.

cards.name: Jim Lawrenson
cards.description: Being small does not affect his ball keeping skills.
cards.description_es: Su pequeño tamaño no le impide tener un imán en sus pies.

cards.name: Joe Chugger
cards.description: He can't focus on the match without a major dose of hot coffee beforehand.
cards.description_es: Si no se toma un café antes del partido, no logra concentrarse.

cards.name: Josh Spear
cards.description: Plays online games late at night. He always sleeps in class.
cards.description_es: Se pasa las noches jugando en red y las mañanas durmiendo en clase.

cards.name: Jude Osbourne
cards.description: A rather unapproachable boy who mutters to himself behind his mask.
cards.description_es: Nadie le dice nada porque nunca hace caso. Habla solo y masculla a menudo.

cards.name: Ken Mayfield
cards.description: When it comes to a certain football video game, he's the world's greatest.
cards.description_es: Es el que juega mejor a cierto videojuego de fútbol. ¡Rétale!

cards.name: Kennedy McCarthy
cards.description: He wants to find a gold mine and get rich quick, but he has no idea where to start.
cards.description_es: Quiere hallar una mina de oro para hacerse rico, pero no sabe por dónde empezar.

cards.name: Klaharn Sangsorn
cards.description: Called the force behind Bhak's technique, Klaharn charges through defenses with raw force and fearless energy.
cards.description_es: Fiel al estilo de tirar y empujar en cada duelo al que se enfrenta.

cards.name: Korin Maebayashi
cards.description: So pretty he has to wear an eyepatch to be taken seriously as a villain.
cards.description_es: Como es tan guapo, lleva un parche en el ojo para que lo tomen en serio.

cards.name: Leighton Bolt
cards.description: He can get to the ball in a flash, like lightning in the heavens.

cards.name: Leo Gally
cards.description: A narcissistic boy whose dream is to have his portrait on a banknote.
cards.description_es: Este niño narcisista sueña con que su cara aparezca en un billete.

cards.name: Lieva Snoshu
cards.description: Has long, beautiful hair, but may cut it all off on a whim if she gets too hot.
cards.description_es: Tiene el pelo muy bonito, pero si le da un arrebato no duda en cortárselo.

cards.name: Lob Stark
cards.description: Unfortunately, a shellfish allergy means he's never tasted lobster.
cards.description_es: Es alérgicos a los crustáceos, así que nunca ha probado una langosta.

cards.name: Locke Saflowe
cards.description: An ostentatious boy who seems to fly around the pitch, his hair in the wind.
cards.description_es: Le gusta que le digan lo sedosa que es su melena. Se lo tiene muy creído.

cards.name: Mei Gongzhu
cards.description: She looks (and smells) just like a princess, but she isn't one.

cards.name: Milo Agrias
cards.description: Naturally light-haired, but dyes it darker to avoid standing out.

cards.name: Montaine Skalin
cards.description: He climbs up Mount Fuji once a year when the season comes round.

cards.name: Mudhi Uppindown
cards.description: Excels in both academic studies and sports, but prone to highs and lows.

cards.name: Myriad Arcadia
cards.description: Collects toy banknotes because it makes him feel like a millionaire.
cards.description_es: Junta billetes de juguete porque dice que así se siente como un millonario.

cards.name: Napa Rattana
cards.description: Captain of the Muay Tigers, known for roaring a battle cry before every match.
cards.description_es: Capitán del Muay Tigers. Antes de los partidos hace un grito alto y enérgico.

cards.name: Nev Erin
cards.description: Even in the dead of winter, he'll be out playing brilliant football.
cards.description_es: Juega con brío incluso los días en los que sopla un viento helado.

cards.name: Neville Foodcake
cards.description: Keeps himself and his friends going with his trademark chocolate gateau.

cards.name: Neville Goodenough
cards.description: He's determined to stand out from the crowd, and he'll spend money to do it if necessary.

cards.name: Noel Taurius
cards.description: They call him the Crazy Bull. He's seen off many would-be matadors.
cards.description_es: Lo llaman el Toro Loco. Ha superado a muchos apirantes a torero.

cards.name: Pam Vision
cards.description: Always one step ahead, she's adept at reading her opponents' moves.

cards.name: Paul Rush
cards.description: Known as Purple Lightning, he races past opponents in a flash.

cards.name: Peony Cash
cards.description: Her money management skills are tip-top. Leading banks are trying to recruit her.
cards.description_es: Lleva las cuentas mejor que nadie. Un banco le ha ofrecido trabajo.

cards.name: Ramona Tempest
cards.description: Second of the Tempest siblings. Her lightning shots never miss their mark.
cards.description_es: El segundo de los hermanos Lightning. Sus disparos de relámpagos nunca fallan.

cards.name: Rei Nurtur
cards.description: Volunteers to plant flowers because she loves to be surrounded by them.

cards.name: Rob Burnsides
cards.description: Confused by feelings for a rival team's coordinator.
cards.description_es: Sufre porque se ha enamorado de la gerente de un equipo rival.

cards.name: Roman Kandel
cards.description: He's usually quiet and retiring, but he really lets himself go once a year.
cards.description_es: Normalmente es muy tranquilo, pero una vez al año arde como el fuego.

cards.name: Rupert Spiers
cards.description: Excels in a straight sprint, but useless if he has to turn.

cards.name: Scott Springer
cards.description: Loves taking baths to take the pain out of any injury.
cards.description_es: Le gustan los baños termales por sus propiedades curativas.

cards.name: Shinjae Choi
cards.description: A defender with exceptional reflexes who spends his days off lost in online games.
cards.description_es: Defensa con una vista excelente. Es un experto en el juego entre líneas.

cards.name: Silas Scrooge
cards.description: Likes the pound shop, but ends up breaking the bank when he goes.
cards.description_es: Las tiendas baratas son su pasión, pero siempre gasta mucho en ellas.

cards.name: Sym Copate
cards.description: A drummer in a band. His ten hour drum solos are quite tiring and quite trying.

cards.name: Taylor Higgins
cards.description: A mother's boy who always falters if his mum isn't in the crowd.
cards.description_es: Niño mimado incapaz de jugar bien si su madre no acude a animarlo.

cards.name: Teal Redsky
cards.description: The local squadron leader, he has a bit of a loud mouth.
cards.description_es: Líder de la milicia local, protectora de la ciudad. Arma mucho escándalo.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 1
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Worried that he's easily breakable.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 2
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Particular about how he ties his scarf.

cards.name: Todd Tempole
cards.description: Wears the national dress of a different country every day!
cards.description_es: Colecciona trajes regionales y se los pone cuando sale a la calle.

cards.name: Tony Hacker
cards.description: A rough kid who's always getting "yellow cards" from his teachers.
cards.description_es: Le encanta el peligro. Su tutor le suele sacar tarjeta amarilla.

cards.name: Tortus Northe
cards.description: A clever and stalwart midfielder who can be swayed by nothing.
cards.description_es: Por confirmar.

cards.name: Troy Glodight
cards.description: Pines for the caveman lifestyle. Eats roast meat with his hands.

cards.name: Tu Eigh
cards.description: A midfielder who sometimes grinds to a halt, but is faithful to Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: Este medio a veces es algo parado, pero siempre es leal a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Tu Eigh
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Este medio a veces es algo parado, pero siempre es leal a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Veneth
cards.description: He appears calm and gentle, but inside he is filled with darkness.
cards.description_es: Aunque parece un chico tranquilo y amable, tiene un lado oscuro.

cards.name: Venus Demila
cards.description: She loves big statues, so she has a huge collection of photographs of them.

cards.name: Vin Fleetwood
cards.description: Loves collecting school rumors— especially ones about teachers.

cards.name: Winnie Hull
cards.description: Her scary look means she gets sweets on Halloween even without a costume.

cards.name: Zhang Fei
cards.description: Brave and hot-tempered general under Liu Bei, for whom he has deep respect.
cards.description_es: Un valiente general que tiene un gran respeto por su líder, Liu Bei.

cards.name: Ace Fettick
cards.description: Gets pampered at beauty salons, where he gets his back hair waxed.

cards.name: Al Mannack
cards.description: Tries to overcome his lack of ability with devoted teamwork.
cards.description_es: Intenta superar su falta de habilidad sacrificándose en cuerpo y alma al juego en equipo.

cards.name: Aquilina Schiller
cards.description: Hillman's successor and Raimon Eleven's head manager. She guides the team to victory with precise, if strict, decision-making.

cards.name: Aymer Loozit
cards.description: He'll blow up at the drop of a hat, but everyone knows it's just hot air.

cards.name: Barry Cade
cards.description: Among the biggest on the squad with a presence that presses in like a solid wall.

cards.name: Becca Pilgreen
cards.description: This spiritual lass climbs sacred mountains with a stick and bamboo hat.
cards.description_es: Le gusta mucho subir montañas con su bastón y su sombrero de paja.

cards.name: Belial
cards.description: He uses his magic powers to clearly perceive the dark underbelly of the world.
cards.description_es: Jugador del inframundo que usa sus poderes para percibir el lado oscuro de las cosas.

cards.name: Billy-Lee Adarma
cards.description: This fortunate player is always lucky in games of chance, such as tombolas.
cards.description_es: Juega a la lotería todas las semanas, y todas las semanas le toca.

cards.name: Björn Brocken
cards.description: His imposing build shuts down advances, and his booming commands are hard to ignore.

cards.name: Bob Whittle
cards.description: He's loved to travel ever since he was born on a transatlantic flight.

cards.name: Bones Size
cards.description: Has the refined hobby of viewing Japanese gardens.

cards.name: Boo Fonte
cards.description: Very particular about her hairdo. It's about as solid as a bowling ball!

cards.name: Brava Hardy
cards.description: She can watch scary horror films all by herself, she's so brave.
cards.description_es: Es tan valiente que es capaz de ver una película de miedo a solas.

cards.name: Burleigh Carpenter
cards.description: A gentle giant on defence who gained surprising quickness through Mark's relentless training.

cards.name: Cain Cavalier
cards.description: A budding performing artist, always ready to give out autographs.

cards.name: Cameron Cambridge
cards.description: A utility player, able to adjust his play style to suit the situation at hand.
cards.description_es: Este versátil jugador sabe adaptar su juego a las exigencias de la situación.

cards.name: Cerise Crane
cards.description: She flies gracefully like the vermilion phoenix of Chinese mythology.
cards.description_es: Es como una de las 4 bestias divinas de China. Revolotea cual fénix.

cards.name: Cheung Po
cards.description: Power play is his field of expertise. Interestingly, he's also a good cook.
cards.description_es: Un jugador fuerte, que no rehúye el contacto. Y también sabe cocinar.

cards.name: Cinereous Slate
cards.description: A Sanctum trainer. His fine judgement makes him a superb goalkeeper.
cards.description_es: Entrenador del Santuario. Sus felinos reflejos lo hacen casi imbatible.

cards.name: Ciril Trine
cards.description: Very fussy about restaurants, but usually spot-on with his assessments.

cards.name: Daisy Young
cards.description: A quiet, petite girl who often gets mistaken for a primary school pupil.

cards.name: Daley Switcher
cards.description: Keeping an eye on the football club for a documentary he's making.

cards.name: Dan Bowsun
cards.description: Lives by the motto "Charge first, think later" and joined the club for the thrill of going all in.

cards.name: Dan Vega
cards.description: A lone superhero who protects the neighborhood in his hero's mask.

cards.name: Dane Upchurch
cards.description: The bone mask is just a replica for scaring opponents, and it does the job a little too well.

cards.name: Dave Lung
cards.description: A diving enthusiast who hunts for treasure in sunken shipwrecks.

cards.name: Dawson Little
cards.description: A man of few words. Give him a meaningful glance and he'll know what to do.
cards.description_es: Da instrucciones al resto del equipo con la mirada.

cards.name: Derika Cachil
cards.description: Fearless foodie who tries anything edible, hell-bent on learning from every stomach-churning mishap.

cards.name: Dock Hickory
cards.description: Practices his regatta skills rowing down the river. He's pretty macho.
cards.description_es: Practica remo en el río. Tiene cuerpo de machote de cintura para arriba.

cards.name: Dong-Hyun Seul
cards.description: This aspiring filmmaker hopes to be recognized with an award someday.
cards.description_es: Este aspirante a director sueña con ganar premios internacionales.

cards.name: Doshin Yomoyama
cards.description: Always has an opinion on everything and is not afraid to voice it, at length.
cards.description_es: Siempre tiene que opinar acerca de todo a gritos y de malas maneras.

cards.name: Eamond Everwing
cards.description: Determined to move like a flying squirrel, he trains by leaping from tree to tree with fearless dedication.

cards.name: Eddie Burroughs
cards.description: Will charge after the ball even if it's deep in the opponent's half.

cards.name: Edward Baron
cards.description: He claims to be royalty. You never know, he might be telling the truth...

cards.name: Everard Valiant
cards.description: A strong, protective lad who defends the goal line with all his might.
cards.description_es: Le gusta proteger a los débiles y mantener su portería a cero.

cards.name: Galahad Chevalier
cards.description: He's a chivalrous person who always looks to help others above all else.
cards.description_es: Mueve la parada del autobús un poco cada día para tenerla más cerca y así dormir más.

cards.name: Gary Primo
cards.description: His habit of always referring to himself as the Supreme Squadron Leader is a tad annoying.
cards.description_es: Líder del llamado "batallón supremo". Es un poco cargante.

cards.name: Gideon Poe
cards.description: A sharp information gatherer tipped as the team's future brain who's still polishing his game.

cards.name: Greg Bernard
cards.description: He plays so robotically that he was given the nickname "Cyborg."
cards.description_es: Le llaman Cyborg por los pases tan milimetrados que da.

cards.name: Grengo
cards.description: Even his friends are put out by his epic standoffishness.
cards.description_es: Como no abre su corazón a nadie, le odian hasta sus compañeros.

cards.name: Grotley Bogwash
cards.description: Son of a powerful sponsor executive, with an unmatched talent for drawing hostility wherever he goes.

cards.name: Guile Crocket
cards.description: Able to lie with a straight face. Don't believe a word he says!

cards.name: Guramki Abantis
cards.description: Constantly moving as a child, he grew up outgoing and able to make friends anywhere.

cards.name: Ham Signalman
cards.description: An avid CB radio enthusiast who makes them from spare parts.
cards.description_es: As de la electrónica. Él mismo se monta sus radios y transmisores.

cards.name: Hector Redding
cards.description: When the spirit moves him, he likes to jive and bop, no matter where he is.
cards.description_es: Cuando está de buen humor, baila mientras toca la guitarra.

cards.name: Hefton Bulk
cards.description: Always cheerful off the pitch, but standing in front of him feels like facing down a stone monument.

cards.name: Helmut Hardy
cards.description: He always wears a helmet to prevent injury to his head.

cards.name: Hershel Layton
cards.description: A university professor of archaeology, and a genius puzzle solver.
cards.description_es: Profesor de arqueología en la universidad y amante de los puzles.

cards.name: Hilary Prentice
cards.description: A newcomer bursting with drive, whose rapid growth lifts the team's morale.

cards.name: Hoots Knightly
cards.description: This owl researcher is often seen prowling around the woods at night.

cards.name: Hugh Dunnit
cards.description: He loves murder mysteries, but can never work out who the culprit is.
cards.description_es: Le gustan las novelas de misterio, pero nunca acierta quién es el malo

cards.name: Ivor Shield
cards.description: A quiet backbone of the team, his sharp judgment and clean control keep them moving forward.

cards.name: Izzy Island
cards.description: Studies football theory. Known for asking adults difficult questions.
cards.description_es: Un teórico del fútbol que lanza preguntas aguadas a los adultos.

cards.name: Jagur Meister
cards.description: Doesn't care much for the finer details. Has a bold and powerful style of play.
cards.description_es: Su estilo de juego es directo, fuerte y sin filigranas.

cards.name: Janine Brook
cards.description: She practices every lunchtime to be the nation's top entertainer.
cards.description_es: Quiere ser la actriz más famosa del país y se pasa los días ensayando.

cards.name: Jason Jones
cards.description: He believes in ghosts and blames them for everything.
cards.description_es: Estudioso de seres fantásticos a los que echa la culpa de todo.

cards.name: John Demi
cards.description: An avid collector of all kinds of bottles.

cards.name: Jon Quill
cards.description: This narcissist just can't stop himself from looking in the mirror.
cards.description_es: Se cree el más guapo de todos y se pasa el día mirándose al espejo.

cards.name: Kit Fischer
cards.description: He's convinced that catfish can avert catastrophes, so he keeps a pond of them.
cards.description_es: Está convencido de que las carpas alejan la mala suerte y tiene una charca llena.

cards.name: Knowle Bathers
cards.description: He goes for a wash before matches by skinny-dipping in the sea.
cards.description_es: Aunque ni siquiera abre los libros, siempre aprueba los exámenes.

cards.name: Knox Loxley
cards.description: A final bastion that remains standing even when the rest of the defence fall.

cards.name: Kuhrach
cards.description: This savage girl gets angry when things don't go her way.
cards.description_es: Una muchacha salvaje que se enfada si le dicen que aprenda modales.

cards.name: Kyohi Sho
cards.description: Always followed by a floral scent, this lady is the subject of many rumors!
cards.description_es: Se cuentan muchos rumores de esta chica, que siempre huele a flores.

cards.name: Lana Service
cards.description: Head of the girl's tennis club, she works on her ground strokes every day.
cards.description_es: Capitana del equipo femenino de tenis. Entrena todas las mañanas.

cards.name: Leo Maine
cards.description: He had a hard time when he was a kid, but he battled through, and he's stronger for it.

cards.name: Lunk Ironbrow
cards.description: His fearsome build and glare keep opponents at bay, though the same intimidation leaves him lonely off the pitch.

cards.name: Maddox Rock
cards.description: He'll ski straight down any slope no matter how steep it is.
cards.description_es: Esquía en todas las pistas por muy peligrosas que sean.

cards.name: Mahrsa
cards.description: Skilled at portraits, but can't quite capture her teammates' likenesses...
cards.description_es: Le gusta hacer retratos, pero sus compañeros no se dejan dibujar.

cards.name: Mantodea Mantus
cards.description: A legendary hunter from Juuro Village who's new to football but full of potential.

cards.name: Mark Failing
cards.description: He's now mending his ways after his woeful grades reduced his parents to tears.
cards.description_es: Sus padres sufren porque nunca estudia, pero está recapacitando.

cards.name: Mat Halled
cards.description: It's good to be prepared, but that steel-plated headband is a bit OTT.

cards.name: Matt Mouseman
cards.description: Loves cheese. Even eats smelly blue cheeses that others leave behind!
cards.description_es: Es muy quesero, tanto que incluso zampa queso azul con mucho gusto.

cards.name: Matt Tudor
cards.description: He insists on wearing a red cape, though it makes the local dogs chase after him.

cards.name: Maya O'Pier
cards.description: Naturally very short-sighted, but her glasses grant her excellent vision.

cards.name: Meriwether Beaumont
cards.description: Always cooking up something silly, he can't help but grin no matter how serious the moment gets.

cards.name: Mike Passing
cards.description: Though he never studies, he always seems to breeze through tests.
cards.description_es: Aunque ni siquiera abre los libros, siempre aprueba los exámenes.

cards.name: Milton Bindings
cards.description: He loves shellfish and has an emergency supply to nibble during games.
cards.description_es: Le gustan tanto las vieiras que las come incluso durante los partidos.

cards.name: Monarch Rome
cards.description: Prefers the classiness of black and white photography, disdaining color.
cards.description_es: Nunca hace fotografías a color. Prefiere el aspecto clásico del blanco y negro.

cards.name: Montaña Tábano
cards.description: When he visits a buffet, he won't leave until he's absolutely stuffed himself.
cards.description_es: El terror del bufé libre, nunca se va hasta haberse quedado bien lleno.

cards.name: Mykerinos Menkh
cards.description: One of the three guardians of Sunil. He will not bow to any other authority.

cards.name: Neil Yetty
cards.description: Likes to go camping alone in the hills. Occasionally startles some poor hiker.

cards.name: Neva Kevinne
cards.description: Really shines during winter festivals, when her snow sculptures win prizes.

cards.name: Neville Merchant
cards.description: Pulled into the club by Billy's persistence and ended up rising from novice to national level.

cards.name: Nick Turine
cards.description: He offers peaches to anyone he wants to make his friend.
cards.description_es: Regala un melocotón a todo el que quiere convertir en su subordinado.

cards.name: Nio Rentall
cards.description: Grabs every new release the moment it drops at the galaxy's ultimate rental store.

cards.name: Nirasane Nebuka
cards.description: His hawklike glare means it's all over for the hapless target he zeroes in on.

cards.name: Norman Porter
cards.description: He's always willing to lend anyone a hand with heavy luggage.
cards.description_es: Es muy amable. Siempre ayuda si ve a alguien cargando con maletas.

cards.name: Oceanus Worldstream
cards.description: Small-bodied he may be, but he's a power player through and through.
cards.description_es: Su pequeño físico esconde una fuerza inusitada.

cards.name: Pete LeGume
cards.description: A committed vegetarian, but don't underestimate his game.

cards.name: Placido Cannes
cards.description: He's always got his headphones on, but he's careful not to annoy others with tinny sounds.

cards.name: Primrose Proppa
cards.description: A stiff, formal girl who addresses even her friends by their surnames.

cards.name: Quebec
cards.description: A midfielder with quiet eyes that hide a fierce determination. A talented player who places his trust in Gamma.
cards.description_es: Parece tranquilo, pero en el fondo es muy tenaz y un rival temible.

cards.name: Quebec
cards.description: Miximaxed with Zanark, his eyes burn with fighting spirit behind his bangs.
cards.description_es: Tras su Miximax con Zanark, su mirada se ha vuelto amenazadora.

cards.name: Quincy Horace
cards.description: As a sideline, this player tries to locate new goldmines in the outback.
cards.description_es: Jugador de banda al que le gustaría encontrar nuevas minas de oro australianas.

cards.name: Renardo Foxe
cards.description: Born into a long line of kabuki actors, he chose the unlikely path of football.
cards.description_es: Su familia se dedica al teatro, pero a él lo que le gusta es el fútbol.

cards.name: Rick Wall
cards.description: Built like a fortress in both body and mind with a reliability that never cracks.

cards.name: Rokah
cards.description: She brightens any room with her innocent optimism.
cards.description_es: Su optimismo inocente alegra a todos sin importar lo triste que estén.

cards.name: Sabrina Passman
cards.description: This speedy sprinter once lapped a rival in a school relay race.

cards.name: Sal Hughes
cards.description: An outstanding striker, he is one of the big four in national junior futsal.

cards.name: Sascha Kotch
cards.description: A living legend who clears whole neighborhoods of snow with just a shovel.
cards.description_es: Disfruta quitando con una pala la nieve de los portales del barrio.

cards.name: Spike Stiletto
cards.description: A rough defender who doesn't hesitate to resort to dirty tactics.
cards.description_es: Este defensa marrullero no duda en recurrir al juego sucio.

cards.name: Telly Fonbocks
cards.description: Public phones are on the way out, but he still collects phone cards.
cards.description_es: Aunque quedan pocas cabinas, aún colecciona tarjetas telefónicas.

cards.name: Tigh Gerwhite
cards.description: He charges aggressively like the white tiger of Chinese mythology.

cards.name: Ton Nino
cards.description: Pumps up the team with songs and dances. Soft-hearted and quick to tears.

cards.name: Ton Nino
cards.description: Pumps up the team with songs and dances. Soft-hearted and quick to tears.

cards.name: Trice Topper
cards.description: Plays with a calm confidence that puts the whole team at ease, rookie or not.

cards.name: Truman Verdy
cards.description: A local squadron member who spends a lot of time practicing cool poses.
cards.description_es: Miembro de la milicia local. Aún no ha decidido una pose de la victoria.

cards.name: Uniform
cards.description: His fierce glare stops any ball in its tracks. Even as a teammate, he still sees Hotel as a rival.
cards.description_es: A su vista de águila no se le escapa nada, y la pelota, mucho menos.

cards.name: Uzma Kyallak
cards.description: A fortune-telling enthusiast whose hair whirls in spirals whenever he reads a fortune.

cards.name: Victor Talis
cards.description: Was no good at football until he got his grandad's lucky charm.
cards.description_es: Era un paquete, pero su abuelo le entrenó y ha mejorado un montón.

cards.name: Waldo Gibbons
cards.description: Armed with animal instinct and deft control, he excels at breaking through tight defences.

cards.name: Warden Watchford
cards.description: Always looking out for his teammates and never misses a chance to lift their spirits.

cards.name: Wenceslas Wales
cards.description: Favours a solid and reliable style of play, well grounded in theory.
cards.description_es: Practica un fútbol sólido y fiable, con buenos fundamentos teóricos.

cards.name: Wes Abbey
cards.description: Hooked on sushi, but too young to afford to pay for it himself.

cards.name: Wiley Cracker
cards.description: He has a limitless supply of corny jokes that invariably go down like lead balloons.
cards.description_es: Siempre hace juegos de palabras más viejos que la ton y sin gracia.

cards.name: Will Reynard
cards.description: Does nothing unless it benefits him. Will do anything to advance himself.

cards.name: Wolfe Redwood
cards.description: Opponents feel the pressure from his gaze alone, long before his strength and finesse come into play.
cards.description_es: Los rivales sienten la presión en cuanto cruzan su mirada, mucho antes de que su fuerza y elegancia hagan el resto.

cards.name: X-Ray
cards.description: With his precise, well-timed kicks, he is often called a model forward.
cards.description_es: Sus tiros precisos y visión de juego hacen de él un delantero modelo.

cards.name: Zenn Wildhorse
cards.description: A wizard with the ball who unnerves opponents with his gymnastic moves.
cards.description_es: Controla el balón con acrobacias y deja atrás al equipo rival.

cards.name: Zyne Hanging
cards.description: A master archer whose surprise-attack skills make him a constant threat on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Cuando la pelota se acerca le presta mucha atención para no dejarla pasar.

cards.name: Ace Server
cards.description: A tennis prodigy who flies everywhere in his family's jet.
cards.description_es: Fue a una escuela de talentos de tenis. Utiliza un cañón de pelotas.

cards.name: Ace Slider
cards.description: This speed skater is a whizz over short, medium and long distances.

cards.name: Adelpha Lovelace
cards.description: Boys tend to treat her like a pal, so she rarely gets asked on dates.
cards.description_es: Muchos chicos la miman como a una hermanita, pero ninguno se la liga.

cards.name: Adi Sivfeet
cards.description: A strange boy who loves rain and has never owned an umbrella in his life.

cards.name: Amy Spires
cards.description: She's obsessed with towers and has to climb every one she sees.
cards.description_es: Está obsesionada con las torres y sube a todas las que encuentra.

cards.name: Apex Paradiso
cards.description: Always worried about his stiff joints. Stretching doesn't seem to help much.
cards.description_es: Ni los estiramientos le ayudan a mejorar su escasa elasticidad.

cards.name: Archie Rider
cards.description: He gets really enthusiastic about things, but he loses interest in no time.

cards.name: Argento Salvage
cards.description: His hobby is searching for sunken treasure with his friends.
cards.description_es: Le pirra buscar tesoros, y si es con sus amigos, más aún.

cards.name: Ayt Bee
cards.description: This defender has an unnerving stare and is utterly loyal to Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: Este defensa de mirada inquietante es plenamente fiel a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Ayt Bee
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Este defensa de mirada inquietante es plenamente fiel a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Banda Crix Junior
cards.description: Son of Banda, the Fertilia Eleven player who lost his life during the match against Earth Eleven.

cards.name: Barbara Bitt
cards.description: A timid, childish girl who can't sleep when she's away from home.

cards.name: Barry Potts
cards.description: Making complicated moves look easy is his forte.
cards.description_es: A pesar de su aspecto, se le da muy bien hilvanar pases con precisión.

cards.name: Biffy Sausse
cards.description: A gourmet alien sampling cuisine from across the galaxy who claims Earth's hamburgers take the prize.

cards.name: Bill Phee
cards.description: Seems to get thinner every day and appears close to falling over.

cards.name: Bjorn Villen
cards.description: It's boos rather than cheers that are driving this aspiring wrestler to become a heel.
cards.description_es: Como lo abuchean mucho, a este aspirante de lucha libre le toca siempre el papel de malo.

cards.name: Brody Gloom
cards.description: A serious player who still broods over a match he lost 3 years ago.
cards.description_es: Joven íntegro que aún medita sobre derrotas sufridas hace 3 años.

cards.name: Cam O'Miles
cards.description: Loves herbal tea. Always relaxes with a brew before every match.

cards.name: Carys Chaparon
cards.description: An expert matchmaker who has trouble finding Mr. Right herself.

cards.name: Cee Eff
cards.description: Devoid of any sign of emotion, this midfielder is loyal to Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: Un centrocampista de rostro inescrutable fiel a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Cee Eff
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Un centrocampista de rostro inescrutable fiel a Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Chester Horse Jr
cards.description: Dreams of being a sports commentator like his father.
cards.description_es: Quiere ser locutor como su padre: locutor de partidos de fútbol.

cards.name: Claude Snap
cards.description: Jude's copycat fan, but does he possess the same skills?
cards.description_es: Usa gafas porque admira a Jude. No se conocen sus habilidades.

cards.name: Cliff Tomlinson
cards.description: Despite not making the team regularly, his ability is fine.
cards.description_es: No es titular porque las lesiones no le respetan, pero tiene madera.

cards.name: Climie Hills
cards.description: This determined lad runs up a steep hill every morning for training purposes.

cards.name: Dave Dreem
cards.description: Tends to drift off into wild daydreams. His odd headgear has no real purpose.
cards.description_es: Sueña despierto a menudo. Se tapa la cara por gusto, no por otra cosa.Descripción/IE GO 2

cards.name: Dave Fate
cards.description: Everyday's a parade for this fun-loving festive fellow.
cards.description_es: Le encantan los festivales. Se pasa el año de fiesta en fiesta.

cards.name: Deece Lightning
cards.description: The second youngest of eleven children. A mischievous, fun-loving girl.

cards.name: Den Hidden
cards.description: A dark horse who's always happy if he gets noticed for a change.

cards.name: Derek Longhand
cards.description: His stellar penmanship puts even his teachers to shame.

cards.name: Doyle Coco
cards.description: His belief that wit and beauty are everything puts him in constant conflict with his brother Kreaton.

cards.name: Drack Gorn
cards.description: He leaps into the air like the azure dragon of Chinese mythology.
cards.description_es: Es como una de las 4 bestias divinas de China. Salta cual dragón.

cards.name: Drakaina Eastwick
cards.description: Weaves her way effortlessly through the pitch like a mystical dragon.
cards.description_es: Sus movimientos elegantes y precisos la colocan entre las más admiradas.

cards.name: Dri Lightning
cards.description: The third child of eleven. A quiet type who lets his defensive skills speak for him.

cards.name: Eren Middleton
cards.description: Drags his feet when asked to help... unless it's a girl that's asking.
cards.description_es: Es un poco torpe, pero si una chica se lo pide, se pone las pilas.

cards.name: Erneste LaRue
cards.description: He takes life so seriously, he looks six times when crossing the street.
cards.description_es: Se toma todo tan en serio que mira seis veces antes de cruzar la calle.

cards.name: Esther Egerer
cards.description: She loves painting eggs and can't wait for Easter to come round.

cards.name: Fabrice Soffner
cards.description: He loves the feel of freshly laundered linen, so he volunteers to do the team's laundry.

cards.name: Grant Stodgell
cards.description: The leader of a rival local squadron, he's far too lazy to do much.
cards.description_es: Batallón rival de la milicia local. Es el líder, pero no pega ni chapa.

cards.name: Graplen Hawk
cards.description: He can scale any wall with a grappling hook, like a true ninja.

cards.name: Greena Grasse
cards.description: Though blessed with a head of blonde curls, she longs for silky dark hair.

cards.name: Greene Beray
cards.description: A special operative who underwent the most rigorous training.
cards.description_es: Espía que ha entrenado en varias misiones especiales muy duras.

cards.name: Grew Driver
cards.description: His hobby is repairing broken household electrical items.

cards.name: Grigham
cards.description: Is perfectly happy to injure opponents if it means he gets what he wants.
cards.description_es: No le importa en absoluto cometer faltas si así logra su objetivo.

cards.name: Guan Yu
cards.description: Sworn brother and ally of Liu Bei and Zhang Fei. Always vigilant, never lets his guard down.
cards.description_es: Aliado de Liu Bei, que lo considera un hermano. Su fuerza es legendaria.

cards.name: Hilda Brunner
cards.description: A mysterious girl seeking a hero blessed with both brains and brawn.

cards.name: Hubert Iger
cards.description: This tiger mask-wearing card game tutor bares his fangs and roars when excited.

cards.name: Iwers Mogan
cards.description: Always teasing with vague hints, but never reveals a single detail.

cards.name: Jasmine Veile
cards.description: She's learning how to belly dance after reading 1001 Arabian Nights.
cards.description_es: Está aprendiendo a bailar la danza del vientre después de leer Las mil y una noches.

cards.name: Jay Pan
cards.description: Fascinated by Japanese history, he wears his hair in a samurai style.

cards.name: Joe Divide
cards.description: This agreeable chap loves nature. He can also converse with his late ancestors.
cards.description_es: Chico majo que ama la naturaleza. Se dice que habla con duendes.

cards.name: Joe Poker
cards.description: Lives for festival beats and dancing, dreaming of a goal that sparks a celebration.
cards.description_es: Una vez al año se desmadra y baila con quien primero pilla.

cards.name: Juan Avis
cards.description: An athlete with lightning reflexes, but he tends to freeze up on the pitch.

cards.name: Justin Cush
cards.description: You can always rely on this fiercely righteous and honorable fellow.

cards.name: Kaburo Hayama
cards.description: Tamed and broke in his own horse. Now terrorizes the countryside with it.
cards.description_es: Domesticó a su propio caballo y ahora siembra el pánico a sus lomos.

cards.name: Laksha
cards.description: A rough, ill-natured forward who plays football like it's a full-contact sport.
cards.description_es: Cuando este delantero se hace con el balón, arrolla a sus contrincantes.

cards.name: Lance Lotts
cards.description: Carries two handkerchiefs so that he can give one to a lady in need.

cards.name: Larry Pogue
cards.description: A cheerful, popular guy despite the pittance he gets for pocket money.
cards.description_es: Es brillante y amigable. Su paga es una miseria.

cards.name: Leon Morcey
cards.description: This bronzeware collector is always hunting around old tombs.
cards.description_es: Colecciona objetos de bronce y los busca cerca de tumbas antiguas.

cards.name: Mackenzie Fordline
cards.description: He swears by goat milk, though those around him complain of the smell.
cards.description_es: Le encanta el cabrito. Aunque huele muy fuerte, está enganchado.

cards.name: Marv Errick
cards.description: He hates playing conventionally and sometimes even ignores the rules.

cards.name: Nancy Polearm
cards.description: This martial artist's moves will put any wannabe fighter, even adults, to shame.

cards.name: Nate Gobby
cards.description: A good-natured lad whose taciturn look often causes misunderstandings.
cards.description_es: Su cara de pocos amigos achanta a más de uno. En realidad es un guasón.

cards.name: Nizo Koda
cards.description: With an arm of pure iron, he's an all-Japan arm wrestling champion.

cards.name: Norlan Rikwatta
cards.description: A top contender in the Fertilia sumo tournament who plays football to stay fit.

cards.name: Oscar Squidows
cards.description: A playful midfielder for Big Waves, rumored to have a crush on Marsha.
cards.description_es: Mediocentro de moda del Big Waves. Se cree que es el novio de Marsha.

cards.name: Pallas Brandish
cards.description: Hasn't grown at all for a few years, so he looks much younger than he is.
cards.description_es: No ha crecido desde hace años y parece más joven de lo que es.

cards.name: Preston Gumbs
cards.description: Takes care of his teeth as he often grinds them during a match.

cards.name: Ricardo Agüero
cards.description: The windy regions of Patagonia have been his training ground, so he's an all-weather player.
cards.description_es: Suele entrar en la fría Patagonia, por lo que puede jugar un partido aunque granice.

cards.name: Rick Hatter
cards.description: He always wants to get at least three points—whatever the sport or opponent.
cards.description_es: Le dan igual el deporte y el rival: sólo le interesa tomar ventaja.

cards.name: Ringo Stagg
cards.description: An old friend of Dan Rhino's. Seems to think they're rivals.
cards.description_es: Amigo de la infancia de Dan Rhino. Ahora lo considera su rival.

cards.name: Roman Blac
cards.description: Bridge isn't just for old ladies— this kid is a master of the game.

cards.name: Russell Walk
cards.description: After a spooky experience, even he is not sure if he is really alive!
cards.description_es: Desde que hizo espiritismo, no sabe si su cuerpo le pertenece.

cards.name: Ryo Terada
cards.description: The other girls are envious of her husky voice and cool look.

cards.name: Sagaminator
cards.description: A big-footed, sunglass-wearing man of steel who hates to lose.
cards.description_es: Es duro de pelar. Se le distingue por los pies y las gafas de sol.

cards.name: Sam Arritan
cards.description: A strong believer in inner strength, he travels the land doing good deeds.

cards.name: Sett Lightning
cards.description: The seventh of eleven siblings. An astute boy skilled at intercepting the ball.
cards.description_es: "El séptimo de 11 hermanos. Es astuto, hábil para interceptar el balón".

cards.name: Severin Volei
cards.description: She's a champion racquetball player, but she worries about the shallow talent pool.

cards.name: Shilo Placidus
cards.description: Plays a sound and respectful game. It's just a shame he's so reserved.

cards.name: Si Sosman
cards.description: He has his own blend of soy sauce, which tastes great even on chips.

cards.name: Sirius Buff
cards.description: Known for having watched every new TV series before everyone else.

cards.name: Stackem Skyhigh
cards.description: He's a larger than life guy who demonstrates a sincere passion.

cards.name: Steve Pinner
cards.description: Uses his family's acupuncture skills to treat any injury with needles.

cards.name: Tam Boyish
cards.description: This tomboy really lost confidence after being told to be more ladylike.

cards.name: Tara Gaudier
cards.description: She loves tacky jewelry and dreams of wearing a gaudy tiara one day.

cards.name: Tey Liadika
cards.description: Captivates foes with a dreamy, sultry gaze, unintentional thanks to chronic sleep deprivation.
cards.description_es: Tiene un aspecto misterioso y distante porque ve mucho la tele por la noche.

cards.name: Tobiah Bragg
cards.description: The heir to Magmavia's secret Kick Arts, capable of landing decisive strikes from unexpected angles.

cards.name: Tog Romack
cards.description: Wriggles his suction-tentacles with skill, using them for everything from eating to washing up.

cards.name: Tom Felix
cards.description: Plays like a star, but struggles to work as part of a team.
cards.description_es: Es muy diestro, pero le cuesta trabajar en equipos.

cards.name: Venoma Sting
cards.description: A patient player who simply watches and waits for her chance to strike.

cards.name: Wilma Morgan
cards.description: An ace volleyball player who has an unbeatable spike.

cards.name: Wowzer Bigtop
cards.description: He has peerless skill in ball-balancing acrobatic routines!

cards.name: Yurina Kumai
cards.description: A member of a popular girl band. She's rather self-conscious about her height.
cards.description_es: Forma parte de un famoso grupo de música femenino. Le preocupa ser la más alta.

cards.name: Ace Bragg
cards.description: A narcissist who believes himself to be the school's Number 1.

cards.name: Alex Copple
cards.description: He's forever charging in without thinking and getting into nasty scrapes.
cards.description_es: Como siempre hace las cosas sin pensar, luego lo acaba pasando mal.

cards.name: Archy Seago
cards.description: He admires penguins and wants to go on an Antarctic tour some day.
cards.description_es: Adora a los pingüinos y quiere viajar al polo sur algún día para verlos.

cards.name: Ashley Silverwood
cards.description: A Sanctum trainer. Her cool head and wits let her build the perfect defence.
cards.description_es: Una entrenadora de la Isla Santuario. Su ingenio le da una defensa perfecta.

cards.name: August Dyers
cards.description: An expert ukulele player who can pluck people's heartstrings.
cards.description_es: Toca muy bien el ukelele. Le alegra el día a quien le escucha tocar.

cards.name: Becks Binder
cards.description: She's pretty handy at restoring old books to good condition.
cards.description_es: Es muy habilidosa y se le da muy bien restaurar libros antiguos.

cards.name: Beorn Kodiak
