cards.name: Biron Pendexter
cards.description: A budding calligrapher who is already in demand for his skills.

cards.name: Blagun White
cards.description: His hobby is collecting old-fashioned monochrome postcards.

cards.name: Bryce Bergman
cards.description: For some reason, his defence improves the colder it gets.

cards.name: Callum Rocke
cards.description: A kind soul despite his fearsome glare, he'll always stand up to a bully.

cards.name: Captain Jokar
cards.description: Enigmatic masked character who is a long-time enemy of the Airvengers.

cards.name: Casey Leather
cards.description: A highly-skilled player, his black-and-white hair makes him look like a football.
cards.description_es: Como tiene el pelo blanco y negro,parece una pelota de fútbol.

cards.name: Chad Taylor
cards.description: This master diver can descend to depths of over a hundred meters without an air tank.
cards.description_es: Submarinista excepcional que puede descender unos 100 m a pulmón.

cards.name: Chauncey Slinka
cards.description: Her preferred tactic is sneaking up on the enemy goal from an unexpected angle.

cards.name: Chesney Horse
cards.description: Known for his bright, refreshing delivery, he is a commentator for the Football Frontier.

cards.name: Chester Horse Sr
cards.description: The famous live broadcaster! He'll commentate any match you want!

cards.name: Chloe Glazier
cards.description: She designed all the stunning stained-glass windows in her house.
cards.description_es: Le gusta decorar cristales, y tiene pintados todos los de su casa.

cards.name: Chuck Pumpkins
cards.description: Looks scary, but actually very kind. Has something of a crush on Silvia.
cards.description_es: Da miedo verlo, pero en realidad es muy buena gente. Le gusta Silvia.

cards.name: Conn Fuchus
cards.description: An avid fan of classical poetry, he always has a book of it on hand.
cards.description_es: Le fascina la poesía china y no sale de casa sin poemarlos.

cards.name: Daryl Floor
cards.description: Loves the hustle of food stalls, but often ends up eating way too much.

cards.name: Demerara Kane
cards.description: He loves sugar cane, and he even chews it when he's at school.

cards.name: Denbee Asama
cards.description: A cunning trickster with a fox-like gaze who uses smooth talk to scam people.
cards.description_es: Dicen que un zorro lo mordió de pequeño y por eso es tan taimado.

cards.name: Derek Rabson
cards.description: A very skillful player who can cut deep into his rivals' midfield.
cards.description_es: Jugador de mucho talento que sabe cómo abrirse paso a través de la defensa enemiga.

cards.name: Dioxily Bocca
cards.description: Conversations with this brilliant mind spiral so deep into theory that most people doze off halfway through.

cards.name: Don Capo
cards.description: Young, but already a gang leader. He believes in survival of the fittest.

cards.name: Dusty Rellicks
cards.description: Very knowledgeable about collecting antiques for a boy his age.

cards.name: Elf Lightning
cards.description: The last of eleven children. A loud, lively boy who refuses to be pushed around.

cards.name: Eunyeong Kim
cards.description: This computer prodigy's only in middle school, but has already won medals as a pro gamer.

cards.name: Formica Anz
cards.description: Small but insanely strong, and stubborn enough to be a real threat.
cards.description_es: Pequeña pero con una fuerza brutal. Muy problemática para los rivales.

cards.name: Frank Lyn
cards.description: Studying hard to become like his dad and grandad, both esteemed scholars.
cards.description_es: Estudia para ser como su padre y su abuelo, eminentes académicos.

cards.name: Freyer Monk
cards.description: Adheres to a strict regimen for eating, training and sleeping. Never gets ill.

cards.name: Frosty Patissier
cards.description: Loves baking. His cakes are both delicious and beautifully presented.

cards.name: Genghis Cohen
cards.description: He dreams of riding through the Mongolian steppe on horseback.

cards.name: Giv'r Trupal
cards.description: Spends all his pocket money on others so he never has any left.

cards.name: Glaucous Gull
cards.description: A Sanctum trainer. A large man whose speed and agility is almost uncanny.
cards.description_es: Entrenador de la Isla Santuario. A pesar de su físico posee una gran velocidad y agilidad.

cards.name: Harpo Kendrick
cards.description: So scared of viruses that he always wears a military-grade gas mask.

cards.name: Harvey Sweats
cards.description: Can't live without air conditioning. How does he cope with sports?

cards.name: Herak Lestril
cards.description: This troublemaker has way too much energy and headbutts everything in sight.

cards.name: Hike Basher
cards.description: His mum often runs errands as the whole family has short memories.

cards.name: Hocus Sesame
cards.description: The elder Sesame brother, storming front lines perfectly in sync with younger brother Pocus.
cards.description_es: El mayor de los hermanos Sesame. Con Pocus forma una pareja mortal.

cards.name: Ian Stein
cards.description: A master of shorthand, but so shy that he prefers to write instead of talking.
cards.description_es: Estudia taquigrafía, pero hablar no se le da tan bien debido a su timidez.

cards.name: Jean-Luc Janeway
cards.description: His dream is to go to the moon, and he sees football as training for this.
cards.description_es: Su sueño es viajar a la Luna y se toma el fútbol como un adiestramiento.

cards.name: Jenral Gaim
cards.description: An expert chess player, unbeaten in his club. Aiming for the pro scene.

cards.name: Ji Tenn
cards.description: A bold forward who is never injured, he's fiercely loyal to Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: Delantero que nunca se lesiona y es leal a Schemer Guile hasta la médula.

cards.name: Ji Tenn
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Delantero que nunca se lesiona y es leal a Schemer Guile hasta la médula.

cards.name: Joaquín Coronado
cards.description: Hates to lose. Has a tendency to value personal pride over good teamwork.
cards.description_es: Odia perder y suele anteponer el orgullo propio al trabajo en equipo.

cards.name: John Maggie
cards.description: Having his top-knot cut off is like being retired from sumo for him.
cards.description_es: Quiere que le corten el moño en una gran ceremonia cuando se retire.

cards.name: Kanzan Focho
cards.description: A celebrated dancer whose bold, graceful performances are a beloved sight among the people of Magmavia.

cards.name: Knight Reader
cards.description: Enjoys reading books in his room with the lights down low.

cards.name: Kurt Sermons
cards.description: He's great at projecting his voice. When he gives orders, people listen.

cards.name: Laura Quilter
cards.description: A home furnishing genius, her room layouts never fail to impress.

cards.name: Loughrey Mose
cards.description: So in touch with his emotions, he's always crying about something.
cards.description_es: No aparece en este videojuego

cards.name: May Jarrett
cards.description: Baton twirling is the hobby of this youngster. She hasn't dropped it while performing yet!

cards.name: Nagahide Niwa
cards.description: A retainer of Nobunaga Oda. Don't let his looks fool you—he's a warrior.
cards.description_es: Un sirviente de Nobunaga Oda. No lo parece, pero es un gran guerrero.

cards.name: Neil Waters
cards.description: Brainwashing helped him look down on those who used to belittle him.
cards.description_es: Ha pasado de sufrir el desprecio de los demás a sentir desdén por todo.

cards.name: Owe Noyster
cards.description: A light eater who's easily satisfied, while Sunny cleans up whatever he leaves behind.
cards.description_es: Se alimenta con pan y un poco de la comida de sus compañeros.

cards.name: Paddy Rise
cards.description: A true rice enthusiast, chasing the dream of producing the nation's tastiest grain.

cards.name: Payne Outler
cards.description: A member of a rival local squadron who is allergic to pain.
cards.description_es: Miembro del batallón rival de la milicia local. No resiste el dolor.

cards.name: Preston Digitator
cards.description: He's got a keen interest in traditional magic tricks and sleight of hand techniques.

cards.name: Prosper Cooka
cards.description: Never one to rush a job, he cooks his food for just as long as it needs.

cards.name: Quentin Rackner
cards.description: This mysterious wanderer turns up and joins the team every winter.
cards.description_es: Jugador misterioso que aparece de improvisto en el equipo en invierno.

cards.name: Quincy Wang
cards.description: He's thinking of writing a commentary on Sun Tzu's "Art of War."

cards.name: Rainier Welkin
cards.description: One of a pair of twin brothers. Only goes to school when it rains.
cards.description_es: Hermano menor de los Welkin. Sólo va al instituto los días de lluvia.

cards.name: Ram Horner
cards.description: He has a strong sense of justice, but he's a bit reckless, so he gets hurt sometimes.
cards.description_es: Tiene un gran sentido de la justicia, pero es un poco temerario y a veces se hace daño.

cards.name: Randolf Finn
cards.description: Enthralled by performing dolphins, he aspires to be a trainer one day.

cards.name: Rick Whitehurst
cards.description: Son of the Whitebridge butler and twin of Bisher. Training as a bodyguard.

cards.name: River Willows
cards.description: At night he plays guitar and sings as a street musician.
cards.description_es: Por las noches sale a cantar y toca la guitarra como músico callejero.

cards.name: Rosa Welle
cards.description: An eccentric with a large collection of photos of UFOs—but they're all fakes.

cards.name: Rumer ReVeale
cards.description: A troublesome boy who likes to spread other people's secrets around.

cards.name: Sheenai
cards.description: All this sweet young girl wants from life is a hoverbike timecraft.
cards.description_es: Todos los cumpleaños pide una moto voladora que viaje en el tiempo.

cards.name: Sinbad Saylor
cards.description: Fluidly shifts between offensive and defensive play as conditions demand.
cards.description_es: Sabe alternar funciones ofensivas y defensivas, según lo exija el partido.

cards.name: Skip Vinall
cards.description: His hobby is decorating his walls with classic record sleeves.

cards.name: Steve Sancey
cards.description: So sensitive, he'll jump out of his skin if someone so much as brushes past him.

cards.name: T.T. Mann
cards.description: He hopes to build a championship-winning motorbike one day.

cards.name: Tage Hamley
cards.description: This child of two worlds seems capable of almost anything, yet never truly follows through.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 7
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Expert at sneaking up on people.

cards.name: Tim Bergoods
cards.description: A slow but steady hard worker. Likes making things out of wood.
cards.description_es: Es un trabajador nato. Su hobby es hacer accesorios de madera.

cards.name: Tiny Jetson
cards.description: He's got a strange and very specific passion for miniature jet engines.

cards.name: Tom-Tom Thrasher
cards.description: A glam rock drummer. His style is basically to hit everything really hard.

cards.name: Tori Torrence
cards.description: One day, she wants to go on a big road trip round the whole country.

cards.name: Trey Hugger
cards.description: Refuses to wear anything but soft, natural, earth-friendly fibers.
cards.description_es: Lleva ropa de materiales naturales porque es agradable al tacto.

cards.name: Val Cano
cards.description: A calm, unflappable girl who somehow always makes her opponents panic.

cards.name: Waite Forrit
cards.description: Carefully bides his time until the right moment—then goes all out!

cards.name: Woody Ellement
cards.description: There's a perplexing and enigmatic aura around this player and his illusory tactics.
cards.description_es: Un aura enigmática y desconcertante rodea a este jugador. Utiliza tácticas ilusorias.

cards.name: Abby de Valera
cards.description: A junior fencing champion, she hopes to one day take on the world.

cards.name: Abe Roof
cards.description: Riverside's football prodigy. Can analyze the whole pitch in one glance.
cards.description_es: Este fenómeno ribereño encuentra el punto flaco del rival de un vistazo.

cards.name: Adam Hesive
cards.description: Sticks to attackers like glue, but gets snappy if they break free.
cards.description_es: Hace marcaje al hombre. Si le hacen una finta, se cabrea.

cards.name: Amelio Thyst
cards.description: A good-natured optimist who takes good things and bad in his stride.
cards.description_es: Optimista por naturaleza. Ninguna adversidad le chafa jamás el ánimo.

cards.name: Amon Boaker
cards.description: Unusually skilled at swimming for someone from Fertilia, he loves floating on lakes.

cards.name: Ann Taisie
cards.description: A real-life princess who is fascinated by how commoners live.

cards.name: Archie Meades
cards.description: Eureka! A truly inspired player. Maybe he'll discover a new move?
cards.description_es: "¡Eureka! Un jugador verdaderamente inspirado. ¿Quizás descubra un nuevo movimiento?"

cards.name: Archie Medes
cards.description: A talented up-and-coming novelist with five critically acclaimed works published.
cards.description_es: Un gran novelista en ciernes, ya está escribiendo la que será su gran obra.

cards.name: Arthur Ascot
cards.description: Has remarkable latent abilities, but his negative attitude holds him back.
cards.description_es: Un diamante en bruto, pero su mala actitud no le permite mejorar.

cards.name: Arthur Crabbe
cards.description: When the going gets tough, this guy tends to faint.
cards.description_es: Cuando las cosas se ponen difíciles, sale del apuro con un desmayo.

cards.name: Austin Tayssus
cards.description: He loves coordinating colorful outfits. But mixing 7 colors? That's a bit much.
cards.description_es: Le encanta combinar colores, aunque a veces se pasa de la raya.

cards.name: Bella Shaded
cards.description: She's rumored to be very pretty underneath those sunglasses.

cards.name: Benny Factor
cards.description: Likes to secretly return favors for people who've helped him.

cards.name: Bill Looney
cards.description: On weekends, he dresses up and hands out balloons at the park.

cards.name: Billy Nomates
cards.description: This dour soul prefers his own company. Just as well, since he has no friends.
cards.description_es: Un lobo solitario que siempre tiene cara de pocos amigos.

cards.name: Bish Beaton
cards.description: His teeth are a mess after years of constant scrapping with his brother.

cards.name: Boe Heemian
cards.description: Favors hoops in her ears, rather than studs—the bigger the better!

cards.name: Bombasta Flamboyanzi
cards.description: She's always in trouble with the teacher for her gaudy, carnivalesque outfits.
cards.description_es: Su profesor siempre la castiga porque va a clase con unos trajes muy estrafalarios.

cards.name: Boo Spector
cards.description: He'd like to build the ultimate haunted house one day.
cards.description_es: Le gustaría poder construir la casa encantada perfecta algún día.

cards.name: Bos Horne
cards.description: Sculpts his hair into horns. Only he thinks it looks cool.

cards.name: Brick DeVille
cards.description: With his trademark scarf, it's the one and only, the passionate Red Ranger!

cards.name: Bruno Tanner
cards.description: Spends all his pocket and birthday money on visits to the tanning salon.

cards.name: Buck Teachey
cards.description: He's only a young'un, but he's a genius. Works part-time as a tutor.
cards.description_es: Es un genio y, a pesar de su corta edad, ya da clases particulares.

cards.name: Buster Chopps
cards.description: Starts fights, but can't remember why. It's hard to stay mad at him.
cards.description_es: Es torpe y se busca muchas peleas, pero resulta imposible odiarle.

cards.name: Cal Cooler
cards.description: He always carries sports drinks and hands them out to anyone in need.

cards.name: Casey Novak
cards.description: A classic gentleman who pulls out all the stops on Valentine's Day.

cards.name: Charles LeMans
cards.description: He's a strong contender in long-distance endurance races.

cards.name: Charr Lightning
cards.description: The fourth of eleven children and easily the strongest and fastest of them all.
cards.description_es: "El cuarto de los 11 hermanos y fácilmente el más fuerte y rápido de todos".

cards.name: Chip Spacek
cards.description: A mysterious spy who had their memory wiped after a blow to the head.

cards.name: Claire Voyant
cards.description: This mysterious fortune-teller's predictions never miss the mark.

cards.name: Cody Fink
cards.description: A genius whose poor social skills stop his ideas from getting an audience.
cards.description_es: Es muy listo, pero no se le da nada bien explicar sus ideas.

cards.name: Conor Trail
cards.description: He loves watching aeroplanes and has a regular spot at the airport.
cards.description_es: Le fascina el vuelo de los aviones y se emboba si va al aeropuerto.

cards.name: Conrad Jacket
cards.description: A big fan of anything with a beat, he loves to shake his funky stuff.

cards.name: Cooper Kettle
cards.description: A great drinker of tea who won't touch water, even when brushing his teeth.

cards.name: Cory Alberts
cards.description: From a long-lived, robust family. His great-grandparents are all still alive.

cards.name: Crateris Mercury
cards.description: Able to control the ball with beautiful fluid motions, like water in a stream.
cards.description_es: Sus movimientos con el balón son limpios y fluidos como el agua.

cards.name: Daren Blakh
cards.description: Loves competitive card games and is always scouting for his next opponent.
cards.description_es: Es pequeño, pero fuerte y resistente. Aguanta muy bien la presión.

cards.name: Dart H. Cylon
cards.description: Though he plays cleanly on the pitch, he's rather unethical elsewhere.
cards.description_es: En el campo juega limpio, pero fuera de él su ética deja que desear.

cards.name: Dee Tarrant
cards.description: He's a classical realist who believes that peace is preserved only by might.

cards.name: Dell Closeout
cards.description: A born haggler who can browbeat shop staff into giving her serious discounts.
cards.description_es: Siempre consigue que le rebajen un 30% en los productos que compra.

cards.name: Ed Ison
cards.description: Attends art classes after school. His creative work draws a lot of attention.
cards.description_es: Después del instituto va a clases de pintura, donde comienza a destacar.

cards.name: Edana Naves
cards.description: Won the 286th Annual Hide-and-Seek Championship after hiding for ten straight days.

cards.name: Electra Faraday
cards.description: Knows the latest in home electronics inside and out, making him the go-to advisor before any big purchase.

cards.name: Eoin Geary
cards.description: This lover of football and sushi has a spicy hint of wasabi to his playing.

cards.name: Esau Tariq
cards.description: Plays in a unique style passed down in his family. A big fan of the paranormal.
cards.description_es: Su familia lleva el fútbol en las venas, fan de lo sobrenatural.

cards.name: Ezra Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Aleksei Karimov to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Aleksei Karimov.

cards.name: Filbert Chestnut
cards.description: Well-known around these parts for his stubborn and contrarian ways.
cards.description_es: Los inquilinos de su edificio lo tienen calado por su eterna mala uva.

cards.name: Finn Attick
cards.description: Works everyone into the ground if he's put in charge.

cards.name: Francie Holly
cards.description: Younger Holly sister, and a former Alpine player. She's unlucky in love.
cards.description_es: La menor de las hermanas Holly. Viene del Alpino y no le van bien los amores.

cards.name: Freddie Stayre
cards.description: The picture of grace and poise, he's even appeared on TV as a dancer!
cards.description_es: Experto bailarín. Ya ha salido varias veces en televisión por ello.

cards.name: Gabriel Shekinah
cards.description: He lives to patrol the streets and help people in need.

cards.name: Gary Burdine
cards.description: Always wears a mask to scare people, but gets laughed at instead.
cards.description_es: Lleva máscara para asustar, pero la gente se ríe de él.

cards.name: Genko Ka
cards.description: He worries his bad eye won't heal in time for the student council elections.

cards.name: George Winters
cards.description: One of the Junior League's Four Emperors. He'll thread shots given only a sliver of space.
cards.description_es: Uno de los "4 Magníficos" que en su día jugó el campeonato cadete.

cards.name: Gerry Attrick
cards.description: Helps out in a care home and wants to be a specialist some day.

cards.name: Gracey Grapples
cards.description: Don't underestimate her ability in Brazilian jiu-jitsu. If you do, she'll break your arm.

cards.name: Grandpa Danger
cards.description: An old man who survives the dangers of the world with pure craftiness.

cards.name: Griff Strummer
cards.description: A budding guitarist with a knack for ad-libbing lyrics.
cards.description_es: Virtuoso de la guitarra. Siempre improvisa canciones cuando toca.

cards.name: Grover Bearing
cards.description: Loves celebrations and forces himself in, even if he's not invited.

cards.name: Hank Shortman
cards.description: Obsessed with basketball, but worried he won't get any taller.

cards.name: Hanna Slack
cards.description: A member of a rival local squadron who likes to leave things till tomorrow.
cards.description_es: Miembro del batallón rival de la milicia local. Tiende a vaguear.

cards.name: Hannah Jarrow
cards.description: A mysterious soul whose origins are unknown, though some say she hasn't changed in a century.

cards.name: Hans Bigger
cards.description: An origami genius who can even make life-sized paper models.

cards.name: Hans Freesing
cards.description: An expert ice sculptor, his work is put on display at ski resorts.

cards.name: Harold Shields
cards.description: He may look small and unimposing, but his play is wild and dangerous.
cards.description_es: Puede parecer menudo y frágil, pero su juego es salvaje y peligroso.

cards.name: Harry Caine
cards.description: Runs around on the windiest days. Probably born in a hurricane.
cards.description_es: Hijo del viento que sale a correr incluso los días de vendaval.

cards.name: Harry Keenan
cards.description: He comes across as very self-assured, but it's really just a bluff.

cards.name: Hedwig Hodge
cards.description: He has a good heart, but he often blurts out insensitive remarks by accident.

cards.name: Hugaro Tarlow
cards.description: Her backside glows at night, so she avoids leaving the house in and getting embarrassed.

cards.name: Iggy Motte
cards.description: A blur of unpredictable motion, he unravels opponents and sticks out his tongue while focusing.

cards.name: Inke Marks
cards.description: Her clever henna tattoo designs are really going down a storm at the moment.

cards.name: Jack Balance
cards.description: A spiritual boy who chalks everything down to the vagaries of fate.
cards.description_es: Suele confiar en sus corazonadas... ¡y acierta a menudo!

cards.name: Jacko Lantern
cards.description: A scary guy with muscles to spare. Can be a little hot-headed.
cards.description_es: Un chico musculoso al que no cuesta mucho hacer enfadar.

cards.name: Janison Veteran
cards.description: Raimon Junior High's long-time janitor. The eldest of three identical brothers.

cards.name: Jay Asher
cards.description: So bright and chirpy, people feel cheered up just by looking at him.

cards.name: Jay Yuu
cards.description: This unflappable goalkeeper obeys every command of Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: Este impasible portero obedece las órdenes de Schemer Guile sin chistar.

cards.name: Jay Yuu
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Este impasible portero obedece las órdenes de Schemer Guile sin chistar.

cards.name: Kay Acker
cards.description: This simple boy likes nothing better than canoeing with his dog.

cards.name: Ken Park
cards.description: Once able to transform at will, he was captured and his power stolen.

cards.name: Kierry Reese
cards.description: Selfish and constantly causing trouble, yet his singing wins everyone over.

cards.name: Kingston Whitebridge
cards.description: Heir to a respected family with a long- time grudge against the Blackcrowns.

cards.name: Kyu Lightning
cards.description: Rough-and-ready ninth child of eleven. Uses football as a form of stress relief.

cards.name: Laraya Orbes
cards.description: This young queen of Falam Orbius sees her late father's reflection in Victor.

cards.name: Laraya Orbes
cards.description: Known as Queen Laraya in her youth, she's full of love for her father, Arculus.

cards.name: Leonidas Epsilon
cards.description: A genius cook. Seems to emit a halo of light when he stands in the kitchen.
cards.description_es: Experto cocinero, brilla en la cocina cuando trabaja entre pucheros.

cards.name: Les Belisha
cards.description: Puts lights on nearly anything, even the flags he brings to cheer with.

cards.name: Levi Atherton
cards.description: He has an uncanny ability to calm the waves with his mere presence.

cards.name: Liana Moonicorn
cards.description: Skilled at playing in the dark, she flits like a football angel in the moonlight.

cards.name: Lou Paster
cards.description: An amateur chemist who always has a test tube handy.

cards.name: Luka Aril
cards.description: Brilliant, athletic, and gorgeous, yet bursts into tears over the smallest things.

cards.name: Luke Blank
cards.description: Stone-faced and soft-spoken, he gives little away except his unmistakable love for the game.

cards.name: Luke Triton
cards.description: Professor Layton's self-proclaimed top apprentice who can speak with animals.
cards.description_es: El aprendiz del profesor Layton. Puede hablar con los animales.

cards.name: Mabhi
cards.description: This serious, methodical boy likes to hatch elaborate plots and schemes.
cards.description_es: A este chico tan serio y metódico le gusta elaborar planes complicados.

cards.name: Mary Curey
cards.description: People are cured of all ailments just by being near her. Provided they don't stay too long...

cards.name: Matt Skerade
cards.description: Greco-Roman drama is a passion for this young man, and he's trying to popularise it.

cards.name: Millie Cheer
cards.description: A large, boisterous girl whose cheery disposition makes her beloved by all.

cards.name: Miyabi Natsuyaki
cards.description: A member of a popular girl band. She's a little bit shy.
cards.description_es: Forma parte de un famoso grupo de música femenino. Es un poco tímida.

cards.name: Munetsugu Niseya
cards.description: Strives to always look his best, and worries that he gets sweaty easily.

cards.name: Naji Khamsa
cards.description: Always wanted to make a wish upon a falling star, but has never seen one.
cards.description_es: Quisiera pedir un deseo a una estrella fugaz, pero no ha visto nunca ninguna.

cards.name: Ollie Tuckney
cards.description: He's nuts about skateboarding and is always practicing new tricks.

cards.name: Ophelio Albans
cards.description: Wise beyond his years. All his friends seek his advice when in trouble.

cards.name: Percy Verence
cards.description: This dependable, nice guy's motto is to never give up.

cards.name: Peter Wells
cards.description: Practices every day with a football manual that his father left him.
cards.description_es: Se entrena cada día siguiendo las notas de su padre, ex futbolista.

cards.name: Petie Pooma
cards.description: He's tiny for an American, but within him hides the coiled power of a jungle cat.
cards.description_es: Aunque es un chico un poco bajito, posee la fuerza de un puma.

cards.name: Phoebus Moonlight
cards.description: A stamina player who charges around the pitch holding nothing back.

cards.name: Ptumri
cards.description: Sometimes hops into a clown doll to prevent his soul from permanently settling in Glacia's body.
cards.description_es: Científico de Kiell y creador del Arpa de la Esperanza. Salvó a Minori de la muerte.

cards.name: Ralph Fary
cards.description: This mysterious chap has a curiously calming influence on those around him.

cards.name: Ray Whitehead
cards.description: Tans easily, even in winter. Hopes he's not damaging his skin.
cards.description_es: Incluso en invierno está muy moreno. Le preocupa la salud de su piel.

cards.name: Reid Scarlet
cards.description: Superstitious. He always wears red underpants for luck.

cards.name: Ricky Shea
cards.description: A would-be sumo wrestler who could not put on weight. Now loves football.
cards.description_es: Su peso no le permitió dedicarse al sumo, así que ahora ama el fútbol.

cards.name: Rip Winkle
cards.description: Completely loses track of the time whenever he's having fun.

cards.name: Rob Anchor
cards.description: Saving every penny he earns from part-time jobs is making him rich.

cards.name: Rod Entwhistle
cards.description: Has legions of multiplying hamsters. He struggles to care for them all.

cards.name: Roland Lex
cards.description: He's a collector of rare watches, with examples from all over the world.

cards.name: Rory Boomer
cards.description: His voice booms like thunder, so his friends often use earplugs.
cards.description_es: Tiene voz atronadora. Sus amigos se tapan los oídos cuando habla.

cards.name: Rory Tigre
cards.description: His sleek figure and soft movements make him reminiscent of a tiger.

cards.name: Sahasra
cards.description: Though he claims loyalty to Zanark, his eyes are set firmly on the captain's seat.
cards.description_es: Hace como que se lleva bien con todos, pero solo quiere ser capitán.

cards.name: Sam Murray
cards.description: Mad about ninjas. Likes throwing playing cards like ninja stars.
cards.description_es: Le fascinan los ninjas y lanza cartas como si fuesen shurikens.

cards.name: Sammy Salter
cards.description: Working hard on both acrobatics and English to join an international circus.
cards.description_es: Va a clases de inglés para poder irse a trabajar a un circo de Canadá.

cards.name: Samuel Buster
cards.description: Plays aggressively close to the edge since being brainwashed.
cards.description_es: ﻿Se ha vuelto un bruto cuyo juego está al limite de la legalidad.

cards.name: Seneca Herrmann
cards.description: Has a fascination for magic shows and travels far and wide to watch them.

cards.name: Senji Kudo
cards.description: If he can't get his hairdo symmetrical, he's grumpy for the rest of the day.
cards.description_es: Si no le queda el pelo completamente simétrico, refunfuña todo el día.

cards.name: Serena Besse
cards.description: She has a gift for flattery and can wrap any boy around her little finger.

cards.name: Serge Major
cards.description: He doesn't like to get his hands dirty, but he's pretty good at telling others what to do.

cards.name: Shah Lott
cards.description: Strangely, people just burst into tears whenever they see his face...

cards.name: Sigmund Wayfinder
cards.description: He's great at reading nautical charts, so his boat is always on course.
cards.description_es: Se le da de maravilla leer cartas náuticas, por lo que siempre lleva el rumbo correcto.

cards.name: Simeon Squareyes
cards.description: Loves watching 3D movies and never takes off his special glasses.

cards.name: Sly O'Hands
cards.description: A master of magic, his moves are faster than the eye can see.

cards.name: Soren Uphigh
cards.description: Dreams of becoming a fighter pilot. Training his body to resist g-force.

cards.name: Souta Hayari
cards.description: Always leading the fashion pack. Says it's because everyone copies him.

cards.name: Stan Tistischen
cards.description: He's adept at assembling statistical data, and then analyzing it.

cards.name: Sunny Fishton
cards.description: A voracious appetite keeps him fueled, from giant steaks to meat pies at halftime.
cards.description_es: Come 2 kg de filete todos los días. En el descanso come pasteles de carne.

cards.name: Súphis Cheops
cards.description: One of the three guardians of Sunil. He's adept at giving orders.
cards.description_es: Uno de los tres guardianes de Ra. Es un mandón de cuidado.

cards.name: Ted Bryant
cards.description: He sees Silicon Valley as a goldmine, and he hopes to make his fortune there.
cards.description_es: Quiere hacerse de oro invirtiendo en nuevas tecnologías.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 4
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Absorbs water but hates getting wet.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 9
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Has many brothers who all look alike.

cards.name: Thomas Oquendo
cards.description: He's an expert practitioner of the old-fashioned art of axe throwing.

cards.name: Tiger Bleriot
cards.description: He's got a thing for old biplanes, and he's got his heart set on a ride in one.

cards.name: Tom Stevenson
cards.description: He likes steam trains and he's ridden on every single one in the country.
cards.description_es: Los trenes de vapor le fascinan y se ha subido en todos los del país.

cards.name: Toshiie Maeda
cards.description: A retainer of Nobunaga Oda. Young and spirited, he excels at the spear.

cards.name: Travis Borer
cards.description: He'd love to be a stand-up comedian, but hasn't got any jokes yet...
cards.description_es: Le gustan los duos cómicos y quiere aprender de ellos cuando se gradúe.

cards.name: Tre Blackley
cards.description: The third of quintuplets and trusty errand boy for the Blackcrowns.

cards.name: Troy Trucker
cards.description: Wants a pimped-out truck, but has to make do with pimping out his bicycle until he is older.

cards.name: Ty Priter
cards.description: A gifted typist, he holds the top qualification for speed typing.

cards.name: Ultima Nextworld
cards.description: A cool-headed master of analysis. Also plays keyboard in a band.
cards.description_es: Una mente fría y analítica, también toca los teclados en una banda.

cards.name: Walken Ruhlbuch
cards.description: He's an expert on all trading card related matters.

cards.name: Wilson Fishman
cards.description: An expert on marine life, but can't swim. Often skips swimming classes.
cards.description_es: Aunque sabe un montón de animales marinos, no pone un pie en el agua.

cards.name: Wulf Blackbean
cards.description: He loves the bean-based cuisines of Brazil, but his friends don't share his passion.

cards.name: Yuth Poonlarp
cards.description: A former Muay Thai fighter who brought his lethal kicks to the pitch, expanding his reach as a true warrior.
cards.description_es: Luchador de muay thai que tiene una actitud muy militar para jugar al fútbol.

cards.name: Aaron Gossamer
cards.description: He's rather self-conscious about his appearance and mannerisms.
cards.description_es: Se siente bastante acomplejado por su apariencia y por cómo gesticula.

cards.name: Ambrose Ericson
cards.description: A renowned matchmaker in school, but has never had a girlfriend himself.
cards.description_es: Un as juntando parejas y haciendo de celestino, pero él no tiene novia.

cards.name: Anne Tenney
cards.description: Afflicted with paralyzing shyness, she strives to remain unnoticed at school.

cards.name: Anthea Tussore
cards.description: Sews her own scrunchies and ribbons, which are popular with all her friends.
cards.description_es: Por confirmar.

cards.name: Apnus Braithwaite
cards.description: Boasts astounding lung capacity. Can hold his breath for over three minutes!

cards.name: Apra Chabel
cards.description: A friendly girl who always seems to get asked for directions, even abroad.

cards.name: Axel Lottle
cards.description: Though he was once a popular child actor, most don't recognize him now.

cards.name: Aye Nort
cards.description: A forward who shows no emotion as he does what Schemer Guile orders.
cards.description_es: Un delantero que no muestra emoción al cumplir órdenes de Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Aye Nort
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Un delantero que no muestra emoción al cumplir órdenes de Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Bella Baker
cards.description: Loves baking bread. People wonder what will emerge from her oven next.
cards.description_es: Le entusiasma hacer pan. Todo el mundo espera impaciente sus próximas creaciones.

cards.name: Ben Danna
cards.description: A headband collector who wears a different one every day.
cards.description_es: Colecciona bandanas y cada día se pone una diferente.

cards.name: Bill Sye
cards.description: A skilled darts player. Has exceptional control and rarely misses his mark.

cards.name: Bill Teller
cards.description: The grandson of a famous archer. He never misses his target.

cards.name: Boyle Egger
cards.description: Eggs are his favorite food. He would eat ten a day if his mother allowed it.

cards.name: Braden Bakewell
cards.description: Likes baking bread and sells it himself at lunchtime.

cards.name: Brom Hexine
cards.description: His fierce gaze belies a gentleness that clears the mind like a quiet breeze.

cards.name: Buzz Scrambler
cards.description: He's really into supercross racing. That's the one with all the funny obstacles.

cards.name: Callie Graffy
cards.description: Her handwriting is so nice, people are always asking her for lessons.

cards.name: Cameron Mann
cards.description: His dream is to have one of his sports photos published one day.

cards.name: Carny Voris
cards.description: Has tried every kind of meat he could find, but never suffered any ill effect.

cards.name: Carter Spaid
cards.description: Leader of a group of local vigilantes who patrol the sky as the Airvengers.

cards.name: Ches Nutcracker
cards.description: His super gnashers can crush even the hardest of gobstoppers.

cards.name: Choen Ryo
cards.description: Makes enemies easily. The only thing that soothes him is napping outdoors.

cards.name: Clark Watcher
cards.description: A school prefect who catches late students at the school gates.

cards.name: Clay Modlin
cards.description: Likes making models. Now working on making the world's biggest one.

cards.name: Colin Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Maxim Adrov to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Maxim Adrov.

cards.name: Colt Youngstein
cards.description: This odd bod boasts about how young he is, saying everyone else is over the hill.

cards.name: Connor Fuschius
cards.description: A ghostwriter for a literary magazine. It seems he's written a lot of articles.
cards.description_es: Escribe artículos bajo el seudónimo en una revista literaria.

cards.name: Connor Seuer
cards.description: Born into a family of gourmets, he turns his nose up at school lunch.

cards.name: Curtis Carson
cards.description: He furiously wills the other team's defeat, but it's less effective than regular tactics.

cards.name: Dai Mondo
cards.description: Somewhat reluctant member of the Airvengers. Fast and discreet.

cards.name: Damon Sumner
cards.description: He likes to summon foul beasts from the netherworld, to help him out during matches.

cards.name: Dan Dandy
cards.description: His years as a high jumper gave him the ability to jump like a rocket.
cards.description_es: Saltador de pértiga que parece un cohete cuando se eleva.

cards.name: Dan Rhino
cards.description: A gentle giant loved by everybody.

cards.name: Dash Dotter
cards.description: A wireless hobbyist. Morse code is a second language to him.

cards.name: Dervan Yorhal
cards.description: Curious about everything but loses interest fast— a typical hot-and-cold type.

cards.name: Dilly Honeywell
cards.description: No great brain herself, but often finds herself watching over her goofy sister.
cards.description_es: No es lo que se dice una lumbrera, pero al menos cuida de su hermana.

cards.name: Dirk Point
cards.description: A secretive boy with a liking for sharp objects—but he only has photos.

cards.name: Dotty Hickman
cards.description: She lost her pet cat and is still pining for her.

cards.name: Dougal Axe
cards.description: His parents own acres of woodland. He's learnt how to safely fell a tree.

cards.name: Drummond Bays
cards.description: A lad whose skills on the decks mean he can chop and screw any track.

cards.name: Earle Humble
cards.description: He was born to an aristocratic family, but he longs to be amongst everyday folk.
cards.description_es: Nació en el seno de una familia aristocrática, pero le gustaría ser uno más de la plebe.

cards.name: Eira Dynamic
cards.description: A fluke champion at ski jumping, who won the first event she took part in.

cards.name: Emosuke Rokudo
cards.description: Has individual taste in clothes. Loves to recite poetry in his latest outfits.

cards.name: Erhard Blower
cards.description: A qigong master who can knock anything over with a mere touch.
cards.description_es: Es un experto en chi-kung. Todo lo que toca sale volando.

cards.name: Evan Yielding
cards.description: He hates fighting and prefers to cheer from the sidelines.
cards.description_es: No le gustan las peleas. Apoya a su equipo en la sombra.

cards.name: Feriando Hidery
cards.description: His parents run a desert palm farm, and he often receives shipments from home.

cards.name: Gem Strata
cards.description: He studied tactics in Europe and plays magnificently.
cards.description_es: Gracias a las técnicas que aprendió en Europa, su juego es excepcional.

cards.name: Gore Lyath
cards.description: This burly kid wouldn't flinch if he were tackled by ten players at once.

cards.name: Gram Vineela
cards.description: He loves old gramophones and even records new discs for them.

cards.name: Guy Kogan
cards.description: He thinks his team's logo is lucky and even paints his face with it.
cards.description_es: Le apacionan los emblemas e incluso lleva uno pintado en la cara.

cards.name: Guy-Jean Harvestman
cards.description: An exchange student from Australia. Has a few odd ideas about Japan.
cards.description_es: Estudiante australiano con unas ideas un poco extrañas sobre Japón.

cards.name: Hampton Harvard
cards.description: A quick-witted boy whose airy attitude can always lighten the mood.
cards.description_es: Un chico listo que con su carácter tranquilo sabe aliviar tensiones.

cards.name: Hardy Scrapper
cards.description: Overconfident and completely without fear. Spends most of his time fighting.

cards.name: Harry Overton
cards.description: Having one magnetic bracelet is fine, but a whole armful?!

cards.name: Hatara Tehaze
cards.description: So painfully shy that her bangs spike up in panic whenever all eyes are on her.

cards.name: Hawky Turbay
cards.description: Travels the galaxy selling food in bulk, making her profits by keeping prices low.

cards.name: Horace Onlign
cards.description: He can always see the bigger picture when he's out on the pitch.
cards.description_es: Observa continuamente lo que pasa en todos los rincones del campo.

cards.name: Horton Giess
cards.description: A beloved Magmavia folk singer whose deep voice and piercing gaze resonate with older fans.

cards.name: Hugh Tinter
cards.description: An expert in exotic names for colors, from puce to ochre to vermilion.

cards.name: Hugo Sauvage
cards.description: Plays like a predator stalking its prey. One day hopes to be a bounty hunter.
cards.description_es: Juega como un depredador y de mayor quiere ser cazarrecompensas.

cards.name: Hulk Flounder
cards.description: Strong enough to crush apples in his hands, but too clumsy to peel them.

cards.name: Ian Watchen
cards.description: A master of using his mind's eye, he walks around with his eyes shut.
cards.description_es: Camina con los ojos cerrados porque ve con los ojos del corazón.

cards.name: Iggy Heade
cards.description: Cast as a terrible adversary in his pro wrestling club, but really quite timid.

cards.name: Jared Dapplegrey
cards.description: The "Sudden Stampede." Normally calm, he is unstoppable when riled up.
cards.description_es: Apacible, pero monta en cólera en un pispás. De ahí el mote: "Estampida".

cards.name: Jari Baras
cards.description: Collects pretty stones and is always scanning the ground for new ones.

cards.name: Jason Strike
cards.description: Loves exercise so much, his home is practically a gym.
cards.description_es: Su afán por el deporte le llevó a convertir su casa en un gimnasio.

cards.name: Jess Winkles
cards.description: A popular online novelist for her age, with some even having been made into films.

cards.name: Jihun Song
cards.description: Trained in taekwondo from a young age, he brings that skill and discipline onto the pitch.
cards.description_es: Se entrena haciendo taekwondo. Usa esa experiencia para el fútbol.

cards.name: Jody MacGough
cards.description: He was given his name because of his father's love of baseball.
cards.description_es: A su padre le gusta tanto el béisbol que le puso un nombre estrafalario.

cards.name: Julius Molehill
cards.description: Has a complex about being small and compensates with a big personality.
cards.description_es: Su tamaño le acompleja, pero le sirve de excusa para esforzarse.

cards.name: Kaven Mirae
cards.description: Eyes closed and fully tuned in, she can hear the faintest whisper from miles away.

cards.name: Kay Zirro
cards.description: This creepy smiling midfielder will do literally anything for Schemer Guile.
cards.description_es: Este medio de sonrisa inquietante haría lo que fuera por Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Kay Zirro
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Este medio de sonrisa inquietante haría lo que fuera por Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Keeley Hall
cards.description: Convinced she's descended from pirates. No quarter for the other team!
cards.description_es: Convencida de que es descendiente de piratas, no da tregua al adversario.

cards.name: Ken Dough
cards.description: Loves samurai dramas on TV. He wove his own straw hat to mimic his hero.

cards.name: Khalil Haddaoui
cards.description: Hailing from Dhahran, where summers scorch and winters freeze, he's forged mental strength that few can match.
cards.description_es: El calor extremo en verano y el frío polar en invierno lo han hecho fuerte.

cards.name: Khefren Chepren
cards.description: One of the three guardians of Sunil. He's obsessed with the riddle of the Sphinx.
cards.description_es: Uno de los tres guardianes de Ra. Está obsesionado con el enigma del esfinge.

cards.name: Kitty Spinster
cards.description: A sprightly girl who can perform high jumps but talks a bit like an old lady.

cards.name: Lars Dijkstra
cards.description: A cool-headed player who only plays football for the sake of his grades.
cards.description_es: Un jugador calculador, que solo juega para sacar mejores notas.

cards.name: Lloyd Tabb
cards.description: Gets up early for his paper round. Usually knackered by lunchtime.
cards.description_es: Reparte periódicos muy temprano y por las tardes se cae de sueño.

cards.name: Lou Fauntleroy
cards.description: He wears a curly wig and pretends he's a European aristocrat.

cards.name: Mac Gabbon
cards.description: When he's not playing football, he's the world student backgammon champion.

cards.name: Mac Robat
cards.description: An aspiring acrobat who trains to make his body more supple.

cards.name: Maia
cards.description: Tezcat's gentle sister, who was cast off into the sea to save her village.
cards.description_es: La hermana de Tezcat. Su pueblo la envió sola al mar para salvarse.

cards.name: Melody Toontune
cards.description: She hopes for success as a singer, singing theme tunes for cartoons.
cards.description_es: Espera triunfar en el mundo de la música cantando temas de dibujos animados.

cards.name: Men Pukk
cards.description: Poker-faced dealer at one of Newcrest's underground casinos.

cards.name: Mickey Schmitt
cards.description: A tough, fearless boy who won't hesitate to go for a diving header.
cards.description_es: Se lanza por el gol, Literalmente. Los marca tirándose en plancha.

cards.name: Mike Vox
cards.description: He longs to be a voice actor, and likes to practice by mimicking people.
cards.description_es: Le encantan los doblajes y hace imitaciones de voces de películas.

cards.name: Milly Vacey
cards.description: This beach beauty looks very cute with a hibiscus in her hair.
cards.description_es: Los hibiscos son bellos... Tanto como esta estrella de fama mundial.

cards.name: Mimi Ceylon
cards.description: Helps out by weeding the garden, but prefers growing plants instead.

cards.name: Mitchi Osha
cards.description: Tries to guide travelers through Mistmarsh Forest, but her poor sense of direction gets her lost.

cards.name: Molly Gunn
cards.description: Likes boys who are stronger than her. Unfortunately, very few are.

cards.name: Nahrje
cards.description: This bright, active girl has a curious streak that often leads to trouble.
cards.description_es: Esta chica alegre y enérgica no para de meterse en líos por su curiosidad.

cards.name: Nate Blackside
cards.description: Third son of the Blacksides. Seems blunt, but actually easily embarrassed.

cards.name: Newt Perfect
cards.description: He's got perfect pitch, so he can name any note just by listening to it.

cards.name: Nick Savers
cards.description: Spends all day looking for cheaper bargains, even if by just a penny.

cards.name: Nick Tofobia
cards.description: At night, he always sleeps curled up with a blanket over his head.
cards.description_es: De noche solo puede dormir si se cubre hasta la cabeza con la manta.

cards.name: Nishan Naudle
cards.description: His goal is to make noodles by only using 100% domestic wheat flour.

cards.name: Norton Waters
cards.description: He's an intellectual with first-rate creativity and powers of observation.
cards.description_es: Es un intelectual dotado de mucha creatividad y una gran capacidad de observación.

cards.name: Ord Ayshus
cards.description: An impertinent boy, whose brazen manner hides a kind, earnest heart.

cards.name: Oscar Petty
cards.description: A huge feng shui buff who always sleeps on the floor.

cards.name: Otto Legge
cards.description: Gets nervous in open spaces. Will try to squeeze himself into a quiet corner.

cards.name: Paco Dermott
cards.description: A gentle giant with great strength, he can be quite fearsome when angered.

cards.name: Paddy Prunus
cards.description: Infatuated with cherries. His house is surrounded by cherry trees.

cards.name: Page Helper
cards.description: A model supporter who can get both the team and the crowd fired up.

cards.name: Pasha Lomo
cards.description: He spends a fortune getting pictures developed from his old toy camera.

cards.name: Paul Steed
cards.description: Rumor has it that he beat a horse at tug-of-war.

cards.name: Phil English
cards.description: Swears blind that his get-up-and-go is down to a daily fried breakfast.

cards.name: Pocus Sesame
cards.description: The younger, more nimble Sesame brother; his tandem attacks with Hocus are pure chaos.
cards.description_es: El menor de los hermanos Sesame. Se coordina con Hocus a la perfección.

cards.name: Pomponius Fanfair
cards.description: He loves the idea of royal pageants, often daydreaming that he's in the seat of honor.

cards.name: Ralph Vance
cards.description: A tough nut with a hard exterior, but he's a big softy underneath.

cards.name: Ringo Spinning
cards.description: Buys any fabric he likes the look of for making clothes with.
cards.description_es: Cuando ve una tela que le gusta, se la compra. Tiene el cuarto lleno.

cards.name: Rob Zervatory
cards.description: An amateur astrologer who has a planetarium in his house.

cards.name: Roost Dubois
cards.description: For some reason, small birds love him and always perch on his shoulders.
cards.description_es: Por algún motivo, los pájaros lo adoran y se posan en sus hombros.

cards.name: Ruff LeGrand
cards.description: An infamous ruffian who acts like he owns the place wherever he goes.

cards.name: Saul Tunk
cards.description: Not a team player, but good at smoothing over ruffled feathers.
cards.description_es: Le cuesta mucho jugar en equipo, pero sabe poner paz tras una pelea.

cards.name: Sean Lavender
cards.description: Loves gardening. A big believer in the soothing power of lavender.
cards.description_es: Le gusta la jardinería y cultiva lavanda, cuyo olor a todos relaja.

cards.name: Shai Klopps
cards.description: His mask scares everyone around, but he only wears it out of shyness.

cards.name: Sharkey Gobble
cards.description: His mouth is so big, he can eat pretty much anything in one bite.

cards.name: Shay Diebold
cards.description: He has a nasty habit of making ominous statements and making people nervous.

cards.name: Snowy Bergman
cards.description: When winter comes, he goes up north to view the ice floes.

cards.name: Sofu Tokrim
cards.description: An alien with impossibly long, sweet-scented hair... and an odd habit of letting others nuzzle the back of it.

cards.name: Solton Benvan
cards.description: She's so obsessed with flying saucers she's modified herself to match. But riding one? Totally out of the question.

cards.name: Steiyah
cards.description: Was a well-mannered young lady, but with her powers, a dark side awoke.
cards.description_es: Un buen día, esta chica sintió un oscuro poder despertar en su interior.

cards.name: Summer Salt
cards.description: Junior member in an acrobatic troupe. Can perform miracles on a trampoline.
cards.description_es: Actúa en un grupo de acróbatas. Su especialidad es la cama elástica.

cards.name: Susuru Hanawa
cards.description: Suffers from terrible allergies all year round, so he's constantly sniffling.

cards.name: Taryn Shyder
cards.description: She never lets guys know when she's taken a shine to them.
cards.description_es: Una princesita que no se muestra débil ante los hombres.

cards.name: Tau Rin
cards.description: She brews her own perfumes, with her newest blend lifting spirits the moment it's uncorked.

cards.name: Ted Fast
cards.description: A stubborn die-hard. Sometimes a little too obstinate.

cards.name: Tenkei Yazu
cards.description: Has a naturally nocturnal body clock. He's fairly useless in the morning.
cards.description_es: Como no pega ojo por las noches, no hay quien lo despierte por la mañana.

cards.name: Theraphos Tranchla
cards.description: Often misunderstood for his shifty eyes and secretive manner, but surprisingly decent.
cards.description_es: Creen que es un villano solo por su aspecto pero es todo amor.

cards.name: Traylor Beadle
cards.description: With her gaudy accessories flailing around, she makes the dance floor her own.

cards.name: Trey Faste
cards.description: Has a real need for speed. Dreams of building the world's fastest racing car.

cards.name: Trey Prongs
cards.description: Believes the fork is the ultimate piece of cutlery. Even uses it to eat soup.

cards.name: Tyson Moodey
cards.description: He might seem grumpy at first, but he's really a nice guy.
cards.description_es: A primera vista parece que tiene mal genio, pero es muy buen chico.

cards.name: Uno Blackley
cards.description: The eldest of quintuplets. A steady lad who takes good care of his brothers.

cards.name: Virgil Amber
cards.description: A local squadron member who can never get enough curry.
cards.description_es: Miembro de la milicia local. Le encanta el curry.

cards.name: Zwei Whitely
cards.description: The second of quintuplets. Likes a peaceful, uncomplicated life.

cards.name: Ada Vyper
cards.description: A ridiculously sore loser, she can hold a grudge for months on end.
cards.description_es: No sabe perder y puede pasar meses rabiando y planeando la venganza.

cards.name: Adam Nesiac
cards.description: Joined the drama club to be an actor, but bombs every time.

cards.name: Adam Orable
cards.description: A timid and modest boy who makes all the girls want to look after him.

cards.name: Aidull Wanabi
cards.description: This one dreams of success and fame, and he's none too fussed how he achieves it.

cards.name: Al Overa
