cards.description: A heartthrob and three-time back-to-back champion of the Tough-skin Contest.

cards.name: Crane Clawson
cards.description: Famous for playing grabber games. There is nothing he can't win.

cards.name: Dar Wynne
cards.description: Girls are his weakness; he can never turn down a request from a pretty face.
cards.description_es: Las chicas monas son su debilidad y no sabría decirle que no a ninguna.

cards.name: Davy Johns
cards.description: A swimmer and sea-water zealot. Refuses to use the school pool.

cards.name: Dec Orum
cards.description: Seems infatuated with tradition, but likes new ideas too.

cards.name: Denrai Ochimura
cards.description: A thug among thugs. Even his baby daughter is terrified of him!
cards.description_es: Su nombre causa tal pavor que hasta los bebés lloran cuando lo oyen.

cards.name: Des Count
cards.description: This natural salesman makes most of the sales at his folks' electrical goods shop.

cards.name: Des Eving
cards.description: Don't be fooled by his intellectual air— his school results are abysmal.

cards.name: Devlin Ogor
cards.description: He used to be handsome, but his face warped as the result of a curse, they say.
cards.description_es: Era muy guapo, pero una maldición le cambió la cara... Al menos, eso dicen.

cards.name: Diazo Cabot
cards.description: A walking powder keg, short-tempered and perpetually covered in fresh wounds.

cards.name: Dorian Lucenzo
cards.description: He longs to crush his opponents off the top ropes on the Mexican pro-wrestling circuit.
cards.description_es: Sueña con ser un profesional de lucha libre mexicana.

cards.name: Dotmar Tricks
cards.description: Born from a discarded device, this humanoid alien crackles with barely contained rage.

cards.name: Dreama Paris
cards.description: Her dream is to become the head maid at the most luxurious mansion in the world

cards.name: Earl Grayson
cards.description: Prefers to austerely sip tea by himself. Will flash a smile once in a blue moon.

cards.name: Eartha Toughlove
cards.description: A formidable girl who can be a bit overwhelming to people she likes.

cards.name: Elu Suay
cards.description: A tiny alien lifeform that infiltrated old electronics and has now adopted a humanoid intellect.

cards.name: Erik Strongarm
cards.description: If it's a boat race, victory's all but certain with this strong-armed fellow.
cards.description_es: Si participa en una carrera náutica, no cabe duda de que él se llevará la victoria.

cards.name: Faiv Ess
cards.description: A defender with an inhuman vibe, he obeys Schemer Guile faithfully.
cards.description_es: Un defensa despiadado que tiene una fe ciega en Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Faiv Ess
cards.description: Schemer Guile's android has a power boosting Hyperdrive Mode.
cards.description_es: Un defensa despiadado que tiene una fe ciega en Schemer Guile.

cards.name: Fingus Inky
cards.description: An avid follower of the news. His family gets five papers a day.

cards.name: Finn Boyle
cards.description: Moody and difficult, but turns into a starry-eyed fan for his favorite idol group.

cards.name: Flint Heutch
cards.description: A skilled cook who treats teammates, though only interested in frying and grilling.

cards.name: Gen Tallgiant
cards.description: Has the strength of two grown men, but he's too gentle and timid to use it.

cards.name: Gene Bottle
cards.description: Hardly match-fit, but very lucky. Maybe his good luck will rub off?
cards.description_es: Es mal deportista, pero tiene mucha suerte. ¿Sabrá repartirla?

cards.name: Gene Bulge
cards.description: He's looking for a slimline wallet that won't spoil the line of his trousers.
cards.description_es: Quiere comprarse una cartera pequeña que no le haga mucho bulto en los pantalones.

cards.name: George Barros
cards.description: Older girls like him, but he's looking for someone his own age.

cards.name: Georgio Plumber
cards.description: No gyms for him! No, he wears a trendy lead-lined shirt to tone his body.
cards.description_es: Siempre lleva camisetas con pesas para entrenar su cuerpo.

cards.name: Gill O'Mend
cards.description: Very superstitious, but plagued by bad luck no matter what he does.
cards.description_es: Siempre que va a que le lean la suerte, le vaticinan mala fortuna.

cards.name: Grant Hoppa
cards.description: With his long legs, he's the rebound champion of his basketball team.

cards.name: Hal Leeward
cards.description: Performing on stage made him a pro at performing feints on the pitch.

cards.name: Hale Quinn
cards.description: Cheers up people on rainy days by showing up in multi-colored wear.

cards.name: Harley Trotter
cards.description: A hotshot who's a very sore loser, but cares about his gang.
cards.description_es: Es malicioso y mal perdedor, pero cuida de quienes están a su cargo.

cards.name: Hector See
cards.description: Magmavia's most alluring beauty, using a teasing charm that keeps men guessing.

cards.name: Holly Blue
cards.description: A talented dancer. Her movements are eerie but somehow entrancing.

cards.name: Hunter Glory
cards.description: Loves being in the spotlight and upstages people at every chance.

cards.name: Isaac Binks
cards.description: His dream is to become an expert at crafting bows for archery.
cards.description_es: Su sueño es ser un experto constructor de arcos y flechas.

cards.name: Ivor Kernel
cards.description: A serious and hard-working boy, often misjudged due to his surly attitude.

cards.name: Iyer Zuck
cards.description: A charming heartthrob with a fan club, whose sharp brows drive women wild.

cards.name: Jarmon Fisk
cards.description: He has an American sweetheart and writes her exceedingly long love letters daily.

cards.name: Joachim Zooner
cards.description: He doesn't know his own strength, so he's always busting doors by accident.

cards.name: Joe Nalist
cards.description: A complete shutterbug. Has a camera to hand wherever he goes.

cards.name: Joe Straiter
cards.description: He's a doer, not a thinker. Gets tunnel vision when he concentrates.

cards.name: Josina Mary
cards.description: Her telescopic vision lets her spot a speck of dust from miles away.

cards.name: Kanchu Ko
cards.description: Thinks his beard looks dignified. Others think it looks "goaty."

cards.name: Kandhul Lai
cards.description: He's not a fan of electric light, so he uses paper lanterns instead.

cards.name: Katie Forester
cards.description: A fifth grader with a touch of spiritual sensitivity from Springdale and Nathan's friend.
cards.description_es: Alumna del colegio de Floridablanca. Gran amiga de Nathan.

cards.name: Keenan Mustard
cards.description: This wandering football player has a deep love for burger and chips.

cards.name: Keir Mudgeon
cards.description: A born pessimist, who bemoans his ill fortune if he so much as loses a penny.

cards.name: Ken Sewer
cards.description: Loves making clothes for dolls, but doesn't make anything full-size.

cards.name: Keshia Readingplace
cards.description: She's popular down at the library, because she hands out home-made bookmarks.

cards.name: Kim Arite
cards.description: A school-age sumo wrestler destined to become a top rikishi.

cards.name: Laurie Driver
cards.description: He'd love to be the king of the road in an eighteen-wheeler truck someday.

cards.name: Lee Bei
cards.description: He lost his father when he was young, so he's taken on a lot of responsibilities.

cards.name: Leon Griffin
cards.description: A real trouble-maker whose arrogance rubs everyone up the wrong way.
cards.description_es: Siempre busca peleas, lo que mete en más de un lío a sus compañeros.

cards.name: Leon Proudler
cards.description: A prideful player who won't let anyone else take a free kick he's earned.

cards.name: Leroy Rhymes
cards.description: Trains his balance by practicing on a unicycle he got in primary school.
cards.description_es: Desde pequeño trabaja su equilibrio con ayuda de un monociclo.

cards.name: Les Knightley
cards.description: A sneaky prankster. His favorite prank is the short-sheet trick.

cards.name: Lewis Brownie
cards.description: He believes in flower fairies and goes searching for them in parks.

cards.name: Lykan Moss
cards.description: He's not overly concerned with his looks, so he let his beard grow out.

cards.name: Marilyn Henshaw
cards.description: Highly-opinionated, she'll give you a piece of her mind whether you asked for it or not.

cards.name: Martin Sheller
cards.description: Always acts like one of the boys, but clams up in front of girls.
cards.description_es: Va de gallito con los chicos, pero con las mujeres se achanta.

cards.name: Mildford Scott
cards.description: Keeps up to date on world football using football sites and magazines.
cards.description_es: Importa revistas y lee en internet sobre fútbol. No se le escapa nada.

cards.name: Minseo Byun
cards.description: Never without her trusty bottle of chili peppers, she drenches every meal in spicy goodness.
cards.description_es: Siempre lleva consigo un bote de chile que echa en todas sus comidas.

cards.name: Mo Lusk
cards.description: Has a profound love for calamari, but can't get it anywhere nearby.

cards.name: Mo Zarella
cards.description: This pizza aficionado knows all of the best restaurants around.

cards.name: Mozun Yarne
cards.description: A cold-blooded enforcer in Newcrest's vigilante force who executes captured criminals without mercy.

cards.name: Naowarat Rahman
cards.description: He and Suchart go way back—childhood friends turned rivals. Serious and driven, he puts his all into everything he does.
cards.description_es: Amigo de la infancia y rival de Charat. Aportan mucha energía al grupo.

cards.name: Nick Washing
cards.description: A fastidious neat freak, he polishes anything that is dirty.
cards.description_es: Quiere ver a su equipo ganar un mundial y cumplir así su mayor sueño.

cards.name: Niki Colbeck
cards.description: An aspiring journalist who wants to cause a stir with a big scoop.

cards.name: Olivia Twist
cards.description: She was born into a family of weavers with a proud tradition of quality.
cards.description_es: Su familia se dedica desde hace años a la fabricación de telas.

cards.name: Olympe Haymes
cards.description: A great athlete who has set world records in seven different disciplines.

cards.name: Onslow Ball
cards.description: He runs like a one-legged millipede in treacle, but handles the ball like a pro.

cards.name: Par Scal
cards.description: Fixed his eyesight with surgery, but still wears glasses as a fashion item.
cards.description_es: Aunque corrigió su miopía con laser, lleva gafas por cuestiones de estilo.

cards.name: Pat Maclean
cards.description: A compulsive cleaner who wipes his desk clean before every lesson.
cards.description_es: Dice que cuando toca limpiar la clase es cuando de verdad disfruta.

cards.name: Percy Stent
cards.description: A sore loser who never gives up until he wins.

cards.name: Pete Pang
cards.description: Hates grown-ups and prays for anything which might delay adulthood.

cards.name: Pontius Blank
cards.description: A fearless warrior, always on the front line in his paintballing team.

cards.name: Preston Creasefree
cards.description: He's obsessive about ironing the wrinkles out of his clothes.

cards.name: Rain Bowe
cards.description: A multi-talented girl, good at attack and defence. At her best after it rains.

cards.name: Ray Bowing
cards.description: His mesmerizing musical performances hold his audiences spellbound.

cards.name: Rhys Semanrime
cards.description: A fledgling rapper, his shelves are stacked with CDs from the streets.
cards.description_es: Le encante el rap y tiene una gran colección de discos de este género.

cards.name: Rod Opsin
cards.description: Can see better at night, but feels very sleepy in the daytime.

cards.name: Roger Rocket
cards.description: Claims to be able to run so fast that he leaves a vacuum.

cards.name: Rusty Spoakes
cards.description: A mountain biking enthusiast who rides everywhere on the weekends.

cards.name: Ryoma Sakamoto
cards.description: Large of girth and of heart, he has a vision for a new Japan.
cards.description_es: Un gran hombre en varios sentidos. Tiene una visión de un nuevo Japón.

cards.name: Sable Tatter
cards.description: She's great at leatherworking and makes her own bags and belts.

cards.name: Samuel Peeps
cards.description: An enthusiastic diarist, he's always looking for new things to write.

cards.name: Sandy Beecher
cards.description: Hates to see marine pollution and goes beachcombing every morning.

cards.name: Saul Durban
cards.description: Likes to build his own electrical devices. Handy with a soldering iron.

cards.name: Senna Regan
cards.description: A young merchant traveling the stars, occasionally lending a hand to her brother Ricky's trade ventures.

cards.name: Shari Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Aaron Gachinsky to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Aaron Gachinsky.

cards.name: Sibylle Equinox
cards.description: A rather spiritual high school girl. Seems to talk to herself a lot...?
cards.description_es: Estudiante y fan de lo paranormal. Habla sola constantemente.

cards.name: Skip Docker
cards.description: A ship fanatic who watches them go by every day from the docks.

cards.name: Sonny Welkin
cards.description: One of a pair of twin brothers. Only goes to school when it's sunny.

cards.name: Spookie Otherside
cards.description: A believer in the occult, who'll put any incident down to spirit interference.

cards.name: Steven Nevets
cards.description: For some reason, he's obsessed with digging holes on flat ground.

cards.name: Suno Aisu
cards.description: Originally from the far east of Japan. His greatest wish is world peace.
cards.description_es: Llegando del noroeste de Japón, su mayor deseo es la paz mundial.

cards.name: Suzy Stamp
cards.description: This resolute defender never lets up on the pressure for even a second.

cards.name: Tahoma Sequoia
cards.description: Freshwater fish are his favorite food, so he often goes fishing in rivers.
cards.description_es: Investiga cómo limpiar los lagos y pantanos contaminados.

cards.name: Tammy Fielding
cards.description: This stationery store lady is sharp as a pencil and hard as nails.
cards.description_es: Quiosquera con ojos en la nuca. No se le escapa ningún mangui.

cards.name: Teagen Brewer
cards.description: Loves dim sum and regularly haunts his local Chinese tea shop.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 5
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Always stands perfectly in line.

cards.name: Terracotta Warrior 6
cards.description: One of Zhuge Liang's terracotta army. Loves making people jump.

cards.name: Theron Starr
cards.description: He's an expert at throwing shuriken, but it rarely comes in handy for anything.

cards.name: Thomas Ediston
cards.description: An audiophile who shuns CDs in favor of vinyl.

cards.name: Tim Opener
cards.description: He loves tinned peaches and gets through a can of them each and every day.

cards.name: Trappy Zeum
cards.description: Fascinated with carpentry, he owns all the tools: hammers, saws, drills...

cards.name: Woody Prince
cards.description: He loves old Japanese woodblock prints, and dreams of making his own one day.

cards.name: Zane Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Zafar Malayev to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Zafar Malayev.

cards.name: Al Istatin
cards.description: Eats loads of garlic to build up his strength. The smell is incredible.

cards.name: Asif Ecks
cards.description: He's really into special effects, and he hopes to work in Hollywood one day.

cards.name: Aubry Dient
cards.description: Got into football through his girlfriend, who's a big fan.

cards.name: Aya Strand
cards.description: She's learning to weave cotton and silk threads into beautiful fabric.
cards.description_es: Está aprendiendo a tejer hilos de algodón y de seda.

cards.name: Ayuta
cards.description: A midfielder with hidden depths who always plays tricks on his teammates.
cards.description_es: Un centrocampista enigmático que siempre anda gastando bromas.

cards.name: Beck Hand
cards.description: He's an expert with a frisbee and never misses a catch.

cards.name: Ben Evolent
cards.description: Loves volunteer work. Donates half of his pocket money to charities.
cards.description_es: Hace voluntariado. Dona la mitad de su paga a obras de caridad.

cards.name: Benedict Eggers
cards.description: He gets very egg-cited about his daily dose of hard-boiled double-yolkers.

cards.name: Bill Formby
cards.description: Regarded as better than the pros at model figure making.
cards.description_es: Sus figuras parecen profesionales, y encima vienen con regalo.

cards.name: Bobby Duo
cards.description: A member of the self-styled Supreme Squadron, and a real cool customer.

cards.name: Bowan Arras
cards.description: The dignified captain of the archery club and winner of countless trophies.

cards.name: Bravo
cards.description: Keeps his long, curly hair loose on the pitch, but his hold on the ball is tight.
cards.description_es: En el campo se suelta el pelo, pero no le molesta para controlar el balón.

cards.name: Breeze Skyler
cards.description: Those piercing blue eyes! It can only be the perpetually cool Blue Ranger!

cards.name: Buster Clout
cards.description: Possesses superhuman strength. Can open the stubbornest of jars.

cards.name: Buster Lungs
cards.description: An expert in free diving, he can hold his breath for five minutes at a time.

cards.name: Calico Corsair
cards.description: Able to battle his way through any defence and create chances to score.
cards.description_es: Sabe abrirse camino en cualquier defensa y crear ocasiones de gol.

cards.name: Cass Crocker
cards.description: An aspiring plate spinner who finally got it after breaking 300 plates.

cards.name: Chaz Biggins
cards.description: His mouth is so big, he can fit his entire fist into it.
cards.description_es: Tiene la boca tan grande que es capaz de meter su puño en ella.

cards.name: Cherrie Menjikko
cards.description: Loves swimming near the surface on sunny days, sparkling like a playful fairy in the sunlight.

cards.name: Christian Dear
cards.description: Loves new things. Whatever it is, he has to buy it.
cards.description_es: Su debilidad son las novedades. Se compra todo lo que acaba de salir

cards.name: Chuckie Roper
cards.description: Having mastered the lasso, he rarely gets up; he just ropes everything in.
cards.description_es: Desde que aprendió a usar el lazo no deja el sofá: prefiere cogerlo todo a distancia.

cards.name: Clay Turnor
cards.description: An amateur potter who fires new pieces every weekend.
cards.description_es: Le gusta la cerámica y los festivos se dedica a crear piezas nuevas.

cards.name: Clem Attish
cards.description: Loves rainy days, especially when the weather won't let up.
cards.description_es: Un defensa muy tozudo al que le gustan los días de lluvia.

cards.name: Consy Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Ruslan Kashimov to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Ruslan Kashimov.

cards.name: Corvus Cardson
cards.description: A hot-blooded forward who attacks with passion, but he's easily spooked.

cards.name: Dave Altair
cards.description: Has a nasty case of unrequited love for a girl he's only spoken to once.

cards.name: Dias Mondragon
cards.description: A steadfast boy whose will cannot be broken by fear or temptation.

cards.name: Dougie McFlea
cards.description: Jumps right up when surprised. May be a pro high jumper in the making.

cards.name: Drew Crenshaw
cards.description: People have been known to refer to him as "melon head" because of his big, round head.
cards.description_es: Tiene una frente grande. Siempre le preguntan si no juega al "frontón".

cards.name: Drew Serkell
cards.description: A would-be rapper. His English is a bit ropey, so he's quite unintelligible.

cards.name: Ducksquiggan Garboyle
cards.description: Invited by Zarboyle to play football and matches his legendary commentating skills.

cards.name: Due Blackley
cards.description: The second of quintuplets. A wanderer at heart who likes to do his own thing.

cards.name: Eggbert Heading
cards.description: Great at studying, but has rarely picked up on sports.

cards.name: Eva Chatton
cards.description: Always found with her phone on hand so she can start livestreaming at the drop of a hat.

cards.name: Ezio Ryder
cards.description: He's watched a bunch of biker movies, so he wants to ride around on a big motorbike.

cards.name: Falco Peregrine
cards.description: An avid bird-watcher with exceptional eyesight. Doesn't even use binoculars!
cards.description_es: Ornitólogo con ojos de lince. Observa los pájaros sin prismáticos.

cards.name: Finn Carper
cards.description: An eccentric child who prefers raising koi over going to school.

cards.name: Florence Tripps
cards.description: He's so taken with the era of Leonardo da Vinci, he's already done a few tours of Italy.
cards.description_es: Le entusiasma el Renacimiento italiano e idolatra a Leonardo da Vinci.

cards.name: Fred Makepeace
cards.description: Hates confrontations. Always first to step in and resolve conflicts.

cards.name: Gabe Roundhouse
cards.description: Boasts an impressive round kick, but sometimes gets dizzy when practicing.
cards.description_es: Practica tanto su tiro giratorio que a veces termina mareado.

cards.name: Gail Ellement
cards.description: He believes in the simple life. But on the pitch, he'll be up in your business in no time.
cards.description_es: Cree que es mejor llevar una vida sencilla, pero te complicará las cosas en el campo.

cards.name: Gary Salmon
cards.description: Likes fishing in mountain streams, but worries about catching a bear?!

cards.name: Gilles de Rais
cards.description: A knight under Prince Charles. Calm and cool, but projects a fearsome aura.

cards.name: Grim Jinxweaver
cards.description: He claims that he can stop his opponents in their tracks with a magical hex.

cards.name: Hal Löwén
cards.description: Has a refined love for afternoon tea. Visits his favorite café at least once a week.
cards.description_es: Es un chico con un corazón tierno como el de una doncella.

cards.name: Hanbee Yabe
cards.description: A rowdy, juvenile man who still behaves like a playground bully.
cards.description_es: Un joven pendenciero que se sigue portando como un matón de colegio.

cards.name: Harold Derry
cards.description: Researches family crests and gets excited when a new one turns up.

cards.name: Harry Angue
cards.description: His harsh tone means no one wants to hear from him, even when he's speaking sense.

cards.name: Hattie Couture
cards.description: For her, it has to be bespoke clothing. She's very clear about that.

cards.name: In Chikita
cards.description: The nation's number one choreographer rocks a trademark afro hairstyle.

cards.name: Isaiah Shutt
cards.description: Carries a sleeping bag wherever he goes and naps at the drop of a hat.

cards.name: Jacob Grimley
cards.description: Desperate to learn magic, he reads every dusty old tome he can find.

cards.name: Jake Fana
cards.description: He thinks there might be a future in the diamond processing industry.
cards.description_es: Piensa que la producción de diamantes sintéticos es un negocio con futuro.

cards.name: Jeku Hydia
cards.description: She's mild and quiet at school, but she rules her home with an iron fist.

cards.name: Jomon Dorg
cards.description: A mysterious lifeform that has existed since time immemorial, his origins forever shrouded in secrecy.

cards.name: Judge Jury
cards.description: He has a strong sense of right and wrong, but he struggles to take others' opinions on board.

cards.name: Junior Cage
cards.description: He's never managed to graduate from junior high and is now a permanent student.

cards.name: Kim Terberry
cards.description: During the winter she loves to stay indoors and rearrange her furniture.
cards.description_es: Durante el invierno le encanta quedarse en casa y reorganizar sus muebles

cards.name: Kreaton Coco
cards.description: Values strength above all, clashing endlessly with his younger brother Doyle.

cards.name: Lee Bartarian
cards.description: He's a liberal, and he often asserts that school regulations ought to be relaxed.

cards.name: Lillie Quattro
cards.description: A member of the self-styled Supreme Squadron, and a real cutie.

cards.name: Luke Dwight
cards.description: Claims he can guess anyone's weight. Not such a useful party trick, though...

cards.name: Luvy & Duvy
cards.description: Deeply in love, these two plan to wed when the time comes.

cards.name: Manny Atom
cards.description: A cartoon nut with a special taste for stuff from the early days.
cards.description_es: Le encantan los dibujos animados, y se traga todas las series viejas.

cards.name: Marc O'Lepsy
cards.description: Picky about finding the right pillow to get the perfect night's sleep.
cards.description_es: Necesita la almohada perfecta para poder dormir plácidamente.

cards.name: Marina Coaster
cards.description: She has an abiding fascination with channels and seaways around the world—especially the Tsugaru Strait.

cards.name: Martin Fleet
cards.description: A champion runner who's taken part in international long-distance events.

cards.name: Matt Chetty
cards.description: His personality is tricky to read, but his skills speak for themselves.
cards.description_es: Su personalidad es un tanto cerrada, pero su técnica habla por si misma.

cards.name: Maxter Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Kenja Jo'rayev to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Kenja Jo'rayev.

cards.name: Maxwell Claus
cards.description: Superstitiously eats pork chops before every match.
cards.description_es: Es supersticioso, y por eso nunca pisa las rayas del campo.

cards.name: Merry Piper
cards.description: He brings a smile to those around him when playing his penny whistle.

cards.name: Mia Pitchford
cards.description: A softball ace. None of the baseball squad can connect with her fastball.

cards.name: Michael Riverside
cards.description: He became a footballer by copying all of his heroes' moves.
cards.description_es: Imitando a jugadores de fútbol, él mismo acabó convirtiéndose en uno.

cards.name: Miles Panzer
cards.description: Crazy about all things military. Spends his evenings building models of tanks.

cards.name: Mitzi Holly
cards.description: Elder of the Hollys, formerly from Alpine. Prefers knitting to football.
cards.description_es: La mayor de las hermanas Holly. Le gusta el fútbol, pero prefiere tejer.

cards.name: Moe Tivation
cards.description: Bullied as a little boy, he hopes to toughen up a little thanks to football.

cards.name: Moses Pumper
cards.description: His family prefers to get water from a well instead of from the tap.
cards.description_es: Aunque tiene agua corriente en casa, se ha hecho un pozo.

cards.name: Nactena Naksey
cards.description: A near-perfect prodigy in almost every aspect, though even she has her flaws.

cards.name: Nai Swanson
cards.description: Lean and fit, he spends every spare moment rowing on the lake.

cards.name: Narcissa Plane
cards.description: She thinks she's the prettiest, even though she definitely isn't.

cards.name: Nathas Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Domitri Sobirov to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Domitri Sobirov.

cards.name: Nazim Nizar
cards.description: Tries everything to get as tough as Asad, though success has so far eluded him.
cards.description_es: Quiere ser tan fuerte como Assad, pero no lo consigue.

cards.name: Nelson Levene
cards.description: He psychologically analyses his opponents in order to get the upper hand.

cards.name: Ness Sheldon
cards.description: An experienced doctor whose only flaw is a lack of self-confidence.
cards.description_es: Cirujano que por algún extraño motivo parece falto de confianza.

cards.name: Nester Damus
cards.description: He checks his horoscope every morning to see if it'll be a lucky day.

cards.name: Nev Puffer
cards.description: A whiz with a blowpipe, he can hit the bullseye from ten meters away.
cards.description_es: Su puntería con la cerbatana es perfecta si el objetivo a 10 m.

cards.name: Newt Tangels
cards.description: Battles daily with his unruly curls and tangles, but is loath to chop it all off.
cards.description_es: Los remolinos y las puntas abiertas le traen de cabeza.

cards.name: Nick Knack
cards.description: Puts his nimble fingers to good use by designing small accessories.

cards.name: Nick Swagg
cards.description: Would become a thief if it weren't illegal. Now steals balls instead.
cards.description_es: Era un choricillo, pero gracias al fútbol ahora sólo roba balones.

cards.name: Nick Yergrub
cards.description: This odd boy is known for running off with other people's food.

cards.name: Olly Popman
cards.description: Cares about road safety and helps kids over the road at crossings.

cards.name: Otto Sheveme
cards.description: His "helmet" is actually part of his face, with his nose sitting at the tip of that horn.

cards.name: Paddy Popper
cards.description: Hunts out people whose birthday it is and throws surprise parties.

cards.name: Paul Caperock
cards.description: A real football maniac. He eats, sleeps and breathes football.
cards.description_es: Futbolero de pro que no piensa en nada que no sea el deporte rey.

cards.name: Pearl Wann
cards.description: This nippy knitter can make you a sweater and a scarf in a flash.

cards.name: Pease Marrowfat
cards.description: He's a spooky chap who doesn't require a mask at Halloween.
cards.description_es: Un tipo de aspecto siniestro. Nunca ha necesitado ponerse máscara en Halloween.

cards.name: Perrick Ambin
cards.description: Korum's loyal bodyguard, whose mechanical arm has been illegally enhanced for greater strength.

cards.name: Peter Johnson
cards.description: Superb at jumping. His room is full of frog-related goods.
cards.description_es: Salta una barbaridad. Su cuarto está lleno de peluches de ranas.

cards.name: Peyton Pope
cards.description: Gets a quick power boost whenever he eats fresh vegetables.

cards.name: Phil Noir
cards.description: An expert in black magic. He curses the opposition before every match.
cards.description_es: Sabe lo suyo de magia negra, y la emplea para maldecir a los rivales.

cards.name: Philip Anders
cards.description: Appears kind and handsome at first glance, but has a brutal character.
cards.description_es: A primera vista parece bonachón y adorable, pero tiene muy mala uva.

cards.name: Philip Prince
cards.description: Possesses the ability to listen to several people at once.

cards.name: Pip Daltry
cards.description: Only in the team to make up the numbers. Oblivious to the rules.
cards.description_es: Entró en el equipo porque faltaba gente. Apenas sabe de fútbol.

cards.name: Queenie Blackcrown
cards.description: Talented in both mental and physical fields, but incredibly self-conscious.

cards.name: Raleigh Greenstreet
cards.description: He dreams of winning a race in a fully solar-powered car someday.

cards.name: Reagan Boneman
cards.description: He sells things people no longer use to people who need them.

cards.name: Reg Thrift
cards.description: Always saving up to pay for his rock band's gear and fees.

cards.name: Reggie Alldark
cards.description: A speedy player who hides in the shadows and mounts sneak attacks.
cards.description_es: Surge por sorpresa de las sombras y lanza impetuosos y brutales ataques.

cards.name: Rhys Eller
cards.description: Renowned for having sold off his rock star memorabilia for a small fortune.

cards.name: Rio Shoring
cards.description: He has a soothing personality, and always helps his friends resolve their woes.

cards.name: Rundeep Stillwater
cards.description: A calm and steady presence on the pitch, he gives confidence to his team.

cards.name: Rush Tooset
cards.description: Always the first to get to the empty seat on any bus or train.

cards.name: Salicy Lic
cards.description: A kind soul who rushes to break up fights, often carrying more of others' burdens than she should.

cards.name: Salvador Addin
cards.description: A skilled player, but quite headstrong. Not great at coordinating with others.
cards.description_es: Tiene talento, pero es es testarudo y no se coordina bien con los demás.

cards.name: Samson Bigglesworth
cards.description: Not one for fine footwork, but his huge frame makes him an invaluable goalie.

cards.name: Sandy Hope
cards.description: Dreams of spending a romantic day playing on the beach with a girl.
cards.description_es: Sueña con pasar un día romántico en la playa jugando con una chica.

cards.name: Sei Lightning
cards.description: Picks fights with her twin all the time, but couldn't manage without her.

cards.name: Shintaro Nakaoka
cards.description: A friend of Ryoma Sakamoto, he's often at a loss at how to handle him.

cards.name: Sid Parting
cards.description: Loves his hair so much, he tries to keep it styled through every game.

cards.name: Silke Coombe
cards.description: Spends many hours a day maintaining her thick, glossy black hair.

cards.name: Slim Pointer
cards.description: This odd boy isn't fazed by needles and looks forward to vaccinations.

cards.name: Sokichi Kitagami
cards.description: Remarkably skilled with his hands. He made his unusual headdress himself.
cards.description_es: Por la máscara que lleva, está claro que se le dan bien las manualidades.

cards.name: Solomon Osaka
cards.description: Claims to have been born in Osaka, but doesn't even know where it is.

cards.name: Sonny Rentman
cards.description: He has so many electric goods that he rents them out to anyone asking.
cards.description_es: Tiene muchos electrodomésticos y los alquila a quien se los pide.

cards.name: Spotter
cards.description: An elderly dog who has been a good friend to Arion since he was young.
cards.description_es: Un perro entrado en años, gran amigo de Arion desde que era pequeño.

cards.name: Strata Pudden
cards.description: Has a terrible sweet tooth. Piles her plate with pudding at the canteen.

cards.name: Ted Larkin
cards.description: Won a prize for junior literature, but no one seems to care...

cards.name: Tem Akirrol
cards.description: Fascinated by the "Sushi" cuisine of a distant planet, he traveled there to train in authentic local dishes.

cards.name: Tex Tuber
cards.description: Keeps a greenhouse full of exotic plants for his biochemistry research.

cards.name: Tia Cruz
cards.description: She's got a fondness for turquoise, so she makes lots of accessories in this color.

cards.name: Tsum Jicker
cards.description: Born from a concentrated blast of wind, this gentle soul hides immense latent power.

cards.name: Turner Tabel
cards.description: A would-be DJ who somehow always gets hold of the mic at school events.

cards.name: Tyko Wondo
cards.description: A huge fan of martial arts of all kinds. Never misses the competitions on TV.

cards.name: Unahr Giil
cards.description: Quiet and reserved by day, but an unpredictable party animal by night.

cards.name: Walter Poseur
cards.description: Dances on street corners with his friends in matching pink uniforms.

cards.name: Will Stonehead
cards.description: Once this stubborn boy has made his mind up, he won't change it.
cards.description_es: Cuando ha decido algo, no hay quien le haga cambiar de opinión.

cards.name: Wyther Longfeys
cards.description: Sensitive about the size of his chin, though most say it gives him gravitas.

cards.name: Yasser Rightaway
cards.description: Even if he's really wound up and angry, he still does exactly what he's told.

cards.name: Zip Windrush
cards.description: Swift as the wind, no one can follow this lightning player.

cards.name: Al Chemmy
cards.description: An aspiring alchemist who dreams of turning base metals into gold.

cards.name: Alan Coe
cards.description: He feels more at home in the trees than on the ground.
cards.description_es: Un chavalín raro que dice estar más a gusto en un árbol que en el suelo.

cards.name: Alf Groundsman
cards.description: Always checks whether the pitch is up to scratch before a game.

cards.name: Alistair Horizon
cards.description: Enjoys stopping and gazing at sunsets, even during practice!
cards.description_es: A veces se queda embobado mirando la puesta de sol mientras entrena.

cards.name: Alma Verchu
cards.description: The younger of the Verchu sisters. Does volunteer work on weekends.
cards.description_es: La menor de las hermanas Verchu. Trabaja de voluntaria los sábados.

cards.name: Andy Roff
cards.description: Loves horse racing and hopes to have a horse of his own one day.
cards.description_es: Le gustan las carreras de caballos, pero aún no le dejan apostar.

cards.name: Andy Sided
cards.description: Has difficulty making decisions and always sits on the fence.

cards.name: Andy Wallpole
cards.description: A design ace. His posters always get used for special events.

cards.name: Anky Mo
cards.description: Strong and brave, a dependable tough guy, yet an extreme idol fan famous nationwide.

cards.name: Anne Sestral
cards.description: Gifted with an incredible memory, she can clearly remember being a baby.

cards.name: Anthocia Arnin
cards.description: Cheerful and friendly, but shamelessly shifts her attitude depending on who she's dealing with.

cards.name: Art Pendragon
cards.description: He seriously believes he's the reincarnation of a mythical beast.
cards.description_es: Está convencido de que es la reencarnación de un dragón mítico.

cards.name: Arthur Myrddin
cards.description: He won't attend a game if his tarot reading is bad that day.

cards.name: Arvin Inkwell
cards.description: He only writes with his favorite fountain pen and won't leave home without it.

cards.name: Bailey Sitter
cards.description: She looks fierce, but she's kind-hearted and looks out for her brother.

cards.name: Barry Tone
cards.description: His naturally deep and husky voice makes everyone want to trust him.

cards.name: Bear Zurka
cards.description: When he gets angry, give him some space, because he likes to throw things about.
cards.description_es: Cuando se enfada, es mejor no estar cerca: le da por lanzar cosas.

cards.name: Beat Baxter
cards.description: A tone-deaf master of musical ad-libs— just not when anyone's watching.

cards.name: Bennett Byers
cards.description: An internet auction nut. Always checking prices on his phone.
cards.description_es: Aficionado a las subastas por internet. Las mira desde su móvil.

cards.name: Bern Ballast
cards.description: He's trying to lose enough weight to be an effective hang-glider pilot.
cards.description_es: Quiere perder algo de peso para poder dirigir una alta delta de manera efectiva.

cards.name: Berthel Stagg
cards.description: He's an ardent breeder of stag beetles, so in the summer they take over the house.

cards.name: Bianco Snowden
cards.description: Was struck by lightning one fateful day, and his hair went all white.

cards.name: Bill Ingsgate
cards.description: The son of a sushi chef. A decisive boy who runs straight for the goal.

cards.name: Bishop Carver
cards.description: His hobby is making chess pieces, and he dreams of a career as an artisan.

cards.name: Bramley Cox
cards.description: His cheeks are like big, juicy apples. Sure enough, he's a big apple fan.

cards.name: Buff Bagenal
cards.description: If some fancy new bag comes out, he has to have it, whether he needs it or not.
cards.description_es: Da igual si le hace falta o no; si sale una mochila nueva a la venta, tiene que comprarla.

cards.name: Butler Chambers
cards.description: A cleaning expert who can tidy up a mountain of junk in seconds.

cards.name: Buzz O'Hare
cards.description: A daydreamer who tends to escape into fantasy when real life gets tough.

cards.name: Caetano Settler
cards.description: A fan of strategy board games, he's a shrewd diplomat and skilled tactician.

cards.name: Cameron Agura
cards.description: A culinary legend in Magmavia whose single word sparked a molten-dish craze.

cards.name: Char Shumaker
cards.description: A ramen aficionado who won't eat anything but tonkotsu ramen.

cards.name: Chuck Hardy
cards.description: He's never without his notepad. A fastidious note-taker.

cards.name: Claire Hostess
cards.description: An avid traveler who aspires to be a cabin attendant.
cards.description_es: Quiere ser azfata de vuelo.

cards.name: Coby Redstone
cards.description: Snacks on the surprisingly tasty and nutritious tentacles growing from his head.

cards.name: Cody Barani
cards.description: Often gets told off for his show- boating antics in swimming class.

cards.name: Cole Bear
cards.description: He looks quiet, but he's famous for having very powerful hands.
cards.description_es: A pesar de su apariencia tranquila, todo el mundo sabe que es muy fuerte.

cards.name: Connie Fuchsia
cards.description: She's interested in Eastern philosophy, so she's always reading about it.

cards.name: Cumulo Nimbus
cards.description: Dreams of eating clouds, which he believes are giant hills of candyfloss.

cards.name: Curtis Rebell
cards.description: His unconventional taste in clothing gets him in trouble regularly with the teachers.

cards.name: Cutter Shorten
cards.description: An expert at discovering cracks, he can wriggle through even the smallest gap.

cards.name: Dan Nettles
cards.description: Picks his own herbs to make natural remedies.
cards.description_es: Recoge plantas medicinales y hace mezclas para curar heridas.

cards.name: Dave Chaucer
cards.description: A true literature buff who always speaks in proverbs.

cards.name: Del Aket
cards.description: Has an interest in Japanese dance and the accompanying hairstyle.

cards.name: Dexter Ambie
cards.description: A very talented sportsman. Can't stick to any single sport for long.

cards.name: Donna Hooan
cards.description: Donald's older sister. Watches her playboy brother like a hawk.

cards.name: Doug Boateng
cards.description: For him, nothing beats the tranquility of a fishing trip in his handcrafted dugout canoe.

cards.name: Dreama Bartle
cards.description: She looks like she's on the ball, but she's a bit of a space cadet.
cards.description_es: A primera vista parece respetable, pero siempre está en Babia.

cards.name: Ducksquiggan Barboyle
cards.description: A Grand Celesta Galaxy's announcer who finally stepped onto the pitch after borrowing an alien's body.

cards.name: Dusky Sunfield
cards.description: Loves the sun. Often seen running around and soaking up the sunshine.

cards.name: Dwight Self
cards.description: Constantly remodeling his room. It's getting a bit out of hand.

cards.name: Dylan Magpie
cards.description: Likes shiny stones. Searches for them in the river every weekend.

cards.name: Eathan Ringer
cards.description: Eats doughnuts every day and is starting to look like one himself.

cards.name: Ed Hartsell
cards.description: He loves cooking at home and entertains his friends regularly.

cards.name: Eddie Prentice
cards.description: A CD shop owner who prefers to talk about music instead of selling his wares.
cards.description_es: Vendedor de la tienda de CD. Los clientes huyen si se pone a hablar.

cards.name: Edward Headwood
cards.description: An unlikely bonsai gardener. The green on his head may actually be foliage...
cards.description_es: Le encantan los bonsáis e incluso parece llevar uno en la cabeza...

cards.name: Eins Whitely
cards.description: The eldest of quintuplets. Responsible and mature, but a bit too inflexible.

cards.name: Eveline Veitch
cards.description: She practises flying on a broomstick, but she hasn't had much success so far.

cards.name: Fala Polaris
cards.description: He has the useful knack of navigating by looking at the night sky.

cards.name: Fez Monkton
cards.description: He longs for the azure skies of the Moroccan desert, and he loves Bedouin dress.
cards.description_es: Echa de menos el cielo azul del desierto y le encanta ponerse chilabas.

cards.name: Fletch Blitzen
cards.description: Swift as light and bright as the sun, he dashes to the enemy goal.
cards.description_es: Raudo cual rayo, fulgurante como el sol, atrápalo ya o te meterá un gol.

cards.name: Florian Fauna
cards.description: He has a knack for befriending animals, no matter how wild.
cards.description_es: Portento capaz de amansar incluso el animal más fiero.

cards.name: Florian Selles
cards.description: His family is so poor, he helps out by selling artificial flowers.

cards.name: Fred Ferrell
cards.description: Animals are just naturally drawn to him without him doing anything.

cards.name: Gadish Oldman
cards.description: A self-proclaimed "scientific authority" who's more mad than methodical.
cards.description_es: Se considera un experto científico, pero sus teorías son muy malas.

cards.name: Gammon Checker
cards.description: Joint-owner of a seaside eatery in Okinawa with his wife.

cards.name: Gauge Diven
cards.description: A scuba-diving fan who wants to live on a tropical island one day.

cards.name: Gomara Raccamere
cards.description: Prefers crunch over taste, happily crunching down walnuts, shell and all.

cards.name: Gonzalo Karter
cards.description: A karting enthusiast who has won countless races, though still young.

cards.name: Graham Awn
cards.description: This footie fiend loves videogames and won't lose to anyone.
cards.description_es: Un jugador genial que adora los videojuegos. No le gusta perder.

cards.name: Griff Hardcasel
cards.description: This history fan has visited castles all over the country.

cards.name: Gudrun Lodestone
cards.description: She's such a confident maritime navigator that she needn't rely on her GPS.

cards.name: Guy l'Acier
cards.description: Had a life-changing grilled salmon encounter and now studies salmon behavior nonstop.
cards.description_es: Quiere poner una piscifactoría y para ello estudia la vida de los salmones.

cards.name: Harly Profett
cards.description: Claims he can see 3,000 years into the future. (No one believes him.)

cards.name: Harriet Reaching
cards.description: A beach volleyball star who switches to footie for the winter season.
cards.description_es: Estrella de voley playa. En invierno se dedica a jugar al fútbol.

cards.name: Hart O'Gold
cards.description: People find his gruff voice and frown intimidating, but he's a real softie.

cards.name: Ian Fountry
cards.description: He has a strong sense of duty, carrying out lawful orders, though they may be hard.

cards.name: Isaac Celise
cards.description: Devised his hairstyle to stand out in a crowd, but it's a nuisance to maintain.

cards.name: Isor Eshen
cards.description: Though he appears spacey, he's a jack-of-all-trades with a lightning-fast mind.

cards.name: Jack Lumbar
cards.description: Builds a log house at weekends with his father.

cards.name: Jack O'Nonne
cards.description: A fan of martial arts, he's tried a few different ones, but never did very well.

cards.name: Jack Tradesman
cards.description: There's no job too big or too small for this jack-of-all-trades.

cards.name: Jamie Cool
cards.description: Has pride in his speed and often attends athletic meets.
cards.description_es: Confía mucho en su velocidad. Está impaciente por correr un maratón.

cards.name: Jem Paste
cards.description: Covers himself in jewels from head to toe. (It's only stage jewelry.)

cards.name: John Baird
cards.description: Can't relax without TV and even watches at school on his mobile.
cards.description_es: No puede vivir sin la tele. Incluso la ve por el móvil en el instituto.

cards.name: June Stagner
cards.description: Odd things occur when she's around. Word is she's an international spy.

cards.name: Kagraro Ephemera
cards.description: Shows so little interest in food that some say he's never eaten a single bite.

cards.name: Karl Blue
cards.description: Likes teasing people, especially if he can knock them down a peg or two.
cards.description_es: Le gusta amedrentar a la gente, en especial a los que van de chulos.

cards.name: Ken Cake
cards.description: A cake fiend whose favorite haunt is an all-you-can-eat cake buffet.
cards.description_es: Los pasteles son su perdición. A pesar de su edad, los come a kilos.

cards.name: Kim Ono
cards.description: When it comes to traditional clothing, no one in his class can match his needlework.

cards.name: Kippy Jones
cards.description: Spends more time playing chess than at the local chamber of commerce.
cards.description_es: Presidente de la asociación de comerciantes. No da palo al agua.

cards.name: Laititia Cheeseman
cards.description: She produces delicious dairy-based foods with fresh milk.

cards.name: Lizzy Squirrel
cards.description: This bookshop clerk hates window shoppers, browsers and ageism.
cards.description_es: Libera a la que la edad ha tratado mal. Si te pilla leyendo de gorra...

cards.name: Lucan Thorpe
cards.description: Isn't allowed out on moonlit nights, as the full moon seems to drive him wild.
cards.description_es: Sus padres no lo dejan salir de noche porque la luna llena lo vuelve loco.

cards.name: Lucien Rarey
cards.description: He has a sparkling presence, causing many people to take great pains to seek him out.

cards.name: Lucien Thrope
cards.description: He's frightened of silver bullets, but there aren't that many around here!

cards.name: Mai Assamu
cards.description: Has a gifted sense of smell, and one day hopes to open a spice shop.

cards.name: Marcus Maan
cards.description: A sharpshooter with the best record in his local air rifle association.

cards.name: Mark Perfect
cards.description: Addicted to taking tests. There isn't a qualification he hasn't got.

cards.name: Mark Skidfree
cards.description: Believes underwear is the mark of a gentleman and only wears the best.
cards.description_es: Siempre se pone ropa interior de lujo. Le obsesiona la elegancia.

cards.name: Mick Askley
cards.description: He believes he is not human and hides behind a mysterious mask.
cards.description_es: Cree que no es humano y por eso lleva siempre el rostro cubierto.

cards.name: Mike Creasewell
cards.description: A human washing machine. He can make clothes as good as new.

cards.name: Mitch Sandstone
cards.description: A pub owner who drinks more beers than he sells.
cards.description_es: Camarero de la taberna. En vez de poner cañas, se las bebe.

cards.name: Narcisse Rotondo
cards.description: Takes care of his looks. You'd never know he used to be a plump child.

cards.name: Nick Templeton
cards.description: A trainee monk. Gets into trouble for playing baseball in the temple.

cards.name: Noah Yu
cards.description: Contrary by nature, he may never have agreed with anyone his whole life.

cards.name: Ort Omaton
cards.description: His expression rarely changes, so people often say he's like a robot.
cards.description_es: Como nunca le cambia la expresión de la cara, le llaman "robot".

cards.name: Paul Pitcher
cards.description: Loves the open air so much, he lives in a tent in the garden.

cards.name: Pauletta Porter
cards.description: She thinks you look good even in mass-market clothing.

cards.name: Penny Linguine
cards.description: They say that the fresh pasta she makes is even better than her dad's.

cards.name: Pete Manter
cards.description: He calms his mind and resets his chakras by chanting mystical sutras every day.
cards.description_es: Calma su mente y restablece sus chakras cantando sutras místicos todos los días.

cards.name: Phil Pagoda
cards.description: A big fan of Chinese paintings, he's hoping to study in China.

cards.name: Philippa Konik
cards.description: She understands horses so well, she can make them obey her every command.
cards.description_es: Habla con los caballos y los guía sin necesidad de fusta.

cards.name: Powers Squatts
cards.description: Working on training equipment to unlock his true football potential.
cards.description_es: Está fabricando unos aparatos para entrenar y ser mejor jugador

cards.name: Prince Charles
cards.description: The distrustful prince of France has acquired a recent interest in football.

cards.name: Ptumri
cards.description: Glacia's body was reshaped by Ptumri's strong will, bringing it closer to Ptumri's true form.
cards.description_es: Científico de Kiell y creador del Arpa de la Esperanza. Salvó a Minori de la muerte.

cards.name: Ramsey Faroe
cards.description: Fascinated by the pyramids. His family holidays in Egypt every year.
cards.description_es: Es un fanático de las pirámides y ha estado en Egipto muchas veces.

cards.name: Ray Dioset
cards.description: Enjoys listening to foreign radio with a big, old-fashioned set.

cards.name: Rayne Shawa
cards.description: As far back as she can remember, every year on her birthday, it rains.

cards.name: Reyes Cabedo
cards.description: He's got a bubbly and raucous laugh, which would be fine, but it's so shrill...
cards.description_es: Tiene una risa áspera pero jovial, lo cual estaría muy bien si no fuera tan estridente...

cards.name: Ribo Som
cards.description: Behind that blank look is a mind sprinting past everyone, laughing at thoughts unspoken.

cards.name: Rich Eden
cards.description: A junior bourgeois, he spends all summer at foreign beach resorts.
cards.description_es: Niño de papá que siempre veranea en hoteles de playa del extranjero.

cards.name: Rick Shaw
cards.description: He's building up his strength by offering rides in his hand-pulled cart.

cards.name: Rihanna Lin
cards.description: A skillful dribbler who never gives up the ball. One of the futsal big four.

cards.name: Rip Airman
cards.description: Great at fixing bicycles. He can fix anything with two wheels.
cards.description_es: Es un genio reparando bicis. Puede reparar cualquier cosa con dos ruedas.

cards.name: Ro St Nutts
cards.description: His scar was caused by an exploding chestnut, but still loves them nonetheless.

cards.name: Rob Crusoe
cards.description: A calm player, with the strength to never lose his cool in any situation.
cards.description_es: Un jugador tranquilo, que no pierde los nervios en ninguna situación.

cards.name: Rolly Kerr
cards.description: Makes people laugh with his unique, prancing victory dance.

cards.name: Ronny Knowles
cards.description: Suffers from bouts of non-stop sneezing. Can he still play?

cards.name: Rook Blackside
cards.description: Second son of the Blackside family and Bishopp's twin. Honest to a fault.

cards.name: Ruth Byron
cards.description: Once she gets hooked by something, she dives in with a burning passion.
cards.description_es: Cuando se entusiasma con algo, se olvida hasta de su propio nombre.

cards.name: Sabrina Carow
cards.description: She unsettles her friends by always reciting incantations.
cards.description_es: Practica a diario la hechicería. Sus amigos le tienen miedo.

cards.name: Sage Wisdom
cards.description: Climbs up mountains and stands in waterfalls to find enlightenment.

cards.name: Sally Honeywell
cards.description: A sweet little airhead, who relies on her elder sister to look after her.

cards.name: Samantha Moonlight
cards.description: She runs the Golden Temple by night, and captain's Street Sally by day.
cards.description_es: Dueña de la taberna. Se dice que su hija juega al fútbol.

cards.name: Sapp Hirell
cards.description: A cool and collected high achiever. Consistently top of his year group.

cards.name: Saul Searcher
cards.description: Lacking in self-confidence, he's on a journey to find himself.

cards.name: Scot Enguard
cards.description: Infatuated with sword battles and carries a wooden sword to school.
cards.description_es: Es fan de los duelos a espada y siempre lleva una de madera.

cards.name: Seb Rosa
cards.description: A stealthy player who can sneak up and steal the ball without a sound.

cards.name: Serena Halcyon
cards.description: A laid-back girl who seems to bring calm with her wherever she goes.

cards.name: Shinken Gaku
cards.description: A crack shot with a bow and arrow, he has practice targets set up in his yard.

cards.name: Shiv Allrie
cards.description: Collects water bird whistles and spends free time jamming with birds in the park.

cards.name: Shuse Keylor

cards.description: She specializes in making dishes with palm oil. She's pretty generous with the portions, too.

cards.name: Orion Tearing
cards.description: He looks at his compass so much, he forgets to look where he's going and ends up lost.
cards.description_es: Siempre se queda mirando su brújula, así que no ve por dónde va y se pierde igualmente.

cards.name: Orpah Talkington
cards.description: She believes everything she hears, which gets her into all kinds of trouble.

cards.name: Orson Riffe
cards.description: A glam rock guitarist, his solos are legend in the school festivals circuit.

cards.name: Ota Shape
cards.description: A rather self-centred type who is quick to push for his own opinions.
cards.description_es: Demasiado egocéntrico, no duda en imponer sus opiniones.

cards.name: Paddy Streehan
cards.description: A road safety role model. Only ever crosses on green.
cards.description_es: Sólo cruza cuando el semáforo está en verde. Es un ejemplo a seguir.

cards.name: Peachy Keen
cards.description: Wearing her lucky pink scarf, it's the fabulous Peach Ranger!

cards.name: Phil Rosey
cards.description: Loves hot baths filled with fresh flower petals.

cards.name: Phil de Rol
cards.description: Lives to clown around. But tell him he's not funny and he'll sulk for days.

cards.name: Phineas Hudd
cards.description: He's got a massive collection of headphones, far more than he needs.

cards.name: Quattro Blackley
cards.description: The fourth of quintuplets. A lovable boy with his head in the clouds.

cards.name: Ray Deo
cards.description: Loves late night radio. Is that why he always seems tired at school?

cards.name: Rayburn Lightly
cards.description: Detests sunlight, preferring instead to lurk in the shade.

cards.name: Reese Fryer
cards.description: He makes great fried rice. He can do a hundred different types.

cards.name: Rich Fowler
cards.description: He's aggressive. He has certainly gone a bit too far on occasion.

cards.name: Rick Warwick
cards.description: Would be solid as a castle wall, but prefers to bulldoze his way to victory.

cards.name: Rita Bloggs
cards.description: A celebrity in certain internet circles, but keeps that out of her school life.

cards.name: Rob Crombie
cards.description: Doesn't feel a thing, no matter how badly injured.
cards.description_es: Por muchas patadas que le den es incapaz de sentir dolor.

cards.name: Rob Freeby
cards.description: Likes sampling free food in department stores.

cards.name: Rocco Shale
cards.description: He's on a quest to collect rocks from all the hills and dales across the country.
cards.description_es: Ha emprendido un viaje para recoger piedras a lo largo y ancho del país.

cards.name: Rock Scowlon
cards.description: Try not to be put off by his stony, expressionless face.

cards.name: Roland Allardyce
cards.description: He loves playing backgammon, but none of his friends at school will play it with him.

cards.name: Rolanda Tempest
cards.description: Youngest of the Tempest siblings. Her lightning footwork foils the opponent.

cards.name: Roy Plimsole
cards.description: Has a profound love for ferries. You won't bump into him on a plane.
cards.description_es: Le gusta viajar en ferry. Aunque tarde más así, nunca coge el avión.

cards.name: Ruben Lamp
cards.description: A fair-minded lad who'll give anyone up to three chances—but no more.

cards.name: Ryan Ferry
cards.description: Devoted to the open waves. Takes harbor trips every weekend.

cards.name: Ryan O'Laugh
cards.description: A fan of ski jumping, he hits the slopes every day in the winter.

cards.name: Sadey Stewer
cards.description: Head of the tea ceremony club, she comes from a long line of tea masters.

cards.name: Sam Firman
cards.description: An aspiring fireman who's already saved his neighborhood once.

cards.name: Scally Wagg
cards.description: A violent boy, who plays rough with friend and foe alike. Universally feared.

cards.name: Seth Paynter
cards.description: He hopes to specialize as an art director in the film world, and win an award some day.

cards.name: Shem Bassey
cards.description: Diplomacy comes naturally to him. Wants to be an ambassador one day.

cards.name: Shiro Hatch
cards.description: Full of quirks, yet strangely well-liked and always surrounded by friends.

cards.name: Silva Gin
cards.description: A mysterious alien who impersonated Sergei Chernov to compete in FFIV2.
cards.description_es: Alien que participaba en el FFI V2. Sustituía a Sergei Chernov.

cards.name: Skip Sofrenic
cards.description: Laughs one minute and cries the next. He changes like the weather.

cards.name: Sloan Hinge
cards.description: Is obsessed with ancient monuments and sleeps on a slab of sandstone.

cards.name: Sol Stiss
cards.description: Loves the summer, but wilts in every other season.
cards.description_es: Ama el verano. Cuando llega otra estación, se deprime al instante. Categoría:Raimon Categoría:Secundario Categoría:Exclusivo del videojuego Categoría:Inazuma Eleven Categoría:Masculino Categoría:Jugador Categoría:Elemento Tierra Categoría:Delantero

cards.name: Stan Trum
cards.description: He's always so shy, but he's a whole other person when he gets angry.

cards.name: Stu Perstitious
cards.description: Has a different lucky item for every day of the week.

cards.name: Sunil Rahman
cards.description: Worships the sun, but it rains wherever he goes.

cards.name: Ted Ledd
cards.description: Uses elaborate sketches as his sole method of communication.

cards.name: Tex Curvator
cards.description: Has a strange fascination with bulldozers and diggers.

cards.name: Toby Patient
cards.description: Goes to hospital for the tiniest things. Every nurse knows his name.

cards.name: Trev Eeya
cards.description: Always coming forth with football trivia, but often gets the facts wrong.

cards.name: Tyche Winham
cards.description: Never loses a bet, but never bets with money.

cards.name: Victor Grand
cards.description: Makes more money than his dad does by playing the stock market.
cards.description_es: Es muy joven, pero ya comercia en futuros. ¡Gana más que su padre!

cards.name: Vinny Trioquist
cards.description: His vocal range is nothing short of astounding, switching from grandpa to child in an instant.
cards.description_es: Tiene hasta siete registros de voz. Sabe imitar a bebés y abuelos.

cards.name: Wacke Koshra
cards.description: A genius inventor whose creations help power the floating technology behind hoverboards.

cards.name: Zin Giber
cards.description: Cold and surly. It doesn't take much for him to make people cry.

cards.name: Abel Forager
cards.description: He hunts and gathers food on the moors, then makes delicious meals with what he finds.

cards.name: Adel Tactor
cards.description: She tries to act like a grown-up, but she's still really immature.

cards.name: Ai Machina
cards.description: With her superhuman technique, some think she's a football robot.

cards.name: Al Askan
cards.description: Has three huge dogs at home and hopes to use them for sledding one day.

cards.name: Ameen Abel
cards.description: He's an easy-going guy who easily forgives those who inconvenience him.
cards.description_es: Es un chico muy despreocupado que perdona fácilmente a quienes lo han ofendido.

cards.name: Anna Bugeisha
cards.description: She comes from a line of female ninjas and can disappear in a puff of smoke.

cards.name: Archy Medez
cards.description: This amateur hang-glider dreams of flying like a bird.
cards.description_es: Se tira en ala delta para volar como los pájaros.

cards.name: Art Teest
cards.description: His dignified paintings have always won the school art competitions.

cards.name: Av Antguard
cards.description: Tired of classical and modern music, he's set out to create his own genre.

cards.name: Barbara Clector
cards.description: A collector of dollhouses, she had thirty in her room at the last count.

cards.name: Belle Allure
cards.description: Her voice is so soft and sweet that people do whatever she asks.

cards.name: Bernina Nightoil
cards.description: She stays up late watching TV and DVDs, so she has a hard time concentrating in class.

cards.name: Bill Fierce
cards.description: He pretends he's brimming with confidence, but is really a bag of nerves.

cards.name: Blowie Armstraw
cards.description: A skilled grass trumpeter, he can play any tune on a single blade of grass.

cards.name: Bob Shishker
cards.description: Has a peculiar habit of using skewers for everything he eats.

cards.name: Bobby Peeler
cards.description: He loved playing cops and robbers when he was a boy. The problem is, he never stopped...

cards.name: Bonnie Sytree
cards.description: Boys are drawn in by her sweet face, but all she talks about is bonsai trees.

cards.name: Bonza Barnett
cards.description: Very particular about his pointy hairstyle. Even uses bespoke hair gel.

cards.name: Boomer Smolen
cards.description: He disliked his own voice, so undertook speech training to change it.

cards.name: Brendan Branch
cards.description: Has a natural affinity for high places. Sleeps in a tree house.
cards.description_es: Frecuenta las azoteas porque le tranquiliza estar en sitios altos

cards.name: Brock Twigg
cards.description: He fears that he's so puny, if he got tackled he might break in two.

cards.name: Brook Dredger
cards.description: He's trying to clean up his local river, fishing out litter and dredging it for slime.
cards.description_es: Intenta limpiar los ríos de su zona. Para ello, pesca toda la basura y elimina el cieno.

cards.name: C-Bear
cards.description: A follower of the darker side of trading card games, and Spot Barkley's rival.

cards.name: Cale Sticklin
cards.description: He started wearing a mask to stand out from the crowd, but no one noticed.

cards.name: Carl Rhodes
cards.description: He's always got his head in an ancient tome and loves imagining what the past was like.

cards.name: Casey Moth
cards.description: Likes to relax by hanging from a gym bar, but sometimes falls asleep on it...

cards.name: Chris Hypogee
cards.description: Interested in superstitions, which he tests like scientific hypotheses.

cards.name: Chris Pecracker
cards.description: His family makes crackers, but he wants to be a pâtissier.

cards.name: Chunk Gorman
cards.description: Loves chowing down on bowl after bowl of plain rice.
cards.description_es: El arroz le vuelve loco y siempre se lo toma a palo seco.

cards.name: Clark Phylen
cards.description: He's great at organizing data, but once he's organized it, he doesn't do anything with it.

cards.name: Clark Tappen
cards.description: This pocket calculator maestro's fingers are just a blur on the keys.
cards.description_es: Es un hacha usando la calculadora. Teclea a una velocidad inaudita.

cards.name: Cletus Badden
cards.description: Hates his name and wants to be a writer so he can adopt a pen name.
cards.description_es: Odia su nombre y quiere hacerse escritor para ponerse seudónimo.

cards.name: Cole Tivator
cards.description: He's trying to reclaim some wasteground, and aims to turn it into productive farmland.

cards.name: Concordia Choral
cards.description: She loves to sing and is practising for a national choir contest.

cards.name: Craig Placid
cards.description: It's impossible to tell whether this fellow is happy or angry at any given moment.

cards.name: Creed Craving
cards.description: He will eat anything—even before someone else has finished with it.

cards.name: Creed Wrighter
cards.description: Has a strong sense of justice and wants to set the world to rights.
cards.description_es: Quiere recorrer Japón para ayudar a los demás y mejorar el mundo.

cards.name: Delia Sykes
cards.description: Daughter of a famous hair stylist. Gets her fashion sense from her mother.

cards.name: Dex Territy
cards.description: A chopstick wiz who even uses chopsticks to eat baked beans.
cards.description_es: Un as de los palillos: ¡es capaz de cazar moscas con ellos!.

cards.name: Donald Hooan
cards.description: A charming youth, who knows exactly how to talk to girls.

cards.name: Downtworth Beyan
cards.description: Tez Beyan's brother. A practical boy who knows how to get things done.

cards.name: Drei Whitely
cards.description: The third of quintuplets and errand boy for the Whitebridges. Daydreamer.

cards.name: Duane Jerus
cards.description: Likes to think of himself as a daring bad boy, but he misses the mark a bit.

cards.name: Edward Albion
cards.description: He's great at fighting, but he never throws the first punch.
cards.description_es: Se le dan bien las peleas, pero nunca las empieza.

cards.name: Emilia Odde
cards.description: A strange girl, with a sweet face but an eerie, disconcerting manner.

cards.name: Faulk Dansa
cards.description: A frequent participant in his local festival, re-enacting ancient legends.

cards.name: Fox Wiley
cards.description: He revels in outfoxing opponents with tricks. But deep down, he just wants to be friends.

cards.name: Francis Paine
cards.description: A returnee student who's lived all over the world. Can talk about football in a range of languages.
cards.description_es: Alumno que viene del extranjero. Habla muchas lenguas.

cards.name: Frank Meyer
cards.description: A connoisseur of citrus, he just loves oranges, lemons and the rest.

cards.name: Gene Bates
cards.description: Thinks an old map he inherited is a treasure map. Digs everywhere.
cards.description_es: Tiene un mapa que cree que lleva a un tesoro, y no deja de cavar.

cards.name: Goldie Locke
cards.description: Thinks ringlets are the height of style. Working to design better hair curlers.

cards.name: Hakki Kyo
cards.description: Whenever there's a hint of trouble, he barricades himself up in his fort.

cards.name: Hans Popov
cards.description: He has this recurring dream that his hands fall off, so he checks them when he awakes.

cards.name: Harpo Thermier
cards.description: He was born up north, but hates the cold. He shudders just looking at snow.
cards.description_es: Aunque viene de un país frío, con ver la nieve ya le dan escalofríos.

cards.name: Heath Planner
cards.description: He studies insurance and is already planning his pension.

cards.name: Hemo Globin
cards.description: A goalkeeper with masterful game sense who commands the pitch with eyes like molten crimson.

cards.name: Iggy Loyaller
cards.description: Has a profound sense of loyalty. He makes friends for life.
cards.description_es: Es tan recto que si te ganas su confianza nunca te traccionará.

cards.name: Jack Pott
cards.description: An arcade pro. He can win over 10,000 tokens in a single session.

cards.name: Jack Trumper
cards.description: A skilled card shark who claims he's never lost a game.

cards.name: Janice Queen
cards.description: Seemingly calm and unruffled, she is consumed by passion on the inside.

cards.name: Jeeves Dropper
cards.description: An expert in laboriously rounding up information on opposing teams.

cards.name: Joy Seeker
cards.description: She always ponders to herself: "what is the good life?"

cards.name: Justice Gavel
cards.description: She dreams of being a high court judge, so she studies really hard at school.
cards.description_es: Le gustaría ser una magistrada de alto nivel, por eso se deja los codos estudiando.

cards.name: Katy Punter
cards.description: She may be small, but she's a karate expert who can chop through wood.

cards.name: Kingley Blackcrown
cards.description: Son and heir of the Blackcrown family, ancient rivals of the Whitebridges.

cards.name: Kocho Kyo
cards.description: He's a big guy but a total coward. Blushes bright red around pretty girls.

cards.name: Lacey Threader
cards.description: She's adept at making all kinds of bead jewelry.
cards.description_es: Tiene mucha maña y fabrica todo tipo de abalorios.

cards.name: Larveo Antlion
cards.description: Gets a weird urge to dig holes in the sandpit whenever he's at the park.

cards.name: Lave Hato
cards.description: A footballer who smolders with a soul of burning hot magma!
cards.description_es: Este jugador alberga una pasión volcánica en su interior.

cards.name: Len Scapp
cards.description: This junior paparazzo always has a camera slung over his shoulder.
cards.description_es: Este joven paparazzi siempre tiene una cámara colgada del hombro.

cards.name: Lennon Trousers
cards.description: He's fussy about wearing natural fabrics, and eschews any synthetic garments.

cards.name: Lon Grainger
cards.description: A farmer's child who swears his family's rice is the tastiest.

cards.name: Lucia Ander
cards.description: An aspiring flamenco dancer who never misses her dance classes.

cards.name: Lynne Mandel
cards.description: This musically-gifted young lady plays a mean zither.

cards.name: Maasa Sudou
cards.description: A member of a popular girl band. She might look sweet, but she hates to lose.
cards.description_es: Forma parte de un famoso grupo de música femenino. Es muy dulce, pero odia perder.

cards.name: Malachi Way
cards.description: He's a believer in astrology, so he's always gazing at the stars.

cards.name: Manny Kinsland
cards.description: Loves to collect figurines. He has well over 1,000 in his room.

cards.name: Manny Saboy
cards.description: A real troublemaker at school, but he'd never answer back to his mother.

cards.name: Mariah Knowles
cards.description: An aspiring singer whose ambition crosses borders, nay continents!

cards.name: Matsuri Chai
cards.description: A fan of teas of all types, she grows rare breeds in her own garden.

cards.name: Melody Fayre
cards.description: Never missed a music festival. Usually at the front, jumping up and down.

cards.name: Mint Royle
cards.description: A keen coin collector, he used to keep only yen, but now takes all currencies.

cards.name: Mo Eisner
cards.description: People jokingly refer to him as "The Mask" because of his expressionless face.
cards.description_es: Es muy poco expresivo y sus amigos bromean diciendo que no tiene alma.

cards.name: Moos Akka
cards.description: The only vegetable he will eat is aubergines, and only in autumn!

cards.name: Nathin Gaunt
cards.description: Always dresses so well, people are surprised to know his true weight.
cards.description_es: La ropa le hace delgado. La gente alucina cuando averigua su peso.
