cards.description: A promising sand artist whose intricate sand castles are displayed in museums.

cards.name: Nico Burz
cards.description: A struggling merchant turned unemployed football player who still dreams of breaking big.

cards.name: Norman Zeus
cards.description: He only needs to look at a glass of wine to start feeling sleepy.

cards.name: Ol Factory
cards.description: He can distinguish things by smell. Which won't help him a great deal on the pitch.

cards.name: Onor Doodad
cards.description: He gets all the latest gadgets, whether they are useful or not.

cards.name: Onslow Mastick
cards.description: He takes a scholarly interest in the origin of surnames.

cards.name: Oscar Esher
cards.description: Enjoys playing in department store playrooms while his mum shops.
cards.description_es: Le encanta jugar en las salas de juegos de los grandes almacenes mientras su madre compra.

cards.name: Pace Keeping
cards.description: He's diligently studying in the hope of bringing about world peace.

cards.name: Pace Maker
cards.description: He's the moderator of an internet message board that gets 10,000 hits a day.

cards.name: Pat Shinko
cards.description: He loves collecting pinball balls. His parents worry about him.

cards.name: Pete Nokeyo
cards.description: People can tell when he is lying because his nose twitches.

cards.name: Pete Parrish
cards.description: Loves to parachute, though once he crash landed in a water fountain.

cards.name: Pete Sadow
cards.description: An Italian cuisine aficionado who makes his own spaghetti by hand.

cards.name: Phil Seebold
cards.description: He is far too concerned with how other people see him.

cards.name: Quill Inker
cards.description: He likes writing essays so much, he contributes regularly to magazines.

cards.name: Raider Takkel
cards.description: Founded a kabaddi appreciation club, but his friends aren't very interested.

cards.name: Ria Vivalist
cards.description: She wants to find a group of people who share her love of Chinese poetry.

cards.name: Ricky Charmers
cards.description: Naturally lucky, but doesn't realize just how lucky he is.

cards.name: Riff Ormd
cards.description: Used to be in a gang, but washed his hands of it after a nasty incident.

cards.name: Rock Poulon
cards.description: He loves studying marine life and visits the ocean every weekend.

cards.name: Rose Bedd
cards.description: She's capable of growing even the most demanding roses with ease.

cards.name: Ry Sling
cards.description: He can distinguish between wines by smell like a proper sommelier.

cards.name: Ryan Haywood
cards.description: His expression changes when he presses a button on his mask.

cards.name: Sam O'Reilly
cards.description: Obsessed with samurai, he lives by way of the warrior.
cards.description_es: Admira el estilo de vida samurái. Quiere ser recto y tener hombría.

cards.name: Sayo Nakamise
cards.description: Her bubbly, outgoing nature keeps her family tea shop full of customers.

cards.name: Senkuro Hajime
cards.description: His eye has healed, but he keeps the eyepatch on because it looks cool.

cards.name: Shawn Broker
cards.description: He gives life to objects that his friends throw away.

cards.name: Sierra Mone
cards.description: Though she looks sharp, she's highly considerate and a real social butterfly.

cards.name: Silver Platt
cards.description: Claims that someone with his talent is one in a million.
cards.description_es: Dice que como él sólo hay uno entre un millón.

cards.name: Solomon Justice
cards.description: He's known for his ability to judge fairly, so friends often come to him for advice.

cards.name: Sonny East
cards.description: He's always first to get to school, but it's a mystery why...

cards.name: Spike Clutcher
cards.description: He often handles the ball because he used to play volleyball.

cards.name: Stace Strikes
cards.description: The ace of the softball team. Can pitch a devastating drop ball.

cards.name: Sue Accharin
cards.description: Her motto is "Smile and the world smiles with you!"

cards.name: Sylvia Lagus
cards.description: Fond of rabbits, she takes great care of those living on the school grounds.

cards.name: Synch Rogram
cards.description: A trading card fan from the future. Has huge respect for Spot Barkley.

cards.name: Terry Toolan
cards.description: He has a large collection of hand towels that double up as headbands.

cards.name: Tim Platton
cards.description: An amateur treasure hunter who likes diving for sunken treasure.

cards.name: Tim Pression
cards.description: He does great impersonations, although people keep telling him to cut it out.

cards.name: Toby Cohill
cards.description: He wears a strange mask and tells jokes, but nobody ever laughs.

cards.name: Trigo Teah
cards.description: He cares for his three-pronged beard by always eating three square meals.

cards.name: Tsun Derrey
cards.description: A prickly girl who rarely lets down her guard, but gets all shy when she does.
cards.description_es: Le da vergüenza hablar con la gente y por eso se muestra tan arisca.

cards.name: Uzi Slugge
cards.description: After an accident with a teapot and a salt shaker, can't even look at salt.

cards.name: Walden Squire
cards.description: His family owns a great area of land, where he holds paintballing events.

cards.name: Walt Whittler

cards.description_es: Le encanta esculpir tótems y su jardín está lleno. Su madre ya no sabe qué hacer con él.

cards.name: Wick Bowler
cards.description: A keen cricketer who works every day to promote the sport in Japan.

cards.name: Will Golightly
cards.description: Known for his adroit footwork. Nobody is able to predict his next movement.

cards.name: Zane Laughead
cards.description: Born into a family of entertainers, but he prefers football.

cards.name: Zowie Trope
cards.description: He's a collector of old-fashioned magic lanterns. He'll show his slides if you ask.

cards.name: Aaron Newgate
cards.description: An optimistic and easily pleased boy in the same class as Arion and co.

cards.name: Adarn Shame
cards.description: Isn't very interested in football itself, but plays it for the sake of his grades.
cards.description_es: El fútbol le interesa muy poco, pero juega para mejorar su expediente.

cards.name: Amy Stinger
cards.description: She's aspiring to become a villain character in pro female wrestling.

cards.name: Ant Hophila
cards.description: Loves eating honey and even picks flowers at school.

cards.name: Attley Hightable
cards.description: Wants to live in a mansion, but he's got nothing to put in one.

cards.name: Bard Crooner
cards.description: A folk music expert. Has won folk singing contests in the past.
cards.description_es: Siempre gana en los concursos de canciones populares.

cards.name: Bear Turnbull
cards.description: His phone always goes off in class with the latest stock market news.

cards.name: Ben deLimms
cards.description: A life-long yoga practitioner who's so limber, he never gets hurt.
cards.description_es: Como ha practicado yoga desde bien pequeño, es flexible como una goma.

cards.name: Bern Macmahon
cards.description: This rugged fellow has been rumored to have kept a grizzly as a pet.

cards.name: Bert Laydie
cards.description: Loves children's picture books. Never borrows anything else from the library.

cards.name: Betty Evenson
cards.description: A cheerful, honest girl who is loved by boys and girls equally.

cards.name: Billy Blanc
cards.description: Always wears white and becomes very irritable if it gets dirty.
cards.description_es: Siempre lleva ropa de un blanco inmaculado. Le irrita la suciedad.

cards.name: Bob Dingnagian
cards.description: He might be big-boned, but he's also getting pretty flabby.

cards.name: Boe Tyer
cards.description: A present-wrapping pro. Even helps out at shops during the holidays.

cards.name: Burt Mocking
cards.description: A talented impersonator who can do all of the teacher's voices.

cards.name: Caffrey Punt
cards.description: Floating down gentle streams in his boat is this player's hobby.

cards.name: Calkrab Antares
cards.description: Boisterous and larger than life, he's rough but fiercely protective of those who look up to him.

cards.name: Chester Horse Sr

cards.description_es: ¡El famoso locutor que vuelve loco al público y anima cualquier partido!

cards.name: Chris Country
cards.description: A skiing ace who won a national junior competition.

cards.name: Chris Massey
cards.description: He leads several after-school clubs, so he's always busy.
cards.description_es: Siempre va escopetado porque es miembro de tres comités distintos.

cards.name: Cole Easteroll

cards.name: Colet First
cards.description: An avid collector of the first issues of magazines.

cards.name: Dan Drobium
cards.description: Nobody can compete with his exquisite decorative plants.

cards.name: Dexter Raleigh

cards.name: Dom Anding
cards.description: Gets bored easily and asks his friends to amuse him all the time.

cards.name: Doug Outon
cards.description: Gave up on sports after breaking his shoulder playing baseball.

cards.name: Duke Scrubine
cards.description: This master toilet cleaner can make even the grottiest U-bends sparkle.

cards.name: Duncan Jump
cards.description: A keen basketball player who hopes to play in America some day.
cards.description_es: Jugador de básquet que se fue a América para hacerse profesional.

cards.name: Dylan Quint

cards.description: Likes to think he has a good poker face, but can't keep it up when upset.

cards.name: Garland Gathers
cards.description: Collects trophies from the various competitions he has entered.

cards.name: Garry Planer
cards.description: An expert whittler who can carve a block of wood into anything you like.
cards.description_es: Se le dan muy bien las manualidades de madera y las venda a tiendas.

cards.name: Gerald Pourer
cards.description: He's always covered in cuts and bruises, though he swears he hasn't been fighting.

cards.name: Handel Turnon
cards.description: A music box aficionado. He even makes his own by hand.

cards.name: Hannah Breer
cards.description: She aspires to be a voice actress and trains non-stop.
cards.description_es: Va todas las semanas a una academia para dobladores.

cards.name: Harold Oldings
cards.description: With his creased brow and thin mouth, many take him for a much older man.

cards.name: Harvey Lifter
cards.description: He always helps out with carrying things whenever asked.
cards.description_es: Te transporta lo que quieras, adonde quieras y cuando quieras.

cards.name: Icarus Damselfly
cards.description: A keen mechanic. Is drawing up plans for a real, wing-flapping ornithopter.

cards.name: Ichimasa
cards.description: Tasuke's friend and capable defender. Always in ridiculously high spirits.
cards.description_es: Un amigo de Tasuke y un defensa competente. Siempre está animado.

cards.name: Incus Quid
cards.description: A fan of Italian cuisine, his specialty is black spaghetti alle vongole.
cards.description_es: Le encanta la cocina italiana y sueña con aprenderla algún día en Italia.

cards.name: James Strang
cards.description: He hikes twenty miles a day in order to keep fit.

cards.name: Jinpei Ashiga
cards.description: His speed always gets him tasked with errands. Already ran ten miles today.

cards.name: Jon Gleur
cards.description: A famed and proficient juggler who can manage up to ten balls at once!

cards.name: Kate Later
cards.description: She thought it'd be cool to turn up seven hours late for a party. No one was there.

cards.name: Kelly Scrivens
cards.description: She is practising calligraphy and can do fancy illuminated letters too.

cards.name: Konano Futsuno
cards.description: She has quite a strange hobby, but keeps it secret to appear normal.

cards.name: Lee Dorr
cards.description: If put in charge, he does a brilliant job of managing people.

cards.name: Lee Screener
cards.description: This film aficionado watches at least a hundred films a year.

cards.name: Lehman Rind
cards.description: He loves things that taste sour and is fond of munching on whole lemons.
cards.description_es: Le encantan las cosas ácidas. Siempre está chupando un limón.

cards.name: Matthew Pencil
cards.description: Loses concentration if he doesn't have something to nibble on.

cards.name: Meg Imai
cards.description: She inherited her surname and love of Japanese food from her grandfather.

cards.name: Nick Yergrub
cards.description: Perpetually hungry and a known lunch box thief. Best avoided at meal times.

cards.name: Nitey Niht
cards.description: Sleeps 12 hours per night, but his eyes always seem to droop in class.

cards.name: Odo Riffeck
cards.description: He practices incense appreciation but is often mistaken for doing aromatherapy.

cards.name: Orel Knighter
cards.description: A voracious fan of heavy metal. Often gets into trouble with the neighbors.

cards.name: Ovie Whisker
cards.description: Hen's eggs, fish eggs, crocodile eggs... If you can lay it, he'll eat it.

cards.name: Pauly Ontology
cards.description: Dreams of successfully excavating an undiscovered dinosaur fossil.
cards.description_es: Su sueño es hacer excavaciones y encontrar fósiles de dinosaurios.

cards.name: Penfold Pulper
cards.description: An origami fiend. He's been using banknotes instead of paper lately.
cards.description_es: Le gusta la papiroflexia, y le ha dado por practicarla con billetes.

cards.name: Pip Skinner
cards.description: Loves nothing more than a nice satsuma. Eats over thirty a day.

cards.name: Radius Pye
cards.description: Wears a mask to hide his face, but they say he's a looker.

cards.name: Roland Netland
cards.description: A junior tennis champion. The walls of his bedroom are lined with trophies.

cards.name: Ron Away
cards.description: A stubborn kid who fled the school his parents chose for him.
cards.description_es: Se empeñó en ir al Raimon a pesar de estar inscrito en otro instituto.

cards.name: Sandra Mudd
cards.description: She has received global recognition for her artworks built from sand.

cards.name: Sandy Insolls
cards.description: Runs around the beach every day, so his feet are as tough as boots.
cards.description_es: Todos los días corre por la playa. Tiene piernas de atleta.

cards.name: Scamp Shrimplin
cards.description: Curls up like a prawn and performs acrobatics to confound opponents.

cards.name: Scean Spector
cards.description: Supernaturally gifted. He knows where all the school ghosts are.

cards.name: Scrap Salvadge
cards.description: Loves cardboard boxes as a means of artistic expression.

cards.name: Shaun Asparr
cards.description: Would love to go and soak in the hot springs, but gets dizzy from the heat.

cards.name: Skip Flashman
cards.description: The Flashman family's second son, mature beyond his years and always watching out for his little brother.

cards.name: Stella Thee
cards.description: Descended from an order of female ninjas, with striking red garb.

cards.name: Taiji Kinetsuki
cards.description: Dreams of pounding rice cakes the old-fashioned way but can't lift the mallet yet.

cards.name: Teodorus Toxsin
cards.description: Those who can't read the dark nature his innocent eyes belie are bound to walk straight into trouble.

cards.name: Terry Dryden
cards.description: His hobby is collecting towels. His room is full of ones he hasn't used.

cards.name: Terry Namby
cards.description: He loves soppy love stories and can't read them without welling up.

cards.name: Theo Broma
cards.description: A raging chocoholic with a strange dislike for Valentine's Day.
cards.description_es: Le encanta el chocolate, pero odia a quien lo regala en San Valentín.

cards.name: Trey Dalbum
cards.description: An avid collector of footballer trading cards.
cards.description_es: Colecciona cartas de futbolistas.

cards.name: Turco Quoisey
cards.description: Already very well-travelled for his age, but ever craving a bit more adventure.

cards.name: Alan Mode
cards.description: Quick to jump on to new fashions, and just as quick to jump off.
cards.description_es: Siempre mete las narices en todo y no tarda en cansarse de las cosas.

cards.name: Alben Moretti
cards.description: A colorful boy who dreams of moving to France or Italy when he grows up.

cards.name: Alfonse Way
cards.description: An interior design enthusiast who changes his room's layout daily.

cards.name: An Tafuri
cards.description: It's said that she keeps a supply of her favorite dumplings in her hair!

cards.name: Andy
cards.description: A classmate of Mark's who only took up football to get noticed by the girls.
cards.description_es: Compañero de clase de Mark. Juega al fútbol para que las chicas le hagan caso.

cards.name: Audry Orange
cards.description: Even in the depths of winter, she's bright and full of life.
cards.description_es: Chica vigorosa a la que el frío invernal no le afecta para nada.

cards.name: Aurie Garmer
cards.description: An origami enthusiast who can make nearly anything out of paper.

cards.name: Brent Cross
cards.description: His obsession with the underground is unique even for trainspotters.

cards.name: Brutus Pummel
cards.description: "Nothing solves an argument like a good fist fight!" is his dubious motto.

cards.name: Buster Locke
cards.description: This sticky-fingered gangster can break any lock in three minutes flat.

cards.name: Champ Pignon
cards.description: An expert hunter of rare mushrooms whose wares sell at inordinate prices.

cards.name: Charlie Krelborn
cards.description: Talks to plants and even stops to speak to flowers during a match.

cards.name: Chip Flashman
cards.description: The youngest son of the Flashman family and a mischievous soul who idolizes Falco and keeps getting bruises.

cards.name: Crester Lipp
cards.description: Surfing is always on his mind. He even sleeps on his board.

cards.name: Del Iverryboy
cards.description: He can courier up to thirty portions of noodles from his family's shop.

cards.name: Dory O'Bonn
cards.description: She's top of the class at her traditional folk dance workshop.

cards.name: Dusty Weeza
cards.description: Prone to coughing fits from the tiniest speck of dust, he has to wear a mask.

cards.name: Egon Timing
cards.description: Whether you like your boiled eggs runny or hard, he's your man.

cards.name: Frank Wintersea
cards.description: School teacher turned servant to the Fifth Sector. Disappeared from Raimon after the revolution.
cards.description_es: Profesor que ayudó al Sector Quinto y por ello fue despedido del Raimon.

cards.name: Fred Sidemanners
cards.description: He wants to help the elderly in places where there aren't enough doctors.

cards.name: Ginny White
cards.description: She likes to sleep during the day so she can avoid getting sunburned.

cards.name: Gregg Deremer
cards.description: He thinks he's a laid-back, chilled-out dude. Everyone else thinks he's a lazy lunk.

cards.name: Grub Munsch
cards.description: Made to choose between football and food, he'd probably choose football.

cards.name: Guy Forker
cards.description: Likes campfires and starts one up at any opportunity.

cards.name: Gwyn Penn
cards.description: He's usually scruffy, but always turns up for parties in a tux.
cards.description_es: Normalmente viste a lo cutre, pero en las fiestas se pone esmoquin.

cards.name: Haden Seek
cards.description: Likes playground games, but nobody his own age wants to play.

cards.name: Humphrey Hedrass
cards.description: Bears an uncanny resemblance to a Napoleon fish, even with the shades.

cards.name: Jak Hammerslam
cards.description: Got into pro-wrestling through his dad and has over 1,000 videos.

cards.name: Jim Cook
cards.description: An amateur explorer who dreams of finding an uncharted island one day.

cards.name: Jimmy Brim
cards.description: He loves his favorite stuffed toy so much that he turned it into a hat.
cards.description_es: No puede separarse de sus peluches y se ha hecho gorros con alguno.

cards.name: Julian Siezer
cards.description: Slow to trust others after having being betrayed many times before.

cards.name: Lamar Bonesteel
cards.description: No matter what kind of trouble you're in, he'll be there to lend you his support.

cards.name: Laurie Nowlin
cards.description: She'll fearlessly stick up for anyone being bullied. Even delinquents fear her.

cards.name: Logan Armstrong
cards.description: A large lad with phenomenal strength. Picks up logs as if they were twigs.

cards.name: Mack Ramey
cards.description: He may be a boy, but likes sewing and makes clothes for his sister.

cards.name: Mary Hugland
cards.description: She might be a bit rough, but she takes great care of her friends.

cards.name: Mat Char
cards.description: A raging tea fiend whose kitchen is stocked with over 100 kinds.
cards.description_es: Le encanta el té verde. Tiene en casa más de cien variedades.

cards.name: Monty Burrows
cards.description: Goes to museums to bone up on as much trivia as he can.

cards.name: Nash Room
cards.description: Amateur mycologist, currently working on the uses of fungi in face cream.

cards.name: Noah Gerkin
cards.description: Loves hamburgers. Usually drops in at a fast-food place after school.
cards.description_es: Todos los días merienda en un restaurante de comida rápida.

cards.name: Owen Rage
cards.description: He is incandescent with rage at all times. He has absolutely no idea why.

cards.name: Patch Borgnine
cards.description: Wants to be known as a cyborg specialist in the future.

cards.name: Paul Chucker
cards.description: Loves street performing. Walks around school juggling balls all day.

cards.name: Pete Grimes
cards.description: Pulls out all the stops every game. Often comes home caked in mud.

cards.name: Philip Flagg
cards.description: Makes his own team supporter flags to bring to games.

cards.name: Philip Stic
cards.description: Renowned for his love of make-up. Currently into anti-aging products.

cards.name: Prue Scription
cards.description: She wants to follow in her mum's footsteps and run a pharmacy.

cards.name: Robyn Weaver
cards.description: A handy girl who can tie ribbons into dozens of different knots.

cards.name: Rose Snelgrove
cards.description: She thinks boys are immature, grubby little urchins and wants nothing to do with them.

cards.name: Rudy Stemper
cards.description: He's a doer, not a thinker and is constantly trying to pep up the team.

cards.name: Ryder Waverly
cards.description: Prefers to hang ten on a sick wave rather than go to school. Duuude.

cards.name: Sim Pathy
cards.description: May appear distant, but he has a real eye for talent.

cards.name: Singer Long
cards.description: Perpetually hoarse, as he loves belting out punk rock at the top of his lungs.

cards.name: Tye Foon
cards.description: A dedicated runner who'll train even in the midst of a hurricane.

cards.name: Walter Walken
cards.description: A pro at swimming who makes it look as effortless as walking.

cards.name: Webber Poster
cards.description: His blog about video games gets over 10,000 hits a day.

cards.name: Will Kilmon
cards.description: He might look nice, but he's got a really nasty turn of phrase.

cards.name: Ade Posting
cards.description: A keen advertiser capable of filling the seats at any match.

cards.name: Cam Vass
cards.description: A watercolor genius. He's even painted using nothing but tears.

cards.name: Crispin Shooter
cards.description: An amateur inventor. Now working on a pair of shot-enhancing boots.

cards.name: Dave O'Resis
cards.description: Sweats so much his clothes are always drenched. (Poor boy.)

cards.name: Deliah Azel
cards.description: Has deep auburn eyes, which seem to twinkle—especially at tea time.

cards.name: Derek Terr
cards.description: Head of the sci-fi club. Plans to make a film of his own this year.

cards.name: Dom Round
cards.description: He likes circular things so much that he only writes in round notebooks.

cards.name: Drew Straitedge
cards.description: Can draw a perfectly straight line without the aid of a ruler.

cards.name: Dylan Swan
cards.description: Picked up the hobby of matchbox collecting from his grandfather.

cards.name: Fawn Blossom
cards.description: She wants to become a fashion model, but worries her face is too girlish.

cards.name: Gwen Slinga
cards.description: Always carries a pair of toy revolvers, which she can fast-draw and spin.

cards.name: Haydn Woe
cards.description: He carries around a great sadness within him, but no one realizes.
cards.description_es: Es una persona muy triste, pero nadie parece darse cuenta de ello.

cards.name: Heath Cover
cards.description: Terrified of getting injured. Spends a fortune on insurance.

cards.name: James Hearson
cards.description: He loves cheesy chart hits and secretly listens to them during class.

cards.name: Leafy Tryadd
cards.description: The eldest of triplets. An earnest boy at the mercy of his rowdy brothers.

cards.name: Marc Mystique
cards.description: An expert in astrology and astronomy! Can he predict the game's outcome?

cards.name: Mary Cramer
cards.description: A raging tapestry fiend who even embroidered the team's banners.

cards.name: May Apple
cards.description: She tries to act mature, but she's still green around the edges.

cards.name: Mo Zake
cards.description: A great fan of jigsaw puzzles who has made her own 3,000-piece behemoth.

cards.name: Nancy Pickney
cards.description: She hates being told to "Give it 110%" and sneers at anyone who says it.

cards.name: Ricky Shee
cards.description: A promising sumo wrestler, his main weakness is his crippling self-doubt.

cards.name: Rob Otts
cards.description: He's convinced he's a robot, but he still prefers drinking fizzy pop to engine oil.

cards.name: Shaun Bonnie
cards.description: He reads self-help books as he strives to be the best Shaun Bonnie he can be.

cards.name: Tex Tingle
cards.description: Few know that he's the writer of a wildly popular web novel.

cards.name: Toya Boyde
cards.description: She's looking for a toy boy and isn't backward about coming forward.
cards.description_es: Le gustan los chicos de los cursos inferiores y les tira los trastos.

cards.name: Viv Grey
cards.description: Likes dissecting frogs. Rumor has it that he came from space.
cards.description_es: Disfruta diseccionando ranas. Se rumorea que viene del espacio.

cards.name: Watson Itfamie
cards.description: A shrewd, calculating boy. Won't lift a finger if it doesn't benefit him.

cards.name: Will Noble
cards.description: A bastion of proper etiquette who simply can't abide ill behavior.
cards.description_es: Tiene un profundo sentido de la justicia. No soporta a los ruines.

cards.name: Adam Icklock
cards.description: Even without a watch, he can tell exactly how much lost time needs to be added.

cards.name: Angus Hogg
cards.description: He grew up in the great outdoors and has a deep rustic suntan.
cards.description_es: Creció en el campo con libertad. Está lleno de quemaduras solares.

cards.name: Anil Latikal
cards.description: He's working on a grand scheme to mathematically assess human ability.

cards.name: Benny Terra
cards.description: A committed young farmer who is outstanding in his own field.

cards.name: Elsa Roamer
cards.description: She loves the nomadic lifestyle and wouldn't dream of having a permanent address.
cards.description_es: Admira a los pueblos nómadas y le gustaría vivir como ellos.

cards.name: Grant Mardy
cards.description: Loves carnivals and always joins in with the samba dancing.
cards.description_es: Le gustan mucho los carnavales y siempre se une al ritmo de samba.

cards.name: Herbie Garnet
cards.description: He loves greenery and even keeps potted plants on his desk at school.

cards.name: Jon Driedon
cards.description: Wants to become a translator and bring over the best foreign works.

cards.name: Mario Nette
cards.description: Keeps his late mother's cherished doll close to his heart.
cards.description_es: Guarda con cariño la muñeca tradicional japonesa de su madre.

cards.name: Shylock Watson
cards.description: This junior detective buys all of his spy gadgets from magazine adverts.

cards.name: Stu Dent
cards.description: Cooks up his own energy drinks to stay up and study all night.
cards.description_es: Crea sus propias bebidas energéticas para quedarse despierto y estudiar toda la noche.

cards.name: Horty Courture
cards.description: Likes brand clothing. Even his school uniform cost a fortune.

cards.name: Walter Card
cards.description: An aspiring comedian whose repertoire of jokes is fifty years out of date.

techniques.name: God Hand
techniques.description: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming with passion for football.

techniques.name: Grenade Shot
techniques.description: Twist the body to build power and drive it into the ball all at once for a knockout special move.

techniques.name: Majin The Hand
techniques.description: Unyielding heart and burning passion call forth the Majin, an Inazuma legend awakened anew.

techniques.name: Triple Defence
techniques.name_jp: トリプルディフェンス
techniques.description: Two players support their goalkeeper from behind to stop incoming shots with the power of friendship.

techniques.name: Fist of Justice
techniques.description: A giant fist of justice protects the goal by punching away incoming shots.

techniques.name: The Earth
techniques.description: A super special move created by David Evans that unites the will of all 11 players.

techniques.name: Hammer of Fury
techniques.description: Focus power into a fist and swing it down angrily with the Majin's support to put a stop to incoming shots.

techniques.name: Dimensional Hand
techniques.name_jp: イジゲン・ザ・ハンド
techniques.description: A variation of God Hand where a dome-shaped aura bursts out from the hand to turn incoming shots aside.

techniques.name: God Catch
techniques.description: A genuine love for football evolves the Majin into a majestic guardian deity of goals.

techniques.name: Gigaton Head
techniques.description: Smash a header with a colossal, gigaton-charged aura driving the ball home.

techniques.name: God Hand V
techniques.description: Raise teammates' dreams upon golden wings and seize victory as you unleash great power!

techniques.name: Easy Breezy
techniques.description: Evade the opponent with a light and breezy step, like a gust of wind blowing through.

techniques.name: Inazuma Break
techniques.description: Three players charge the ball with thunder and launch it high for a lightning-like shot!

techniques.name: Tornado Tunnel
techniques.description: Stir up a strong cyclone and dive in, using the air tunnel to go right past the opponent.

techniques.name: Fire Tornado
techniques.description: Unleash a fiery shot from midair. The deadly ball enveloped in flames pierces straight to the goal.

techniques.name: Heat Tackle
techniques.description: Tackle the opposition head-on by using one's burning fighting spirit as armor.

techniques.name: Quick Draw
techniques.description: Quickly draw close to the opponent and steal the ball before they know what hit them.

techniques.name: Inazuma Drop
techniques.description: Use a large player's body as a springboard to shoot a high ball down like lightning from the sky.

techniques.name: Fireball Storm
techniques.description: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm that burns all in its path.

techniques.name: Fireball Screw
techniques.description: Shoot the ball at the goal while surrounded by whirling flames that burn everything up instantly.

techniques.name: Grand Fire
techniques.description: A trio of powerful kicks stokes roaring fire into a mighty ground shot.

techniques.name: Fire Drill
techniques.name_jp: スクリュードライバー
techniques.description: A rough and dangerous move that blows the opponent away with a fiery jumping kick.

techniques.name: Plasma Cut
techniques.name_jp: スパークエッジドリブル
techniques.description: Scatter out sparks that explode violently! Dazzle the opposition and make them cower.

techniques.name: Fire Tornado DD
techniques.description: A special move that utilizes the flames blazing within. Synergy with the red-hot power of friendship fuels it further.

techniques.name: Swallow Counter
techniques.description: Dive down sharply from mid-air to kick the ball in a curved arch.

techniques.name: Atomic Flare
techniques.description: Imbue the ball with explosive solar energy and fire off a shot engulfed in crimson flames.

techniques.name: Eternal Blizzard
techniques.name_jp: エターナルブリザード
techniques.description: Sharpened focus summons freezing snow and conjures up a blizzard at the goal area.

techniques.name: Northern Impact
techniques.description: An ultimate attack that imprisons the keeper in permafrost. The power dormant in the aurora breaks the opposing ranks.

techniques.name: The Wall
techniques.description: Harness the power of the earth to raise a wall, blocking the way and proving yourself a mighty defender.

techniques.name: Super Armadillo
techniques.description: Curl up like an armadillo and rapidly spin forward, clutching the football while crashing through opponents.

techniques.name: Mole Fake
techniques.description: Apply pressure on the ball to bury it and charge forward underground like an actual mole.

techniques.name: Mega Quake
techniques.description: Break the ground apart with a devastating quake that blows everything away.

techniques.name: Stone Wall
techniques.description: Combine The Wall with God Hand to block charging enemies like a dam.

techniques.name: The Mountain
techniques.description: A greatly powered-up version of The Wall that summons a towering mountain to block opponents.

techniques.name: Jumbo Sandwich
techniques.description: Two jumbo-sized players approach from behind and put a stop to any player sandwiched between them.

techniques.name: Jungle Jam
techniques.description: Turn the pitch into a jungle as you swing three players into a simultaneous attack.

techniques.name: Flurry Dash
techniques.description: Buffet the opposition into disarray with speed like the wind! Can only be mastered by lightweight players.

techniques.name: Clone Faker
techniques.description: A high level ninja move that confuses the opponent by splitting into three fast-moving ninja clones.

techniques.name: Fire Rooster
techniques.description: Two players kick the ball with full force and make it fly towards the goal as if with fiery wings.

techniques.name: Dark Phoenix
techniques.description: Transform a ball surrounded by dark aura into a phoenix to amplify its original power.

techniques.name: Wind God's Dance
techniques.description: A wild dance too fast for the naked eye to perceive! Trap the opposition in a violent vortex.

techniques.name: The Hurricane
techniques.description: Mix a blizzard and storm together to generate an ultra-destructive hurricane shot.

techniques.name: Whirlwind Drop
techniques.description: New version of Inazuma Drop where two players work together to execute a whirlwind bicycle kick.

techniques.name: Ozone Flayer
techniques.description: Forge the air into a bullet of wind, blast the foe away and steal the ball.

techniques.name: Zigzag Spark
techniques.description: Electrocute nearby opponents with the spark of passion that occurs from the friction of this zigzag dribble.

techniques.name: Rolling Hell
techniques.description: Two players form a whirling wheel and slam into opponents, sending them flying.

techniques.name: Dragon Crash
techniques.description: Harry the opposition with a merciless roar borne from a dragon's might.

techniques.name: Dragon Tornado
techniques.description: A powerful special move that is a combination of Dragon Crash and Fire Tornado.

techniques.name: Wyvern Crash
techniques.name_jp: ワイバーンクラッシュ
techniques.description: An improved version of Dragon Crash that combines the Wyvern's speed and power.

techniques.name: Wyvern Blizzard
techniques.name_jp: ワイバーンブリザード
techniques.description: A powerful strike combining the Wyvern Crash and Eternal Blizzard.

techniques.name: Dragon Slayer
techniques.description: A blue dragon king spreads its wings and roars, unleashing a fierce yet majestic attack.

techniques.name: Katana Kick
techniques.description: Behold the sharpness of an ancient blade! A shot that cuts straight through the pitch.

techniques.name: Rising Dragon
techniques.description: Summon a red dragon from the ground to break through the opponent's defences.

techniques.name: Dragon Driver
techniques.description: Unleash a swirling onslaught of draconic energy in a single, powerful burst.

techniques.name: Rodeo Clown
techniques.description: Ride the ball at breakneck speed, dazzling defenders with acrobatic flair.

techniques.name: Comet Shot
techniques.description: Rain the ball down like a blazing comet, leaving a trail of light in its wake.

techniques.name: Monkey Turn
techniques.description: Jump around the opponent like an agile monkey and slip past their defences.

techniques.name: Run Ball Run
techniques.description: Dash atop the ball to accelerate it so it blasts for the goal with boosted speed.

techniques.name: Utter Gutsiness Bat
techniques.description: Grab a teammate to use as a bat in an ultimate show of mutual trust.

techniques.name: Rolling Kick
techniques.description: Execute artistic mid-air somersaults to build power for an acrobatic shot.

techniques.name: Cyclone
techniques.description: Deliver a sharp kick that stirs up a cyclone around the opponent and carries them, ball and all, into the air.

techniques.name: Freeze Shot
techniques.description: Freeze your surroundings with a glacier stare, and unleash a fearsome ice-cold shot.

techniques.name: Revolution V
techniques.description: The bond of friendship between two players stirs up victorious winds of change.

techniques.name: Mole Shuffle
techniques.description: Use a mole fake that leaves the opponent guessing: will the buried ball strike, or is it just an illusion?

techniques.name: Plasma Ball
techniques.description: Use high voltage to surround the ball with plasma before shooting it low at the goal.

techniques.name: Odin Sword
techniques.description: Penetrate the goal using the aura of Odin's sword, summoned via a magic circle on the ground.

techniques.name: Spiral Shot
techniques.description: Spin the ball to build energy, and hit the goal with a swirling, piercing shot.

techniques.name: Illusion Ball
techniques.name_jp: イリュージョンボール
techniques.description: A clever dribble that produces afterimages of the ball and visually tricks the opponents.

techniques.name: Back Tornado

techniques.description: The ball flies high up into the air and plunges down at high speed while spinning.

techniques.name: God Hand
techniques.description: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming with passion for football.

techniques.name: Majin The Hand
techniques.description: Unyielding heart and burning passion call forth the Majin, an Inazuma legend awakened anew.

techniques.name: Mugen The Hand
techniques.description: Summon innumerable hands to shield the goal, impeding all possible angles of approach.

techniques.name: Fiend Hand
techniques.description: Channel anger into energy to manifest a fearsome fiend.

techniques.name: All-Star
techniques.name_jp: スターリフレクション
techniques.description: Spread both hands to summon a star-shaped barrier and deflect the ball at comet-like speed.

techniques.name: Three-Legged Rush
techniques.description: A challenging dribble move where two players run in sync and carry the ball all the way to the goal.

techniques.name: Utter Gutsiness Catch
techniques.description: Absorb any shot with the softest part of the body and cushion the impact with mastery.

techniques.name: No Escape
techniques.description: Raise up stone barriers from the earth, forming a narrow path of no escape before stealing the opponent's ball.

techniques.name: Tsunami Boost
techniques.description: Ride a massive wave and perform an impressive long shot that rips through the water toward the goal.

techniques.name: Whale Guard
techniques.description: Sound a conch to summon a giant whale that devours opponents and the ball with its massive jaws.

techniques.name: The Typhoon
techniques.description: Rise with a force that could conquer raging seas and fire a storm shot from the eye of the typhoon!

techniques.name: Whirlpool
techniques.description: Conjure a whirlpool strong enough to sink ships and steal the ball after the opponent is swept up in the waves.

techniques.name: Asteride
techniques.description: Send the ball rocketing through the infinite galaxy at breakneck speed.

techniques.name: Black Tide Ride
techniques.description: The player stands tall with arms folded as a whirlpool underfoot turns into a dragon and attacks the opponent.

techniques.name: Heel Kick
techniques.description: Kick the ball up with your knee and hammer it down with a sharp heel kick.

techniques.name: Triple Dash
techniques.description: Bolt forward with two allies as an unstoppable trio that barrels through defenders.

techniques.name: Swan Dive
techniques.description: Dive from above the goal and crush the ball with a body slam to stop the shot.

techniques.name: Thunder Beast
techniques.description: A jumping side volley that summons a thunder beast. Used to boost a teammate's shot.

techniques.name: Dual Smash
techniques.description: Two players close in on incoming shots from both sides in a perfectly timed combo block.

techniques.name: Baby Dragon
techniques.description: He might be cute, but this baby dragon has a shot like lightning!

techniques.name: Tiger Drive
techniques.description: Crouch down like a predator hunting prey until the illusion of a tiger can be seen behind the player.

techniques.name: Tiger Storm
techniques.description: Deadly special move that combines the power of Fireball Storm and Tiger Drive.

techniques.name: Gladius Arch
techniques.description: Seven glowing swords rip through the air hurtling toward the goal.

techniques.name: Guided Collide
techniques.description: Harness repulsion and suction to hover and drive forward like a motor vehicle.

techniques.name: Vac Attack
techniques.description: Use a kick to create a tear in space that sucks in the ball and reduces its power.

techniques.name: Spectacle Crash
techniques.description: Who cares if your glasses break? It's worth it if it makes the ball change trajectory!

techniques.name: Barrier Reef
techniques.name_jp: グレートバリアリーフ
techniques.description: The South Pacific Ocean appears before the goal and its currents weaken the strength of incoming shots.

techniques.name: Kangaroo Kick
techniques.description: Kick the ball forward with both feet, in a move inspired by the kangaroo's jump.

techniques.name: Gravestone
techniques.description: Hit the ground with full strength to make stone pillars jut out and send the opponent flying.

techniques.name: Power Charge
techniques.description: Focus all your strength into a shoulder tackle and snatch the ball.

techniques.name: Barbarian Shield
techniques.description: Manifest a shield infused with barbarian strength to intimidate and repel any assault.

techniques.name: Stone Prison
techniques.description: Imprison the opponent with stone pillars from the ground and steal the ball from them.

techniques.name: Megalodon
techniques.description: A giant shark appears from among raging waves and attacks the opposing team's goalkeeper.

techniques.name: Mirage Shot
techniques.description: A mesmerizing illusion shot where a mirage makes it look like the ball splits into two.

techniques.name: Mad Express
techniques.description: A triple-train-threat that seems silly, until it hits: blasting opponents away with awesome force.

techniques.name: Storm Rider
techniques.description: A swirling sandstorm sucks in the ball and weakens it enough to be caught.

techniques.name: Bewilder Blast
techniques.description: Trigger an explosion at your feet, masking your advance in a cloud of smoke.

techniques.name: Desert Blast
techniques.description: Kick up a cloud of sand, blind the opponent, and snatch the ball while they stagger.

techniques.name: Dog Run
techniques.description: The ball dodges and confuses the opponent as if it has a will of its own.

techniques.name: Nitro Slap
techniques.description: Unleash a ferocious streak of fiery sumo slaps on the ball to cause a large explosion that blows it backwards.

techniques.name: Racing Flame
techniques.description: Steal the ball with a fiery roundhouse kick, Taekwondo-style.

techniques.name: Abaddon Drop
techniques.description: Hit the ball with a heel to make it bounce off the ground and into the opponent.

techniques.name: Burning Bomb
techniques.description: Send a blazing ball rolling to their feet and ignite it in a burst at the perfect moment.

techniques.name: Great Wall
techniques.description: Summon a Great Wall from underground to surround and block the entire pitch.

techniques.name: Galatyn
techniques.description: A brilliant aura transforms into a towering blade that slices incoming shots into two.

techniques.name: Excalibur
techniques.description: A noble aura engulfs the player's raised right foot, forming a massive blade that cleaves the field.

techniques.name: Ultra Moon
techniques.description: Execute a series of backflips with the ball against a moonlit sky, ending with a perfect moonsault.

techniques.name: Paladin Strike
techniques.name_jp: パラディンストライク
techniques.description: All body power flows into a single toe. A dazzling light erupts with the mighty toe kick!

techniques.name: Unicorn Boost
techniques.description: Two players volley in unison to summon a unicorn that charges straight for the goal.

techniques.name: Flash Upper
techniques.description: Focus while hopping from side to side to unleash an uppercut that negates incoming shots.

techniques.name: Giant Spider
techniques.description: Catch and devour incoming shots like a spider catching prey in its web.

techniques.name: Diabolical Cut
techniques.description: Execute a hair-raising roundhouse kick that sends out a diabolical shockwave.

techniques.name: Emperor Penguin X

techniques.name: Megaton Head
techniques.description: Launch a header, hitting the ball with a giant hand raised above the head.

techniques.name: Million Hands
techniques.description: Pantomime at high speed to create multiple hand shapes that form a shield to block incoming shots.

techniques.name: Zigzag Flame
techniques.description: Run forward in a zigzag manner to start a fire while charging towards the opponent.

techniques.name: Iron Wall
techniques.description: This looming wall is an ironclad defence that strikes fear into the heart of opponents.

techniques.name: Hellfire
techniques.description: A special move that ignites the ball with hellfire through a powerful kick.

techniques.name: Gun Shot
techniques.description: Twist the ball between both feet to add a spin that causes it to hurtle down from above like a bullet.

techniques.name: Grand Fenrir
techniques.description: Three players come together to revive the legendary Fenrir, whose bestial roar tears through the goal.

techniques.name: Tri-Pegasus
techniques.description: Three players combine powers to summon a Pegasus that rides to the goal from mid-air in a stormy hurricane.

techniques.name: Colosseum Guard
techniques.description: Focus power into both arms to manifest the Colosseum as a stalwart fortress that stops incoming shots.

techniques.name: Capoeira Grab

techniques.name: Rolling Slide
techniques.description: Overtake the opponent using high-speed backflips and steal the ball with a sliding tackle.

techniques.name: Super Elastico
techniques.description: The ball sticks to your feet like magic, dribbling in midair without ever falling.

techniques.name: Double Tornado
techniques.description: Combine spinning Back and Fire Tornadoes into a strike that swirls onward.

techniques.name: Samba Strike

techniques.name: Breakthrough 3

techniques.name: Soul Hand

techniques.name: X-Blast

techniques.name: God Hand X

techniques.name: Ground Quake
techniques.description: Unleash a mighty punch that shakes the ground, stopping everything in its path.

techniques.name: Double Jaw
techniques.description: A shot that approaches the goal in a zigzag manner, like fangs rushing to crush their prey.

techniques.name: The Stinger
techniques.description: Focus all force at your fingertips to pierce and stop the ball in a single strike.

techniques.name: Eiffel Tower
techniques.description: Launch a towering shot that celebrates your triumph in a French twist on the legendary Steeple Shot.

techniques.name: Slingshot
techniques.description: Stretch the ball out to its limits, and use the elastic energy to fire a high-speed shot.

techniques.name: Yo-Yo Ball

techniques.name: Matador Feint
techniques.name_jp: マタドールフェイント

techniques.name: Sub-Terfuge
techniques.description: Dive beneath the surface like a submarine, reading the opponent's movements as you break through.

techniques.name: Dual Pass
techniques.description: Trade lightning-fast passes until the ball looks like it's multiplied mid-dribble.

techniques.name: Am-Bush
techniques.description: Stay hidden and strike from behind to ambush enemies before they notice what's happening.

techniques.name: Liar Shot
techniques.description: Whip up a gust and blow opponents away in a whirlwind of festive fun.

techniques.name: Shot Trap

techniques.name: The Galaxy
techniques.description: Channel the power of God Hand to leap across the cosmos and slam a cosmic shot.

techniques.name: Celestial Zone
techniques.description: A cleansing light from the sky seals up the ball's momentum.

techniques.name: Heaven's Ascent
techniques.description: Call forth a divine pillar of light using a rising kick to send opponents flying.

techniques.name: Heavenly Drive

techniques.name: Shadow Ray

techniques.name: The End
techniques.description: Infuse your right hand with a dark aura that causes incoming shots to vanish into thin air.

techniques.name: Hell's Descent
techniques.description: Call forth a dark shockwave using a downward stomp to assault the opponent.

techniques.name: Devil Ball
techniques.description: The ball grows a pair of devilish black wings, mocking and confusing the opponent.

techniques.name: Dark Matter
techniques.description: Gather dark matter from outer space around the ball and unleash hell on the opposing team's goalkeeper.

techniques.name: Shadow Ray
techniques.description: Light born from darkness turns into a destructive ray in this move that unifies light and shadow.

techniques.name: High Voltage
techniques.description: Teammates on each hand of the goalkeeper generate a high-voltage barrier to protect the goal.

techniques.name: Needle Hammer
techniques.description: Gather electricity into a hand and release it all at once to put a quick stop to incoming shots.

techniques.name: Electrap
techniques.description: Swing electrically charged hands around to create a laser trap that blocks incoming shots.

techniques.name: Doom Rain
techniques.description: The ball turns into a weapon of destruction that rains down crimson rays of death.

techniques.name: Supermassive Shot
techniques.description: Wrap the ball in chaotic energy and hurl it like a devastating meteor.

techniques.name: Mega Wall
techniques.description: Radiate the presence of a giant and halt attackers with sheer, undeniable authority.

techniques.name: Neo Galaxy
techniques.description: Link your resolve with two teammates and launch a shot powerful enough to shake the heavens.

techniques.name: Inazuma-1 Drop
techniques.description: Two players use a large player's body as a springboard to combine Inazuma-1 and Inazuma Drop.

techniques.name: Card Protector
techniques.description: Guard the goal with a shield of flying cards in a hyper-dimensional card duel.

techniques.name: Sweet Deal
techniques.description: Bounce the ball off a summoned card and angle it straight toward the goal in one swift trick.

techniques.name: Card Slap
techniques.description: Slam a colossal card down to knock opponents flying in a hyper-dimensional card strike.

techniques.name: Triple Threat
techniques.description: Three powerful kicks push the shot to evolve the triple shot closer to its ultimate form.

techniques.name: Zephyr Shot
techniques.description: Generate a strong gust of wind with an explosive run to execute a shot that's too fast for human eyes.

techniques.name: Whirly-Whirly
techniques.description: Unleash a tornado on the opposition and send them flying. Then, with the wind, make a mad dash straight for the goal.

techniques.name: Hyper-Swiper

techniques.name: Acrobatic Keep

techniques.name: Format Disk

techniques.name: Typhoon, Tornado, Hurricane!
techniques.name_jp: 嵐・竜巻・ハリケーン
techniques.description: Unleash a raging hurricane from the ball and send it barreling toward the goal.

techniques.name: Look! UFO

techniques.name: Asterocks
techniques.description: Smash the ground to fling opponents aside, then crush them beneath six massive boulders.

techniques.name: Wall of Atlantis
techniques.name_jp: アトランティスウォール
techniques.description: Awaken the legacy of Atlantis' ancient power and drive the ball back with its immense force.

techniques.name: Atlas Sword
techniques.description: Swing a towering greatsword to cleave the ground and crush everything beneath.

techniques.name: Ultrasonic
techniques.description: Emit piercing, bat-like ultrasound to pinpoint the ball and snatch it with precision.

techniques.name: Fist Beam
techniques.description: Release stored power from a fist to fire a strong beam that hits the ball back.

techniques.name: Werewolf Howl
techniques.description: Let out a savage roar and strike from a cliff like a shadowy beast under the full moon.

techniques.name: Hoopsie-Daisy
techniques.name_jp: ビューティフルフープ
techniques.description: A delicate move for offence that uses an elegant display of rhythmic gymnastics to block the opposition's movements.

techniques.name: Bicycle Blade

techniques.name: Big Bang
techniques.description: This special move has three players working together to add explosive cosmic power to the shot.

techniques.name: Big Bang Slash
techniques.name_jp: ビッグバンスラッシュ
techniques.description: Use Achilles D9's special function to cut through the goal in a Big Bang-worthy blast.

techniques.name: Venus Balltrap
techniques.description: Summon a snapping carnivorous plant that clamps down on the ball.

techniques.name: Pincer Pinch
techniques.description: Two players slide in to trap the opponent like crabs brandishing their claws.

techniques.name: Black Ash
techniques.description: A shot of pure darkness that possesses desolating destructive power. The black fog in its wake devours the pitch whole.

techniques.name: Black Dawn
techniques.description: A lightning-fast combination shot that evokes the harmony of light and shadow like an eclipse.

techniques.name: Electric Impedance

techniques.name: Boomerang Bluff
techniques.name_jp: ブーメランフェイント

techniques.name: Bouncing Bunny
techniques.description: Achieved by an extraordinary jumping ability, leap into the air like a rabbit and deliver this acrobatic shot.

techniques.name: Bouncing Bomb
techniques.description: Rub the ball on the ground for friction to create a heated bouncing shot with unpredictable trajectory.

techniques.name: Brave Shot
techniques.description: Leap into an overhead kick and drive the ball with a razor-sharp strike that mesmerizes all who watch.

techniques.name: Bubble Trouble
techniques.description: Encase the ball in boiling water, leaving the keeper scorched if they dare to block it.

techniques.name: Capable Hands
techniques.description: Channel dark, ethereal hands from your arms, smashing the ball head-on to block any shot.

techniques.name: Combustion Catch
techniques.description: Catch the ball firmly with a fist of fire. The willpower contained within refuses to let the ball pass.

techniques.name: Pyrokinetic
techniques.description: Launch a blazing ball with a somersault kick straight into the opponent's jaw.

techniques.name: Jumping Jack

techniques.name: Jumping Whack

techniques.name: Card Shark
techniques.description: Unleash a barrage of attack cards in a hyper-dimensional football clash, stopping opponents in their tracks.

techniques.name: Bastion Block

techniques.name: Blast Mine

techniques.name: Tesla Coil
techniques.description: Infuse the ball with electromagnetic power to make it spiral into the air together with the dribbler.

techniques.name: Close Counter
techniques.description: Strike at the perfect moment with an uppercut to block the ball and guard the goal.

techniques.name: Solar Surprise

techniques.name: Crocodile Crush

techniques.name: Crystal Barrier

techniques.name: Runaway Train

techniques.name: Straight Counter

techniques.name: Doom Dive Drive
techniques.description: Kick the ball up and surround it with a dark aura before slamming it down for an overhead shot.

techniques.name: Low Scythe Slice

techniques.name: Center Scythe Slice

techniques.name: Doomsword Slash
techniques.description: Infuse the ball with shadow energy and shoot. Its effectiveness is that of a deadly blade wrapped in dark flames.

techniques.name: Decoy Deploy

techniques.name: Mystic Mist

techniques.name: Defence Equation

techniques.name: Desert Drift

techniques.name: Psychlone

techniques.name: Supernatural Strike
techniques.description: Awaken the demon within to unleash a supernatural strike with wings of darkness.

techniques.name: Diffusal Chord
techniques.description: Stamp the ball and unleash a cascade of notes to orchestrate a dazzling breakthrough.

techniques.name: Major Miner

techniques.name: Under Miner
techniques.description: Dive into the turf, spinning to upend opponents and reclaim the ball from below.

techniques.name: Dimensional Deluge
techniques.name_jp: ディメンションストーム
techniques.description: Kick the ball as it hovers through a dimensional rift with full power!

techniques.name: Dinosaur Roar

techniques.name: Disaster Strike

techniques.name: Stomper Stopper

techniques.name: Tale of the Dragon

techniques.name: Sandwinder

techniques.name: Einsatz

techniques.name: Splitting Hares

techniques.name: Psychic Lift

techniques.name: Fingers of Gaia

techniques.name: Flower Plougher

techniques.name: Flying Fish

techniques.name: Fancy-Footwork

techniques.name: Fortissimo Foot

techniques.name: Galactic GigaFall

techniques.name: Giant Beanstalk

techniques.name: We Have Liftoff!

techniques.name: Majestic Radiance

techniques.name: Double God Hand
