techniques.description: Close your eyes to deliver a kick sharp enough to make the petals of a chrysanthemum fall apart.

techniques.name: Bridge to Nowhere
techniques.description: Build a bridge using dark shockwaves to cancel out the power of incoming shots and catch the ball.

techniques.name: Menace Elbow
techniques.description: Dive into the shot and split the ball in two with a brutal elbow.

techniques.name: Killer Whale
techniques.description: Unleash a sleek aquatic assault, sliding with deadly precision to knock opponents aside and snatch the ball.

techniques.name: Oglitteration
techniques.name_jp: きらきらイリュージョン
techniques.description: Mesmerize the opponent with a fantastic display of stardust and fireworks.

techniques.name: Jurassic Jaws
techniques.description: Execute a shot that bites into the opposing team's goal like a tyrannosaurus biting into its prey.

techniques.name: Pterrordactyl Swoop
techniques.description: Charge at the opponent like an ancient winged dinosaur swooping down with a cyclone in its wake.

techniques.name: Crescent Cross
techniques.description: Unleash energy blades in a cross-shape and use them to hit incoming shots away.

techniques.name: Verdure Vortex
techniques.description: Spin hand-in-hand with a teammate, whipping up leaves as you barrel forward.

techniques.name: Leaf Bowler
techniques.description: Roll through the pitch wrapped in leaves, crashing into opponents and taking them by surprise.

techniques.name: Driving Header
techniques.description: Lock eyes on the goal and deliver a full-swing header with deadly precision.

techniques.name: La Flamme
techniques.description: Block the opponent's offence with a wall of blazing flames swirling around your body.

techniques.name: Hydro Flow
techniques.description: Melt into liquid form to flow around the defender before they can react.

techniques.name: Cupid's Arrow
techniques.description: A dazzlingly cute and magical show fires a heart-shaped arrow shot.

techniques.name: Loyal Heart Shot
techniques.name_jp: ロイヤルハートショット
techniques.description: Pour unwavering loyalty into the ball and fire it with the precision of a devoted warrior.

techniques.name: Grand Slam
techniques.description: Lift the opponent with the ball and blast them away with a spinning kick in a mad, unstoppable strike.

techniques.name: Magic Amp
techniques.description: Send the ball through a magic circle and blast it forward with explosive, amplified power.

techniques.name: Floral Fiesta
techniques.description: Launch a dazzling fireworks display that mesmerizes both allies and foes alike.

techniques.name: Magmire
techniques.description: Cause molten magma to erupt and harden instantly, trapping the opponent's legs.

techniques.name: Magnetism
techniques.description: Use the power of magnetism to draw the opponent's ball away and hold on firmly to it.

techniques.name: Majin The Hand
techniques.description: Unyielding heart and burning passion call forth the Majin, an Inazuma legend awakened anew.

techniques.name: Maximum Fire
techniques.description: Infuse the right foot with a blazing sword that rips through the ground on its way to the goal.

techniques.name: Goopy Gloopy Goo
techniques.description: Whip up a mixture of gloopy goo. Vigorously stretch it out and mix in the ball to trap it.

techniques.name: Easter Island Header
techniques.description: Summon a giant Moai statue from a rising mound to lift and hurl opponents far away.

techniques.name: Somersault Stamp
techniques.name_jp: ムーンサルトスタンプ
techniques.description: Use the goalpost to execute air somersaults and make a splendid landing right on top of incoming shots.

techniques.name: Acrobotics
techniques.description: Their moves may seem all over the place at first, but it's all a calculated move to steal the ball.

techniques.name: In-Line Stampede
techniques.description: Synchronize perfectly with your teammates and barrel through defenders in a single, unstoppable line.

techniques.name: Log Roll
techniques.description: Stand on the ball and roll it smoothly past opponents by making use of the momentum of the waves.

techniques.name: Falling Planet
techniques.description: Form a seal and summon ghostly fire to unleash a circular blade shot.

techniques.name: Gusher Crusher
techniques.description: Harness the unstoppable surge of oil to blast a thick, unstoppable shot at the goal.

techniques.name: Okehazama Ravine
techniques.description: This move recreates the scene of an epic historical battle on the pitch.

techniques.name: Athena's Anthem
techniques.name_jp: オリンポスハーモニー
techniques.description: The player's prayer for victory results in a divine miracle that intimidates the opponent.

techniques.name: Omega Assault
techniques.description: The strongest shot in all of El Dorado's arsenal. A myriad of aspects converge to form a dazzling rainbow beam.

techniques.name: Omega Hand
techniques.description: The God Hand evolves into its ultimate form to catch and crush any shot with ease.

techniques.name: Menacing Glare
techniques.description: Fix the target with a cold, cutting stare that knocks the fight right out of them.

techniques.name: Orbital Drive
techniques.description: Command the ball's path mid-flight, curving it unpredictably to catch the keeper off-guard.

techniques.name: Sword of the King
techniques.description: Take a dazzling sword and swing with all your might. Only one with a royal bearing can master this skill.

techniques.name: Fangtasmagoria
techniques.description: This shot is many times more fang-tastically powerful than Jurassic Jaws.

techniques.name: Snowstorm Leopard
techniques.description: A ferocious snow leopard cuts through a blizzard to devour the goal.

techniques.name: Parkour Power
techniques.description: Leap freely around the pitch, landing a fierce heel shot from above.

techniques.name: Penguin the Hand
techniques.name_jp: ペンギン・ザ・ハンド
techniques.description: Use a forbidden technique to summon penguins that bite your arms, boosting your catching power.

techniques.name: Optimal Trajectory
techniques.description: Analyze the best ball trajectory for a goal, and execute a shot that follows it perfectly.

techniques.name: Phalanx
techniques.description: Form a shielded formation like ancient heavy infantry, shoving foes aside.

techniques.name: Mighty Save
techniques.name_jp: パワーハンドキャッチ

techniques.name: Power Spike
techniques.description: Dive towards the ball from mid-air and use the momentum to slam it to the ground.

techniques.name: Hey Presto
techniques.description: Feign left and right in quick succession to leave the opponent at their wit's end.

techniques.name: Psi Arrow
techniques.description: Shape the ball with psychic force and fire it like an arrow through the defence.

techniques.name: Remote Combustion
techniques.description: The ball transforms into an RC car tire and cuts through the pitch directly to the goal!

techniques.name: Rainbow Bubble Burst
techniques.name_jp: レインボーバブルショット
techniques.description: Blow a bubble around the ball and then kick it at the goal as a colorful stream!

techniques.name: Rapid Fire
techniques.description: Strike the ball at superhuman speed, igniting it in a scorching, unstoppable shot.

techniques.name: Whip Crack
techniques.description: Launch a rapid flurry of punches, then finish with a knockout strike that blasts the target away.

techniques.name: Bounce Handler
techniques.description: Catch any shot in a springy circular barrier and fling it back.

techniques.name: Rejection
techniques.description: Turn confidently away from the ball and pierce it with sharp aura thorns.

techniques.name: Negative Feedback
techniques.description: Invert everything in the world and change the direction of incoming shots.

techniques.name: Claw de Force
techniques.name_jp: ライジングスラッシュ
techniques.description: Channel force into a claw around your hand and shred the ball with fang-point precision.

techniques.name: Gravel Gavel
techniques.description: Call forth a colossal rock hammer and bring it crashing down, shaking the ground and blasting your opponent away.

techniques.name: War Saw
techniques.description: Team up to spin like a saw, slicing across the pitch and barreling past all in your path.

techniques.name: Dark Reversal
techniques.description: Teleport the shooter in front of their own shot, forcing them to block it with their body.

techniques.name: Ultimate Eleven Assault
techniques.description: All 11 players of the team combine powers to execute a rainbow shot that makes the impossible possible.

techniques.name: Master Stroke
techniques.description: Summon a mighty being that blasts forth a beam from its mouth at enemies.

techniques.name: Rotary Sander
techniques.description: Instill fear into the opposition with a wicked saw blade that tears through ball and pitch alike.

techniques.name: Sand Blaster
techniques.description: Hurl a giant sand-arm uppercut and blast the ball away.

techniques.name: Scream of Eden
techniques.name_jp: スクリーム・オブ・エデン
techniques.description: Spawn a forbidden fruit and shatter it, fusing creation and destruction in a single strike.

techniques.name: Shell Burst
techniques.name_jp: シェルビットバースト
techniques.description: Hammer the ball into a collection of hard shells and shoot it out as seven laser beams.

techniques.name: White Hole
techniques.description: Summon a glowing hole that swallows the ball and banishes it to another dimension.

techniques.name: Shiny Feathers
techniques.description: Call forth radiant wings with magic, and streak past your opponent with effortless grace.

techniques.name: Shot Stopper
techniques.description: Deliver a series of powerful kicks to incoming shots that make the ball burst apart.

techniques.name: Goal Gobbler
techniques.description: Unleash a glowing projectile that swallows the ball, kills its momentum, and hurls it away.

techniques.name: Sidewinder
techniques.description: Kick the ball using acrobatic moves to give it a snake-like winding trajectory.

techniques.name: Silk Road
techniques.description: Weave past defenders against the backdrop of a Silk Road sunset.

techniques.name: Dance on Air
techniques.description: Soar over the opponent and bound lightly through the air while advancing forward.

techniques.name: High-Rise Hop
techniques.name_jp: スカイツリーフォール
techniques.description: Leap from a towering height and descend in a blazing arc beneath the crimson sunset.

techniques.name: Sonic Shot
techniques.description: The ball accelerates rapidly to the speed of sound immediately after being kicked.

techniques.name: Twin Sun Smash
techniques.description: Two players deliver perfectly-timed kicks in unison that greatly increase the ball's conductivity.

techniques.name: Spin Meister
techniques.description: Conjure a small cyclone while rising into the air, using the rotation to fire out a forceful shot.

techniques.name: Spin Out
techniques.description: Add an incredible backspin to the ball before launching it at the opponent, causing them to be blown away.

techniques.name: Double Helix
techniques.description: Surround both legs with a coil-like aura and send out a shot that pierces sharply like an arrow.

techniques.name: Warp Step
techniques.description: Accelerate past defenders at warp speed, leaving even sprinters in the dust.

techniques.name: Stealth Step
techniques.description: Harness stealth technology to vanish and snatch the ball unnoticed.

techniques.name: Eye of the Storm
techniques.description: Whip up a ground-shaking tempest to blind defenders and surge past.

techniques.name: Solar Nexus
techniques.name_jp: サンシャインストーム
techniques.description: Slice through the clouds and unleash a searing shot that blazes like the midsummer sun.

techniques.name: Song of the Three Kingdoms
techniques.description: Manifest a rock hand in a space reminiscent of an ink painting to put a stop to incoming shots.

techniques.name: Bindweed
techniques.description: Wrap opponents in writhing pink vines, squeezing them tight before slipping past.

techniques.name: Mystifying Mist
techniques.description: Conjure up a concealing mist which prevents the opposition from knowing that the ball has been stolen from them.

techniques.name: Nocturne
techniques.description: Harness a dark, blood-charged power to launch a monstrous shot bathed in moonlight.

techniques.name: Seal Matrix
techniques.description: Transform the ball into a massive sigil and crush defenders from above.

techniques.name: Thief's Eye
techniques.description: Do a thorough scan to read the opponent's next move and steal the ball from them.

techniques.name: Entropic Arrows
techniques.description: Fire a rising burst of energy that splits into a storm of arrows aimed straight at the keeper.

techniques.name: Copy Cut
techniques.description: Read the opponent's every move and snatch the ball under relentless pressure.

techniques.name: Triangle ZZ
techniques.description: Three players come together in a perfectly balanced manner to unleash an eye-catching triangle shot.

techniques.name: Slice and Dice
techniques.description: Stir up a violent sandstorm to lower visibility and attack the opponent to steal the ball away.

techniques.name: Twist 'n' Clout
techniques.description: Swing wide and punch the ball with full reach, stopping it in its tracks.

techniques.name: Bloodsucker Bite
techniques.description: Command a swarm of eerie bats to paint the crescent sky blood-red.

techniques.name: Volcanic Flight
techniques.description: Launch skyward on a volcanic updraft and snatch the ball while soaring at full speed.

techniques.name: Volcano Head
techniques.description: Slam a headbutt that shakes the ground and blasts the ball skyward.

techniques.name: Waterwall
techniques.description: Summon a towering waterfall to block the opponent's path, embodying the grandeur of nature.

techniques.name: Frosticle
techniques.description: Create a ring of ice that turns into icy attack blades with the snap of a finger.

techniques.name: White Hurricane
techniques.description: A light storm sweeps through the pitch and blows everything away as it heads for the goal.

techniques.name: Blam Dunk
techniques.description: Hammer the opponent's shot with a full-force basketball dunk.

techniques.name: Willy-Willy
techniques.description: Spin rapidly to unleash a willy-willy dust devil and blast foes aside.

techniques.name: Logicstical Sync
techniques.description: Combine sharp calculation and keen insight to orchestrate a flawless, unstoppable defence.

techniques.name: Zed Zag
techniques.description: Break their balance with a sharp feint, slicing past in a flash that traces a perfect Z.

techniques.name: Zero Magnum
techniques.description: This ultimate shot reduces everything to nothingness by blending light and darkness together.

techniques.name: Flash Dash
techniques.name_jp: イナビカリ・ダッシュ
techniques.description: Keep the ball under control at blinding speeds. Pass by the opposition like lightning, leaving them thunderstruck.

techniques.name: Golden Gull
techniques.description: Harnessing the power of the sun, this overhead kick turns the ball into a radiant bird that flies forth with unstoppable force.

techniques.name: Daruma Boomer
techniques.description: Ignite the ball into a blazing fireball and blast it across the ground like a speeding bullet.

techniques.name: Flying Colours
techniques.description: Summon a tornado with three allies and send cloned balls hurtling at the goal from three directions.

techniques.name: Gale Dash
techniques.description: Unleash a souped-up Flurry Dash and blaze past opponents in a streak of fire.

techniques.name: Fire Tornado A
techniques.description: A blazing shot cloaked in fierce flames, launched into the air with a fiery right-foot strike.

techniques.name: Fire Lemonade
techniques.description: Add explosive fizz to a Fire Tornado shot and unleash a deceptively powerful strike.

techniques.name: Mermaid's Veil
techniques.description: Dive beneath the waves and dance like a mermaid, wrapping the ball in a veil of water to stop it.

techniques.name: Maelstrom the Hand
techniques.name_jp: ウズマキ・ザ・ハンド
techniques.description: Summon swirling waves that coalesce and form a colossal hand to reel in incoming shots.

techniques.name: Deep Diver
techniques.description: Drag foes into the depths in a swirling plunge and snatch the ball with relentless force.

techniques.name: Flower Power
techniques.description: Use flower petals dancing daintily on the pitch to reduce the power of incoming shots.

techniques.name: Gravity Cage
techniques.description: Pool the power of three to summon a black hole, sucking in the opponent's shot.

techniques.name: Flash Dance
techniques.description: Channel the rhythm and intensity of a perfect duo dance into a dazzling, unstoppable shot.

techniques.name: Twister Trap
techniques.name_jp: シューティングカット
techniques.description: Whip up a tornado with nimble footwork to weaken the ball and seize it instantly.

techniques.name: Short Circuit
techniques.description: Lure opponents into a massive labyrinth and slip past while they're lost in your cunning dribble.

techniques.name: Sparky Spin
techniques.description: Toss opponents into a lightning-charged tornado to shock them, then surge past.

techniques.name: Meteor Strike
techniques.description: Leap skyward with the power of your allies and smash the ball down in a meteor-like overhead strike.

techniques.name: Cold Snap
techniques.description: Kick an ice-coated ball along an arcing path to freeze the opposition in their tracks.

techniques.name: Ninja Toad
techniques.description: Confuse the goalkeeper with a fierce bouncing shot fueled by the might of a giant ninja toad.

techniques.name: Spider Web
techniques.description: Spread a spider web on the ground that makes movement difficult.

techniques.name: Desecrater
techniques.description: Smash the ground with all your might, sinking the goalposts and deflecting the shot.

techniques.name: Fur Trapper
techniques.description: Send forth a giant tangle of fisty fur to entangle the ball and weaken its force.

techniques.name: Divine Dummy
techniques.description: Radiate a heavenly light to blind opponents and burst through in one swift move.

techniques.name: Containment Field
techniques.name_jp: ゾーン・オブ・ペンタグラム
techniques.description: Erect a circular barrier around you to create myriad reflections and stop enemy attacks.

techniques.name: Centrifugal Blast
techniques.description: Spin the ball with both feet to charge energy and fire it like a devastating plasma cannon.

techniques.name: Double Wrath Shot
techniques.description: A blistering two-man Wrath Shot barrage that hammers the goal with relentless strikes.

techniques.name: Clone Death Zone
techniques.description: Create a deadly triangle with your own power in a fearsome clone version of Death Zone.

techniques.name: Perfect Penguin
techniques.name_jp: パーフェクトペンギン
techniques.description: Unite elite forces into the ball to form a flawless penguin that rushes straight for the goal.

techniques.name: Penguin Volley
techniques.name_jp: オーバーヘッドペンギン
techniques.description: Gather the penguins' power into the ball, then strike a fierce overhead toward the goal!

techniques.name: About Face
techniques.description: Strike from behind with a sneaky knee, then snatch the ball while they stagger.

techniques.name: Grabber Arm
techniques.name_jp: キャスティングアーム
techniques.description: Unleash an arm-like aura to snatch any shot from the air—no matter the angle.

techniques.name: Lunar Eclipse
techniques.description: Raise a shield forged from unwavering loyalty that grows brighter and stronger with your heart.

techniques.name: Shadow Catch
techniques.description: Manipulate shadows to catch the ball using a hand filled with eerie dark energy.

techniques.name: Air Ride
techniques.description: Transform the ball into a surfboard that can be mounted and used to jump past opponents.

techniques.name: Divine Stamp
techniques.description: Summon a colossal foot from above to crush defenders like a hammer of justice.

techniques.name: Celestial Saw
techniques.description: Spread your wings and strike from the sky with an overhead that slices through air to pierce the goal.

techniques.name: Royal Lancer
techniques.description: A long shot which pierces like a spear retaining the spirits of past rulers. A divine demonstration of majesty.

techniques.name: Ghost Pull
techniques.description: Those who are caught by these ghostly hands that appear from the ground can never escape.

techniques.name: Frankenstun
techniques.description: Generate a monstrous aura and overwhelm opponents with a horrifying blow.

techniques.name: Utter Gutsiness Club
techniques.description: Swing your teammates like a club for a game-changing, hole-in-one strike.

techniques.name: Comet Shot
techniques.description: Rain the ball down like a blazing comet, leaving a trail of light in its wake.

techniques.name: Savage Beast Fang
techniques.name_jp: ハイビーストファング
techniques.description: Strike with fangs from every part of your body to hunt your prey in bestial style.

techniques.name: Mistral
techniques.description: Summon a swirling leaf tornado to guard the goal and knock away the ball.

techniques.name: Tsunami Wall
techniques.description: The sea god's roar summons a tall tsunami wave that forms a wall to block off incoming shots.

techniques.name: Angel Ball
techniques.description: The ball grows a pair of angelic white wings, making the opponent lose their will to fight.

techniques.name: God Alone Knows
techniques.name_jp: ゴッドノウズ・インパクト
techniques.description: Call upon the beauty and lightning of the heavens to rock the earth and mark the dawn of a new myth.

techniques.name: Rodeo Clown
techniques.description: Ride the ball at breakneck speed, dazzling defenders with acrobatic flair.

techniques.name: Super Sumo Stomp
techniques.description: A large foot appears in the sky and stomps on the opponent in this enhanced version of Sumo Stomp.

techniques.name: Cold Front
techniques.name_jp: ホワイト・ダブルインパクト
techniques.description: Combine forces with a teammate to unleash a devastating blizzard-class shot that glimmers in silvery radiance.

techniques.name: Ursa Binder
techniques.description: Block your target with force strong enough to stop even the fiercest bear.

techniques.name: Ursa Rager
techniques.description: Unleash a beastly shot that bares its fangs at the goal, capable of felling even a bear.

techniques.name: Rabbit Run
techniques.name_jp: シロウサギダッシュート
techniques.description: Charge forward with a rabbit-like sprint and deliver a springing kick full of flair.

techniques.name: Astro Gate
techniques.description: Summon a massive black hole to crush all in its path, powering up Astro Break to devastating effect.

techniques.name: The Detonator
techniques.name_jp: ザ・エクスプロージョン
techniques.description: Charge the ball with rapid kicks, then unleash a powerful blast shot!

techniques.name: Zigzag Zoom
techniques.description: Become lightning itself, and fire a shot that reaches the heavens!

techniques.name: Mega Majin
techniques.description: Summon the Wind and Thunder Majin, covering blind spots and taking Majin the Hand to the next level.

techniques.name: Heavenly Tianlong
techniques.description: Channel the power of a mighty dragon into your foot and strike with a sharp, roaring shot.

techniques.name: Wetsuit
techniques.description: Expand your aura and take on a gel-like form to absorb the force of every shot coming your way.

techniques.name: Double-Trouble
techniques.description: Split the ball and drill through with a glowing, high-intensity combination strike.

techniques.name: Diamond Cutter
techniques.description: Polish the ball with a diamond-hardened kick to send it arcing just before the goal.

techniques.name: Perseus Strike
techniques.description: Call a great hero forth whose heart of justice drives the ball straight toward the goal.

techniques.name: Diamond Ray
techniques.description: Strike the ball with a flurry of kicks to sharpen the ball into a diamond-bright shot.

techniques.name: Formidable Fortress
techniques.description: Construct a massive underground shelter and lock its layers to prevent any enemy breakthrough.

techniques.name: Hammer of Fury
techniques.description: Focus power into a fist and swing it down angrily with the Majin's support to put a stop to incoming shots.

techniques.name: Polar Bear No. 2
techniques.description: Encase the ball in frigid air, driving it toward the goal with the ferocity of a polar bear.

techniques.name: Tornado Barrier
techniques.description: Spin at blazing speed to create five colossal tornadoes and snatch the ball away.

techniques.name: Fizzy Fire Lemonade
techniques.name_jp: ファイアレモネード・ライジング
techniques.description: Strike with a blow carrying the hopes of your allies, sending the ball soaring onward with overwhelming power.

techniques.name: Heel Kick
techniques.description: Kick the ball up with your knee and hammer it down with a sharp heel kick.

staff.name: Silvia Woods
staff.description: A strong and supportive big-sister type who brought the football club back to life with Mark Evans.

staff.name: Celia Hills
staff.description: A master of digging up info, her footie knowledge may rival even Jude's.

staff.name: Nelly Raimon
staff.description: A strong-willed young lady. Her dad will tell you she's a big softy at heart.

staff.name: Ray Dark
staff.description: Runs Royal Academy with ruthless focus, ruling both school and club to snatch every win.

staff.name: Stephen Black
staff.description: Royal Academy teacher turned interim manager, who stepped up when Ray Dark vanished.

staff.name: Hekyll Jyde
staff.description: Occult's mild yet enigmatic manager. Tick him off and he flips hard.

staff.name: Lanny Tern
staff.description: Officially, the team's long-standing coordinator. Unofficially, a ghost no one outside knows.

staff.name: Harry Savage
staff.description: Speaks in jungle roars, yet somehow teammates understand every word.

staff.name: Flammie Gonzalez
staff.description: A supporter who always rocks fresh scrapes and loves one-legged flamingo poses.

staff.name: Newton Thomas
staff.description: They call him the Football Cyborg, every play, every move machine-precise.

staff.name: Manny Artic
staff.description: Maid café regular who practically lives there and invented a watermelon menu item.

staff.name: Meina Maiden
staff.description: Takes to the pitch in full maid attire to heal tired teammates with her smile.

staff.name: Sammy Igajima
staff.description: Modern-day ninja who trains players in secret techniques passed down for generations.

staff.name: Turtle Newfield
staff.description: Small in stature but steady and sharp, with a calm heart and a watchful eye.

staff.name: Seth Nichols
staff.description: Kirkwood's manager with scruffy stubble. He trusts his players and they trust him too.

staff.name: Seymour Hillman
staff.description: Although he's the proprietor of a ramen place now, he was once crucial to Inazuma Eleven.

staff.name: Clint Loggan
staff.description: Manager of Umbrella Football Club, a calm presence who puts even nervous players at ease.

staff.name: Hilton Bernaton
staff.description: Manager of Alpine, hidden deep in Hokkaido's snow. Always bundled up, face unseen.

staff.name: Isaias Setik
staff.description: Sees football as ascetic training. His motto: strengthen body, sharpen mind, purify soul.

staff.name: Nerina Hartland
staff.description: Manager of Osaka Triple C. Her savory pancakes are legendary, and so is her team's style.

staff.name: Augustus Hargrave
staff.description: Looks like a strict, old-school dad, but believes in giving his players freedom.

staff.name: Jambo Reemoth
staff.description: The jovial manager who grooves through life, leading with laughter and rhythm football.

staff.name: Godric Wyles
staff.description: Manager of the Dark Emperors, planning to conquer the world with the Alius Crystal's power.

staff.name: David Evans
staff.description: Manager of Raimon Junior High who built the legend of the undefeated Inazuma Eleven.

staff.name: Aquilina Schiller
staff.description: Hillman's successor and Raimon Eleven's head manager. She guides the team to victory with precise, if strict, decision-making.

staff.name: Percival Travis
staff.description: The manager representing Japan, at Hillman's recommendation. He competes calmly, using perfectly calculated strategies.

staff.name: Camellia Travis
staff.description: An old friend of Mark's. Quite bashful, but she's grown thanks to training.

staff.name: Robert Kleiser
staff.description: Manager of Big Waves. Adapts his strategy like a flowing, unpredictable tide.

staff.name: Eliza Mannan
staff.description: Manager of the Desert Lions. Specializes in tactical second-half surges.

staff.name: Lee Ji Seong
staff.description: Manager of Fire Dragon. Lets Choi, his midfield general, run the show.

staff.name: Aaron Adams
staff.description: Manager of the Queen's Knights. Known for his precise, elegant formation calls.

staff.name: Mister D
staff.description: Ray Dark's alias. His true goal? To deny and destroy the very existence of football.

staff.name: Daniel Sturbin
staff.description: Manager of The Empire. His defences are called unbreakable fortresses.

staff.name: Mac Scryde
staff.description: Manager of Unicorn. Tough as nails but truly cares for his players.

staff.name: Leão Samus
staff.description: Former Kingdom manager, ousted by Zoolan.

staff.name: Zoolan Rice
staff.description: The Kingdom's new manager, a wealthy oil magnate with global reach.

staff.name: David Arrows
staff.description: Manager of the Little Gigantes, driven to raise the ultimate team.

staff.name: Mark Evans
staff.description: The former captain of Inazuma National, turned manager. A passionate leader.

staff.name: Skie Blue
staff.description: A cheerful girl and long-time friend of Arion's. Hard-working team coordinator.

staff.name: Rosie Redd
